An Agent leaves behind a Theme effectively rendering it no longer within their control or of the normal security as one's property. Carolyn abandoned her car and jumped on a red double decker bus. Perhaps he left the key in the ignition Abandonment of a child is considered to be a serious crime in many jurisdictions.
The Agent is the person who acts to leave behind the Theme.
The Theme is the entity that is relinguished to no one from the Agent's possession.
The location where the Agent gives up the Theme.
When the Agent gives up the Theme.
The style in which the Agent gives up the Theme.
For what expanse of time the Agent has given up the Theme.
Explanation denotes a proposition from which the act of abandonment logically follows.
The FE Depictive describes the Agent during the abandoning event.

A Location is filled or covered with the Theme. The Location is realized as the External Argument, and the Theme either as PP complement headed by with, in or of. NB: This frame does not include uses of adjectives like paved when they merely specify the Type of some location, as in "paved and unpaved roads". The waters of the bay teemed with fish. The waters of the bay were teeming with fish. The road was completely covered in mud.
The Theme covers or fills the Location. This FE most frequently occurs in a PP Complement headed by with or in.
Location is the object or area that the Theme fills or covers. This frame element generally occurs as the External Argument.
This FE identifies the Degree of abundance with which the Theme covers or fills the Location.
The Depictive describes the state of the Location.
The period of time during which the the Abounding_with event occurs.

An Entity (generally food) is exposed to a Heat_source whose Temperature may also be specified. Generally, the Entity undergoes some sort of change as a result of this process. Bacon was frying in the pan, and a great heap of eggs already lay steaming on a plate. If it cooks at 400 for an hour, it 'll be nothing but a pile of ash!
The Entity (often a food item) that absorbs heat.
The Container that holds the Entity that absorbs the heat.
This FE identifies the object that directly supplies heat to theEntity.
This FE identifies the Place where the heat application occurs.
Medium is a substance through which heat is absorbed by the Entity.
Any description of the cooking event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
The Time when the heat absorption takes place.
The thing or state-of-affairs that leads to the Entity being heated and undergoing change.
The temperature that the Entity stays at, resulting in change.
The length of time that the Entity is exposed to heat.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
The reason why a state of affairs is caused or maintained by an (implicit) agent.
This FE describes the Entity as being in some state during the action.
The final state of affairs after the absorbing heat event has finished.

The Quantity of a Collection occurring in a Place has a particular Measure. The Measure of the Collection is referred to only in terms of how the Measure diverges from a norm for Collections of the specified type. Degree may further refine the relation of the Measure to the norm. Beauty is abundant in a land flowing with snowmelt. Detritus of life abounds in the atmosphere. There was a recent discovery that exotic microbes teem in the rocks hundreds of metres beneath the floor of the Pacific Ocean.
The Collection whose Quantity is under consideration.
The feature of an Collection which is under discussion. This FE is incorporated by all the lexical units in this frame.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Measure from the norm or from the value for another Collection.
The Time during which the Collection is in the state of having a particular Measure for the Quantity.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
The measure of the Quantity, which is incorporated by the lexical units.
The location in which the Collection occurs.

In this frame an Abuser repeatedly treats the Victim in a cruel and violent way, including physically harming or forcing the Victim to engage in sexual activity against their will. The Victim usually lacks the power to resist or fight back. A Type of abuse may be indicated. There may also be a Degree. Her father verbally abused her mother.
The Abuser subjects the Victim to repeated verbal, physical, emotional or sexual attacks.
The Victim is the recipient of the Abuser's actions.
Type is used for the domain in which the Abuser mistreats the Victim.
Degree is the extent to which the abuse occurs.
This FE identifies the Place where the abuse occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the abuse occurs.

Manner is used for any description of the abuse event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Abuser that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
This FE identifies the Means by which the Abuser accomplishes the abuse.
An entity used by the Abuser to accomplish the abuse.
An action that the Abuser intends to accomplish by performing the abuse.
This FE identifies the Reason for which the Abuser abuses others.
The amount of time that abuse occurs.

This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action. The depicted state does not necessarily or usually facilitate or cause the state of affairs reported by the target.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
The length of time from when the Abusing event began to be repeated to when it stopped.
A Theme is or is not capable of entering or accessing a Useful_location because of/despite a Barrier.
The Theme whose motion is blocked or free.
The place or thing that the Theme is headed towards, despite a potential or actual Barrier.
An entity that (at least potentially) prevents the Theme from getting to the Useful_location.
A Coparticipant fills the same role as the Participant in an event or relation.
In this frame, Participant is the accompanied entity (person or object).
In this frame, Coparticipant is the accompanying entity (person or object).
After a period in which the Agent has been working on a Goal, the Agent manages to attain it. The Goal may be a desired state, or be conceptualized as an event.
An intentional action performed by the Agent that lets them accomplish their Goal.
The conscious entity, generally a person, that performs the intentional act that fulfills the Goal.
An entity directed by the Agent that allows them to achieve their Goal.
This FE identifies the place where the Agent achieves their Goal.
This FE identifies the time when the Agent achieves their Goal.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
A state-of-affairs from which the accomplishment would be predicted.
The extent to which the Agent achieves the Goal.
The state or action that the Agent has wished to participate in.
The Outcome is the failure or success of accomplishing a Goal.
Some specification of the circumstances under which Goal is accomplished.
The length of time that it takes for Goal to be accomplished.
The particular aspect or domain of the Goal that is achieved.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
A Wearer wears accessories, which are made of some Material and may have a Style. Most of the accessories are non-essential (clothing) items. She wore a black velvet hat on her head.
This FE identifies the Style of the Accoutrement.
This FE identifies the Material from which the Accoutrement is made.
This FE identifies a characteristic or description of the Accoutrement.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Accoutrement is worn or made.
This FE identifies a part of the Accoutrement.
This FE identifies the place on the body where a particular Accoutrement is located.
The individual or group who created the Accoutrement.
The time at which the Accoutrement was created.
A name given to an individual Accoutrement to distinguish it from all other objects.

An Agent is involved in an activity whose degree of success is dependent on a parameter of the action matching a particular set of values of a continuous variable or variables (e.g. quantity, location, time). The Agent, or metonymically the Instrument or Means action, is described in terms of the actual or expected Deviation between the location, time, or quantity in the activity and the location, time, or quantity which is necessary for the intended event. The Longview Rangefinder is accurate to within one foot per hundred yards . His estimate was off by an order of magnitude . The fork truck operator must be fairly accurate in his aim. The precision of the daily measurements is dependent on a number of factors.
The individual who tries to interact with the Target.
The Target is the entity whose attributes (esp. position) the Agent is attempting to match in an action.
The Outcome is the failure or success of an attempt at interaction, incorporated in the LUs of the frame.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Agent attempts to hit a Target_value.
How closely the expected or actual location that the Instrument interacts with corresponds to the Target_value.
This FE identifies the Time when something hits or misses.
The place where the Agent manages or fails to interact with the Target.
The object manipulated by the Agent in order to interact with the Target.
The value or values for a parameter that match the Agent's intent.
Expected or actual deviation from the Target_value.
The particular aspect or domain in which something is accurate.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
How often the Agent, Means, or Instrument is accurate.
A Cognizer introduces a New_idea into society. It is difficult to imagine how different our lives would be without Edison's invention of the light bulb.
The Cognizer comes up with or conceptualizes the New_idea. It is normally expressed as an External Argument:
The New_idea is a concept not previously present in society which the Cognizer introduces.
This FE identifies the Time when the Cognizer comes up with the New_idea.
This FE identifies the Place where the Cognizer comes up with the New_idea.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Cognizer accomplishes the innovative achievement.
This FE identifies the Purposefor which the Cognizer creates the New_idea.
This FE identifies the Reason for which the Cognizer created the New_idea.
The Field is the general domain of endeavor to which the Cognizer is contributing and of which the New_idea is a part.
An entity used by the Cognizer to achieve the introduction of the New_idea into society.

Any description of the creative event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of a Cognizer that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The conceptual material from which the Cognizer invents the New_idea.
The Location_of_appearance is where the Invention is first discovered by others.

A Substance causes an Effect. The Substance is produced by a process understood as directed towards the Effect. The Name for the material that makes up the substance may also be given. A rationale for using denatured gp160 as a therapeutic agent in HIV-infected people is to boost the immune response . The quinolones now seem to be the antimicrobial agents of choice for acute bacterial prostatitis. Hormonally active chemicals have the potential to cause significant environmental injury. Only after the potion has been drunk does the active ingredient form. DNI The sarin agent might have been a leftover shell from a chemical-arms dump.
The change brought about by the Substance.
The internally undifferentiated physical entity that has an Effect.
This FE indicates what subtype of the general category the Substance belongs to.
The name of the material that makes up the active Substance.

This is an abstract frame for durative activities, in which the Agent enters an ongoing state of the Activity, remains in this state for some Duration of Time, and leaves this state either by finishing or by stopping. The Agent's Activity should be intentional. This frame is intended mostly for the inheritance of common FEs, and to provide the frame structure for the beginning, ongoing, finish, or stop stage of an Activity, each of which constitutes a subframe of this frame. This frame should be compared to the Process frame.
This FE identifies the Activity in which the Agent is engaged.
This FE identifies the amount of Time an Activity takes.
This FE identifies the Place where the Activity occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the Activity occurs.
The Agent is engaged in the Activity.

Any description of the activity which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An Agent is in an unfinished part of an activity.
This FE identifies the Agent in an unfinished State of an activity.
The time at which the Agent and Activity remain unfinished.
The length of time that the Activity remains unfinished.
The process that the Agent is performing.
The location at which the Activity is no longer in progress.
An Agent has completed an Activity.
This FE identifies the Agent in a done state of an the Activity.
This FE identifies the Activity in which the Agent was engaged.
The point at which the Agent is done with the Activity.
The location where the Agent finishes the Activity.
An Agent finishes an Activity, which can no longer logically continue. This frame is a subframe of Activity.
This FE identifies the Depictive phrase describing an actor or an undergoer of an action.
This FE identifies the Manner an Agent is engaged in finishing an Activity.
This FE identifies the Result of finished Activity.
This FE identifies the last Subevent of the finished Activity.
This FE identifies the Place where the Agent finishes the Activity.
This FE identifies the Time when the Activity finishes.
This FE identifies the Agent who has finished an Activity.
This FE identifies the Activity that the Agent has finished.
This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent finishes an Activity.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Agent finishes for an Activity.
This FE describes the how near the agent is to finishing.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
An Agent is performing the portion of an Activity in which there is dynamic stability.
This FE identifies the amount of Time for which an Activity is ongoing.
This FE identifies the name of the ongoing Activity in which an Agent engages.
This FE identifies the Place where the ongoing Activity occurs.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Agent is engaged in an ongoing Activity.
This FE identifies the Time when an ongoing Activity occurs.
This FE is used for the Depictive phrase describing the actor or undergoer of an Activity.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an Agent performs an ongoing Activity.
This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent engages in an ongoing Activity.
This FE identifies the Subevent with which the Agent continues an ongoing Activity.
The Agent engages in an ongoing Activity.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.
In general, this FE is used for phrases that describe the clause of the target as a whole.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end. In many cases, the continuous situation is a dynamic action which is ongoing, while in others it is simply an undifferentiated state.
An Agent pauses in the course of an Activity.
This FE identifies the Activity for which an Agent is pausing.
An Agent pauses in the course of an Activity.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an Agent pauses during the course of an Activity.
This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent pauses in the course of an Activity.
This FE identifies the Place where an Agent pauses in the course of an Activity.
This FE identifies the Time at which an Agent pauses in the course of an Activity.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Agent pauses in the course of an Activity.
This FE is used for the Depictive phrase describing the actor or undergoer of an action.
The extent to which the Agent pauses in the Activity.
The length of time of the pause in the Activity.
This FE describes the legal basis or precedent by which the Agent pauses the Activity.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.
An Agent remains in a particular stage of an Activity, without progressing in the activity.
This FE identifies the Agent in the paused State of an activity.
The point at which the Agent
The overall event that the Agent is involved in.
The length of time that the Activity does not resume.
An Agent prepares for an Activity.
An Agent prepares for an Activity.
This FE identifies the Activity for which an Agent is preparing.
This FE identifies the Place where an Agent prepares for an Activity.
This FE identifies the Time at which an Agent prepares for an Activity.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an Agent prepares for an Activity.
Thsi FE identifies the Means with which an Agent prepares for an Activity.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Agent prepares for an Activity.
This FE identifes the length of Time during which an Agent prepares for an Activity.
This FE is used for the Depictive phrase describing the actor or undergoer of an action.
This FE describes the amount of preparation the Agent puts into an activity.

This extrathematic FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the occurrence of the event specified by the target predicate. Further, the target predicate should involve some sort of Agent that intends that the benefit go to the Beneficiary.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.

This FE describes the state of affairs denoted by the target as role fillers in other frames. The state of affairs reported by the target is understood to play a role in the state of affairs of the modifier.

The Protagonist is in an initial state, before beginning to be involved in the Activity, but all pre-conditions for performance of the Activity have been satisfied. In many cases, the Protagonist is an intentional agent, but there are other uses in which the agent is deprofiled, and the Protagonist is an entity which is essential to the Activity. Alternatively, the Activity may be indicated by a Salient_entity which stands in for the Activity. This Salient_entity may also be an intentional agent, but need not be. She 's not ready ! DNI. He 's ready to talk , I think . Is the UK government ready to do a u-turn on passport-ID cards ? Check and see if Sal is ready for the bathtub . The world is finally prepared for him !
This FE identifies the Protagonist in the initial state of an activity.
The action that the Protagonist is prepared to do.
An entity which stands in metonymically for the Activity.
The time when the Protagonist is ready.
The state or event that follows due to the ready state.
The length of time that the Protagonist remains capable of the Activity without beginning it.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.

An Agent resumes participation in an Activity. Progress on the Activity is retained from before the interruption. Normal Service Will Be Resumed Shortly. CNI The Kinshasa government has resumed supporting Rwandan rebels.
The amount of Time for which the Activity is resumed
The Activity which is being resumed by the Agent.
The Reason for which the Activity is resumed.

Any description of the Activity which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also mark indications of salient characteristics of the Agent which affect the Activity.
The Agent who resumes an Activity that they were engaged in earlier.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

his FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action. The depicted state does not necessarily or usually facilitate or cause the state of affairs reported by the target.
The consequence of the resuming of the Activity.
n general, this FE is used for phrases that describe the clause of the target as a whole.
An Agent initiates the beginning of an ongoing Activity in which he will be continuously involved.
This FE identifies the Place where the Agent starts an Activity.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Agent engages in a starting Activity.
This FE identifies the Time when the Agent starts an Activity.
This FE identifies the Depictive phrase describing the actor or undergoer of an action.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an Agent starts an Activity.
This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent starts an Activity.
This FE identifies the Activity that an Agent starts.
This FE identifies the being that starts the intentional Activity.
This FE identifies the first Subevent of the started Activity.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
In general, this FE is used for phrases that describe the clause of the target as a whole. There are two somewhat distinct subgroups of sentence modifiers that cover this function.

The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases. I

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
A consecutive event to the starting of the Activity of the Agent.
This FE modifies the target to indicate the legal- or other domain within which it is true or operational.

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause.
An Agent ceases an Activity without completing it.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Agent stopped the Activity.
This FE identifies the Place where the Agent stops the Activity.
This FE identifies the Time when the Agent stops the Activity.
This FE is used for a Depictive phrase describing the actor or undergoer of an action.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Agent stops the Activity.
This FE identifies the Result of the stopped Activity.
This FE identifies Agent that stops the Activity.
This FE identifies the Activity that the Agent stops.
This FE identifies the length of Time during which the Activity is stopped.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Agent stops the Activity.
This FE identifies the last Subevent of the stopped Activity.
This FE describes the completeness of stopping.

This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often. It is to be distinguished from Iteration, which pertains simply to the number of times an event occurs-Iteration expressions answer the question how many times.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
This FE presents the current frame as an integral part of a larger conceptualization expressed by another frame.
The reason the Agent stops the Activity.
n general, this FE is used for phrases that describe the clause of the target as a whole.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

Against the background of a contextually salient non-real world, for instance a hypothetical, imagined, simulated, expected, projected, or dream world, an Instance of a Type encountered in a relation or event in the real world is presented as being different from the instance found in the non-real world. Of course, the real-world Instance of the expected Type may also be presented as not occurring, as in the last example below. Actual results may vary. ACTUAL results may vary. Also present is the actual policeman, now 20 years older and helping to cast and prepare the young actor who'll be portraying him onscreen. Also present is the ACTUAL policeman, now 20 years older and helping to cast and prepare the young actor who'll be portraying him onscreen. Of course, an actual car with all these capabilities simply did not exist. Of course, an ACTUAL car with all these capabilities simply did not exist.
The real-world individual--a concrete or abstract thing or an event--which differs from its counterpart in a discourse-salient non-real world.
A kind of entity, instances of which are expected to occur in both the real and the non-real world.
This frame concerns an Addict's physiological or psychological compulsive dependence on an Addictant, the substance or behavior to which the Addict is addicted.
The Addict is physiologically or psychologically dependent on a substance or a behavior.
Addictant is the substance or behavior to which the Addict is dependent.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an Addict is addicted to the Addictant.
Compeller is the part of a human's body or psyche that compels the Addict to seek out the Addictant.

A Cognizer computes a Result on the basis of input Numbers by addition. Add up your savings. This is a cumulative figure obtained by adding up the cost of treating a given volume of specific diseases. When he later took the trouble to add up the bill he discovered that the actual cost was Fr 1,481 , around 140 pounds : an overcharge of 40 pounds Chaperones tallied the number of tickets sold at the school dance at more than 1000.
The Numbers that are used in the calculation.
The outcome of the Cognizer's calculcations.
The time at which the Cognizer operates on the Numbers.
The location where the Cognizer performs their calculation
The state-of-affairs that the Cognizer hopes to bring about by calculating.
The action performed by the Cognizer that brings about their calculation of the Result.
A holistic description of the event (e.g. "the same way"), including depictions of the Cognizer in terms of how the Cognizer's state affects the entire action.

A Speaker mentions a Specified_entity filling a Role, thereby providing information which supports a point of the Speaker. He cites the chief original observations adduced by Darwin as evidence for his theory. Mexico cited the drought, now in its eighth year, to avoid releasing Texas' full share of 110 billion gallons per year from the reservoirs. DNI An objector will immediately point to the lack of stability of this simple, some will say simple-minded, hierarchy. DNI She expected a restaurant as their meeting place, but instead the lady named the hotel where she was staying.DNI Where is the second-order neural pattern located? Damasio already pointed to the cingulate cortex in his 1994 book.
The Speaker is the person who specifies the Role to be filled by the Specified_entity.
The Addressee is the person to whom the Speaker identifies the filler of a Role.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In agentive frames, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An act whereby the Speaker makes a statement.
Medium is the physical entity or channel used by the Speaker to transmit the statement.
The state of the Speaker during the statement.
The time when the statement is made.
The FE specifies the place where the statement takes place.
The entity that the Speaker identifies as filling a particular Role.
A slot in a particular or generic event or relation whose filler the Speaker identifies.
An action that the Speaker intends to accomplish by performing the action indicated by adducing the Specified_entity.
The reason for which the Speaker (or Medium) comes to said conclusions about the Specified_entity.
The event of which the adducing is a part.
In general, this FE is used for phrases that describe the clause of the target as a whole.
The number of times an event is occuring (within a period of time).
The circumstances under which the adducing takes place.

An Agent changes a Part of a complex entity with regard to some Feature in order to achieve some Imposed_purpose affected by the Feature. The complex entity is often a device or mechanism, but may also be an abstract entity such as the economy. Also, the full entity may be used in place of the Part. I need to adjust the thermostat to around 80 degrees when she visits. It didn't work the first time , so she had to tweak the oven a little . Greenspan expressed confidence that the current calibration of interest rates was not an overcompensation .
The individual that controls the value of a Feature.
The part of the complex entity which is changed in the process of adjusting.
The Feature with respect to which the Part is adjusted.
The state of the Part with respect to the Feature that the Agent brings about by making the adjustment.
The action performed by the Agent which affects the Part.
The location where the adjusting takes place.
The time at which the adjusting occurs.
The value associated with the Feature that the system ends up in.
An entity manipulated by the Agent to adjust the Part and Feature.
The state-of-affairs that the Agent hopes to bring about by adjusting.

Any description of the adjustment act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of the Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
A characterization of the amount that the Final_value and Initial_value differ.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

An Agent has an Attribute which can take different Values, and the Agent selects and then begins to use some Value for that Attribute. The Attribute includes both physical (shape, color) and abstract (belief, practice) types. For some LUs in this frame, it is common for only the Value to be expressed, with the Attribute implicit. (Often this implicit attribute can be given second-layer expression on the Value. Note that such second-layer annotation should be assumed in the first two examples below.) They scoff at their opponents and assume an air of superior knowledge There are times when teachers should adopt a neutral stance in discussion of morally controversial issues. A person does not have to make the statement "I adopt this as my position" to do so.
The Agent selects a Value for his/her Attribute and begins to use it.
The Attribute of the Agent can take on several Values, selected by the Agent.
The Value, chosen and made effective by the Agent, specifies the Attribute.
The time period when the Agent selects and begins to put into effect the Value.

A description of the adoption of a position which is not classified under more specific descriptions, including comparisons to other events (similarly), rates of adoption (slowly), and descriptions of the Agent which also influence the action (eagerly).
In general, this FE is used for phrases that describe the clause of the target as a whole.
This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Agent adopts the Value of the Attribute.

This FE identifies the role filled by a particular participant of the clause headed by the target. In so doing, it relates the state of affairs evoked by the target to another background state of affairs by indicating that one of the role fillers of the current frame also fills a second kind of role in the background, either generically or in some specific instance.
This FE identifies the Place where the Agent has the Attribute which can take different Value.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
This FE presents the current frame as an integral part of a larger conceptualization expressed by another frame.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
The Means by which an Agent adopts a Value for an Attribute.
The instument through which an Agent adopts a Value for an Attribute.

Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end. In many cases, the continuous situation is a dynamic action which is ongoing, while in others it is simply an undifferentiated state.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.

This FE modified the target to indicate the legal- or "by rule" domain within which it is true or operational. This legal domain is in contrast to the reality, which may or may not reflect the ?official? state-of-affairs.

This frame involves a static (primarily spatial) relationship between a Location and a Theme. All of the verbs used statically in this frame can also occur in the frame Filling, producing pairs such as the following: Filling: Pat covered the table with flowers. Adorning: Flowers covered the table. Please note: adorned, covered, etc are in the Abounding_with frame because of the point of view shift.

The Theme in this frame is the object which is described as standing in some spatial relation to a particular Location. Theme typically occurs as the External Argument or, with passives, as a PP Complement headed by "with" or "by".
Location is the entity or area with respect to which the Theme's spatial arrangement is described. This frame element generally occurs as an NP Object.
The part of the Location which contains or is covered by the Theme.
The time at which the Theme occupies the Location.

An Entity is judged to be sensually pleasing or intellectually interesting to a (generally implicit) Judge. . We saw this beautiful boat with the red sails several times We camped here on the beach and had an absolutely lovely early morning walk through farm fields
The Entity for which a particular gradable Attribute is appropriate and under consideration.
The feature of an Entity which is under discussion.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the implicit value either from the norm or from the value for another Entity.
The Time during which the Entity is in the state of having a particular implicit value for the Attribute.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity has a particular implicit value for the Attribute.
The individual who judges the Entity's aesthetics.
The location where the Entity is in the state of having a particular implicit value for the Attribute.

An Entity has existed for a length of time, the Age. The Age can be characterized as a value of the age Attribute, or a Degree modifier may express the deviation of the Age from the norm. The Expressor exhibits qualities of the age of the Entity. This building is twenty thousand years old. My grandpa is really old Junior is only five weeks old. A cunning oldish voice called out from the crowd. His age was 23 at the time. People of age 55 or older should consult their physician. I have a 13-year-old cousin My grandma is old There are additional patterns that the LUs in this frame occur in which are not licensed by a particular lexical head but by a construction. Additionally, there are patterns that evoke this frame without any overt lexical head that are part of this frame. She is 45 years of age. Billy is 13.
The Entity for which a particular age is under consideration.
The feature of an Entity which is a function of the amount of time that the Entity has existed.
A quantity or other characterization of the Entity's age.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Age from the norm.
The Time during which the Entity is at a particular Age.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity has a particular Age.
The Frame Element Expressor marks expressions that indicate a body part, gesture or other expression of the Entity that reflect its age.

Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation to its end. In many cases, the continuous situation is a dynamic action which is ongoing, while in others it is simply an undifferentiated state.
This frame contains nouns denoting Aggregates of Individuals. The Aggregates may be described by an AggregateProperty. An army of postal workers descended on my office.
This FE identifies the people or things that form the Aggregate.
This FE identifies the collection of entities that are the Aggregate.
This FE describes a property of the Aggregate rather than the Individuals and is used to tag the adjective that modifies the aggregate noun when it is unambiguous.
The term used to refer to the Aggregate.
The location or political locale that the Organization is contained within
The relevant Domain as it pertains to the Aggregate.

An Entity is undergoing a change in age typically associated with some deterioration or change in state. This bark ages and turns black. The U.S. is to upgrade aging missile defense systems with advanced tech.
The Entity which is undergoing aging.
The Time during which the Entity ages.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity undergoes the aging event.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In agentive frames, it may indicate salient characteristics of an intentional Theme that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
This FE indicates where the Entity is located.
The end Result of the Entity aging.
A Speaker either agrees to or refuses to engage in a Proposed_action, proposed by an Interlocutor.
The Speaker is the person to whom a particular action has been proposed and who responds to the request or offer made.
This is the person who proposed the Proposed_action to the Speaker and to whom the Speaker communicates their response.
As with Medium in other communication frames, the physical entity or channel used to communicate can be expressed.
The Proposed_action is an action that the Speaker would perform if they were to accept or refuse the request or offer.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of the Speaker that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly).
This FE identifies the Meansby which the Speaker responds to the request or offer made.
The response may be prompted by either some outside phenomenon or occurrence, or by an Internal_cause, the Speaker mental or emotional state.
The location in which the Speaker gives their verbal response to the proposed action.
The time interval during which the Speaker makes their verbal response concerning the proposed action.
An action that the Speaker intends to accomplish by agreeing or refusing to perform the Proposed_action that is requested of, or suggested to them.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of response events.
Role denotes the status that the Interlocutor requested to be granted.
This FE identifies the subevent of the agreeing/refusing to act.
The number of times (within a given period) that the agreeing/refusing to act occurs.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.

This FE applies to appraisals of the event, typically a judgment of its expectedness, and consists of any descriptions of the state of affairs denoted by the target as role fillers in other frames. The state of affairs reported by the target is understood to play a role in the state of affairs of the modifier.
Peasants were encouraged to cultivate basic food crops such as beans and corn. Shrimp farming seems to be a recipe for disaster Some fields were probably cultivated only in the dry season CNI
The Agriculturist is the agent cultivating Food.
Food is the item cultivated by the Agriculturist.
The Instrument is used by the Agriculturist as a tool to help obtain Food. (This tool is not limited to typical artifacts and can be hands, arms, and other atypical hunting and fishing instruments.)
For what length of time the Agriculturist attempted to obtain Food.
The Manner in which the Agriculturist cultivates Food.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Agriculturist cultivates Food.
The failure or success of an attempt.
The greater geographic location where the Agriculturist cultivates Food.
An action that the Agriculturist intends to accomplish by cultivating Food.
How often the Agriculturist cultivates Food.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.
This is the the background or context for the Food to which the Agriculturist pays attention in his agricultural efforts.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
This FE indicates the subtype of agriculture that the Agriculturist is engaging in.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the agricultural event itself and any of its participants.

An Agent adjusts an Instrument to enable it to interact directly with a difficult-to-access Target_location. Usually, there is a Targeted entity at the Target_location which is mentioned in its place. If you aim your weapons somewhere else , I 'll be more likely to talk . The sortie targeted primarily resupply points , but these included several civilian areas . INI A good marksman still should take aim for a moment before each shot . INI INI
The individual that manipulates the Instrument to enable interaction with the Targeted.
The Targeted is the entity located in an indirectly accessible location relative to the Agent.
The Outcome is the failure or success of an attempt.
This FE identifies the Means by which the aiming is achieved.
This FE identifies the Time when the Agent takes aim.
The Depictive is a phrase which describes the Agent during the event.
The place where the Agent aims at the Targeted.
Any generalized description of the details of the event in terms of comparison to another event or what would be expected of the details given some state of the Agent.
The time peiod over which the adjustment of the Instrument takes place.
The reason for which the Agent attempts to interact with the Targeted

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is independent of the the aiming of the Agent, but contextualizes it.
The object manipulated by the Agent in order to interact with the Targeted.
The location that the Agent wishes to ready the Instrument to access.
The location from which the proto-agent acts or perceives. This does not include the location of a thing which is affected or perceived in the event.
An Alignment_match region has the same orientation as the relatively linear Ground. The Alignment_mismatch region is oriented perpendicularly to the Ground.
A region of space oriented the same as the Ground.
An entity whose location and orientation is relatively well-known and which, thus, can serve as a land-mark to identify the Alignment_match and Alignment_mismatch regions.
A region oriented approximately perpendicular to the Ground

After having worked separately for some time, two or more organizational or individual Members are now organized in an Alliance so that they may better pursue some common Purposes. The formerly separate Members may be presented separately as Member_1 and Member_2.
The entity of which the individuals are Members.
The persons or groups belonging to the Alliance.
The reason for which an Alliance is formed.
The interval during which the Alliance exists.
That group or individual which has joined the Alliance which is grammatically more prominent when the Members are presented separately.
That group or individual which has joined the Alliance which is grammatically less prominent when the Members are presented separately.
A characterization of some property of the Alliance.

In this frame an Undergoer is in a phase brought about after a change of phase. This can be its inherent phase or indicate that it is returned to its inherent state. Collect up the thawed water from the freezer section. Put under the broiler until the cheese becomes melted. Major companies are switching to liquefied natural gas.
The Undergoer is the entity which has had its phase altered.
The part of the Undergoer that is in an altered state.

These words refer to Parts merging to form a Whole. (The Parts may also be encoded as Part_1 and Part_2.) There is a symmetrical relationship between the components that undergo the process, and afterwards the Parts are consumed and are no longer distinct entities that are easily discernable or separable in the Whole. The two droplets merge, and then travel down the windowpane even faster.
The entities that merge to form a single Whole.
The single, undifferentiated entity that is the result of the amalgamation.
The prominent entity that combines withPart_2 to form a Whole.
The less focussed-upon entity that the Part_1 merges with.
This FE identifies the thoroughness of the mixing job, i.e. to what degree the resulting Whole is undifferentiated.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In this frame, it is also deemed to include modification indicating the speed of the event.
The state of the Parts after the amalgamation.
The time at which the Parts become amalgamated into a Whole
The location at which the amalgamation occurs.
The state of Part_1 or Parts.

A Recipient (who may or may not be agentive) ends up in possession of a Mass_theme (which may be conceptualized as a single mass entity, or may be a group of individual entities). Some lexical units (e.g. stockpile) specifically indicate an intentional Recipient. This frame differs from Gathering_up in that this frame refers specifically to the acquisition and (according to expectation) long-term possession of entities, rather than (as in the Gathering_up frame) simply talking about causing a group of entities to be located in the same place. In sum, Gathering_up concerns (co-)locations, but Amassing concerns possession.
The Recipient indicates the entity that ends up in possession of the Mass_theme.
The collection of objects that ends up in the Recipient's possession.
The Source is the location that the Mass_theme formerly occupied. Persons that begin in possession of the Mass_theme may metonymically stand in for the Source.
The Place denotes where the Mass_theme is acquired.
The purpose for which an intentional amassment is performed.
The Reason refers to the existing eventuality that the Recipient is responding to.
The Means is the action of the Recipient which results in their possession of the Mass_theme.

A description of the Amassing which is not covered by more specific FEs. It includes such specifications as comparisons to other events (similarly), rates of acquisition (slowly), and descriptions of the Recipient which also influence the action (eagerly).
The state that either the Recipient or the Mass_theme end up in after the acquisition.
This FE describes the length of time over which amassing occurs.
Some specification of the circumstances under which amassing occurs.
Role is used for the capacity in which the Recipient amasses stuff, and is expressed in as-PPs.

The Temperature in a certain environment, determined by Time and Place, is specified. It's too hot to do anything today. Nome is pretty cold this time of year Last Tuesday was a real scorcher. Tomorrow is gonna be chilly.
The Place where it is a certain Temperature .
The temperature feature of the weather.
A quantity or other characterization of the Temperature of the environment.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Temperature from the norm.
The Time during which an ambient environment has a particular Temperature.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the ambient Temperature is as specified.
The meteorological conditions which determine the ambient temperature of a locale.

A piece of Ammunition is a disposable artifact to be fired as a projectile in a weapon with the purpose of causing harm or damage. The octagenarian inventor's vest repels armor-piercing bullets. It is armed with a automatic loaded 105 mm gun firing anti-tank rounds Depleted uranium munitions are primarily used by the US and the UK.
This FE identifies the Ammunition that is designed to have a particular Use.
The use for which a piece of ammunition is intended.
An individual or individuals that bring the Ammunition into existence.
The time at which an Ammunition comes into existence.
The term used to refer to an Ammunition.
An indication of the subtype of Ammunition.
Any indication of what makes up the Ammunition, including components, ingredients, etc.

The absolute Value of a quantifiable Attribute of an item is determined by adding up the values for the Attribute of the individuals or parts that make up the item. The item is not expressed as a separate constituent but it is presupposed by the concept of Attribute. Alternatively, the Numbers form an implicit set whose sum is the Value associated with the set. In some cases what is reported is just the cardinality of the individuals that make up the item so that in effect the Value is a count. In other cases the identity of the Attribute can only be inferred from the Value. There is no cognizer on the scene in this frame. Instead, the frame focuses on the relationship between the Attribute or Numbers and the Value, which is stable and unchanging regardless of who performs the calculation. Defence is provided in West Germany by armed forces whose number totals close to half a million men and women . Revenues totalled 568.86m pounds The WHO estimated that the cumulative total of AIDS cases was more than 1,500,000.
The scalar property of a concrete or abstract entity.
The span of time when the Attribute has the Value.

This FE indicates the time span during which the total of the Attribute is the Value, with the added information that it is (somehow) calculated at a regular interval coinciding with the transition between spans of time.
A set of numbers that add up to the Value.
An Experiencer, Expressor, or State has a feeling of annoyance as evoked by a Stimulus or concerning a Topic. Peck was annoyed at the interruption. Maggie noted his rather irritated expression.
The Experiencer is the person or sentient entity that experiences or feels the emotions.
The Topic is the general area in which the emotion occurs. It indicates a range of possible Stimulus.
The Stimulus is the person, event, or state of affairs that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.
The extent to which the Experiencer's emotion deviates from the norm for the emotion.
The Empathy_target is the individual or individuals with which the Experiencer identifies emotionally and thus shares their emotional response.
The body part, gesture, or other expression of the Experiencer that reflects his or her emotional state. They describe a presentation of the experience or emotion denoted by the adjective or noun.
The Reason is the explanation for why the Stimulus evokes a certain emotional response.

The Circumstances is the condition(s) under which the Stimulus evokes its response. In some cases it may appear without an explicit Stimulus. Quite often in such cases, the Stimulus can be inferred from the Circumstances
The State is the abstract noun that describes a more lasting experience by the Experiencer.
The Parameter is a domain in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus.

Any description of the way in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). Manner may also describe a state of the Experiencer that affects the details of the emotional experience.
The Time when the Experiencer, Expressor, or State can be described as having said emotion.

In the Appeal stage of the criminal process the Convict or his or her Representative applies to a higher Court to reverse the Decision of the lower court on certain Grounds. The defense plans to appeal the court's decision on the grounds that the judge violated Code 81.b . John Michaels will appeal his conviction .
The Convict is the individual convicted of the crime who may make an appeal on her or his behalf.
The Representative applies to a higher court on behalf of the Convict.
The Decision is the ruling handed down by the first court.
The Grounds is the legal basis on which the appeal rests.
The Court is the judicial establishment to which the Convict appeals.
The Time at which a Convict or Representative appeals.
This FE presents the current frame as an integral part of a larger conceptualization expressed by another frame.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.

In this class of perception words, a Phenomenon, typically expressed as External Argument, and its perceptual characteristics are given some description. This may be a Characterization describing purely perceptual properties, an Appraisal (i.e. positive or negative judgment) or an Inference about some non-perceptual property based on the Perceiver_passive's perception.
The Phenomenon is typically the External Argument of the verbs in this frame.
Characterization is the subjective description (of the Perceiver_passive ) of the Phenomenon.
Appraisal is the positive or negative judgement given to the Phenomenon.
Inference expresses some property of the Phenomenon that is not a direct feature of the particular sensory modality (if any), but rather is based on perception within that modality.
The Perceiver_passive experiences some perception without necessarily intending to, but makes a judgment about the Phenomenon. The Perceiver_passive generally occurs in a PP Complement.

Body_part expressions are not common in this frame, but may occur with the verb "feel" (the only verb in this frame that does not lexically encode the Body_part involved in perception) or occasionally (and redundantly) with other verbs.
Location_of_perceiver identifies the position of the Perceiver_passive during the act of perception. Typically it is expressed in a PP-from.

This frame element, usually expressed in a PP, is used for all path-like expressions, except those indicating the Location_of_perceiver (see above), that describe how the Perceiver_passive's attention is directed during the act of perception.
This FE identifies expressions that predicate something of the Phenomenon, providing some information about its State while the Perceiver_passive experiences it.
Ground is the perceptual background against which the Phenomenon is experienced (or not experienced) by the Perceiver_passive.
The extent to which a Phenomenon gives the impression that a certain Characterization or Inference holds.
The physical or abstract Circumstances that determine the appearance of the Phenomenon.
How often the Phenomenon has the Appraisal, Characterization, or Phenomenon.

This frame includes words that are used as the Titles of individuals. The Title is applied to a Name (surname or full name) and often designates their rank within a man-made institution. Pairings of Title and Name can be used as vocatives (see Attention_getting), while the Titles may not always be vocative on their own. He saluted General Fightmaster walking into the room. Everyone stood as Captain Jack Aubrey delivered a toast.
The name of the person referred to by a Title.
How a person is referred to within an Institution, often denoting their rank or status. Title is always marked on the target.

A Cook applies heat to Food, where the Temperature_setting of the heat and Duration of application may be specified. A Heating_instrument, generally indicated by a locative phrase, may also be expressed. Some cooking methods involve the use of a Medium (e.g. milk or water) by which heat is transferred to the Food. A less semantically prominent Food or Cook is marked Co_participant. Sally fried an egg in butter. Sally fried an egg in a teflon pan. Ellen fried the eggs with chopped tomatoes and garlic. This frame differs from Cooking_creation in focusing on the process of handling the ingredients, rather than the edible entity that results from the process.
The Cook applies heat to the Food.
This FE identifes the entity that directly supplies heat to the Food.
This FE identifies the Place where the heat application occurs.
Food is the entity to which heat is applied by the Cook.
This FE identifies the Time at which the heat application occurs.
This FE identifies the Means by which heat is applied to Food.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
Duration is the amount of Time heat is applied to the Food.
Medium is the substance through which heat is applied to the Food.
Co_participant is the gramatically less prominent of two foods to which heat is applied by the Cook.
This FE identifies the Temperature_setting of the Heating_instrument for the Food.
This FE identifies the Degree to which heat application occurs.

Any description of the cooking event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Cook that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The Container holds the Food to which heat is applied.

A Selector, often an individual in a leadership role, appoints a Official to assume an official Role in an organization (which can be expressed as the Body). Press secretaries accredit journalists to the sessions.
The Selector is responsible for the appointment of the new official. Typically, it occurs as the External Argument of verbs.
The Official is a person appointed to a recognized position.

Frequently, the Official is referred to only by his/her role. However, the Role can be expressed separately from the leader, usually as either a secondary predicate or in a PP Complement (headed by as).
This FE indicates the Degree to which an event occurs.
Depictive indicates the state of one of the participants during the action.
This FE is used for the Manner of performing an action.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Selector accomplishes the designation of the Official.
This FE is used for indicating the Result of an event.
This frame element describes the situation that brought about the new appointment.
The Function is the purpose the Official will fufill.
When the designation of the official takes place.
A group of individuals who are elected or appointed to perform some function, and to which the Official is assigned.

An entity is integrated into a building as a Part of a (possibly unexpressed) Whole which may refer to the whole building or merely to a sub-part of the building. We need new counters for the kitchen The storm ripped off the bathroom's roof
A Part of a larger architectural unit, the Whole.
An architectural unit which includes the Part.
A property relating to the Part.
This is a property of the Part that situates the Part within the Whole.
Any indication of what makes up the Part, including components, ingredients, etc.
The Individual who creates the Part.
This frame describes a certain type of mathematical scenario in which two numbers, labeled Term1 and Term2, interact via some mathematical operation.
The grammatically more prominent number in an arithmetic operation.
The grammatically less prominent number in an arithmetic operation.

This frame describes types of arithmetic operations and statements which have the commutative property, i.e. the operation is bi-directional, e.g. addition and multiplication. The terms involved are either individually labeled Term1 and Term2 or grouped together as a single noun phrase labeled Terms.
Two more or elements of a commutative arithmetic operation. This frame element may be represented as Term1 and Term2.
The grammatically more prominent number involved in a commutative operation.
The grammatically less prominent number involved in commutative operation.

This frame describes types of arithmetic operations and statements which are not commutative, i.e. the operation is uni-directional, e.g. subtraction and division. Because of the non-commutative nature, terms must be separated from each other in the form of Term_1 and Term_2 instead of a combined Terms FE.
Term_1 is the first operand in the non-commutative arithmetic that is modified by Term_2 (e.g. subtracted or divided by Term_2).
Term_2 is the second operand of the non-commutative arithmetic which modifies Term_1 (e.g. subtracts from or divides Term_1).
At a court hearing, a Defendant is informed of the Charges against him or her, (usually) enters a plea, and a decision is made by a Judge as to the amount of bail, if any.
The Defendant is charged with a crime by a Judge.
This FE identifies the Place where the arraignment occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the arraignment occurs.
The Judge is the head of the court where the arraignment occurs.
Charges is the crime with which the Defendant is charged.
The length of time that the arraignment takes.

Any description of the arraignment which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (openly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Judge that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).

An Agent puts a complex Theme into a particular Configuration, which can be a proper order, a correct or suitable sequence, or a spatial position. He arranged the elements in the pattern that we now call the periodic table. Try to order them by importance. CNI
The person who causes the Theme to be in a particular Configuration.
An entity that consists of parts which can be put into a configuration relative to each other and/or relative to their environment.
The Time when the arranging takes place.
A state that holds of the Theme or a relation that holds among the constituent parts of the Theme as a result of the arranging action.

Any description of the arranging action which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). With agentive use, it may indicate salient characteristics of anAgent that also affect the action ( eagerly, carefully).
The place in which the Theme is put into a Configuration.
Circumstances identifies the situation in which an Agent arranges a Theme.
An action that the Agent is trying to bring about by changing the Configuration of the Theme.
An entity used by the Agent to change the Theme's Configuration.
An action performed by the Agent in order to arrange the Theme.
The extent to which the Arranging act has occured.
Authorities charge a Suspect, who is under suspicion of having committed a crime (the Charges), and take him/her into custody.The police arrested Harry on charges of manslaughter.
Charges identifies a category within the legal system; it is the crime with which the Suspect is charged.
This FE identifies the Place where the arrest occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the arrest occurs.
The Authorities charge the Suspect with commiting a crime, and take him/her into custody.
The Suspect is taken into custody, under suspicion of having committed a crime.
This FE indicates the subtype of arrest under which the Suspect is placed.
Offense identifies the ordinary language use of the reason for which a Suspect is arrested.

Any description of the arresting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Authorities that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
This FE identifies the Means by which Authorities arrest a Suspect.
This FE identifies the purpose for which Authorities arrest a Suspect.
The Source_of_legal_authority describe the law which grants the power of arrest to the Authorities.
A person that participates in the event along with the Authorities or the Suspect.
An object Theme moves in the direction of a Goal. The Goal may be expressed or it may be understood from context, but its is always implied by the verb itself.
Theme is the object that moves. It may be an entity that moves under its own power, but it need not be.

Source is any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion. While Source expressions are possible in this frame, they are relatively infrequent. If present, they often express a general direction from which a Theme moves, rather than a landmark away from which it moves.
Path is any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal. In this frame, Path expressions almost always have a via-sense.
Goal is any expression that tells where the Theme ends up, or would end up, as a result of the motion.

A Manner expression describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion. Descriptions of speed, steadiness, grace, means of motion, and other things count as Manner expressions.
This FE identifies the Means by which a Theme arrives.

The Mode_of_transportation expresses how the motion of the Theme is effected, by its body or by a vehicle which holds and conveys the Theme. Vehicles can move in any way and in any medium. They are usually expressed obliquely with 'in' or 'by'.
Cotheme is the second moving object, expressed as a direct object or an oblique.
This FE identifies the Time when ariving occurs.
The Goal_conditions are the state of the Goal when the Theme arrives.
The Depictive is a phrase which describes the state of the Theme upon arrival.
The time period within which the arrival repeats multiple times.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
This FE identifies the purpose for which the Theme arrives to the Goal.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.
This FE marks the state of affairs reported by the Arriving Event as understood to play a role in the state of affairs of the modifier.
This FE presents the current frame as an integral part of a larger conceptualization expressed by another frame. The frame expressed by the target typically corresponds to a Means action.
How often the Theme arrives at the Goal.
This FE identifies the Place where the arriving event occurs.
A Perpetrator intentionally sets fire to his own or someone else's property, often in order to collect an insurance payment on this property.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an event occurs
Depictive identifies a phrase that describes the actor of an action.
The illegal setting of fire to destroy something.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an action is performed.
This FE identifies the Means by which arson is committed.
The action that the Perpetrator is trying to accomplish with the arson Event.
This FE identifies the Duration of time that a state holds or a process is ongoing.
This FE identifies the Place where the arson occurs.
This FE identifies the Reason for which an event occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the arson occurs.
The Perpetrator sets fire to a building in order to gain some benefit from so doing.
Victim identifies the enity that is negatively effected by the arson.
The frequency with which an act of arson is committed.

An Artifact is deliberately made or modified by an intelligent entity to be put to a certain kind of Use. Various properties of the Artifact may be specified, such as its Creator, Time_of_creation, Name, Type, and the Material of which it is composed. The Artifact may or may not be a physical entity.
This FE identifies the entity or substance that is designed to have a particular Use.
The use for which an artifact is intended.
An individual or individuals that bring the Artifact into existence.
The time at which an Artifact comes into existence.
The term used to refer to an Artifact.
An indication of the subtype of Artifact.
Any indication of what makes up the Artifact, including components, ingredients, etc.

An Entity is evaluated for whether or not it belongs to a particular Type in a context where its category membership is doubtful. The criterion or criteria that are relevant to evaluating Type membership depend on the individual lexical units and/or on the context. Typically, either the material composition of the Entity, its method of creation, or the identity (and proper authority) of its creators are critical for proper category membership. Note that Entity also covers behaviors. It can be hard to get your money back after discovering you've bought a bogus autograph for hundreds or thousands of dollars! It can be hard to get your money back after discovering you've bought a BOGUS autograph for hundreds or thousands of dollars! A bogus policeman pulling over motorists was arrested after stopping a car carrying four real officers. A BOGUS policeman pulling over motorists was arrested after stopping a car carrying four real officers. You people are pretty thick if you think you have evidence to prove that the moon landing was fake. You people are pretty thick if you think you have evidence to prove that the moon landing was fake.
The Entity that is being evaluated in terms of whether it is an instance of the Type.
The type relative to which the Entity is evaluated.

The extent to which the Entity seems to belong (or not, if so specified by the lexical unit) to the category of the Type is clear. Typically, this frame element is realized as an end-of-scale expression.

In this frame a group of Individuals intentionally come together to form a Group. Alternatively, a grammatically more prominent Party_1 assembles with a Party_2, expressed as an oblique phrase. If this asymmetric construal is chosen, Purpose only relates to Party_1. We assembled in the courtyard to talk about our future plans. Our study group is convening outside today. The Dodgers meet the San Francisco Giants tomorrow at Dodger Stadium.
The Individuals are self-movers who intentionally assemble together.
The Group describes the resulting formation of the Individuals.
Party_1 is the grammatically more prominent participant in the assembling event. It can refer to either a single individual or a larger party separate from Party_2 previous to the assembling.
A grammatically less prominent participant in the assembling event. It can refer to either a single individual or a larger party separate from Party_1 previous to the assembling.

Any description of the assembling which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of the Individuals or Group that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, eagerly, carefully).
The Place is where the assembling occurs.
The Means descibes the way in which the Individuals accomplish the assembling.
The Time is when the assembling occurs.
An action that the Group plans to engage in upon assembly.

An Assessor examines a Phenomenon to figure out its Value according to some Feature of the Phenomenon. This Value is a factor in determining the acceptability of the Phenomenon. In some cases, a Method (implicitly involving an Assessor) is used to determine the Phenomenon's Value. Each company is then evaluated for their earning potential. CNI From the evidence of the pilot studies the risk of damage to the test subjects was rated too high to continue. CNI He weighed his options carefully.
The sentient entity that evaluates the Phenomenon.
The entity whose Value according to a Feature is being measured.
The value (according to some scale) that the Phenomenon is deemed to have. The Value is taken to indicate the Phenomenon's acceptability.
The type of property or feature that the Phenomenon is being judged on.
Some fact perceived by the Assessor which leads to their evaluation of the Phenomenon.
Any secondary effect of the action or characterization of the Assessor which saliently affects the character of the assessment.
An event or procedure that allows the Assessor to evaluate the Phenomenon.
The means by which assessment occurs
The time at which the Assessor makes the assessment.
An entity that the Phenomenon is compared to in the assessment.
The goal that the Assessor hopes to accomplish by assessing the Phenomenon.
The location where the assessing takes place.
Medium is the physical entity or channel used by the Assessor to make the assessment.
A person who participates along with the Assessor in the assessing event.
This frame element is defined as the number of times assessing occurs per some unit of time.

This extrathematic FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the occurrence of the event specified by the target predicate. Further, the target predicate should involve some sort of Agent that intends that the benefit go to the Beneficiary.

This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action. The depicted state does not necessarily or usually facilitate or cause the state of affairs reported by the target.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.
The state of the world at a partiicular time and place.
This FE denotes the length of time during which a continuous event occurs.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
