A Helper benefits a Benefited_party by enabling the culmination of a Goal that the Benefited_party has. A Focal_entity that is involved in reaching the Goal may stand in for it. Will you help the Government find your brother? Maybe Stephen should assist him with the last manuscript. They helped me psychologically to overcome the physical loss I had suffered. You have helped him tremendously by showing him how to stand up for himself and by being his friend. By bringing assistance to his troops wherever they were in trouble he aided them greatly.
The Benefited_party receives a benefit from the action of the Helper.
The Helper performs some action that benefits the Benefited_party.
The desirable state of affairs that the Benefited_party is involved in and which is enabled by the Helper.
This FE identifies a Focal_entity involved in achieving the Goal.
This FE identifies the Time when the Assistance occurs.
This FE identifies the Place where the Assistance occurs.
This FE identifies the Manner in which a Helper assists a Benefited_party.
An action that the Helper undertakes in service of the Benefited_party's Goal.
An entity used by the Helper in service of the Benefited_party's accomplishing their Goal.
The aspect of accomplishing the Goal to which the Helper's assistance is relevant.
The measure to which the Helper's assistance brings the Benefited_party closer to accomplishing their Goal.
The time period during which the Helper gives assistence to the Benefited_party.
The situation that the Helper wishes to bring about by helping the Benefited_party to acheive the Goal. Note that this FE should normally be used only when this situation is separate from the Goal.

The frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the questions how often. It is to be distinguished from Iteration, which pertains simply to the number of times an event occurs; Iteration expressions answer the question how many times.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.
An Agent has committed a Wrong in the past and is making Amends for it. The Degree to which the Amends are adequate may also be expressed.
The Agent has committed a Wrong and is making Amends.
Wrong identifies the act committed by the Agent for which Amends are made.
Amends marks expressions that indicate what the Agent does to compensate for the Wrong that was committed.
This FE marks expressions that indicate the Degree to which Amends made are adequate for atoning the Wrong.
The situation that the Agent hopes to bring about by atoning.

Any description of the atonement which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of the Agent that also affect the action (deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The time at which the Agent atones for the Wrong.
The location at which the Agent expiates the Wrong.

The Attaching frame covers two situations: a scene in which somebody causes one thing to be physically connected to something else; or a scene in which somebody causes two things to be connected to each other. In the first, the frame includes an Agent who attaches an Item to a Goal by manipulating a Connector, creating an asymmetric relationship between the Item and the Goal. In the second, the Agent attaches two Items to each other, where each serves as a Goal for the other, creating a symmetric relationship between the two Items. In both cases, the Connector remains to bind the two entities (either Item and Goal, or two Items), without creating a new entity. The robber tied Harry to the chair. Make sure you bind his wrists as tightly as possible.

The Agent manipulates an object. Agent typically refers to animate beings, but is also extended to mechanical and other inanimate objects. It is most frequently expressed as the external argument of verbs.
This FE identifies the Item that the Agent attaches to the Goal.
This FE identifies the Result of an attaching event.
Goal identifies the location to which an Item is attached.
The Connector forms the bond that maintains the Item or Items in a fixed position; it is usually expressed in a with-PP.
This FE identifies the plural Items that are tied together, resulting in their mutual attachment.
Thie Handle is the point of attachment on the Item to which the Agent attaches.
This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent intentionally affects an Item or Items.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an Agent intentionally affects an Item or Items.
This FE identifies the Place where the Agent intentionally affects an Item or Items.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Agent intentionally affects an Item or Items.
This FE identifies the Time when the Agent intentionally affects the Item or Items.

This FE identifies the Instrument with which an Agent attaches an Item or Items. Typically, it transmits the force applied by the Agent, and is not left behind as a participant in the resultant Being_attached frame.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the Item ends up attached.
This frame element is defined as the number of times the Attaching event occurs per some unit of time.
The length of time from when the Attaching event began to be repeated to when it stopped.
The time when the Attaching occurs.

An Assailant physically attacks a Victim (which is usually but not always sentient), causing or intending to cause the Victim physical damage. A Weapon used by the Assailant may also be mentioned, in addition to the usual Place, Time, Purpose, Reason, etc. Sometimes a location is used metonymically to stand for the Assailant or the Victim, and in such cases the Place FE will be annotated on a second FE layer. As soon as he stepped out of the bar he was set upon by four men in ski-masks. Is he invading Iraq just to cover other shortcomings? Then Jon-O's forces ambushed them on the left flank from a line of low hills.
This FE is the being or entity that is injured by the Assailant's attack.
An entity used by the Assailant to cause damage to the Victim.
The person (or other self-directed entity) that is attempting physical harm to the Victim.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Assailant that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An intentional action performed by the Assailant that accomplishes the assault.
This FE identifies the place where the Assailant makes an assault on the Victim.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Assailant attacks the Victim.
A state of affairs that the Assailant is responding to that leads them to make an assault on the Victim.
This FE identifies the time when the Assailant attacks the Victim.

The starting-point of the motion of the Assailant or projectiles of the Assailant as they move toward the the Place that the Victim is occupying in the attack. In prepositional phrases, the prepositional object expresses the starting point of motion. With particles, the starting point of motion is understood from context.
This FE is used for any Depictive phrase describeing the state of the Assailant or Victim while the Attack occurs.

This FE presents the current frame as an integral part of a larger conceptualization expressed by another frame. The frame expressed by the target typically corresponds to a Means action within the frame expressed by the Re_encoding, but not necessarily.
The Result of the attack on the Victim by the Assailant.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held. Form: once, twice, Cardinal expression + /it times, /it lots/a lot
In general, this FE is used for phrases that describe the clause of the target as a whole. There are two somewhat distinct subgroups of sentence modifiers that cover this function.
The Path refers to (a part of) the ground over which the Assailant travels.
An Agent attempts to achieve a Goal. The Outcome may also be mentioned explicitly. John attempted to climb Mt. Everest. The attempt to climb Mt. Everest failed.
The Agent makes an attempt to achieve a Goal.
The Goal is what the Agent attempts to achieve.
The Outcome is the failure or success of an attempt to achieve a Goal.
This FE identifies the Means by which an attempt occurs.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an attempt occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the attempt occurs.
The Depictive is a phrase which describes the Agent.
The place where an attempt is made.
The Manner in which the Agent makes the attempt.
The time peiod over which the attempts take place.
The reason for which the Agent attempts the Goal.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is independent of the the attempt of the Agent to achieve the Goal.
The area of work to which the Attempt event belongs.
The conditions under which the the Agent attempts the Goal.
This frame element is defined as the number of times the Attemping event occurs per some unit of time.
The state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in desiring the Goal.

An Agent attempts to interact with a relatively distant or indirectly accessible Target using some Instrument (which may be a body part, e.g. hand). The Agent's ability to manipulate the Instrument and put it in the Target location is in question. The most common types of distant interaction involve an Agent attempting to move the Instrument ballistically so that it contacts the Target (e.g. Shooting_scenario), or an Agent attempting to direct an Instrument that enables perception at a Target_location to be examined.
The Agent tries to interact with the Target.
The Target is the entity located in an indirectly accessible location relative to the Agent.
The Outcome is the failure or success of an attempt.
This FE identifies the Means by which an attempt occurs.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an attempt occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the attempt occurs.
The Depictive is a phrase which describes the Agent during the event.
The place where an attempt is made.
The Manner in which the Agent makes the attempt.
The time peiod over which the attempt or attempts take place.
The reason for which the Agent attempts to interact with the Target

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is independent of the the attempt of the Agent.
The object manipulated by the Agent in order to interact with the Target.
The location that the Agent is attempting to access using the Instrument.

An Agent attempts to achieve a Goal using some Means. The Means are crucially focused upon, typically appearing as the Object of the Target. John tried using a crowbar to open the door. They tried opening the window in order to rob the store.
The Agent makes an attempt to achieve a Goal.
The Goal is what the Agent attempts to achieve.
Note: this FE might not be in frame. It is temporarily here during the early stage of annotation. (JGK) The Outcome is the failure or success of an attempt to achieve a Goal.
This FE identifies the Means by which an attempt occurs.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an attempt occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the attempt occurs.
The Depictive is a phrase which describes the Agent.
The place where an attempt is made.
The Manner in which the Agent makes the attempt.
The time peiod over which the attempts take place.
The reason for which the Agent attempts the Goal.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is independent of the the attempt of the Agent to achieve the Goal.
Note: this FE might not be in frame. It is temporarily here during the early stage of annotation. (JGK) The area of work to which the Attempt event belongs.
This FE denotes the number of times an event is attempted per some unit of time.
A Seeker is trying to obtain Food and is seeking it within the context of a Ground.
The Seeker is the agent hoping to obtain Food.
Food is the sought-out item by the Seeker.
The Instrument is used by the Seeker as a tool to help obtain Food. (This tool is not limited to typical artifacts and can be hands, arms, and other atypical hunting and fishing instruments.)
For what length of time the Seeker attempted to obtain Food.
The Manner in which the Seeker makes the attempt for Food.
This FE identifies the Means by which an attempt at achieving a Food obtainment.
The failure or success of an attempt.
The greater geographic location where the Seeker attempts to obtain Food.
When the Food seeking action occurs.
An action that the Seeker intends to accomplish by seeking Food.
How often the Seeker attempts to obtain Food.
This FE identifies the amount of effort the Seeker puts into an attempt to obtain Food.
This is the entity to which the Seeker pays attention. It is referred to as Ground because it serves as the background or context for the Food.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
An Agent attempts to obtain a non-renewable resource, often solid minerals or metals, but also oil, water, and other valuable substances.
The Agent makes an attempt to obtain minerals.
The Outcome is the failure or success of an attempt to achieve a Goal.
This FE identifies the Means action performed by the Agent which they hope will let them obtain the Mineral.
This FE identifies the Time when the attempt occurs.
The place where an attempt is made.
The time period over which the attempts take place.
The valuable resource which the Agent attempts to acquire.

The Speaker expresses through language his wish to get the Addressee to act. There is no implication that the Addressee forms an intention to act, let alone acts. Mr Smithers always encourages the employees to stay late and work harder. Dennis Rodman advises moderation in all things. INI
The wish for action on the Addressee's part that the Speaker expresses.
The person that the Speaker seeks to influence to act.
The person who intends through the use of language to get another person to act.
The written or spoken material that contains a message that potentially influences the Addressee towards the Content.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an action is performed.
Depictive identifies a phrase that describes the actor of an action.
This FE identifies the Means by which an action is performed.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an event occurs.
The time at which the lobbying occurs.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.
The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.
The state of the world (independent of the event).
The Group is the set of Speakers and Mediums within which the Attempt_suasion is occuring.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often.
This FE presents the current frame as an integral part of a larger conceptualization expressed by another frame.
The location where the Speaker attemtps susaion on an Addressee.
The reason for which the Speaker attempts to persuade the Addressee.
An Agent has a particular Goal in mind, and then uses some Means that they believe will bring about the Goal. The Agent succeeds or fails inasmuch as the result of the Means action matches the Goal.
The Agent makes an attempt to achieve a Goal.
The Goal is what the Agent attempts to achieve.
The Outcome is the failure or success of an attempt to achieve a Goal.
This FE identifies the Means action performed by the Agent which they hope will bring about their Goal.
This FE identifies the Time when the attempt occurs.
The place where an attempt is made.
The time period over which the attempts take place.

An Agent goes to an Event and is present in a relatively non-participatory way. The Angolan guerrillas will attend a September meeting in Zaire. We just go to the movies when it rains. His attendance at the funeral did not go unnoticed.
The Agent is the person who chooses to make himself present at the Event.
The Event is the deliberate set of happenings given at a particular time and place.
The way in which the Agent went about going to the Event.
Through what strategies and efforts the Agent made possible his attendance at the Event.
The location where the Agent attends the Event.
When the Agent attends the Event.
Under what conditions the Agent goes to the Event.
The reason why the Agent goes to the Event.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.
This FE describes the event as a whole.

This frame concerns a Perceiver's state of readiness to process and consider impressions of a Figure within a Ground. It is often unknown to the Perceiver whether or not the Figure exists within the Ground. Alternatively, the Expressor may be expressed as showing signs of the Perceiver's state of attentiveness. Legislator tells consumers to be alert to dioxin levels. They demand an attentive gaze, a careful accounting of parts.
The individual that pays attention to the Ground.
The sensory field or subset of a sensory field that the Perceiver is attending to.
The entity that the Perceiver is specifically focussing on within the Ground.
The amount of attention that the Perceiver is paying to the Figure or Ground.
The situation within which the Perceiver is alert.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of a Perceiver that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An entity (or event) associated with a Perceiver that gives evidence for a Perceiver's attentiveness.

This frame covers terms used to get someone's attention, including Interjections (e.g. hey, yo) and certain terms of address (Address_term), the latter of which may serve the function of attention getting. Hey. Hey, boy. Hey, boy, come over here now!
This FE identifies the Address_term as used to get someone's attention, and may be a proper name.
Interjection identifies the attention getting element.

A Proposition is attributed to a Speaker or a Text. According to the Press Trust of India in an article published on its Web site Thursday, the woman has been identified as 31-year-old Aafia Siddiqui, who was being sought by U.S. officials last week along with two other men, including one whose last known address was in Miramar, Fla. In addition, according to Section I3.5b, the spacing of stud shear connectors along the length of a supporting beam shall not exceed 36?. According to the Pope, Muslims believe in the same God and according to Jesus, Muslims are the greatest in Heaven.
The information attributed to the Speaker or Text.
A sentient entity that has communicated the information encoded by the Proposition.
A written or verbal collection of statements, which imparts the information of the Proposition.
An Entity has a particular Attribute with some Value. This frame is primarily for inheritance.
The Entity for which a particular Attribute is appropriate and under consideration.
The feature of an Entity which is under discussion.
A quantity or other characterization of the Entity's state with respect to the Attribute.

An Agent avoids an Undesirable_situation under certain Circumstances. That situation may be an activity (e.g. going to school), or an entity (perhaps) metonymic for such an activity or situation (e.g. the curb). The situation may be undesirable from the Agent's point of view (e.g. evade), to someone else (e.g. forbear), or from the point of view of an external morality (e.g. abstain).
This FE identifies the Place where the avoiding occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the avoiding occurs.
This FE identifies the Purpose avoiding occurs.
This FE identifies the situation that the Agent avoids.
This FE identifies the Means by which avoiding occurs.
This FE identifies the Manner in which avoiding occurs.
This FE identifies the Circumstances under which the Undesirable_situation is avoided.
This FE identifies the Degree to which avoiding occurs.
This FE identifies the Reason for which avoiding occurs.

A Cognizer has a piece of Content in their model of the world. The Content is not necessarily present due to immediate perception, but usually, rather, due to deduction from perceivables. In some cases, the deduction of the Content is implicitly based on confidence in sources of information (believe), in some cases based on logic (think), and in other cases the source of the deduction is deprofiled (know). Note that this frame is undergoing some degree of reconsideration. Many of the targets will be moved to the Opinion frame. That frame indicates that the Cognizer considers something as true, but the Opinion (compare to Content) is not presupposed to be true; rather it is something that is considered a potential point of difference. In the uses that will remain in the Awareness frame, however, the Content is presupposed. Your boss is aware of your commitment.

The Cognizer is the person whose awareness of phenomena is at question. With a target verb or adjective the Cognizer is generally expressed as an External Argument with the Content expressed as an Object or Complement.
The Content is the object of the Cognizer's awareness. Content can be expressed as a direct object or in a PP Complement.
The source of awareness or knowledge which can be expressed in a PP Complement:
Some verbs in this frame allow a Topic to be expressed in about-PPs.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an event occurs.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Cognizer knows or thinks something.
Expressor is the body part that reveals the Cognizer's state to the observer.
Role is the category within which an element of the Content is considered.
This frame element identifies the Paradigm which serves as the basis for the Cognizer's awareness.
The time interval during which the Cognizer is aware of the Content.
The reason why or how it came to be that the Cognizer has awareness of the Topic or Content.
This frame covers a step in a criminal process in which a Judge decides whether the Accused should be released on bail, and, if so, what the amount of the bail should be.
At the time of bail setting, the Accused is held without bail/bond, released on his/her own recognizance, or required to give the Court a specific amount of money for bail.
The Judge, as head of the Court, determines the Accused's bail.
Status idenitifies the decision made with regard to bail. The possible statuses are "without bail/bond", "on one's own recognizance", or a specific amount of money required for bail.
This FE identifies the Time when the bail setting occurs.
This FE identifies the Place where the bail setting occurs.

Any description of the bail setting which is not covered by more specific FEs, including, secondary effects (openly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Judge that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The method used by the Judge to set the bail.
The purpose for which the Judge sets bail.

Two (or more) people (the Parties, also encodable as Party_1 and Party_2) have an agreement. Both sides are construed as having a commitment to an Obligation--the relationship is understood to be symmetrical or reciprocal. Instead of a specific mention of the Obligation, a Topic expression may be used to indicate the domain covered.

The individual or individuals that form the more prominent (i.e. agentive) party of the agreement, as compared with Party_2. That is, Party_1 is generally encoded as the External Argument of verbs, and peripheral FEs that do not make reference to the event itself generally make reference to Party_1. Thus Manner is construed to be that of Party_1, not necessarily that of Party_2 or the group of Parties as a whole.
The semantically (and grammatically) less prominent participant (or group of participants) in the agreement. It is generally encoded within a prepositional phrase (e.g. headed by with).
An expression of the commitment of the Parties .
Topic is a description of the domain covered by the agreement.
As with other frames in the Communication domain, the Medium of communication may be expressed. Medium is the physical entity or channel used to record or negotiate the Obligation.
The group of individuals portrayed as equally involved in having an agreement.
This FE identifies the Place where an agreement was made.
This FE identifies the Time when the agreement was made.
Any description of the agreement not specified by the other FEs, including particularly salient characteristics of the parties.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.

Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end. In many cases, the continuous situation is a dynamic action which is ongoing, while in others it is simply an undifferentiated state.
This FE describes a characteristic or description of the agreement_on_action.

The Cognizers have a similarity (or dissimilarity) in their Opinion. The Cognizers may be expressed separately, with Cognizer_2 being the basis for establishing the Opinion of Cognizer_1. Rather than a specific Opinion, a phenomenon about which a similar or differing Opinion is held, the Topic, may be specified. A specific Opinion may also go unmentioned when the Opinions of the Cognizers are understood as answers to a Question. Dr. Gerry and Mr. Pond agree in their impressions. This copyeditor and I mostly see eye to eye on things. I agree with you that everything should be monitored to keep the person from wasting time and protecting the interests of the company.
This FE marks constituents that express the set of Cognizers whose similarity of opinion is at issue.
When there is an asymmetry, Cognizer_1 is the individual characterized by their similarity in opinion to Cognizer_2, whose opinion is assumed to be known. Cognizer_1 is often an external argument.
When the Cognizers are expressed separately, Cognizer_2 is the one whose opinion is assumed to be known; it serves as a basis for establishing the opinion of Cognizer_1.

This FE denotes an implicit question in response to which the Cognizers give their Opinions, which are then assessed for their similarity. The Question may concern the identitiy of a particular entity, as in the first example below, or it may be of the yes/no-type, as in the second example below.
The extent to which the Cognizers are similar in their Opinions.
This FE identifies the Time when the Cognizers are in agreement or disagreement.
The Place is the general area in which the Cognizers are in agreement or disagreement.
This FE is for descriptions of the agreement state not covered by more specific FEs, especially characterizations of the state as a whole or of one of the Cognizers or Cognizer_1.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the agreement or disagreement logically follows.
This FE is used for any Depictive phrase describing the state of the Cognizers
A state of affairs believed by the Cognizers.
A phenomenon that the Cognizers are considering with respect to their Opinion.
The state-of-affiars under which aggreement occurs (as independent of the act of agreement).
A Controlling_entity is in conscious control over a Dependent_entity, Dependent_situation, or Dependent_variable.
A thing or person whose behavior controls a Dependent_situation, Dependent_variable, or Dependent_entity.
An entity, usually a thing, that is influenced in its behavior by an Controlling_entity or an Controlling_situation.
A situation that whose temporal or other characteristics are influenced by an Controlling_entity, Controlling_event, or Controlling_variable.
A scalar variable, whose value depends on the behavior of an Influencing_entity, a Influencing_variable, or an Influencing_situation.
The Degree to which the Controlling_entity effects the Dependent_entity.
The time at which the controlling occurs.
The location at which the controlling occurs.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Controlling_entity that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause.

A Part is considered to be a member of the set described by the Total. The relationship between Part and Total subset-superset rather than part-whole (as it is in the frames Part_whole and Including). Dr. Nelson numbers among the world?s foremost geotechnical engineering experts. Restaurant-Pizzeria Dante counts among the few restaurants of Florence where you can find good typical Tuscan and fish dishes and a first-class pizza.
The complex multi-part entity of which a constituent Part is specified.
This FE identifies the frequency with which the Part is included in the Total.
This FE indicates other totalities that the Part may also be a subset of.
This FE indicates the sub-location of the Total in which the Part is included. [MAY BE UNNECESSARY]
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
Any description of the inclusion event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
The Time at which the subset relation holds.
The Place at which the subset relation holds.

A Target_symbol in a Target_representation system is presented as equivalent to a Source_symbol in a Source_representation system in the ability to express a particular Content. The term employment area translates the French zone d'emploi. The term employment area translates the French zone d'emploi. The term translates the Russian raznorechie (literally "different-speech-ness"). The term translates the Russian raznorechie (literally "different-speech-ness".
A symbol or set of symbols representing the Content in the Source_representation format.
The representation system in which the Content pre-exists.
The period of time during which the translation equivalence holds.
The Circumstances are the set of conditions in which the translation is made.
A symbol or set of symbols representing the Content in the Target_representation format.
The representation system within which the Target_symbol is equivalent in its signification to the Source_symbol within the Source_representation system .
The information that is meant to be represented by the Source_symbol and Target_symbol.
An assessment of how equivalent the Source_representation and the Target_representation are.
A text in which the Target_symbol is used to render the Content of a Source_symbol.

A Protagonist has (or does not have) a Weapon. The Degree to which the Protagonist is armed may also be described. The Protagonist is normally a human but may be a device that has subsidiary weapons. Apparently, the suspect is armed with a shotgun. After she pulled the .45 from her sock drawer, she felt well enough armed to face anyone coming in. The Tomahawk missile packs a lot of heat . An individual with a right-to-carry license may continue to carry in a "school zone" in compliance with existing state and local laws. INI
The amount of Weapons that the Protagonist has (relative to some standard).
The destructive device that the Protagonist has with them.
The individual that possesses a Weapon.
The location where a Protagonist carries a Weapon.
The time at which the Protagonist carries a Weapon.
A Winner has victory over an Loser.
The individual or individuals who beat the Loser.
A quantity whereby progress is measured during the game, and Rank and Prizes are awarded to the Winner afterward.
The amount by which the Winner's and Loser's Scores differ.
The rank (according to Score) that a Winner acheives.
A socially and/or monetarily significant entity which is given to a Winner according to Score or Rank.
An action of the Winner or Loser that makes the beating event possible.

Any description of the Winner or Loser which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of a Winner or Loser that also affect their action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
When the Winner has victory over the Loser.
The location where the Winner has victory Loser.
This FE is for the named venue of a competition, particularly when the place has been built for the purpose of a competition.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
The reason why the Winner has victory over the Loser.
The length of time from when winning events began to be repeated to when they stopped.
The individual or individuals that get beat by the Winner.
The state of the world when the Winner beats the Loser.
The frame expressed by the target typically corresponds to a Means action within the frame expressed by the Re_encoding, but not necessarily.
The state-of-affairs that prevails as a result of the Winner beating the Loser.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times the Winner beats the Loser.
This FE modifies the target to indicate the legal- or other domain within which the winning event is considered true.
This FE applies to appraisals of the event, typically a judgment of its expectedness, or a description of the state-of-affairs introduced by the winning event.
A qualitative measure of how much the Winner beat the Loser.
This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action.
The event in which the Competition competes.
How often the Winner beats the Loser.

In this frame a Speaker ceases speaking, sometimes about a particular Topic. An Expressor may also be indicated. The words of this frame are very frequently used imperatively, to the extent that certain words and phrases (not another word, silence, shhh) can only be used this way. Finally, Jan shut up about his car accident. The children's laughter quieted down. Somehow, he managed to hold his tongue.
The Speaker has previously been speaking but has now stopped.
The Topic is the subject which the Speaker had been speaking about.
The Place is the location where the becoming silent occurs.
The Time is when the becoming silent occurs.
The Reasonis why the Speaker ceases speaking.
The Expressor is theSpeaker's voice or other communicative noise emitted by the Speaker.
The manner in which the quietening occurs.

An Entity ends up in a Final_state or Final_category which it was not in before. Why I became an Emacs user I Left The Ministry And Became An Atheist Surprisingly, various veteran organizations also turned vehemently antiwar. Over the years she became very much a part of the Sturtevant family.
A state of affairs that an intentional Entity is responding to by changing.
For how long the Entity remains in the Final_state or Final_category.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In cases where the Entity is intentional, Manner may indicate salient characteristics of an intentional Entity that also affect the event (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The Entity which undergoes a change, ending up in the Final_state or Final_category.
The state of the Entity after the event.
The category that the Entity ends up in after the event.
The period during which the Entity is in transition.
Any eventuality or entity which brings about the change of the Entity.
This FE describes the state of the Entity before becoming occurs.
This FE marks the set of conditions under which the Entity enters the Final_state or Final_category
This FE describes the category of the Entity before becoming occurs.
The Explanation for the occurance of the Becoming event.
The individual entities related to the Entity which are saliently affected by its change.

A New_member becomes a member of a socially-constructed Group. Seven new members and the three countries joined the alliance five years ago. Most new students enroll in a university without declaring a major. It represents every man and woman who has enlisted in the armed forces to protect our families and serve the community.
The New_member becomes a member of a (socially-defined) Group.
This FE identifies the place where the joining occurs.
This FE identifies the purpose for which the New_member joins the Group.
This FE identifies the time when the New_member joins the Group.
This FE identifies the Means by which the New_member becomes part of the group.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of a New_member that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The Frequency with which the New_member becomes a member of a Group.
The Group is a socially-constructed entity composed of members.
A factor that explains why the New_member joins the Group.
The capacity or role in which the New_member is placed upon joining the Group.
The state of the New_member when they join.

This FE denotes an event paired with that of the main clause, which explains why the event of the main clause is expected. In particular, reciprocation is used to indicate an action that is being rewarded or punished in the main clause, or an action that is paired with the action in the main clause as the other side of an agreement.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
This FE presents the current frame as an integral part of a larger conceptualization expressed by another frame. The frame expressed by the target typically corresponds to a Means action.

Words in this frame have to do with a Cognizer adding some Phenomenon to their model of the world. They are similar to Coming-to-believe words, except the latter generally involve reasoning from Evidence. The words in this frame take direct objects that denote entities in the world, and indicate awareness of those entities, without necessarily giving any information about the content of the Cognizer's belief or knowledge. These words also resemble perception words, since creatures often become aware of things by perceiving them. Later that night, they found the barely-alive victim inside the Red Hall estate flat. Almost immediately, the police discovered the wrought-iron crypt gate swinging open. In the bag on the tableI could vaguelydiscern two bottles of wine and several cartons of cakes and other goodies. People passing through recognize it from afar, by the clouds of coal dust darkening the air. General Grammatical Observations: Passive forms of the verbs in this frame can occur with extraposed clauses expressing Phenomenon: That year it was discovered that consumers preferred the older model. It is not always recognized how much work goes into a dinner party.
The Cognizer is the person who becomes aware of a Phenomenon. It is normally expressed as an External Argument.
Thm Phenomenon is the entity or situation in the world of which a Cognizer becomes aware. It is normally expressed as an Object:
The Ground is the background or context against which a Cognizer becomes aware of a Phenomenon. It is normally expressed by a locative PP:
The State indicates the state or situation of the Phenomenon at the time when the Cognizer becomes aware of it. It is normally expressed by a Predicate expression (e.g. a PP or a participial VP):
The Evidence is some fact that allows the Cognizer to become aware of something. It is normally expressed with PP-from:
This FE identifies the Degree to which becoming aware is occurring.
This FE identifes the Manner in which becoming aware occurs.
This FE identifes the Means by which the Cognizer becomes aware of the Phenomenon.
Topic indicates the general field within which the Phenomenon is found.
This FE identifies the Time when the Cognizer becomes aware of the Phenomenon.
The goal that the Cognizer has in mind, which they believe to be accomplishable by finding the Phenomenon.
The Cognizer uses an Instrument to (enable themselves to) become aware of the Phenomenon. In some cases, the Instrument may appear in subject position.
his frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
This FE is minimally distinct from Duration and Duration_of final_state in that the clause described is conveyed to be iterative.

The Becoming_detached frame covers two situations: a scene in which one thing comes to be physically detached from something else; or a scene in which two things come to be disconnected from each other. In the first, the frame includes an Item that detaches from a Source, creating an asymmetric relationship between the Item and the Source. In the second, the Items detach from each other, where each serves as a Source relative to the other, creating a symmetric relationship between the two Items. The Items that were formerly attached re-appear as the two separate or potentially separate entities that they were throughout.
This FE identifies the Item that detaches from the Source.
Source identifies the location to which an Item was attached before getting detached.
This FE identifies the plural Items that are becoming detached from each other, resulting in their separation. Notice that when the FE Items occurs, neither Item nor Source can occur.

Any description of the detaching event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
This FE identifies the Place where the Item becomes detached.
This FE identifies the Time when the Item becomes detached from the Source.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the Item ends up detached.
In general, this FE is used for phrases that describe the clause of the target as a whole.
An Entity loses moisture with the outcome of being in a dry state.
The Entity is the thing that loses moisture and becomes dry.
The intensity with which the Entity becomes dry.
The way in which the Entity becomes dry.
The location where the Entity becomes dry.
The situation in which the Entity is becoming dry.

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause.
This FE indicates that the visiting is a particular instance in a series of repeated visiting events.

A Whole separates into Parts, or one part of a whole, called Part_1, becomes separate from the remaining portion, Part_2. This small channel meanders through marsh and wetland, splitting into several smaller channels that empty into Lake St. Clair. Just crack one open and if the yoke quickly separates from the whites, they are probably bad.
The Whole is a single entity or an aggregate of entities which separates into Parts.
This refers collectively to the Parts resulting from separation of a Whole:
Part-1 is the first of two Parts mentioned.
Part_2 is the second of two Parts mentioned. This is usually a PP Complement.

This frame element expresses a property of the Parts or components of the Whole which correlates with the separation. Criterion is typically expressed as a PP headed by by, or as a complex PP of the form on the basis of....
This FE identifies any Depictive phrase describing the undergoers of the separation.
An intermediate action or event that enables the separation.
This FE identifies the Result of an event.
This FE identifies the Time when the separation occurs.

Artists work at various tasks that further the completion of a film, play, television show, or other similar Production. Artists never appear on stage or in front of a camera. Some (e.g., a director) may interact with the actors (on-screen participants) of the Production. Often times a particular Production is made for distribution by a Distributor, by a particular Studio, or in a specific Medium. The Artists may be categorized into Type or work in specific Medium. Steven Spielberg directed several films for Universal Pictures. Universal Pictures and Amblin Entertainment produced Jurassic Park for MCA. Surprisingly, this film producer was willing to work for a cable company. Independent producers often win big at smaller film festivals.
The Artist works off-stage to help make the Production.
The Production is the final product put out by the off-stage (and on-stage) participants.
An Artist may be categorizedy by Type.
Often (especially with film or television) the Production is advertised and transmitted to the audience by the Distributor.
This FE indicates the particular orgainzaion that makes the Production.
This FE indicates the Medium in which a particular Artist works or a Production is made.
This FE indicates the time when the Production is made.
This FE indicates the location of production.
This FE indicates the Nationality, ethnicity, or primary working location of the Artist.
The Purpose for which an Artist works on a Production.
In screen performances, the Performer is filmed as he or she acts out a role with respect to the larger Production
The music which may be performed in the performance of the Production, either in isolation or accompanying actions and speech.
A Scene is a sub-part of a larger production. In film, scenes are sometimes recorded independently, and later edited into the final movie.
The Manner in which the Artist creates the Production.

An Agent is described as pursuing an Activity, expending some effort. The Agent may be active in a particular Role. Alternatively, the Activity itself may be described as having an Agent who is expending effort. In some cases, the Activity may involve a Salient_entity which may stand in for it. Sky, a Korean War veteran, was active in his opposition to Vietnam and continues to protest current combat in Iraq. She is active in the community by establishing parent groups, life skills program, sharing circles and various Aboriginal cultural activities for young women.. John Colville was quite active as a land speculator in both Virginia and Maryland.
This FE identifies the amount of Time for which an Activity is ongoing.
This FE identifies the name of the ongoing Activity in which an Agent engages.
This FE identifies the Place where the Activity is pursued.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Agent is engaged in an ongoing Activity.
This FE identifies the Time when the Activity is pursued.

Any description of the Activity which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that affect the action (presumptuously, deliberately).
The Agent engages in an ongoing Activity.
An entity acted upon by the Agent.
This FE identifies the role filled by the Agent which is saliently associated with an Activity.
The Degree to which the Agent or Salient_entity is active.
In general, this FE is used for phrases that describe the clause of the target as a whole. There are two somewhat distinct subgroups of sentence modifiers that cover this function.

This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often. It is to be distinguished from Iteration, which pertains simply to the number of times an event occurs-Iteration expressions answer the question how many times.

This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action. The depicted state does not necessarily or usually facilitate or cause the state of affairs reported by the target.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.

An Asset is in a state where it is exposed to or otherwise liable to be affected by a Harmful_event, which may be metonymically evoked by reference to a Dangerous_entity. Words expressing relative safety (i.e., lack of risk) are also in this frame. If you are a farmer, you are at risk for hearing loss caused by noise exposure in your work. No child is secure from the temptation to do what "my friends" are doing. Our nation is making a disastrous mistake thinking that we can have security from people: There is only security with people. You don't have security against impersonation unless you have security against eavesdropping.
Something judged to be desirable or valuable which might be lost or damaged.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the actual level of security from the expected value given the Asset and the state indicated by the target itself.
An action that may occur or a state which may hold which could result in the loss of or damage to the Asset.
A concrete or abstract entity which may come to cause the loss of, or damage to the Asset either due to its participation in a Harmful_event.
A particular location in which the Asset is secure. Frequently, it is to be inferred that the characteristics of the location protect the Asset from a potential Harmful_event.
The time period during which the Asset enjoys the specified level of security from a Harmful_event.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the state of security or insecurity of the Asset logically follows.
The Situation under which the Asset is safe or unsafe.
The Domain in which the Asset has a degree of safety.
This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often.

Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end. In many cases, the continuous situation is a dynamic action which is ongoing, while in others it is simply an undifferentiated state.

An Item is attached by a Handle, via a Connector, to a Goal, or Items are attached to each other. There may be a Dependent_state, which depends crucially on Item(s) being attached. My thumb was stuck to the tube of glue. The prisoner's legs were shackled.
Connector identifies the instrument used to attach and is usually expressed in a with-PP.
Handle identifies the point of attachment on the Item.
Item identifies the entity that comes to be attached to the Goal.
Items identifies the plural items that are tied together, resulting in their mutual attachment.
Goal identifies the location to which the Item(s) is attached.
Dependent_state identifies the state of the Item or Itemswhich depends on the existence of the attachment.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an Item is in an attached state to a Goal, or two Items are attached to each other.
A Protagonist is awake at some Time and Place. This entails the Protagonist having a higher general level of awareness of the surroundings than when asleep.
The entity that is not sleeping.
This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Protagonist is awake.
This FE identifies the Time when the Protagonist is awake.
The degree to which the Protagonist is awake.
Any description of the Protagonist being awake which is not covered by more specific FEs including secondary effects (quietly, noisily), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
This frame concerns the inception of the life of a Child, generally human, at a particular Time and Place. The Relatives may also be mentioned.
Child identifies the new self-motile creature.
This FE identifies the Time when the birth occurs, generally expressed as a date or a year.
The location where the Child enters the world.

The individuals that the Child is related to, including the male and female individuals that come together to produce a Child (the parents), as well those who are related to them by birth or marriage.
The state of the Child as it enters the world.
The way in which the Child leaves the womb; this FE is typically only filled by phrases such as by natural birth or by Caesarian.

An Item is detached from a Source, or Items are detached from each other. When the snow plow is disconnected from the vehicle, extend the lift cylinder to the end of its stroke and coat the chrome rod with a light grease. The gold leaves that are unattached to the engraved surfaces fall off. By 5:00 to 5:30 (depending on the time of year) the boat is unmoored and loaded.
Item identifies the entity that is detached from a Source.
Items identifies the plural items that are detached from each other.
Source identifies the location from which the Item(s) is detached.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an Item is in an detached state relative to a Source, or two Items are detached from each other.
An Item is in a state of dryness. The shingles are dry. The apple is completely dehydrated. The mop is dry.
The Item exists in a state of dryness.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the Item is dry.
Subregion identifies the affected part of the larger whole.

An Employee has a Position doing work in a particular Field, or doing work on a particular Task, for which an Employer gives Compensation to the Employee. Undocumented foreigners are working as building contractors for Laing Builders.
The Compensation is the payment that the Employee receives for performing a Task.
The Employee is obligated to perform a Task in order to receive Compensation.
The Employer gives Compensation to an Employee.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an Employee works for an Employee.
This FE identifies the Place_of_employment of the Employee.
The label given to a particular type of employment.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Employer is in employment.
The Employee is obligated to perform the Task to recieve Compensationfrom the Employer.
This FE identifies the Time period during which an Employee works for an Employer.
This FE identifies the Field in which one works.
This FE identifies the amount of Time for which the Employee continues being employed.
Rank is the position in a hierarchy that an Employee occupies within the organization of the Employer.
This FE identifies the Type of the profession.
The Contract_basis describes the conditions of employment with respect to permanency, hours per time period, or payment basis.
The amount of work the Employee is doing for the Employer.
The location where the Employee works.
This FE gives a description of the Being_employed event.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
An Item belongs to a Category, as (often implicitly) conceived of by a Cognizer.
This is the person who performs an act of categorization. Typically, this frame element is expressed as an oblique.
This is the entity which is is an instance of a particular Category. Typically, the Item is expressed as the external argument.
This frame element expresses a general type or class of which the Item is considered an instance. Typically, it is expressed in a prepositional phrase headed by as or under.

This frame element expresses properties of the Item which is used as a basis for categorization. Criteria are the general dimensions along which Items can potentially differ from one another and hence, fall into different Categorys. For example, a paint sample can be classified by color or by finish (matte or gloss); if they are classified by color, one can be classified as orange and another as red. The Criteria FE is typically expressed as a PP headed by by, or as a complex PP of the form on the basis of...:
The Manner in which an Item (metaphorically) is construed as being in a Category.
An act or state of affairs by which the Item (perhaps metaphorically) is interpreted as being in a Category.
This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate when a certain Categorization holds.
The Circumstances are the set of conditions in which the categorization holds.

A particular Binding_principle is (or is not) operative, that is, any obligations, restrictions, and any other aspects of the Binding_principle are (or are not) in effect. The Binding_principle can be expressed as being in effect for a particular Duration, or at a particular Time or Place, or under certain Circumstances. This law will only become in effect during the last three weeks of the year. The statutory wetlands definition is effective immediately. This contract is binding on all parties. Although the in effect is properly in this frame, (put) into effect is analyzed in the Execute_plan frame. This is in part because to put an (evacuation) plan into effect is to actually execute the plan (to evacuate), while to put a plan in effect is to determine that in the future the plan may have to executed, i.e., to make the plan binding. Similar observations can be made for come into effect.
The Binding_principle is the law, contract, principle, or other (set of) obligations that is (or is not) operational.
The length of time for which the Binding_principle is or is not in effect.
The Time at which the Binding_principle is in effect.
The Place at which the Binding_principle is or is not operational.
The state-of-affairs under which the Binding_principle is/isn't operational.
A cause, reason, or other explanation for the status of the Binding_principle
The individual or group who is obligated to follow the Binding_principle.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.

A Device or machine is in (or out of) service. Note that being broken or functional is a separate issue from being turned on or off. This latter notion is what the present frame is concerned with. The Time when and the Place where the Device is in use may be specified, as may be the Purpose a backgrounded human User had in turning the Device on or off. The TV is on The lights were off when I came by.
The Device or machine that is in or out of operation.
The Time when a Device is in or out of operation.
The Place in which the Device is or is not operating.
Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
A Part is profiled as being a subset or constituent subpart of a Whole. This is in contrast to Inclusion frame, wherein the same relation is seen from the point of view of the Whole.
The Whole is the larger entity that includes the Part.
The Part is either a subset or a constituent part of the Whole.
A Theme is in a stable position with respect to a Location. Our offices are located about two miles south of I-85 .
An entity which is at a particular Location
The location (generally presumed to be known to the interlocutor) with respect to which the location of the Theme can be understood.
A state (of the Theme) that results as a consequence of the Theme being situated at the Location.
The time at which the Theme is at the Location.
A salient entity that the Theme is located with respect to.
This frame element is used to denote phrases that specifically entail an entity which is conceived as moving relative to another entity.
This frame concerns entities conventionally being referred to by particular names. Her name was Lola. People call me Zvonimir
Name identifies the linguistic expression used to refer to Entities.
The Entity is the person the speaker intends to refer to by using a particular name.
The FE Speaker is the person using the name of the Entity.
Name_source is used for a person or thing to whose name the Name of the Entity is related.
The FE Type denotes sub-type of names.

A Dependent state-of-affairs has a Requirement as a prerequisite for obtaining or occurring. The atomic bombings were probably not necessary to win WWII without a mainland invasion of Japan. We will take the required measures, regardless of the yelping of the left. DNI Two tokens are necessary for county to county trips.
The state-of-affairs which cannot hold without the Requirement.
The entity or state-of-affairs that must be present or obtain in order for the Dependent to obtain.
The extent to which the Dependent depends on the presence of the Requirement.
The state-of-affairs which militates that the Requirement is necessary for the Dependent to obtain.
The time at which the Requirement is necessary for the Dependent.
The conditions under which the the Requirement is necessary.
The field of endeavor whose nature imposes the Requirement.
Place denotes a location in which the specified relation between Requirement and Dependent holds.
The individual who needs to have the Required_entity or for the Requirement state of affairs to obtain.
An entity that has to be present for the Dependent state of affairs to obtain
An characteristic or feature of the Requirement or Required_entity.

Under some Condition, usually left implicit, a Responsible_party is required to perform some Duty. If they do not perform the Duty, there may be some undesirable Consequence, which may or may not be stated overtly. NB: Contrast this frame with Likelihood and Preconditions frames, which involve many of the same lemmas. This country must support its citizens' right to express themselves. I gotta get going or I'll be late for the concert.
The person who must perform the Duty.
The action that the Responsible_party is obligated to perform.
This FE indicates the Conditions under which the Responsible_party is obligated to perform the Duty.
The Consequence will result if the Duty is not performed.
The time interval during which the Responsibly_party is obligated to fulfill the Duty.
A location in which the Responsible_party has a specified Duty .
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.

Under some Condition, usually left implicit, a Duty needs to be fulfilled by a Responsible_party. If the Duty is not performed, there may be some undesirable Consequence for the Responsible_party, which may or may not be stated overtly. Compare this frame to the Being_obligated frame. It would behoove us to comprehend and personalize what Jesus had to tell his disciples Fressed too much at the obligatory BBQ. INI When I was in HS, marching band was mandatory in order to participate in any of the other ensembles INI Should insurance be compulsory?
This FE indicates the Condition under which the Duty is required of the Responsible_party.
The Consequence will result if the Duty is not performed.
The action that the Responsible_party is obligated to perform.
The person who must perform the Duty.
The time interval during which the Duty is mandatory.
A location in which the Duty obtains.
The positive consequence of the Duty being fulfilled.
The reason why the Duty is necessary for the Responsible_party.
An Artifact, either a machine or a network of operations, is in a state ready to perform its intended function.
The device that no longer works.
The extent to which the Artifact exceeds or falls short of the minimum requirements for being operational.
An organic item, the Undergoer, has undergone the natural process of rotting and decaying with a possible expression of the Degree to which the rotting has occurred. The coconut milk became rancid.
The Undergoer is the organic matter that has decayed.
This FE identifies the Degree to which rotting has occurred.

An Entity can bear a great outer force so as to resist destruction and damage. The great and impregnable fortress still stands today. His heart is by no means strong, so he should ease into his exercise regime.
The Entity is the item that cannot be penetrated.
This FE describes the intensity and extent of the Entity's strength.
The way in which the Entity is strong.
The action by Entity earns its strength.
The location where the Entity has strength.
The Time when the Entity is strong.
The reason why the Entity has strength.
The Force is the power against which the Entity has strength.
The state and conditions of the world when the Entity is strong.

This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action. The depicted state does not necessarily or usually facilitate or cause the state of affairs reported by the target. In some cases, the Depictive describes the participant by characterizing a subpart.

An Entity meets the pre-conditions for participating in an Activity that is judged to be difficult for it to participate in, either due to inherent properties of the Entity or temporary Circumstances. A Degree modifier may indicate by how much the Entity exceeds or falls short of the minimum requirements.
The Entity whose meeting or falling short of pre-conditions is assessed.
The Activity that the Entity may participate in.
The extent to which the Entity exceeds or falls short of the minimum requirements for participating in the Activity.
The Circumstances under which the Entity meets or fails to meet the pre-conditions.
An entity, event, or state that causes the Entity to meet or fail to meet the pre-conditions for participating in an Activity.
A characteristic or behavior of the Entity that is considered when judging whether the Entity might participate in the Activity.
An Item is in a state of wetness with the possibility of the wetting Liquid being mentioned, along with the Degree of wetness. The mop is drenched with water from last night's rain.
The Item takes up the Liquid through its pores.
The Liquid is a fluid or gas that permeates the Item. It most frequently occurs in a PP Complement headed by with.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the Item is wet.
The Cause brings about the state of wetness, and is usually expressed in a from-prepositional phrase.
The Subregion describes which part of a larger whole is being affected.

An Assailant, a group of armed forces, surrounds the Victim, a military location and the people within it, in an attempt to cut the Victim off from the outside, with the goal of either forcing their surrender or weakening them so that an invasion would be successful. A successful siege is often followed by the Assailant taking control of (the land held by) the Victim. Towards the end of the summer, a great English host besieged the Danish fort of Tempsford and took it, killing the last Danish king of East Anglia.

The Assailant is a group of armed forces (or, metonymically, their commander or the organization they represent) that encircles, surrounds, or otherwise cuts off the Beseiged in an attempt to force surrender.
The Victim is the fortification or geopolitical entity that is being attacked.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Assailant that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An intentional action performed by the Assailant that accomplishes the assault.
This FE identifies the place where the Assailant makes an assault on the Victim.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Assailant attacks the Victim.

The starting-point of the motion of the Assailant or projectiles of the Assailant as they move toward the the Place that the Victim is occupying in the attack. In prepositional phrases, the prepositional object expresses the starting point of motion. With particles, the starting point of motion is understood from context.
This FE identifies the time when the Assailant attacks the Victim.
An entity used by the Assailant to cause damage to the Victim.
The Path refers to (a part of) the ground over which the Assailant travels.
The length of time that the Victim is under attack from the Assailant

Compared to its Competitors, a Standard is at the high end of a scale with respect to some Variable. The Competitors are frequently not realized syntactically. The taxpayer is supporting a system unmatched in wastefulness . The drawing room was a place of unmatched squalor. She was envious of her mother's matchless beauty. When there is no overt Variable it must be understood from the context. He was unmatched by any other politician of his time. When the target occurs as the modifier of a predicate nominal, it is tagged as Standard, rather than Variable. They were matchless needlers of each other.
The Standard is the entity that is located closest to the end of the scale evoked by some Variable.
The Variable is a property that evokes a scale along which the Standard is located closest to one extreme in comparison to its Competitors.
The FE Competitors denotes the entities that are exceeded by the Standard with regard to the Variable.
The spatial or temporal context in which the Standard is not matched by any Competitors.
This frame contains words that denote large ecological areas as well as smaller locations characterized by the type of life present--in other words, geography locations as defined by biota.
Container_possessor is the location of which the Locale is a part.
Formational_cause brings about the features of the Locale.
This FE identifies a stable bounded area, and is typically the designation of the nouns of Locale-derived frames.
This FE indicates the Names of Locales.
Relative_location identifies a place in respect to which a Locale is located.
Any description, characteristic, or property of the Locale which is not covered by more specific FEs.

An Experiencer is in a State where a biological urge is signaling the need to perform a certain action such as eating, drinking, stopping exertion, sleeping, regurgitating, or having sex. The Duration, Time, Place, or Degree of intensity associated with the occurrence of the urge may also be indicated. In this frame, the Experiencer does not necessarily want to perform the action that would fulfill the urge, and there is no specific focus associated with the urge. Mike feels hungry. Sam was thirsty after dinner.
Degree identifies the extent to which the Experiencer receives the biological signal.
The Experiencer receives the biological signal and possesses the internal experience which is a reaction to the phsyical signal.
This FE identifies the Time when the Experiencer feels the biological signal. Time may also allow inference about the Reason for the biological urge.
This FE identifies the Place is where the Experiencer feels the biological signal.
Expressor is used for a gesture, expression, or body part indicating that the Experiencer is feeling a certain urge.
Duration identifies the amount of time for which the Experiencer feels the urge.
This FE identifies the Reason for which the Experiencer has the biological urge.
State identifies the Experiencer's state of being.
Parameter is the particular biological realm in which the Experiencer feels the urge.
A Mother and Father produce a Child or an Egg. Betty bore Gerry three intelligent daughters.
Mother is the female creature that produces the Child.
Child identifies the new self-motile creature produced from the Mother and Father.
Father is the male creature that copulates with the Mother, thus leading to the birth of the Child.
This FE identifies the Place where the event occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the event occurs.
Depictive identifies the phrase describing a participant of an action
This FE identifies the Circumstances under which a Mother and Father produce produce a Child.
Egg is an immobile object containing an organism that may hatch as a mobile, infant organism.
This FE identifies the Means by which the event occurs.
The Mother and Father expressed together.
This FE identifies the Result of the birth.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of the Parents (or a Father or Mother) that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).

A Traveller boards a Vehicle that they intend to use as a means of transportation either as a passenger or as a driver. On the 5th of December, 1834, we embarked on board the merchant ship Hellespont. She boarded the train ahead of him. On 19 September the battalion embussed and headed southward into the Swordfish training area some 40 miles away.
The Traveller is the entity which boards the Vehicle.
The Vehicle is the intended means of conveyance of the Traveller.
Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion outside of or off the Vehicle expresses the frame element Source.
The Manner describes a property of the motion not related to its trajectory.
The Path describes the trajectory of the Traveller's motion onto the Vehicle.
The amount of time the Traveller spends on the Vehicle after boarding it.
The state of the Traveller or Vehicle during the boarding.
When the boarding of the Vehicle takes place.
A theme that rides in the same Vehicle as the main Traveller. This may be an entity the Traveller transports or a co-traveller moving under their own power.
The Purpose for which the Traveller boards the vehicle.
The location in which the Traveller boards the Vehicle.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
This frame concerns the decorations that human beings have on or apply to their bodies. Abby rarely wears lipstick.
This FE identifies the location on the body where the decoration takes place.
This is the individual whose body is decorated.
Decoration is the decorative item that adorns the body.
Dec_desc identifies a descriptor of the Decoration.
This is the frame element that describes what shape the Decoration represents.
This FE identifies the Use to which a body decoration is put.
