The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
An agent acts so as to cause some process to begin again after an interruption or suspension.
A sentient being acts with the intention of causing a process to begin again.
The process which begins again after a suspension.
The period of time during which the process is suspended.
The time at which the process is restarted.
An animate or inanimate entity, a force, or event that causes the process to resume. Volitionality is not a necessary characteristic of Causes.
The location where the Agent causes the Process to resume.
The intentional act performed by the Agent that results in the resumption of the Process.
A description of the manner in which the Agent causes the resumption of the Process.
The length of time for which the Process continues after being started by the Agent.
An Undergoer, which is an organic substance, undergoes the natural process of decay due to a Cause (or Agent).
The Agent intentionally brings about the decay of the Undergoer.
A depictive phrase describing the actor of an action.
The Result of causing the Undergoer to rot.
An act performed by an Agent, or a sub-event centered around a Cause that leads it to cause the Undergoer to rot.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The time at which the Cause causes the Undergoer to rot.
The location at which the Cause acts upon the Undergoer.
An event which causes the Undergoer to rot.
The Agent may use an instrument to bring about the rotting.

A Cause, animate or inanimate, causes a process, the Effect, to begin. The murder of Sergei Kirov set off a chain of events that culminated in the Great Terror of the 1930s. Ressam planned to set a bomb off at the Los Angeles International Airport. Space email sparked astronaut jealousy. A crime surge in a former coal town prompted a crackdown on illegal immigrants.
An animate or inanimate entity, a force, or event that produces an effect. Volitionality is not a necessary characteristic of Causes.
This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate the process that the Cause initiates.
This FE identifies the Place where the Effect occurs.
The Means is the way in which the Cause causes the process to begin.
This FE is for the Time when causing to start occurs
Medium is the physical or abstract setting in which the Cause results in the Effect.
To what end the Cause caused the Effect.
This FE identifies the first Subevent of the started Effect.
The way in which the Cause causes the Effect.
This FE modifies the target to indicate the legal- or "by rule" domain within which it is true or operational.
The reason why or the way in which the Cause causes the Effect.
The state of the world at the time when the Cause produces the Effect.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
A consecutive event to the starting of the Effect.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause.
This FE identifies the Depictive phrase describing the actor or undergoer of an action.
This FE applies to appraisals of the event, typically a judgment of its expectedness
An Agent or Cause causes a Sleeper to transition from the Sleep_state to wakeful consciousness.
The person or being that is sleeping.
The Agent is the person performing the intentional act.
This FE identifies the Instrument with which an Agent intentionally affects a Patient.
This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent intentionally affects a Patient.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent wakes the Sleeper.
This FE identifies the Reason for which an intentional act is performed. Mary woke him because he looked troubled.
An animate or inanimate entity, a force, or event that produces an effect. Volitionality is not a necessary characteristic of Causes.
This describes the state out of which the Sleeper is awakened.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The degree to which the Sleeper ends up awake.
Concrete or abstract entity that does not exist after the event.
This is the Place where the new Entity ceases to exist.
This FE identifes the Time when a new Entity ceases to be.
This FE labels the Cause of the destruction or disappearance of the Entity.
This FE identifies the components into which the Entity dissipates.
This FE identifies the length of time before the Entity comes into existence again.
The aspect of the Entity which no longer exists.
This FE identifies the Period_of_Iterations during which habitual or iterative actions are performed.
The way in which the Entity disappears.
The completeness of the disappearance of the Entity
This frame concerns a Cognizer's certainty about the correctness of beliefs or expectations. It only includes uses where a Cognizer is expressed. Lermontov was certain he would come to the party.
The Cognizer is the person whose certainty or uncertainty is at issue.
The Topic is the entity that a Cognizer has a certain/uncertain belief about.
The Content denotes the mental content that the Cognizer is certain or uncertain about.
This FE indicates the Degree to which the Cognizer is certain or uncertain.
The FE Manner denotes the manner of the certainty or uncertainty.
The Expressor is the body part or action by a body part that conveys the mental state of the Cognizer.

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause.
The reason for which the Cognizer is certain.

A Theme that is in motion assumes a new Direction in which it moves. We took our chances and turned right by a petrol station and, bingo, there she was--Fir Park. Molly followed silently as Desmond left the large paneled hall and turned right through a swing door into a long, bare corridor. Cross O'Connell Bridge and continue along D'Olier Street, make a right turn onto College Street. CNI Go past the unattended guardhouse, and take a sharp left turn down the ramp. CNI Take the elevator to the sixth floor and make two lefts. CNI

This is the object which moves. In many sentences this FE will be expressed as something which moves under its own power. However, this FE is not required to be an animate mover, so it is different from a self-mover.
Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion expresses the frame element Source.
Any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal (see below) expresses the frame element Path, excluding directional expressions.
Any expression which indicates where the Theme ends up as a result of the change of direction.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In agentive frames, it may indicate salient characteristics of an intentional Theme that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An event involving the Theme that results in the Theme moving in the specified way.
The Speed is the rate at which the Theme changes direction.
This is the second moving object, expressed as a direct object or an oblique:
A phrase describing the state of the Theme during the act of changing direction.
The Place is the setting where the change of direction during the Theme's motion occurs.
The configuration formed by the Path that the Theme traverses during the change of direction.
The new direction in which the Theme continues its motion.
The time at which the change of direction takes place.
The state-of-affairs that the Theme wishes to bring about.
The device or bodypart that serves to move the Theme.
A factor which explains the change of direction of the Theme.
An event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at the time the change of direction occurs and which the change of direction is taken to be a part of.
The number of times that a change of direction occurs.

A larger conceptualization that includes the change of direction as an integral part. The change of direction expressed by the target typically corresponds to a Means action in this larger conceptualization.
An unexpected event that affects the Theme, which is enabled by, and occurs after, the change of direction.

The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the change of direction event itself and any of its participants, and is merely peripherally related to the event as a whole.
The angle between the old and the new Direction in which the Theme moves.
The situation that results from the change of direction

In this frame, an Agent or Cause changes the duration of an Event. The Event will then take place for a New_duration, rather than the Initial_duration. This can be done with by certain Means, in a certain Manner or to a certain Degree. Don't let him prolong the discussion to an absurd length. Harsh weather made it necessary to cut the tour short from its original four months to three. CNI
The sentient entity that changes the duration of the Event.
The new duration of the Event.
The planned duration of the Event before the change takes place.
The time at which the change in duration of the Event is caused.
The extent to which the initial and final durations differ from each other.

Any description of the event causing the change of the Event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Agent that also affect the action (deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in bringing about the change of duration.
An event that causes the change in Event duration.
An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by changing the duration of the Event.
An intentional action performed by the Agent (or event resulting from the Cause) that produces a change in the Event's duration.

In this frame, an Agent or Cause changes the timing of an Event. The Event will then take place at the Destination_time or with respect to a Destination_event. This can be done with by certain Means, in a certain Manner or to a certain Degree.
The Agent is the animate entity which brings about the change in time of the Event.
The Cause is the non-sentient force which brings about the change of time for the Event.
TheEvent is the occurrence which changes time.
The Manner is the way in which the time change takes place.
The Means describe the way in which the time change is accomplished.
The Degree is the extent to which the time change takes place.
The Destination_event is the occasion which the timing of the Event occurs with respect to.
The Destination_time is the time at which the Event actually occurs.
The Interval between the Landmark_time and the Destination_time may be expressed.
The Landmark_time is when the Event was originally intended to take place.
The Reason is the reason or explanation for why the Event occurs at a different time.
The state-of-affairs that the Agent intends to bring about by changing the time the Event will take place.
The time at which the delay occurred.
The location at which the expected time of the Event changes.

In this frame an Undergoer changes its consistency. There may be a Initial_state and a Result. Note that this frame contrasts with Change_of_phase in that this frame describes a change in an Undergoer within a particular phase (solid, gas, liquid). The blood congealed. The liquid gelled into a semi-solid mass.
This FE indicates the Result of the change of consistency of the Undergoer
This is the original state of the Undergoer.
Undergoer is the entity that undergoes a change.
Where the the Undergoer changes consistency.
The Reason for which the Undergoer changes consistency.
The Speed at which the change of consistency occurs.
This FE identifies the Circumstances at which the consistency change occurs.
The Manner in which the Undergoer changes consistency.
Degree to which the Undergoer changes consistency.
The Subregion describes which part of a larger whole is being affected.

This frame concerns the appointment of a New_leader or removal from office of an Old_leader. The Selector brings about the change in leadership, for example, by electing or overthrowing a leader. Some words in the frame describe the successful removal from office of a leader (e.g. depose, oust), others simply the attempt (e.g. uprising, rebellion). On March 17 , Mamedov appointed Rakhim Gasiyev as Defence Minister .
The Selector (most commonly a group of people) is responsible for a change in leadership. Typically, it occurs as the External Argument of verbs.

With words denoting removal (or attempted removal) from office of a leader, the Old_leader is typically the direct object of verbs, or occurs in a PP Complement with noun targets, frequently headed by the preposition against.
With words denoting appointment to a position, the New_leader is typically the object of verbs.

Frequently the Old_leader or New_leader is referred to only by his/her role. However, the Role can be expressed separately from the leader, usually as either a secondary predicate or in a PP Complement.
The FE Old_order identifies the political order that existed before the change of leadership occurs.
This FE indicates the Degree to which an event occurs.
Depictive indicates the state of one of the participants during the action.
This FE is used for the Manner of performing an action.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Selector accomplishes the change of leadership.
This FE is used for indicating the Result of an event.
This frame element describes the situation that brought about the change of leadership.
The Function is the purpose the New_leader will fufill.
A group of individuals who are elected or appointed to perform some function of governance.

In this frame an Undergoer undergoes a change of phase. Note that this frame contrasts with Change_of_consistency in that this frame describes a change of an Undergoer between different phases (i.e. solid to liquid or frozen to "unfrozen"). The water froze. The rock solidifies from its molten state. The lake froze solid. The lake froze into ice. The lake froze to depths of 30 feet.
Undergoer is the entity that undergoes a change of phase.
The FE Result indicates the result of the change of phase.
This is the original state of the Undergoer.
Degree to which the Undergoer changes phase.
The Speed at which the change of phase occurs.
The Manner in which the Undergoer changes phase.
This FE identifies the Time at which the Undergoer changes phase.
This FE identifies the Circumstances at which the phase change occurs.
The Subregion describes which part of a larger whole is being affected.
The sequence of events in which the Undergoer begins as one state of matter and ends up as another.
The Undergoer is the entity that undergoes a change of phase.
The FE Result indicates the result of the change of phase.
This is the original state of the Undergoer.
Degree to which the Undergoer changes phase.
The Speed at which the change of phase occurs.
The Manner in which the Undergoer changes phase.
This FE identifies the Time at which the Undergoer changes phase.
This FE identifies the Circumstances at which the phase change occurs.
The Subregion describes which part of a larger whole is being affected.

This frame describes a general situation in which an Owner either increases or decreases their amount of a Possession. The increase or decrease may either be physical or metaphorical. The plant lost water as the the temperature increased. Gaining leadership experience is one of the benefits of being a camp counselor. CNI
The Owner is the entity that contains within itself or controls the Possession.
The Possession is the physical or metaphoric object that increases or decreases in quantity.
The Time when the Possession undergoes a change in quantity.
The Place where the Possession undergoes a change in quantity.
The Degree of the change in quantity.
This FE denotes a proposition from which the event of increasing or decreasing in quantity logically follows.
The endstate of a simple event X-schema.
The initial state of a simple event X-schema.
This frame denotes simple Events in which an Entity punctually or continually changes in the direction of the Endstate.
This FE identifies Reason for which an event occurs.
Name of the event which occurs.

A Device or machine is put in (or out of) service either by a volitional Agent or by a Cause event or force acting on the Device. The Time when and the Place where the Device is put in or out of use may be specified, as may be the Purpose of the human Agent in changing the operational state of the Device. The laborer realized that he activated the machine but did not know how to stop it.
The Device or machine that is in or out of operation.
The Time when a Device is put into or out of operation.
The Place in which the Device is put into or out of operation.
The Agent is the person who changes the operational state of the Device.
Cause identifies the non-agentive force that causes the Device to begin to operate.
The FE Purpose denotes a state of affairs that the Agent wants to bring about by putting the Device into operation.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the event of the Device's being caused to operate or cease to operate logically follows.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In agentive uses, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The degree to which the Device is active after the action.

This frame consists of words that indicate the change of an Item's position on a scale (the Attribute) from a starting point (Initial_value) to an end point (Final_value). The direction (Path) of the movement can be indicated as well as the magnitude of the change (Difference). The rate of change of the value (Speed) is optionally indicated. Another scale (Correlate), which the values are correlated with, is indicated if it is not the default correlate (namely, absolute time). The distinction between Attributes and Items is not always an easy one. The clear cases involve the expression of the Attribute in an in-PP. Hawke's Bay winery doubled in size last year. The amount you can deduct, then, depends on whether or not the stock has increased in value during the period you have owned it. Other clear cases of Attributes involve NP's like size, quality, number, value that denote abstract attributes rather than events or classes of things. The analysis is more complicated when an event-denoting noun phrase occurs as the subject and the sentence has no in-PP. In the simplest cases, where the Attribute is the number of occurrences of the event, the Attribute is usually left implicit, as in exx. 1 and 2, the Attribute below. (1)Accidents increased 20% to 345. (1--second FE layer)Accidents increased 20% to 345. (2) Attacks on civilians decreased over the last 4 months DNI. In cases like (1), we will tag the Attribute on the second layer below the Final_value label, as that FE makes it clear that the Attribute is simply cardinality. In cases like (2), we tag it as DNI because in context the hearer has to understand a particular Attribute rather than just some or any appropriate Attribute of the Item. Note that the above pattern can be compared to cases involving tangible Items, where the Attribute may similarly be missing when the incidence or frequency of the Item is specified. (3) Woodland birds increasedto their highest level since 1990 DNI. A more complicated case involving event-denoting subjects is when the Attribute measured is not the incidence of the type of event specified but rather an Attribute of an event-participant. In (4), it is not the number of times that turbot was caught that has changed but the amount of fish caught. (4) Turbot catches increased from around 100 tonnes in the 1960s to around 1,200 tonnes in the mid 1990s. (4-second FE layer) Turbot catches increased from around 100 tonnes in the 1960s to around 1,200 tonnes in the mid 1990s. (Note the 2nd layer annotation of the Attribute below the Initial_value and Final_value FEs, since they indicate that the Attribute is implicitly weight.) Similarly, in (5), the report is (in context) about the total monetary value of the gifts, not about the number of donations made. (5)Overall Giving by Church Members increased from 2000 to 2001 As can be seen from the above examples, we consider the event nouns in uses such as (4) and (5) to also specify Items. Note that in cases like (4), we do not want to treat the subject NP "turbot catches" as an Attribute that includes information about the Item, since it would not make sense to restate (4) as follows: *Turbot increased in catches. Two more complications arise. First, certain nouns that do not, by their etymology, denote abstract attributes have a second sense in which they do denote an Attribute. (6) The population of Smallville increased fourfold to 807. Under one reading, (6a), the population could be understood as referring to "the people", in which case the Attribute cardinality is understood as unexpressed, as in (1), (2), and (3). The Attribute could be overtly specified: (6a) The population of Smallville increased fourfold in size to 807. Under another reading, (6b), population is an Attribute that habitats or locations possess. In this case, the whole NP "the population of Smallville" is treated as the Attribute and on the second layer "of Smallville" is tagged as Item. (6b) The population of Smallville increased fourfold to 807. (6b-second FE layer) The population of Smallville increased fourfold to 807. Support for the possibility of this second reading comes from the fact that you can also state the facts as in (6c). (6c) Smallville increased fourfold in population to 807. The last complication is that Initial_value expressions can also function as the subject, which superficially look like expressions of Attribute. (7) The 1999 price had increased to $3400 by 2001. (7--second layer) The 1999 price had increased to $3400 by 2001. There is no Attribute "1999 price" here (though the concept is plausible in certain special statistical contexts where prices are indexed to prices of a particular year). (7) simply reports that the value of the price-Attribute changed from whatever it was in 1999 to the new value of $3400 by 2001. For sentence (7), Attribute would only be indicated as "price" on the 2nd layer.
The Attribute is a scalar property that the Item possesses.
The entity that has a position on the scale.
The distance by which an Item changes its position on the scale.
Any expression that gives information about points on the scale that the Item traverses between the starting and ending point of its movement along the scale.
The position on the scale where the Item ends up.
The initial position on the scale from which the Item moves away.
The rate of change of the Value.
The Correlate is a directional path (or ordered collection of values) that the (dependent) Attribute is measured against. Note that normally, the Correlate is simply (forward-directional) time.
The Circumstances under which the change of position takes place.
The Group in which an Item changes the value of a Attribute in a specified way.
The Time is the time-frame in which the change of position occurs.
The length of time over which the change takes place.
A portion of the scale, typically identified by its end points, along which the values of the Attribute fluctuate.
The value, location, or state-of-affairs that corresponds to the Initial_value of the Attribute.
The value, location, or state-of-affairs that corresponds to the Final_value of the Attribute.
A location where Attribute is measured
A description that presents the Item's state before the change in the Attribute's value as an independent predication.
A description that presents the Item's state after the change in the Attribute's value as an independent predication.
The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
A Protagonist changes the overall position and posture of the body.

Any description of the change in posture which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of a Protagonist that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The Protagonist's state throughout the time they are changing posture.
The place or setting in which the Protagonist's change of posture takes place.
The Time at which the Protagonist changes posture.
The final state of the Protagonist after the change of posture.
Path is used for expressions that indicate the trajectory of motion without referring to the Source or the Goal of motion.
This FE is used for any expressions that indicate the endpoint of the posture change. Often this is the place that provides support for the posture.
Source is used for expressions that indicate the starting point of the change of posture.

This FE is used for expressions that indicate a line from the deitic center towards a reference point (which may be implicit) that is neither the Goal of the posture change nor a landmark along the way of the moving part of the body. Often Direction is defined with reference to the canonical orientation of the Protagonist, or the orientation imposed by an implicit observer.
The Purpose for which a Protagonist assumes a posture.
This FE is used for expressions that indicate the extent to which the body (part) moves during the change of posture.
The part of the body that provides support to the Protagonist in holding the posture.
An action of the Protagonist whereby they achieve the change of posture.

An Agent changes a Patient's ability to resist literal or figurative attack. This frame differs from Cause_change_of_strength only in that the Patient is restricted to acting as a defensive force, i.e., it can resist but not exert force.
The Agent makes the Patient more resistant to attack.
The Patient is the entity that is being made more resistant.
Depictive phrase describing the actor of an action
The resultant state of the action.
An act performed by an Agent that enables them to act upon the Patient.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The time at which the Agent makes the Patient more resistant.
The location at which the Agent makes the Patient more resistant.
An event which causes the Patient to become more resistant.
This FE describes the literal or figurative Attack that the Agent is strengthening the Patient for.

An Agent changes Tools, from the Old_tool to a New_tool. The Tools may include vehicles, services providers, or more proto-typical implements. If this happens one more time, we 're going to switch operating systems. Stephen had to transfer five times by the time he got to Lincolnville. DNI.
The individual that changes their situation.
This FE identifies the place where the Agent makes a change.
The aim of the Agent when they carry out the change.
This FE identifies the time when the Agent acts intentionally.
The action of the Agent which brings about a change.

Any description of the Agent's change which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The entities controlled by an Agent to achieve some Purpose.
The tool that the Agent had been using.
The tool that the Agent ends up using.
The number of times that the action goes from start to finish.

A group of people (the Interlocutors or Interlocutor_1 and Interlocutor_2 together) have a conversation. No person is construed as only a speaker or only an addressee. Rather, it is understood that both (or all) participants do some speaking and some listening--the process is understood to be symmetrical or reciprocal. In this frame, the purpose of the conversation is generally social, rather than specifically to decide something or exchange information, or to quarrel (see Discussion and Quarreling). If you ain't got nothin' better to do, I 'd like to shoot the breeze with you for a couple. We used to chat about everything.
The group of individuals involved in chatting.

The individual or individuals that form the more prominent (i.e. agentive) party of a conversation, as compared with Interlocutor_2. That is, Interlocutor_1 is generally encoded as the External Argument of verbs, and peripheral FEs that do not make reference to the event itself generally make reference to Interlocutor_1. Thus a Purpose (or Means, Depictive, or Manner) is construed to be that of Interlocutor_1, not necessarily that of Interlocutor_2 or the group of Interlocutors as a whole.
The semantically (and grammatically) less prominent group of participants in a conversation. It is generally encoded within a prepositional phrase (e.g. headed by with).
The length of time that the chatting goes on.
The general subject that the statements of the Interlocutors in the conversation pertain to.
The language(s) or dialect(s) that a conversation is conducted in.
The device used by the Interlocutors to communicate.
What the Interlocutors (or Interlocutor_1) hope to accomplish by chatting.
The time at which a chat takes place.
The location where a chat takes place.
The way that the Interlocutors succeed in having a conversation.

Any description of the conversation which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Interlocutors (or Interlocutor_1) that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
A description of the state of the Interlocutors (or Interlocutor_1) during the conversation.

This frame covers the descriptions of tastes and smells, and has one main frame element, Source. The frame element Sensory_attribute occurs mainly with the words taste, flavour, and smell. The almonds had a bitter taste. The almonds are bitter.
Perceptual_source is used for the entity that is being described. A recipe can stand in for a Perceptual_source which is a kind of food.
This FE identifies the Degree to which a chemical sense is described.
Sensory_attribute is used for words that describe the perception itself.

A Cognizer decides upon the Chosen (either an item or a course of action) out of a set of Possibilities . The Cognizer may have an Intended_purpose for the Chosen. Often a Reason, which serves as the basis of the choice, is given. The council picked you out of all the pilots available to head this mission. No one would choose to live in such squalor. If no judge was unanimously selected in the previous round, play rock-paper-scissors pairwise. CNI
Depictive labels an independent descriptor of a Cognizer in a choosing event.
The Cognizer chooses the Chosen out of the Possibilities.
Chosen identifies the entity or course of action which is selected from among the Possibilities.
This FE identifies the Reason for which the Cognizer chooses the Chosen.

A Cognizer makes a choice from among a set of Possibilities. Possibilities are commonly expressed via an oblique phrase which indicates the alternative or alternatives, or by a subordinate clause (choosing to do it or choosing not to do it), typically headed by "whether or "if".
This FE identifies the Means by which bthe Cognizer accomplishes the choosing.
This FE identifies thePlace where the choosing occurs.
This FE identifies the Larger_purpose for which the Cognizer chooses. It exemplifies what the Cognizer hopes to accomplish by choosing the particular Chosen.
This FE identifies the Time when the Cognizer chooses the Chosen.

Any description of the selecting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of a Cognizer that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
Topic occurs quite rarely in this frame and usually only as a PP Complement of a noun target:
The Cognizerintends the Chosen to fulfill an Intended_purpose.
The hypothetical Chosen that is less desirable for the Cognizer.

A Claimant asserts his or her right to possession of a piece of Property (either real, such as land, or private). The Claimant may be acting on the behalf of a Beneficiary. The King claims this land and surrounding waters. Hoping to strike it rich, Thaddeus Gulch staked his claim by the river bed. I have dibs on the last piece of cake.
The Claimant asserts rights or priviliges, typically ownership, over some Property.
The Property is declared to be under the ownership of the Claimant.
The Beneficiary is declared the owner of the Property by the Claimant, or the person or group in whose name or favor the Claimant is acting.
The Role of the land claimed.

The Outcome of a contest is described in terms of the Margin between what would be required for victory and the actual Outcome. The Basque nationalists won a narrow victory in the regional elections on Sunday. It was a major victory for workers, and a decisive defeat for the Tory.
The Outcome of a contest whose Margin is under consideration.
The difference between the minimum required for victory and the actual Outcome.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Value from what is expected given the Outcome and the Value indicated by the target.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Outcome has a particular Value for the Margin.
The generally implicit Value of the Margin.

An Executive_authority exercises their power to reduce or remove negative consequences for someone who has been labeled an Offender who participated in an Crime. A Fort Worth man convicted of a robbery his brother later confessed to committing was granted clemency on December 20, 2002, by Governor Rick Perry. A Fort Worth man convicted of a robbery his brother later confessed to committing was granted clemency on December 20, 2002, by Governor Rick Perry. Engel represented Robert Bacon, the first man Easley gave clemency in 2001. INI Ohioans will receive a blow-by-blow account of arguments before the Ohio Parole Board on whether Cincinnatian John Byrd Jr. should be executed or granted clemency for a 1983 murder. CNI
The individual who is accused or convicted of a Crime.
An action deemed criminal by law.
The constitutionally specified authority who has the power to grant clemency.
A state of affairs that the Executive_authority is responding to in granting clemency.
The time at which clemency is granted.
An intentional action performed by the Executive_authority that accomplishes the granting of clemency.

Any description of the act of clemency which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of an Executive_authority that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An action that the Executive_authority intends to accomplish by granting clemency.
The location at which the Executive_authority grants clemency.

An Agent manipulates a Fastener to open or close a Containing_object (e.g. coat, jar). Sometimes an Enclosed_region or a Container_portal may be expressed. Since the Manipulator is syntactically omissible, many verbs in this frame incorporate the Fastener. Mary closed her coat with a belt. Mary closed her coat with one hand. Mary buttoned her coat .
This FE identifies the item that is closed by the agent with the fastener. Lee buttoned his coat.
This FE identifies the fastener that the agent manipulates.
This FE identifies the region enclosed by the container-object that is closed.
This FE identifies the instrument or part of the body that manipulates the Fastener.
This FE identifies the active zone of the container that may be expressed as the direct object of the target verb.
The degree to which the Container_portal/Containing_object ends up closed.
An entity manipulated by the Agent that accomplishes the closure of the Containing_object or the Container_portal.

Any description of the closing event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An action of the Agent that accomplishes the closure of the Container_portal or Containing_object.
The location where the closing event takes place.
The time at which the Agent closes the Container_portal or the Containing_object.
The resultant state of the Closure action.
The person for whom the Closure event occurs.
This FE describes the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the Closure event and any of its participants.
This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action.

This frame refers to clothing and its characteristics, including anything that people conventionally wear. The Wearer wears a Garment that has a certain Style, is made of a certain Material, and can be otherwise characterized by a Descriptor. In some cases, the Body_location (where the garment is worn) and Subregion of the clothing may also be specified. Claudia dressed in a dark green cotton DRESS clasped round her slender waist with a broad yellow belt , drank a cup of coffee and opened her neglected post .
This FE identifes the clothing worn.
The Wearer is the person wearing the clothes, or for whom the clothes are intended.
This FE identifes the design, or cut, of the clothing.
This FE identifes the material from which the clothing is made.
This FE identifes any description of the clothing besides Style and Material.
This FE identifies a part of the clothing.
This FE identifes the Use for which a Garment is worn or was made.
Body_location identifies the place on the body where the clothing is worn.
The individual who created the Garment.
The time at which the Creator makes the Garment.
The name given to a specific Garment. Note this is not the name of a general class of clothing items, but rather an individual item. This is accordingly VERY RARE.
The Subparts of Clothing items worn by a Wearer and made of a certain Material. The Subpart may itself have parts, which we label Subregion: The shirt features a long sleeve with shiny gold buttons.
This is the Clothing of which the target word is a part.
This is a Subpart of the Clothing item.
The Material from which the Subpart is made.
A part of the Clothing item.
The person who is wearing the clothes, or for whom the clothes are intended.
This is the part of the body were the garment is worn.
This FE identifes any description of the clothing besides Material.

A person, the Cognizer, thinks about a Topic over a period of time. What is thought about may be a course of action that the person might take, or something more general. The men were silently mulling over the proposition of committing an assassination
With a target verb, the Cognizer is usually expressed as an External Argument, with the Topic appearing as an Object NP, a gerundive verbal Complement, or a PP.
With a target verb, the Topic is usually expressed as an Object NP, a gerundive verbal complement, or a PP.
The FE Degree indicates the degree to which the cognizing occurs.
Depictive phrase describing the actor of an action
The FE Manner indicates the way in which the cognizing is being done.
An intentional action performed by the Cognizer that makes them able to cogitate.
The physical or abstract setting in which the Cognizer considers the Topic.
The state-of-affairs that the Cognizer is trying to bring about by thinking.
The time at which the Cognizer considers the Topic.

A concept, Concept_1, is related causally or collocationally to another concept, Concept_2, by means of some Evidence. They may be related only under certain Circumstances or from a certain Point_of_view. The two concepts may be expressed collectively as associated Concepts. Any cognizer is deprofiled.
The concept which is linked to Concept_2. Generally expressed as the external argument.
The concept which is tied to Concept_1. Generally expressed as a PP complement.
The point of view from which the connection exists.
The Circumstances under which the connection exists.
The Degree of connection between the Concepts.
A further specification on the linkage.

A State_of_affairs (a state or event) either holds or occurs, and is presented as being causally independent of other (implicit) states or events that might otherwise have been expected to be causally related to the State_of_affairs. The Time or Place may also be mentioned.
A State_of_affairs (that is, an event or state) that holds independently of (potentially) causally-related States of affairs.
The Time at which the State_of_affairs holds.
The Place where the State_of_affairs holds.

Partner_1 and Partner_2 or a group of Partners work together in some Undertaking. The Partners are taken to be of equal status even when expressed disjointly. CSTR actively collaborates with the Departments of Artificial Intelligence and Physics. Tom and the American composer Steve Riche have recently collaborated on a piece of elevator music.

When the parties in a collaboration are expressed separately, this Frame Element marks constituents that express the one that is grammatically more prominent, i.e., the one that is the subject of an active clause.
This Frame element marks constituents expressing the grammatically less prominent, typically oblique, party in a collaboration.
This frame element marks constituents that express the project in which the Partners are collaborating.
This FE identifies the Manner in which Partner_1 collaborates with Partner_2 or in which the Partners collaborate.
This frame element marks expressions that express the parties that work together in an Undertaking.
This FE identifies the time when the Partners are engaged in their collaboration.
This FE identifies the Place where the collaboration occurs.
This FE identifies the amount of time the Partners collaborate.
This FE marks expressions that indicate to what extent the Partners are cooperating.
The action taken by the Partners that lets them accomplish the collaboration.
A Profiled_region is specified as entirely or largely coinciding with that of a Ground.
A region of space located at a Ground.
An entity whose location is relatively well-known and which, thus, can serve as a land-mark to identify the Profiled_region.

A group of Colonists from a Homeland migrate to and proceed to settle in a New_area. The New_area then becomes their permanent home. The New_area and Homeland are in some way construed as being part of the same organization or system. In the case of (people from) nation-states colonizing other areas, the colony and nation-state are considered a single political entity. In the extended sense of living things in general colonizing or settling a new area, the original Homeland must still inhabited by some of the same group. In this sense Colonization is distinct from migration or exodus. In the 7th century BC, Phoenicians colonized the eastern section of Libya. In the 7th century BC, Phoenicians colonized the eastern section of Libya. Finns colonized the land from the south some 2,000 to 4,000 years ago If a colony from Britain was established in that large tract of Country, and if we were at war with Holland or Spain, we might very powerfully annoy either state from our new settlement. This frame also includes metaphorical uses involving animals or plants, or abstract domains such as ideas. Deciduous trees such as red alder subsequently colonized the logged area. Conservatives don't get what the left gets, which is that the left has already colonized and converted whole university departments. As the years progressed and adaptations occurred new species and subspecies began to populate the islands.
A group of people who move together to an area outside their Homeland for the purpose of settling.
The Homeland is where the Colonists are originally from.
The Colonists move to the New_area, inhabiting it and (in the case of nation-states) extending the control of the Homeland.
The time at which the colonizing takes place.
The extent to which the group of Colonists spreads across or inhabits the New_area.
The purpose for which the colonizing is done.
A characteristic of the Colonists, Homeland, or New_area.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the colonization event logically follows.

A Color serves as a landmark in color-space, either a point-like landmark (e.g. burnt sienna) or a broader region (e.g. blue). Especially when the Color designates a broad region in color-space, it may be defined with a specific Type, further specified by comparison to the color of a Comparand, modified by a Color_qualifier, or evaluated with a Descriptor. All color words are generally used to specify the color of some (physical) Entity. I really like that shade of blue. The welts on his side had already turned an angry red. The room was bathed in a soft pink light. They promptly set up a zillion bright vermilion pavilions. His face and hands were brown from a life spent in the bright sun of the fields.
This FE identifies the Entity described by the Color.
A position in color-space, generally used to describe the quality of some Entity.
This FE indicates what subtype of the general category of a Color is indicated.

A physical entity (or type of physical entity) whose color is similar to the designated color. When this FE occurs with adjective targets, (a relatively rare circumstance) the Comparand also serves to specify a Type, which should be labeled on the second FE layer.
A phrase that indicates the direction in color-space from the center of the region designated by the Color.
Some characteristic or judgment of a Color implicitly imposed by a speaker.
The state of affairs that the Color is dependent on.
The closeness of the Entity 's color to the center of a Color prototype.
The part of the Entity that has the indicated Color.
The aspect of the Entity which is under discussion, namely color.

This frame contains words that describe specific aspects of a Color. The Degree to which the color being discussed deviates from the prototype may be marked. The description may also target a specific Aspect of color.
The color that is being described.
The level to which the Color is representative of a specific quality.
The entity whose Color is being described.

In this frame a group of Individuals meet to form a Configuration. The Individuals or the Configuration may be expressed as the external argument of the predicates in this frame. In this frame, it is ambiguous whether or not the Individuals intentionally come together. In an alternative construal, a grammatically more prominent Party_1 congregates with a Party_2, expressed as an oblique phrase. If this asymmetric construal is chosen, Purpose relates only to Party_1. The congregating happens in a certain Place and at a certain Time. The crowd came together in the courtyard. The architects amassed in the lobby.
The Individuals are self-movers who come together.
The Configuration describes the resulting formation of the individuals.
The Means descibes the way in which the Individuals accomplish the congregating.
The Place is where the congregating occurs.
The Time is when the congregating occurs.
An action that the Configuration plans to engage in upon assembly.
The position in a series of iterations that the current congregating event occupies .
How often the Individuals come together to form an Configuration.

Any description of congregating which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of the Individuals or Configuration that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
A Topic of a discussion that may occur between the Individuals.
Party_1 is the grammatically more prominent participant in the congregating event.
A grammatically less prominent participant in the congregating event.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

An Entity comes into existence at a particular Place and Time which may take a certain Duration_of_endstate, have a Cause, or be formed from Components. Problems may arise whenever an S1 sophont enters the game. Mountains sometimes form in as little as a million years. A new paradigm emerged from the discussion of nuclear weapons. New Plants form from the cut veins in two weeks.
Concrete or abstract entity that did not exist before the Time of the event.
This is the Place where the new Entity comes into being.
This FE identifes the Time when a new Entity comes into existence.
This FE labels the Cause of the formation of the Entity.
This FE identifies the components out of which the Entity forms.
This FE identifies the length of time that the Entity exists after coming to be.
The form in which the Entity comes to be.
This FE identifies the Period_of_Iterations during which habitual or iterative actions are performed.
The way in which the Entity comes to be.

A person (the Cognizer) comes to believe something (the Content), sometimes after a process of reasoning. This change in belief is usually initiated by a person or piece of Evidence. Occasionally words in this domain are accompanied by phrases expressing Topic, i.e. that which the mental Content is about. Based on the most recent census I have concluded that most Americans sleep too much.
Cognizer is the person who comes to believe something. Sue realized that Bob was lost.
Words in this frame may occur with a PP headed by from which expresses the Evidence on which knowledge or belief is based: I have learned from experience that poison oak can be painful.

With a target verb, the Content is usually expressed as a finite clausal Complement or an Object NP, and may sometimes be expressed by a PP: The President learned that the reporters were hungry. The children determined the answer.

Some verbs in this frame may occur with postverbal Topic expressions: They found out about us! More generally verbs in this frame may occur with quantificational nouns followed by Topic expressions: The jury learned something terrible about the suspect.
An act performed by the Cognizer which enables them to figure something out.
The time at which the Cognizer discovers the Content.
Medium is the text created by the Cognizer to communicate that they came to believe a specified Content.
The location at which the Cognizer realizes the Content.

Words in this frame have to do with a Cognizer creating a new intellectual entity, the Idea. These words are similar to words of physical creation such as build and make, and in some cases may be understood as metaphorically based on such words. However, the Ideas in this frame are predominantly conceptual in nature. Compare this frame with Achieving_first. In that frame, the fact that the idea is new to society is emphasized, whereas Coming_up_with refers to an agentive Cognizer using mental effort to figure something out, without any implication of the impact of the idea. I 've been trying to come up with a plan .
Cognizer is the person who comes up with or conceptualizes the Invention. It is normally expressed as an External Argument: Kim devised a new recipe.
Invention is the intellectual creation of the Cognizer. It is normally expressed as an NP Object, but sometimes as a PP Complement:

Some of the words in this frame frequently occur with a constituent expressing the Purpose for which the Idea is intended. Normally this constituent is a PP Complement headed by for or a to-marked VP Complement:

Words in this frame sometimes occur with a constituent that expresses the intellectual material from which the Idea is created. This frame element is characteristic of physical creation verbs like make; its presence gives sentences in this frame an especially strong metaphorical quality. The Material FE is normally expressed by a PP Complement headed by from or out of:
The extent to which the Cognizer succeeds in coming up with the idea.
The state of a focal participant during the time the invention takes place.
A state of the Cognizer that directly and palpably influences the overall action.
An act performed by the Cognizer that contributes to the creation of the Idea.
(This FE belongs in Achieving_first, not here.)
The location in which the Cognizer comes up with the Idea.
The Time when the Idea is created.

This frame describes a particular compounding construction (a pattern of coinage) by which more complex words can be created by joining an Honored_entity to a Dedicated_type to describe a particular Dedicated_entity which has been officially named for the Honored_entity. The Dedicated_type and Honored_entity FEs each form part of the Lexical Units (annotated on the second FE layer), and the Dedicated_entity is the denotation of the whole. Since each of the FEs is a part of the Lexical Unit, there is no assignment of Grammatical Function or Phrase Type. The Dedicated_type should (in principle) also be annotated as a LU in a separate frame. Targets are added opportunistically to this frame in the course of annotating other frames. For example, the Day of Armistice Day should also be annotated in the Calendric_unit frame. 1st layer: Turn right at the Jefferson Building. 2nd layer: Turn right at the Jefferson Building.
This FE identifies the person, subject, or event that is being honored.
This FE identifies the type of entity that had been dedicated to honor the Honored_entity.
The entity which has been dedicated to the Honored_entity.

These are words describing a basic commercial transaction involving a buyer and a seller exchanging money and goods, taking the perspective of the buyer. The words vary individually in the patterns of frame element realization they allow. For example, the typical pattern for the verb BUY: BUYER buys GOODS from SELLER for MONEY. Abby bought a car from Robin for $5,000.
The Buyer wants the Goods and offers Money to a Seller in exchange for them.
The FE Goods is anything (including labor or time, for example) which is exchanged for Money in a transaction.
The means by which a commercial transaction occurs.
Money is the thing given in exchange for Goods in a transaction.
In some cases, price or payment is described per unit of Goods.
The Seller has possession of the Goods and exchanges them for Money from a Buyer.
This FE is any unit in which goods or services can be measured. Generally, it occurs in a by-PP.
The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
The Reason for which an event occurs.

Any description of the purchasing event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Buyerthat affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The individual intended by the Buyer to receive the Goods.
The length of time from when the commerce event began to be repeated to when it stopped.
The Buyer's intended purpose for the Goods.
Subframe of Commerce_money-transfer in which the Seller comes to have the Money.
The Buyer wants the Goods and offers Money to a Seller in exchange for them.
The FE Goods is anything (including labor or time, for example) which is exchanged for Money in a transaction.
The means by which a commercial transaction occurs.
Money is the thing given in exchange for Goods in a transaction.
In isome cases, price or payment is described per unit of Goods.
The Seller has possession of the Goods and exchanges them for Money from a Buyer.
This FE is any unit in which goods or services can be measured. Generally, it occurs in a by-PP.
The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
The Reason for which an event occurs.

Any description of the collection event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Seller that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The subframe of the Commercial_transaction in which the Seller gives the Goods to the Buyer (in exchange for the Money).
The Buyer wants the Goods and offers Money to a Seller in exchange for them.
The FE Goods is anything (including labor or time, for example) which is exchanged for Money in a transaction.
The means by which a commercial transaction occurs. Abby bought the car with cash. Robin paid for the car by check.
Money is the thing given in exchange for Goods in a transaction.
In some cases, price or payment is described per unit of Goods.
The Seller has possession of the Goods and exchanges them for Money from a Buyer.
This FE is any unit in which goods or services can be measured. Generally, it occurs in a by-PP.
The Reason for which an event occurs.

A description of the transfer not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of a Buyer, Seller, or Exchangers that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The state-of-affairs that the Buyer, Seller, or Exchangers wish to bring about by participating in the exchange.
The Buyer and Seller considered jointly.
The subframe of the Commercial_transaction frame which involves the transfer of Money from the Buyer to the Seller (in exchange for the Goods).
The Buyer wants the Goods and offers Money to a Seller in exchange for them.
The FE Goods is anything (including labor or time, for example) which is exchanged for Money in a transaction.
The means by which a commercial transaction occurs.
Money is the thing given in exchange for Goods in a transaction.
In isome cases, price or payment is described per unit of Goods.
The Seller has possession of the Goods and exchanges them for Money from a Buyer.
This FE is any unit in which goods or services can be measured. Generally, it occurs in a by-PP.
The Reason for which an event occurs.

A description of the transfer not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of a Buyer, Seller, or Exchangers that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The state-of-affairs that the Buyer, Seller, or Exchangers wish to bring about by participating in the exchange.
The individuals participating in the commercial exchange, otherwise encoded as Buyer and Seller.
This frame involves Buyers paying Money for Goods. In this frame the Money is the direct object, and is mapped to the theme of the transfer.
The Buyer has the Money and wants the Goods.
The FE Goods is anything (including labor or time, for example) which is exchanged for Money in a transaction.
The means by which a commercial transaction occurs. Abby bought the car with cash. Robin paid for the car by check.
Money is the thing given in exchange for Goods in a transaction.
In some cases, price or payment is described per unit of Goods.
The Seller has the Goods and wants the Money.
This FE is any unit in which goods or services can be measured. Generally, it occurs in a by-PP.
The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
The Reason for which an event occurs.

Any description of the paying event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Buyer that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.

Commerce is a situation in which a Buyer and a Seller have agreed upon an exchange of Money and Goods (possibly after a negotiation), and then perform the exchange, optionally carrying it out with various kinds of direct payment or financing or the giving of change. The Seller indicates their willingness to give the Goods in their possession to a Buyer who would give them some amount of Money. The Seller may have already decided on the amount of money that they would require, in which case it is called the Asking price. The Buyer also indicates their willingness to give an amount of money called an Offer to a Seller who would give them the Goods. Normally the process is begun by the Seller. The means by which the Seller indicates their wish to engage in an exchange are various, ranging from putting a price tag on an item on a store shelf, to advertizing, to communicating directly and specifically with a possible Buyer. In some cases, however, the process may be initiated by the Buyer indicating to a possible Seller that they would like to make an exchange.
The Buyer has the Money and wants the Goods.
The Seller has the Goods and wants the Money.
Money is given in exchange for Goods in a transaction.
Goods is anything including labor or time, for example, which is exchanged for Money in a transaction.
In some cases, price or payment is described per unit of Goods.
This FE is any unit in which goods or services can be measured. Generally, it occurs in a by-PP.
The means by which a commercial transaction occurs.
A state of affairs that the agent intends to bring about as a result of participating in the Commercial Transaction.

These are words describing basic commercial transactions involving a buyer and a seller exchanging money and goods, taking the perspective of the seller. The words vary individually in the patterns of frame element realization they allow. For example, the typical patterns for SELL: SELLER sells GOODS to BUYER for MONEY. Robin sold a car to Abby for $5,000.
The Buyer has the Money and wants the Goods.
The FE Goods is anything (including labor or time, for example) which is exchanged for Money in a transaction.
The means by which a commercial transaction occurs.
Money is the thing given in exchange for Goods in a transaction.
In some cases, price or payment is described per unit of Goods.
The Seller has possession of the Goods and exchanges them for Money from a Buyer.
This FE is any unit in which goods or services can be measured. Generally, it occurs in a by-PP.
The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
The Reason for which an event occurs.

Any description of the selling event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Seller that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The state of the Seller after the sale has occurred.
The length of time from when the commerce event began to be repeated to when it stopped.
The Buyer's intended purpose for the Goods.
This FE indicates that the selling act reverses an earlier separate act in which the current Seller bought the Goods from the current Buyer.
This FE indicates that the selling act constitues a re-selling by the current Seller of Goods that they bought earlier from a third person who is not the Buyer of the current selling act.

These are words that describe basic commercial transactions involving a Buyer and a Seller who exchange Money and Goods. The individual words vary in the frame element realization patterns. For example, the typical patterns for the verbs buy and sell are: BUYER buys GOODS from the SELLER for MONEY. SELLER sells GOODS to the BUYER for MONEY.
The Buyer wants the Goods and offers Money to a Seller in exchange for them.
The FE Goods is anything (including labor or time, for example) which is exchanged for Money in a transaction.
The means by which a commercial transaction occurs.
Money is the thing given in exchange for Goods in a transaction.
Price or payment per unit of Goods.
The Seller has possession of the Goods and exchanges them for Money from a Buyer.
The Unit of measure of the Goods according to which the exchange value of the Goods (or services) is set. Generally, it occurs in a by-PP.

A Speaker makes a commitment to an Addressee to carry out some future action. This may be an action desirable (as with promise) or not desirable (as with threaten) to the Addressee. Some of the words in this frame allow an Addressee to be expressed. You promised me you'd come to my graduation. Other words cannot normally occur with an Addressee. Kim undertook to finish the project by June.

The Speaker is the person who commits him/herself to do something. Speaker is usually the External Argument of predicative uses of the target or the Genitive modifier of a noun: Jo made a promise to me. Jo promised me she would cook dinner. Jo's promise to cook dinner came to nothing.

The Speaker's commitment can be made to an Addressee. With those words which allow this frame element to be expressed, Addressee usually occurs as a PP Complement headed by to or the (Indirect) Object of verbs: Kim made a promise to me. Kim promised me that everything would be okay.

An expression of the commitment made by the Speaker expresses the frame element Message. Message is expressed as a finite or non-finite clausal Complement or an NP Object: I swore that I would never make the same mistake again. The owner finally consented to sell the business. They threatened revenge.
Topic expressions are not very frequent in this frame. They can occur with noun targets. Jo made endless promises about working harder at school.

As with other frames in the Communication domain, the Medium of communication may be expressed. Medium is the physical entity or channel used to transmit the Message. Bob threatened the workers in Spanish.
The Manner in which the commitment is made.
The time period during which the Speaker makes the commitment.
The location in which the Speaker makes the commitment.
An action that the Speaker intends to accomplish by taking on the commitment.
This FE is used to indicate length of time from when Commitment event began to be repeated to when it stopped.

A Perpetrator (generally intentionally) commits a Crime, i.e. does something not permitted by the laws of society. They perpetrated a felony by substituting a lie for negotiations. The suspect had allegedly committed the crime to gain the attention of a female celebrity.
The individual that commits a Crime.
An act, generally intentional, that has been formally forbidden by law.
The action that the Perpetrator was trying to accomplish in the Crime.

A description of secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of the Perpetrator that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An action performed by the Perpetrator in order to accomplish the Crime.
A state of affairs that the Perpetrator is responding to in their Crime.
The location where the Crime occurs.
The Instrument used in committing the crime.
The frequency with which a Crime is committed.

A Speaker communicates a message stating an Item's membership in a Category, i.e., asserts that the Item has the defining characteristics of the Category. Alternatively, the message is conceived as communicated by a Medium. He depicted his involvement as merely peripheral. The first half of the book portrays Bragg's mother as a beautiful and heartbroken woman.
The individual that communates the message concerning the Category of an Item.
The class of entities with characteristics that match those of the Item according to the portrayal of the Speaker.
The entity that the Speaker portrays as belonging to a Category.
An action taken by the Speaker through which they communicate that the Item fits into a particular Category.
The piece of text in which a Speaker communicates their categorization of the Item.
The point in time at which the Speaker makes a characterization of the Item.
The location at which the Speaker characterizes the Item
The Circumstances under which the categorization is made.
The characteristics of an Item that fit the defining characteristics of a Category, and thus serve as the basis of the Speakers characterization of the Item.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of a Speaker that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).

Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end. In many cases, the continuous situation is a dynamic action which is ongoing, while in others it is simply an undifferentiated state.

A Communicator conveys a Message to an Addressee; the Topic and Medium of the communication also may be expressed. This frame includes no specification of the method of communication (speech, writing, gesture, etc.). The frames that inherit the general Communication frame can add elaboration to the Medium in a variety of ways (in French, on the radio program, in a letter) or to the Manner of communication (babble, rant, shout, whisper). There are also frames that either do not inherit all of the FEs of this frame or do not inherit them in a straightforward manner (such as Conversation, in which Communicator and Addressee alternate roles, and are often expressed by a single, plural NP). Let's hope it did n't have time to communicate any of its findings to its overlords . NB: For many words in this domain (those which do not inherently ascribe cognitive/social processes to a Communicator, position a statement within a conversation, or specify Medium in detail), there is a metaphorical usage which maps Communication onto an alternate POV of Becoming_aware, with corresponding maps for frames related to Communication. This metaphor is most felicitous with Means or Medium subjects, which are mapped onto the Evidence FE of Becoming_aware. In many cases this metaphor maps Communication onto the Evidence frame, but not always. Some words from the Communication domain are listed in the Evidence frame since they are deemed to be lexicalized. A flick of his gaze toward the doorway told me what he really wanted . MET This painting really speaks to me . INI MET Putting his arm around her protectively achieved nothing but announcing to their captors their vulnerability . MET It says a lot that he did n't come back . INI MET
The sentient entity that uses language in the written or spoken modality to convey a Message to another person.
The Addressee receives a Message from the Communicator.
Message A proposition or set of propositions that the Communicator wants the Addressee to believe or take for granted.
Topic is the entity that the proposition or propositions conveyed relate to, that they are about.
The physical or abstract setting in which the Message is conveyed.
The amount of information exchanged when communication occurs.
The Depictive describes the state of the Communicator.
The Manner in which the Communicator communicates.
The Means by which the Communicator communicates.
The time at which the communication takes place.
Duration is the length of time during which the communication takes place.
This FE describes the number of times per unit of time that the Communicator conveys a Message.
The location where the act of communication occurs.
The purpose for which a Communicator communicates.
The words in this frame describe Manners of verbal communication. All of them can occur with quoted expressions. He slurred his confession.
Speaker is the sentient entity that produces a Message or communicates about a Topic. It is expressed as the External Argument of verbs:
Addressee is the person to whom the Speaker is communicating. When expressed, the Addressee occurs as a PP Complement:
Message is the content which is communicated by the Speaker. The Message may be a direct quote, a finite complement clause or an NP Object:

Topic is the subject matter of the communicated Message. It is normally expressed as a PP Complement headed by about and, in this frame, is frequently preceded by a quantificational noun which is treated as referring to the Message:

This frame element expresses the medium of communication, such as the language used or the specific type of text in which the Message occurs. It is normally expressed as a PP-complement headed by on or in:
Depictive is used for any phrase describing a participant in an action.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an event occurs.
This FE identifies the Result of an event.

This FE indicates that the communication act denoted by the target is in response to an earlier communication act in which the roles of Speaker and Addressee were reversed. This is conceptually akin to the Communication_response frame in which the targets themselves denote the responsive nature of the act.
The amount of time that the communicative event lasts.
The time at which the communication event takes place.
The location at which the communication event takes place.
The action that the Speaker performs in order to communicate in the particular way described by the target.
This frame concerns Communicators communicating with each other with the aid of a Means of communication such as a telephone.

This FE is the person who uses the Means of communication to deliver the Message to the Addressee. The Speaker is normally expressed as the External Argument of target verbs, or as the Genitive modifier of nouns.

Addressee is the person to whom the Message is communicated. When this FE is expressed, it often appears in a prepositional phrase introduced by to, or as the direct object, or as the first object in a double object construction.
This is the FE that identifies the content of what the Speaker is communicating to the Addressee. It can be expressed as a clause or as a noun phrase.
Topic is the subject matter to which the Message pertains. It is typically expressed as a PP Complement headed by about.
This Frame Element is for expressions that elaborate the manner in which an action is carried out.
This Frame Element refers to the Instrument of Communication that is used by the Speaker (and Addressee).
This FE identifies the Reason for using the means of communication.
The state of the Communicator or Messageduring the communication.

This frame contains words for types of noise which can be used to characterize verbal communication. It inherits from Communication (possibly more specifically Communication_manner) and the Sound_emission frame (which simply characterizes basic sounds of whatever source, including those made by animals and inanimate objects). As such, it involves a Speaker who produces noise and thus communicates a Message to an Addressee.
Speaker is the sentient entity that delivers the Message.
The Addressee refers to the one toward whom the Communication_noise is directed. Addressee generally occurs in to or at PPs.
Message has a number of different realizations in this frame, including that-clauses, direct quotes, infinitival complements, for-to phrases, and NP Objects.
Topic occurs in PP Complements, usually headed by about.
Medium is used for a physical entity or channel that transmits the Message. It is normally expressed as a PP Complement headed by on or in.
This FE identifies the state of the Speaker during the communication.
Manner describes the manner or style in which the Communication_noise is delivered.

The Communication_noise may be prompted by either some outside phenomenon or occurrence, or by an Internal_cause, the Speaker's mental or emotional state. Internal_cause is expressed in a PP Complement.
The Means by which the Speaker communicates.
The Voice describes the Speaker's utterance or other message-encoded production.
This FE identifies the Place where an event occurs.
This FE idenitifes the Reason for which an event occurs.
