An Agent acts according to a Plan, carrying it out (or taking steps to carry it out). In some cases, the Agent is a focal participant in the Plan, although a separate Focal_participant may also be mentioned. The Plan may be specified for the Duration for which it is in effect. Health authorities say they have put measures into effect in all ports of entry and in centers of provinces. Channing House has recently implemented a new dining program for residents on pureed diets. Note: the phrase (put) in effect is in the Being_in_effect frame.
The Plan is a goal or purpose that the Agent carries out.
The length of time for which the Plan is or is not in effect.
The Time at which the Agent puts the Plan into effect.
The Place at which the Plan is or is not operational. [CHANGE: or, place where agent puts into effect? 2 fes?]
The state-of-affairs under which the Agent puts the Plan into effect.
A cause, reason, or other explanation for the implementation of the Plan
The individual or group who is obligated to follow the Plan. [CHANGE: may only be relevant for "implemented the policy for residents of florida only"]
The Agent, often an institution or governmental organization, puts a Plan into effect. The Agent is generally a primary participant in the Plan, but a separate Focal_participant may be specified.
The Manner describes some state of the Agent, or provides additional characterization of the event of executing the plan.
The Means is an intermediate action done by the Agent in order to execute the Plan.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Agent executes the Plan.
This FE describes how fully the Plan was executed.
This FE describes the medium through which a plan was executed. It may occur in the same syntactic position as the Agent.
The Outcome is the failure or success of executing the plan.
An Executioner punishes an individual (Executed) with death as a consequence of some action of the Evaluee (the Reason).
The Executioner is the individual who performs the execution.
This FE identifies the Instrument with which an Executioner performs an execution.
The action that is taken that accomplishes the execution
The purpose for which the execution is carried out.
The punishment of death given to the Executed by the Executioner.
This FE identifies anyDepictive phrase describing a participant in the action.
The Executed is the person who is killed by the Executioner in retribution for the crime that the Executed was convicted of.

Any description of the execution event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). Moreover, it may indicate salient characteristics of the Executioner that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
Often, there is a constituent expressing the Reason for the Judge's judgment which the Executioner is carrying out. It is usually a for-PP.

This frame concerns a specific subset of Instances of a Type which are evaluated in terms of their similarity to a conceptual prototype of the Type. The judgment of exemplariness may be made along a certain Domain. She is a model student. He's the image of a good father.
A thing or episode that is considered exemplary of a certain Type.
The category of things or events from which an Instance is picked out.
The comparative terms along which the Instance is deemed an exemplar of the Type.
A property of the particular Instance.
An Entity, with regard to a particular Domain, is representative of a conceptual prototype of the Comparison_set of which it is a member.
The thing being judged by its similarity to an ideal.
The group which the Entity is a member of.
The domain along which the Entity is judged to be exemplary.
The degree to which the Entity is exemplary.

An Agent actively maintains or improves their level of phyiscal fitness. The action may target a specific Body_part, or happen through a particular Means. Football players exercise every day. Don't work out your legs after a long run. CNI
The person who is trying to improve or maintain their physical fitness.
An area of the Agent's body that the activity is direct at.
Something that the Agent uses to exercise.
A general description of how the Agent acts while exercising.
The time that the Agent exercises.
The location of the Agent while exercising.
How often the Agent works on their fitness.

An Entity is able to exert a Force of the Magnitude specified by the target. Physically, she is very strong and uses her strength to benefit her football. Yes, Bronstein had the chance to punish his mighty opponent for his three-year neglect of work on chess. CCE faces strong opposition from WCA and other groups.
The Entity which possesses an ability to exert Force, whose Magnitude is under consideration.
The feature of an Entity which is under discussion.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Magnitude of Force that the Entity can exert from the norm or from the value for another Entity.
The Time during which the Entity is in the state of being able to exert a Force of a particular Magnitude.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity is able to exert a Force of the specified Magnitude .
The generally implicit value of the Force.
An action in which the Entity exerts Force.
An Agent exhausts a Resource. We exhausted our supply of oil long ago.
The Resource is exhausted over time by being used.
The Agent uses the Resource for a Purpose.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action ( deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
This FE identifies the place where the Agent exhausts the Resource.
This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent exhausts the Resource.
This FE identifies the time when the Agent exhausts the Resource.

An Entity is declared to exist, generally irrespective of its position or even the possibility of its position being specified. Time, Duration, Inherent_purpose, and State may also be mentioned. This frame is to be contrasted with Presence, which describes the existence of an Entity in a particular (and salient) spacio-temporal context, and which also entails the presence of an observer who can detect the existence of the Entity in that context. Finally, Poland ceased to exist as a state for hundreds of years. Such laws exist to prevent exactly this kind of fraud. There IS a Santa Claus!
Some entity, abstract or concrete, which is stated to exist.
A time at which the entity is in existence.
The period during which the Entity exists.
The reason why the Entity exists. Generally, this is more specifically the reason why the Entity was made.
The condition that the Entity exists in.
A situation, force, or entity which brings about the existence of the Entity.
Circumstances marks expressions that indicate a set of conditions under which the Entity is declared to exist
The perspective of an individual who judges whether they consider the Entity (or further state of affairs) to exist or not.

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause.
This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action.

An Item changes its physical size. The Size_change of an Item may be explicitly indicated or characterized in terms of Initial_size and/or Result_size. In the default case, expansion is along all dimensions, but sometimes the Dimension of expansion is incorporated or made explicit. The pile of leaves had shrunk by about half after the first haul. The jeans stretched a little.
This FE identifies the Item whose size changes.
Change of size may be limited to or described in terms of a single Dimension.
This FE identifies the Group in which an Item changes size.
Initial_size is used for the size of the Item before any change occurs. It is rarely expressed without Result_size also being explicit. Initial_size generally occurs in a PP-from Complement.
Result_size is the size that the Item has after the event. It is typically expressed in a PP Complement headed by to.
This FE identifies the Size_change of an Item.
This FE identifies the Rate of change of the value.
This FE identifies the Duration of time that the expansion takes.
This FE identifies the Time when the expansion occurs.
Co_variable is the quantity that varies commensurately with the size of the Item, usually construed to be causally linked to the size.
This FE is used for any description of the Manner of the expansion including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
This FE identifies the Degree to which the expansion occurs.
Path is used for any expression that gives information about points on the scale of size that the Item traverses between the starting and ending point of its movement.

Words in this frame have to do with a Cognizer believing that some Phenomenon will take place in the future. Some words in the frame (e.g. foresee.v) indicate that the Phenomenon is asserted also to be true, while others do not. Michael expected Abby to demand examples. From the look on her face Michael expected that she would say she got the job.
This is the person who believes some Phenomenon will take place in the future. It is normally expressed as an External Argument: Pat expects that the Yankees will win the World Series.

This is what the Cognizer believes will happen in the future. It can be expressed as a Finite Clause Complement, an NP Object, or a VP Complement with or without an NP Object (see General Grammatical Observations):
Depictive phrase describing the actor of an action
Words in this frame may occur with a PP headed by from which expresses the Evidence on which knowledge or belief is based: I have learned from experience that poison oak can be painful.
The location where the Cognizer foresees the Phenomenon.
The time when the Cognizer makes the prediction.
An entity that serves as the focus of a predicted Phenomenon.
A Person usually resides or works in a Location. Is Mr. Adams in today? DNI
The Location is the place of business or residence prototypically occupied by the Person.
The Person is located in or at a place that they customarily occupy.
The time period during which the Person occupies the Location.
The length of the time interval during which the Person occupies the Location.

A Payer gives up (or potentially gives up) the use of an Asset (generally money) in order to achieve an Intended_event. This event is often more specifically described as gaining possession of some Goods or receiving a Service. In the majority of cases, the Payer is described generically (INI), and the situation depicted answers the question of how much of an Asset would have to be given up to receive the Goods or bring about the Intended_event. It 'll cost Sandra's parents fifty grand a year for her to attend that school. That book would cost you more than twenty dollars to bind in a local book bindery. Stamps used to cost only five cents. INI The cost of a trip to a resort or spa varies by region, dependent primarily on weather, not local economic conditions. INI Well, it 'll cost you. For you, thirty bucks is practically free. DNI
The FE Goods is the item(s) whose price is being assessed. Goods is usually an External Argument:
The person whose Asset is given up in order to achieve an Intended_event. This FE is often expressed as INI.
The price of or payment made for the Goods.
The place where a transaction would take place, generally where Goods and services are created or sold.
This FE identifies theDegree to which Goods are cheap or expensive.
The event that the Payer brings about by deploying the Asset.
The time when a transaction takes place.
The amount of an Asset relative to some measure of the Goods

An Experiencer is involved in a bodily injury to a Body_part. (In some cases, no Body_part need be indicated.) Often an Injuring_entity on which the Experiencer injures themselves is mentioned. I think that I hurt myself pretty bad back there. He smacked his head on the mantel getting up from poking at the fire.
The location on the body of the Experiencer where the bodily injury takes place.
The event in which the bodily injury takes place.
Manner in which the injury takes place.
The place where the harming event occurs.
The being or entity that is injured.
The time when the harming event occurs.
The Experiencer injures him/herself on an Injuring_entity.
The extent to which the Experiencer is affected by the injury.
The number of times that the injury happens to the Experiencer.
The period of time during which the Experiencer repeatedly receives bodily injuries.
The number of times that the Experiencer has an experience of bodily harm.

The words in this frame describe an Experiencer's emotions with respect to some Content. A Reason for the emotion may also be expressed. Although the Content may refer to an actual, current state of affairs, quite often it refers to a general situation which causes the emotion. My enjoyment of the movie was considerably impaired by the seven-foot guy sitting in front of me. Smithers takes great pleasure in collecting matchboxes. Sergio derives great pleasure from smoking. Smoking gives me extreme pleasure. With certain verbs, the Circumstances can be expressed in a finite clausal or wh- complement which may optionally be preceded by a Null NP Object: I hate it when you do that. Note: This is not how it is currently tagged.
The Experiencer experiences the emotion or other internal state.

Content is what the Experiencer's feelings or experiences are directed towards or based upon. The Content differs from a stimulus because the Content is not construed as being direcly responsible for causing the emotion.
The Reason is the explanation for why an Experiencer experiences the particular emotion.
The Degree to which the experience occurs.

The Frame Element Expressor marks expressions that indicate a body part, gesture or other expression of the Experiencer that reflect his or her emotional state. They describe a presentation of the experience or emotion denoted by the adjective or noun.
The Parameter is a domain in which the Experiencer experiences the Content.
The Topic is the area about which the Experiencer has the particular experience.
The State is the abstract noun that describes a more lasting experience by the Experiencer.
The Event is the occasion or happening that Experiencers in a certain emotional state participate in.

The Circumstances FE encodes the circumstances or conditions under which the Experiencer experiences the emotion. Unlike Content it does not give the specific content of the emotion, but the Content can often be inferred from the Circumstances.
The time at which the Experiencer is in the specified emotional state.
Some phenomenon (the Stimulus) provokes a particular emotion in an Experiencer. Nightmare on Elm Street scared me silly.
The Experiencer reacts emotionally or psychologically to the Stimulus.
The Stimulus is the event or entity which brings about the emotional or psychological state of the Experiencer.
The Degree is the degree to which the Stimulus brings about an emotion in the Experiencer.
Depictive identifies a phrase which describes a state of the Experiencer.
The Manner in which the Stimulus affects the Experiencer.
The Means by which the Stimulus affects the Experiencer.
The Result of the Stimulus affecting the Experiencer.
The Circumstances is the circumstances under which the Stimulus brings about the experience.
The reason why the Stimulus causes the emotion in the Experiencer.
The Time when the Experiencer has an emotion as caused by the Stimulus.

This frame concerns people's knowledge or skill in certain domains. It does not concern acquaintance or familiarity with people. With adjectives as targets in this frame, we annotate on two FE layers. FE Layer-1: He is an experienced programmer. FE Layer-2: He is an experienced programmer.
The person whose expertise is assessed.
Skill identifies the Protagonist's talent or ability to do things with one's hand or body.
The area of knowledge (as opposed to a practical skill) in which the Protagonist 's experience is assessed.
A product of behavior that shows the Protagonist's skill or lack of skill.

This frame element can only occur in place of a skill expression. It refers to the prototypical patient in an action involving the Protagonist. For instance, in the following sentence the children are experts at some (contextually given) action such as rolling the hoops. Some children were quite expert with wooden hoops.
This frame element denotes a role in which the protagonist has developed his expertise.
The Manner give further description of the way in which the Protagonist exhibits their skill or lack of skill.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.
The Time when the Protagonist has the expertise.

A Question about the reason or cause of a known State_of_affairs is presented as being answered by the existence of a particular Fact. The exact chain of reasoning, including the answer itself, of which the Fact is a part is not specified. Contrast this frame with the Evidence frame which casts a Support (a fact) as providing Evidence for, or conclusively proving, the Proposition (another proposed fact). Thus, there is no open question in the Evidence frame. Ruby's orange vest marked with the words "service dog" accounts for why the 3-year-old goes along. The nation's history explains why the current conflict succumbs to, and yet simultaneously transcends, the stereotype. Then that I exist is explained by A and B having come together. Lack of potential for improvement in the immediate future accounts for the low number of returnees into South Ossetia, even for the Ossetian ethnic group. That explains it. Somehow this explains why Apple is always the last man to get the technology.
A fact which can be connected by a chain of reasoning to the State_of_affairs.
A fact whose cause is under consideration.
This FE identifies how much of the State_of_affairs is explained by the Fact.
This FE indicates salient characteristics of the Fact considered as an explanation.
An intermediate logical step that justifies the relationship between the Fact and the State_of_affairs.
The perspective of an individual who judges whether they consider the Fact an explanation for the State_of_affairs.
An open proposition concerning the cause of the State_of_affairs.

The state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the Concessive.

An Exporter moves Goods across a border from an Exporting_area to an Importing_area. Several companies actually make most of their income by exporting goods out of the country. Exportation into nations of "special interest" is essentially prohibited.

The conscious entity, generally a person, that moves the Goods across a border out of the Exporting_area. Very often, an Exporting_area will metonymically stand in for the person or persons directly responsible for the movement of the Goods. In such cases the constituent should be labeled Exporter on the first layer and with the appropriate locational FE on the second layer.
A mobile entity directed by the Exporter that holds the Goods and moves them along from the Exporting_area to the Importing_area.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Exporter that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An intentional action performed by the Exporter that accomplishes the action indicated by the target.
The items of value whose location is changing.
This FE identifies the state-of-affairs that the Exporter is attempting to bring about by exporting.
A state of affairs that explains why the Exporter moves the Goods across the border.
This FE identifies the time when the Exporter moves the Goods.
This FE identifies the state of a participant during the action
The FE Importing_area is the place that the Goods end up as a result of motion.
Path identifies the location of the Goods during transit, i.e. after leaving the Exporting_area and before reaching the Importing_area.
The place where the Goods are initially, before the the Exporter moves them.
This FE presents the current frame as an integral part of a larger conceptualization expressed by another frame.
This FE indicates what subtype of the general category the Exporting event belongs to.

A Communicator publically communicates some difficult-to-express Content which they (or a social group of which they are a member) have had for some time. The Content may not have been previously communicated due to inability or social stricture. In cases where the individuals addressed are a smaller group than the public at large, a separate Addressee may be expressed. Those grievances can be aired during Board meetings. CNI Saddam voiced his joy when he was told Spain's new government had left the US-led military coalition in Iraq.
The Communicator is the person who expresses the Content (whether spoken or written).
The Addressee is the person to whom the Content is communicated.
The attitude or feeling that the Communicator had not previously expressed.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Communicator that also affect the action (eagerly).
An act whereby the Communicator communicates the Content.
The emotional or physical state of the Communicator that leads to their communication.
Medium is the observable action or product of the Communicator.
The state of the Communicator during the statement.
The time when the Content is communicated.
The FE specifies the place where the communication takes place.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE indicate that the particular Statement event referred to is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. Most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
The Purpose is the desired result of public expression.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.

The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the communication and any of its participants. Quite often, Circumstances secondarily provide an Explanation for the particular communication.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the particular public expression logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the expression, but not in all cases.

A Suspect in a Current_jurisdiction is forced by Authorities (of the Current_jurisdiction) to go to the Crime_jurisdiction, i.e. the jurisdiction which requested that the Suspect be handed over for trial for a crime which he or she is suspected to have committed in the Crime_jurisdiction. The purpose or reason for the extradition may also be expressed.
The Authorities act on behalf of the Current_jurisdiction, giving up the Suspect to the Crime_jurisdiction.
The jurisdiction (generally a nation) the Suspect starts off in.
The jurisdiction (generally a nation) to which the Suspect is sent.
The Suspect is forced to go to the jurisdiction where a crime he or she is suspected of took place or is being tried.
The Purpose for which the Authorities extradite the Suspect.
The Reason for which the Authorities extradite the Suspect.
This FE indicates the basis in law of an extradition.
The time at which the Suspect is moved.
A description of the manner of the extradition.
A description of the Authorities or Suspect during the extradition.
The act of the Authorities which brings about the transfer from the Current_jurisdiction to the Crime_jurisdiction.
The location where the extradition occurs.

An Entity that has characteristics which change over time is at a point or in a phase of its development in which, compared to other actual or expected stages of development, it possesses extremely high or low powers or intensity. The high or low level of development correlates with the occurrence of a Marker, a product produced by the Entity or an event in which it participates, which is indicative of the Entity's abilities or intensity. The Tang Dynasty was the high point of the Silk Road's importance. Meeting Fiona Bennett was the LOW POINT of my summer. It must be remembered that this man was born at the zenith of the Victorian age and witnessed the glory of Britain at her greatest. But Lubitsch was at the high point of his genius, and he has made a masterpiece not to be missed.
An concrete or abstract entity that possesses characteristics that change over time.

A point or phase in time when, viewed across the actual or expected development, the Entity's powers have reached an extreme high or low point. The point or phase is often identified metonymically by reference to a product created by the Entity or an event involving the Entity.

An Entity possesses a Value for a certain Attribute which is extreme when compared to the values either of other entities or to values of the same Entity at other points of time. Airfares hit a 10-year low today. DNI Today's temperature high was 71F, and the low was 50F. INI The index hit a post crash high of 2,423.9. DNI By 1972, the campus had reached a historic enrollment high of 6,300. So, right after the company's IPO, you happily bought at the high of $14 per share, because you believed they were the first player into this market? DNI INI We are currently expecting a price low associated with the 9-Month (40-Week) Cycle. INI The Swiss low of 5.8 percent in 1999 was followed by a high of 12.6 percent in 2001. DNI
The Entity whose Value of a particular gradable Attribute is extreme.
The feature of an Entity which is under discussion.
A quantity or other characterization of the Entity's state with respect to the Attribute.
The period for which values of a particular Attribute of one or more entities are compared.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.
The Domain for which there is a Value of an Attribute of an Entity.
A characterization of some property of the Extreme_value.

This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action. The depicted state does not necessarily or usually facilitate or cause the state of affairs reported by the target.
The reason for which the Extreme_value event occurs.
The words in this frame refer to facial Expressions and the Possessors of those Expressions.
Degree to which the Expression occurs.
This is the person who exhibitis the Expression.

The Expression may be prompted by either some outside phenomenon or occurrence, or by an Internal_cause - the Possessor's mental or emotional state. Internal_cause is expressed in a PP Complement as in:
The part of the face saliently exhibiting the Expression.
The emotion that is conveyed by a particular Expression.
An entity toward which the Expression is directed.
The state of affairs perceived by the Possessor which leads to an Internal_cause (emotion, etc.) which then gives rise to the Expression.
The period of time for which the facial Expression is held.

In this frame an Action is evaluated with respect to how fairly, justly or equitably the Action affects the Affected_party. An Actor may also be identified, who performs the Action and may be characterized as fair, unfair, etc. based on how these actions affect the Affected_party. Grounds may also be identified. Smithers was being very fair about the distribution of supplies. Smithers was being very fair about distributing the supplies. The decision was fair to all involved. It was not fair for the warning to remain in place. The company was unfair to its loyal employees. Smith received a fair trial. The student loan system is socially unjust.
The Actor is the individual who performs the Action and can thus be characterized with repsect to how that Action affects the Affected_party.
The Action is judged based on how just and appopriate it is to the Affected_party in a particular situation.
The Grounds is the event or state that requires some decision or action in response to it for which the Actor is judged.
The Affected_party's treatment is what determines the evaluation of the Actor's Action.
The Degree is the extent to which the Action or Actor is evaluated as being fair or unfair.
The Parameter is the area in which the Action is judged.
A holistic characterization of the description of the Actor, including depictions of the Actor's state in terms of how it affects the entire description.

A Sleeper goes from wakefulness to an altered state of consciousness where they are largely unaware of their environment. The LUs of this frame are differentiated by how quickly and deeply the state is entered and what causes the change (especially whether it comes about naturally as a result of sleepiness or is brought about by injury).
This FE identifies the Place where the event occurs.
The Sleeper is the entity that falls asleep.
This FE identifies the Time where the event occurs.

An Entity is well-known among a wide range of people (in general or in a particular domain) for a particular Reason, which may be a behavior, characteristic, or some other associated item. In the case of events, fame entails a large number of people being aware of the event's occurence; in the case of concrete entities, including humans, fame entails awareness of existence. In both cases, often fame is accompanied by awareness of the Entity's significance in historical, cultural, or social contexts. Shakespeare was famous during his life because he performed in front of Queen Elizabeth I more than anyone else.
The Entity which is widely known and recognized.
A modifier expressing the degree of fame of the Entity.
The Time during which the Entity is famous.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity is considered famous.
A state of affairs that provides an explanation (via reasoning, causation, etc.) for the level of fame of the Entity.
The behavior, attribute, or associated entities that provide the reason for the Entity being famous.
The length of time during which the Entity is famous.
The location where the Entity is famous.
The Role underwhich the Entity become famous.
The way in which the Entity becomes famous.

An Entity is presented as having been seen or experienced by a (typically generic and backgrounded) Cognizer on a certain number of occasions, causing the Entity to have a certain degree of recognizability for the Cognizer. Susanna Fulton's work is new to me. Two of these frames were new to me as a beginning professor. This was as new to him as the rest of the outcity. JSON is fairly new to me as a data format. Moreover, this way of describing and categorizing architecture is familiar to most people. Coronaviruses are not unfamiliar to the epidemiological world. Abbey Stadium will bring us into contact with one familiar face at least.
A concrete thing or abstract phenomenon or fact that is assessed in terms of how well recognizable it is to a Cognizer.
The (typically non-specific and backgrounded) sentient being for whom the Entity possesses a specified level of recognizability.
The deviation of the actual level of recognizability of the Entity from the level specified by the target.

This FE identifies the role filled by a particular participant of the clause headed by the target. In so doing, it relates the specification of a level of familiarity to another background state of affairs by indicating that one of the role fillers of the current frame also fills a second kind of role in the background, either generically or in some specific instance.
This FE describes the Cognizer as being in some state during the event.
A situation or source from which the Entity is made more recognizanble to the Cognizer.

The Fastener is an artifact created to close a Container (e.g. coat, jar). Sometimes, the Container_portal rather than the Container is expressed. The door seal prevented air from getting in and the kids' screams from getting out. She has an antique ivory button at the front and another vintage button on her apron. NIST designed a high pressure seal for the extension sleeve using a series of metal washers to load the window under pressure.
This FE identifies the item that is closed with the Fastener.
The artifact created to close a Container.
This FE identifies the active zone of the container where the Fastener is located.
This FE identifes the material from which the Fastener is made.
This FE identifies a characteristic or description of the Fastener.
An individual or individuals that bring the Fastener into existence.
The time at which the Fastener comes into existence.
The term used to refer to the Fastener.
An indication of the subtype of the Fastener.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Fastener is made.
An Experiencer, Expressor, or State can be described as characterized as having an emotion of fear concerning a particular Topic or as evoked by a Stimulus.
The Experiencer is the person or sentient entity that experiences or feels the emotions.
The Topic is the general area in which the emotion occurs. It indicates a range of possible Stimulus.
The Stimulus is the person, event, or state of affairs that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.
The extent to which the Experiencer's emotion deviates from the norm for the emotion.
The Empathy_target is the individual or individuals with which the Experiencer identifies emotionally and thus shares their emotional response.
The body part, gesture, or other expression of the Experiencer that reflects his or her emotional state. They describe a presentation of the experience or emotion denoted by the adjective or noun.
The Reason is the explanation for why the Stimulus evokes a certain emotional response.

The Circumstances is the condition(s) under which the Stimulus evokes its response. In some cases it may appear without an explicit Stimulus. Quite often in such cases, the Stimulus can be inferred from the Circumstances
The State is the abstract noun that describes a more lasting experience by the Experiencer.
The Parameter is a domain in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus.

Any description of the way in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). Manner may also describe a state of the Experiencer that affects the details of the emotional experience.
The Time when the Experiencer, Expressor, or State can be described as having said emotion.

In this frame an Experiencer experiences an Emotion or is in an Emotional_state. There can also be an Evaluation of the internal experiential state. John feels anger towards his mother. Martha feels angry. Dr. Hibbert feels good. Inalienably possessed aspects of the Experiencer frequently stand in for the Experiencer. Her heart felt angry.
The Experiencer experiences the Emotion or is in the Emotional_state.
The Emotion is the feeling that the Experiencer experiences.
The Emotional_state is the state the Experiencer is in.
The Evaluation is a negative or positive assessment of the Experiencer regarding his or her Emotional_state.
The thing or state-of-affairs that leads to the Experiencer feeling the Emotion or Emotional_state.
An Agent acts in such a way as to give the incorrect impression to observers that a particular State_of_affairs holds. Jordan feigned a love of jazz music to get her phone number .
The Agent is the person who acts in a misleading way to create the impression that a State_of_affairs holds.
This is the entity which is copied. With verbs it is frequently expressed as an NP Object: Pat falsified the papers.
The Copy produced by the Creator most commonly occurs as the External Argument of a predicative use of an adjective or noun target: The painting is a fake.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An act performed by the Agent that accomplishes the imitation.
The State_of_affairs is a an event, a state, or a property that the Agent wants others to believe have occurred or hold.
An action or state that the Agent intends to accomplish by performing the feigning of some State_of_affairs.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the feigning event logically follows.
How often the Agent engages in the Feigning event.
The Time when the Agent feigns something.
The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.
The amount of time that the Agent feigns something.
This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs as being in some state during the feigning action.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
The place in which the Agent feigns something.

An individual or group (Practitioner) or a part of their work life (Work) is defined professionally by the Activity that they typically engage in. Alternatively, the Activity may be indicated by a Salient_entity conventionally associated with it. Chris was in the construction industry for 20 years before coming to GSCM. My career was in oil and gas.
An activity that defines a group of people in their professional capacity.
The individual, group, or organization that engages in the Activity as part of their profession.
A physical or abstract entity that is characteristically associated with the Activity.
A phase of a Practitioner's career that is spent engaged in an Activity.
The subfield of the Activity that the Practitioner is engaged in.
The location where the Practitioner engages in the Activity.
The Time when the Practitioner engages in the Activity.

A generally large group of people, the Combatants, are engaged in a chaotic, violent, and usually protracted Fight amongst themselves. There are no distinct sides, and generally no particular goal (compare Hostile_encounter). The Fight may be described as having a Manner or Degree of violence. Time and Place may also be expressed.
The Combatants participate as fighters in the Fight.
This is the Degree of violence of the Fight.
An activity that engaged in by the Combatants while fighting.
The Issue over which Fight happens.
The amount of time for which the Fight takes place.
The means by which the Combatants engage in the Fight.
The weapon or other instrument used by the Combatants.
The state of affairs that (some of) he Combatants wish to acheive by fighting.

These are words relating to filling containers and covering areas with some thing, things or substance, the Theme. The area or container can appear as the direct object with all these verbs, and is designated Goal because it is the goal of motion of the Theme. Corresponding to its nuclear argument status, it is also affected in some crucial way, unlike goals in other frames. Lionel Hutz coated the wall with paint.
The Agent is the actor who instigates the filling.
The Theme is the physical object or substance which changes location.
The Source is the location where the Theme begins its motion.
The Path is the trajectory of the motion.
The Goalis the area or container being filled. Goal is generally the NP Object in this frame.
Degree to which the filling occurs.
Depictive phrase describing the Agent of the filling action.
The Manner in which the filling occurs.
The Means by which the filling occurs.
The Result is the resultant state after the filling has occurred.
The Reason for which the Agent fills or covers the Goal.
The purpose for which the Agent fills the Goal.
The Instrument with which the filling occurs.
The Subregion is the smaller area of the Goal where the filling or covering occurs.
An event which brings about the filling of the Goal.

The Payer is (legally) forced to pay a Fine by an official Speaker as a punishment for some action (the Reason). The Speaker represents an entity which receives the payment. They were fined approximately $3.1 billion dollars for their knowing, malicious injury to consumers.
The Speaker is the person imposes the fine upon the Payer.
The instrument with which the fining is performed.
The action that is taken that results in punishement/reward. His parents disciplined him by taking away his toys. The Bar Association rewarded her by host a lunch in her honor.
The purpose for which an intentional act is performed. John flattered her to receive a raise.
The Payer is the person or thing about whom/which a judgment is made. With verbs this FE is typically expressed as Object:

A description of the event (or state) not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of the Speaker that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).

Typically, there is a constituent expressing the Reason for the Judge's judgment. It is usually a for-PP, e.g. I admire you for your intellect. For some words in this domain, the Reason frame element is obligatory. That is to say, the overt expression of this frame element may only be omitted when the reason for the judgment is understood from context. For example, the sentence 'I blame you!' can only be uttered when it is clear what the addressee is being blamed for.
The money given to expiate some debt for transgression. Pat paid 14 dollars in fines.
In isome cases, price or payment is described per unit of Goods. The manager pays the paper boys five dollars an hour Rate.
This FE is any unit in which goods or services can be measured. Generally, it occurs in a by-PP. Bob sells peppers by weight. Lee buys potatoes by the pound.
The imposition of a debt due to culpable behavior.
The Degree to which the Fine is punitive to the Payer.

A Competition comes to an end, with a Competitor tying, winning, or losing against an Opponent (or opponents) according to their Score. (In the symmetrical situation of a tie, the Competitor and Opponent may be jointly mentioned as Competitors.) According to the Score that the Competitor and Opponent have achieved, they may receive a Rank or a Prize. The Margin may also be mentioned. Unbelievable--he lost the gold medal by just .02 points! Looks like it will came to a draw between Woods and Stephenson.
The individual involved in the Competition.
The individual that the Competitor has been competing against.
The individuals who compete against each other.
A quantity whereby progress is measured during the game, and Rank and Prizes are awarded to the Competitors afterward.
The amount by which the Competitor's and Opponent's Scores differ.
The rank (according to Score) that a Competitor acheives.
A socially and/or monetarily significant entity which is given to a Competitor according to Score or Rank.
The event in which the Competitors compete with each other.
An action of the Competitor that results in the outcome of the Competition.

Any description of the Competition which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of a Competitor that also affect their action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The time at which the Competition takes place.
The location at which the Competition takes place.
This FE is for the named venue of a competition, particularly when the place has been built for the purpose of a competition.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

A Player finishes a Game, possibly with an outcome of winning or losing. A Game is an activity that is considered recreational, and is valued for associated pleasure, as well as social interaction, material reward, or status. Not all games can be won or lost. Those that are specifically competitions are defined in the inheriting frame Finish_competition. In some LUs, the Game is DNI. John won the lottery! John lost.
An activity the Player participates in.
The individual participating in a Game.

Any description of the Game which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of a Player that also affect their action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An action of the Player that results in the outcome of the Game.
The time at which the Game takes place.
An Employer ends an employment relationship with an Employee. There is often a Reason given for the action.
The person who is let go by their Employer.
The person (or institution) that end an employment relationship with an Employee.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an Employer fires an Employee.
This FE identifies the Place where the Employer fires the Employee.
The label given to a particular type of employment.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Employer fires the Employee.
The action that the Employee is relieved from doing for the Employer .
This FE identifies the Time when an Employer fires the Employee.
The Reason for which the Employee is terminated.
The means whereby the Employer fires the Employee

An implicit experiencer has an Experience for the first time. Some LU's may specifically imply an agentive activity. In Italy the term was first used by the Venetians in 1546 This time, the comet was first seen on the night of 19th October, 1805 by European observers Jean Louis Pons, Johann Sigismund Huth, and Alexis Bouvard
An event happens for the first time within the Context.
A spatial, cultural, or personal delimitation within which the Experience occurs for the first time.

An Item is located at the top end of a scale of importance or social rank (or some other Attribute) in comparison to other members of a Contrast_set (usually, implicit) that is otherwise similar in kind to the Item. Oftentimes, the limits of the Contrast_set are determined by an expression of the Limits_of_consideration. The main problem is that the administration has not yet clarified "Regime change." INI Oh, he had a great many concerns -- chief among them his own boredom. Their primary objective in Bosnia was bringing about a lasting peace. INI
An Item is the foremost thing in the Contrast_set.
This FE identifies the domain (usually temporally or spatially defined) within which the Item is primary among its kind.
The Contrast_set is a group of entities similar to the Item out of which the Item is the most preeminent.
The Attribute of the Item which is under consideration.

A Self_mover responds to a (real or imagined) danger by moving away from it. She had fled from DCS facilities several times before.. Pakistanis in US trying to flee to Canada hit roadblocks. Anderson's division suddenly bolted north from Devil's Den, flanked out III Corps almost entirely, and shattered the entire Corps. We fled for several miles before reaching our safe-house.
Self_mover is the living (or self-directed) being which moves under its own power.
Source is used for any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion.
Path is used for any description of a trajectory of motion involving a landmark which is neither a Source nor a Goal. This includes "middle of path'' expressions.
Goal is used for any expression which tells where the Self_mover ends up as a result of the motion.

An expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory or rate of motion. Descriptions of steadiness, grace, means of motion, and other things count as Manner expressions.
Any expression which characterizes the extent of motion expresses the frame element Distance.
The time when the motion occurs.
An entity whose motion is correlated with that of the Self_mover, following and tracking the Self_mover, being followed and tracked, or with both parties mutually matching Paths.
The rate at which the location of the Self_mover changes with respect to time.
Depictive phrase describing the actor of an action
An act whereby the Self_mover achieves movement.
The state of the world which exists because of the motion of the Self_mover
The emotional or mental state of the Self_mover which motivates them toward motion or the particular manner of motion.
The amount of time for which the Self_mover moves.
This FE identifies the purpose for which a Self_mover moves.
The Place is the location within which a defined motion takes place. Any specified or implied Source, Path or Goal should designate a location contained with the Place.
The state of affairs that leads to the particular motion that the Self_mover adopts.
External_cause is something in the external environment that causes the Self_mover to move.
The direction that the Self_mover heads in during the motion.
The entity used by the Self_mover in getting away from the undesirable Source.
In this frame a Fluid moves from a Source to a Goal along a Path or within an Area. The blood spurted from the wound. The water gushed into the house .
Area is the setting in which the Fluid's movement takes place on an unspecified Path.
This FE describes the phsyical extent of the motion of the Fluid.
The amount of time for which the Fluid moves.
Goal is the location the Fluid ends up.
The Path is the trajectory along which the Fluid moves.
The Source is the location the Fluid occupies initially.
This is the rate at which the Fluid flows.
The Fluid is the entity that changes location and moves in a fluidic way.
The Time when the Fluid flows.
The Configuration encodes information about the amount, arrangement, and unitization of the flow.
The Manner in which the Fluid flows.
The Cause is the reason for the fluidic motion.
This FE identifies the Depictive phrase describing the Fluid throughout the action.
This FE identifies the result of the Fluid moving.
The Place describes the location of the motion which has a specified Source, Path or Goal.
This frame contains words referring to items of food. Specialties include deep fried shredded beef , duck , prawn dishes and hand-made noodles.
This FE indicates a characteristic or description of the food.
This FE identifies a particular Type of the food item.

A Gatherer removes Crop ripe and ready to an accepted degree. The Crop comes from a Source where it has been grown and matured. They harvest their pumpkins in the Autumn. INI We bring in the tobacco from the fields during the summer. The stage at which the peppercorns are harvested from the vine decides their colour . CNI
The Gatherer is the agent gathering the Crop.
Crop is item being collected together by the Gatherer.
For what length of time the Gatherer was gathering the Crop.
The Manner in which the Gatherer gathers the Crop.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Crop is gathered.
The greater geographic location where the Gatherer gathers his Crop.
When the Crop gathering action occurs.
An action that the Gatherer intends to accomplish by gathering his Crop.
How often the Gatherer collects his Crop.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
The Source is the ground where the Crop is gathered from.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
This FE describes the amount of effort put into the food gathering event.
The person on who's behalf the Gatherer gathers the Crop.
A Current_country is identified as matching or not matching the instance of the Discourse_salient_country. Foreign sales account for only 20% of IBM's income .
The materials or Constituent_parts that make up the Current_country.
The location that the Current_country is a part of.
The country or countries that the speaker is indicating in the current instance, which may match or be distinct from the Discourse_salient_country.
ULTIMATELY TO BE REPLACED BY MULTIWORD TARGETS (in almost all cases). This FE is used for the Names of Locales.
A place that the Current_country is located with respect to.
Any description, characteristic, or property of the Current_country which is not covered by more specific FEs.
The people living in the jurisdiction of the locale.

The country that has been featured in the discourse, or that the speaker/hearer identify with or are located in; it serves to identify the Current_country by specifying it as the same or different. This FE is incorporated in the targets of this frame.

An Agent produces a Forgery, an entity that they intend to pass off as a particular (instance of) a Standard. An instance of the Standard may actually exist that served as an original that is copied by the Agent, or the Standard exists only as an idea. So who was it that faked the photo "showing" Jane Fonda and John Kerry with the Vietcong?
The Agent is the person that creates a Forgery with the intent of passing it off as (an instance of) the Standard.
The Forgery is the product that the Agent creates with the intent of passing it off as (an instance of) the Standard.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An act performed by the Agent that accomplishes the imitation.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the forging event logically follows.
An action or state that the Agent intends to accomplish by producing the Forgery.
The Standard is the actually existing or imagined (kind of) thing that the Agent wants to pass the Forgery off as.
An entity manipulated by the Agent in order to produce the Forgery.
The location in which the Agent makes a Forgery.
The time at which the forgery takes place.
The way in which the Forgery does or does not match the Standard.
An entity corresponding to the Standard which the Agent scrutinizes in order to copy.
A Judge refrains from imposing, or demanding a punishment for an Evaluee who has committed an Offense. God forgives repentant sinners. Won't you forgive me for keeping it a secret?
The Judge holds the Evaluee responsible for the Offense.
The Evaluee is subject to the judgment of the Judge for having committed the Offense.
The Offense is the illicit or unpleasant act committed by the Evaluee.
AForgoer decides not to partake in something ordinary that is otherwise Desirable. Chuck often skips lunch.
TheForgoer decides not to partake in the desirable activity or event.
Desirable identifies the event or activity in which is the Forgoer does not partake.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the forgoing occurs.
This FE identifies the Manner the forgoing occurs.
This FE identifies the Means by which the forgoing occurs.
This FE identifies the Place where the forgoing occurs.
This FE identifies the Time at which the the forgoing occurs.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which the forgoing occurs.
This FE identifies the Reason for which the forgoing occurs.
This FE identifies the Circumstances under which the Forgoer does not partake in the Desirable.
Partner_1 interacts with Partner_2 (also collectively expressible as Partners) to change their social relationship. I befriended the little pony by giving him a piece of apple.
The individual who comes to form a relationship with Partner_2.
The individual whose relationship with Partner_1 changes.
The individuals whose relationship is changing.
The action that Partner_1 or the Partners take in order to bring about the change in the relationship.
The time when the relationship changes.

Any description of the event including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Partner_1 or Partners that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
A salient state of Partner_1, Partner_2, or Partners which affects the perception of the formation of relationship.
The length of time that the changed relationship status lasts.
The state-of-affairs that the Partners or Partner_1 hope to bring about by changing their status.
?Formally? and ?officially? plus maybe ?technically? and ?in law.? This FE indicates the legal- or "by rule" domain within which the Forming_relationship event is true or operational.
How often the Forming_relationship event occurs.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.

A Whole fragments or breaks into Parts, or alternatively a part, Part_1, breaks off from the rest of the item, called Part_2. Last year, it broke off from the Ross Ice Shelf and began drifting out to sea. The calved ice broke into three large icebergs, named A22, A23 and A24.
The Whole is a single entity which breaks into Parts.
This refers collectively to the Parts resulting from fragmentation of a Whole.
Part-1 is the first of two Parts mentioned. This is most often the external argument of a verb.
Part_2 is the second of two Parts mentioned. This is usually a PP Complement.
This frame element expresses a property of the Parts or components of the Whole which correlates with the locations (e.g.) of fragmentation on the Whole.
This FE identifies any Depictive phrase describing any of the undergoers of the fragmentation.
This FE identifies the Result of an event.
This FE identifies the Time when the fragmenting occurs.
The hard surface against which the Whole (or Part_1) breaks.
An action or state that enables the fragmentation.

This frame has to do with the repetition (and especially the frequency of repetition) of an event. Many of the adjectives and adverbs in this frame are based on nouns in the Calendric_unit frame. China will have to face a high frequency of sand storms in the years to come.
This FE is used for any (bounded) Event whose frequency or iteration is described.
The extent to which the actually observed rate of occurrence of the Event or Salient_entity differs from the expected rate.
The Intervalis a noun modified by the target word. The target word specifies the frequency of the Interval.
The Time_span is the length of time of the Interval. This FE is incorporated by most of the lexical units in this frame.
The number of times per unit of real or scanning time that an Event or Salient_entity is encountered.
An entity which the implicit cognizer encounters with the specified frequency.
The frequency feature of the Event or Salient_entity that is under discussion. All the lexical units in this frame incorporate this frame element.
The Time when the Event has a particular frequency.

A Theme moves on or against the surface of a Static_object. (Alternatively, Themes moves against each other simultaneously). The Theme exerts pressure on the surface and experiences resistance to its movement. Smithers' boots scraped on the floor.
The physical entity which moves over the suface of the Static_object
A non-moving physical object over a surface of which the Theme moves.
Two moving entities whose surfaces move against each other.
The way in which the Theme moves against the Static_object
The setting in which the motion of the Theme happens
The amount of friction produced in the Theme's motion.
An individual or organization, the Front, serves as a cover for an Illicit_activity or an Illicit_organization.
The Front acts as a legitimate individual, organization, or enterprise, but is truly a cover for an illicit organization or activity.
The existence and activities of the Illicit_organization are concealed by the Front.
The Illicit_activity of the Illicit_organizationis concealed by (the activities of) the Front.
The time at which the deceptive activity occurs
The state-of-affairs that the Front is attempting to bring about.
The place where the fronting occurs.
The action taken by the Front to ensure successful deceit of authorities.
Any description of the similarity of the event to some other event, particularly descriptions of the Front that also affect the details of the action.

The words of this frame describe how a Resource_controller spends money or other Resources for a particular purpose . They can be applied to the Resource_controller or to their Behavior in particular instances. These words indicate a judgment of how conservatively the Resource_controller guards their Resource. Margeret has always been penny-wise. Bill squanders his money. To spend the surplus now would be needlessly profligate .

The Resource_controller is the individual whose frugality or generosity is being described. Person typically occurs as the External Argument or, in some cases when Behavior is also expressed, in an of-PP:
Some specific Behavior may be described as frugal or extravagant, rather than attributing the characteristic directly to the Resource_controller.
This FE is the resource which the Resource_controller expends.
This FE identifies the Degree to which a Resource_controller is frugal or profligate.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.

A Container is in a state of fullness/emptiness with respect to some Contents. Note the connection between words in this frame and those in the Containers, Emptying, and Filling frames. John carried a bucket full of water.
Container is used for the entity whose fullness is being described.
Contents is used for the stuff that is present/absent in the Container.
The extent to which the amount of Contents in the Container diverges from the maximal expected amount for the Container.
The Time when the Container is full.
The amount of times the Container is empty per unit of time.
Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of the Container's fullness to the end.

This frame describes an Agent's gathering of Individuals (people or entities) into a group, the Aggregate, defined by relative proximity. The police gathered the suspects into a line-up. Compare this frame with Congregating, and contrast it with Amalgamating.
This FE identifies the aggregate that results from the gathering. It may be expressed either as an adjunct result phrase or as a direct object of a target verb.
Agent is the person who gathers Individuals.
This FE identifies the time when the gathering event occurs, if specified. The crowd assembled at dawn.
An act performed by the Agent that accomplishes the gathering.
This FE identifies the place where the gathering event occurs. He assembled the children in the hall.
This FE identifies the entities that come together to form an Aggregate.
The way in which the Individuals are gathered up.
An Instrument that the Agent uses to gather the Individuals together.
The state of affairs that the Agent is attempting to bring about by gathering.
This frame element is defined as the number of times the Gathering_up event occurs per some unit of time.
This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the Gathering_up event occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
Goal designates the location where the Individuals might end up.
The Co_participant participates in a coordinated way in the same event as the primary protagonist.
The Path is the trajectory of motion that the Individuals take.
The Source is the location where the Individuals are at the beginning of the gathering event.

The words in this frame have to do with non-verbal communication. Topic is not normally expressed with these words. This seems to be related to the absence of a verbal code in cases of gestural communication. Topic can be viewed as a partial characterization of a Message, but such partial characterization is either difficult or irrelevant in the absence of a verbal code. I gestured with my hand for him to come over.
This is the sentient entity that communicates a Message non-verbally. It is normally expressed as an External Argument: The teacher gestured us into the room.

This is the person to whom a non-verbal Message is communicated. It may be expressed as an NP Object or as a PP Complement: The teacher gestured us into the room. The teacher gestured to us to enter the room.

This is the content of non-verbal communication. It may be expressed as a that-clause Complement, a to-marked infinitive VP Complement, or a directional PP Complement: The teacher gestured that it was time to leave. The teacher gestured to us to enter the room. The teacher gestured us into the room.
An act performed by the Communicator that results in the successful transfer of a Message.
The Body_part is the specific body part of the Communicator which gestures.
The Place is where the gesturing occurs.
The Indicated_entity is the entity which the Communicator is pointing out to the Addressee as meaningful.
An Instrument that the Communicator uses to gesture to the Addressee together.

A new Employee obtains a Position with an Employer, with which there are certain Tasks associated; in exchange for the performance of these Tasks, the Employee receives Compensation from the Employer.
The Compensation is the payment that the Employee receives for performing a Task.
The person who enters an employment relation with an Employer.
The person (or institution) that the Employee enters an employment relationship with.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an Employee enters an employment relationship with an Employer.
This FE identifies the place where the Employee enteres an employment relationship with an Employer.
The label given to a particular type of employment.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Employee enters an employment relationship.
The action that the Employee is obligated to do for the Employer.
This FE identifies the Time when an Employee signs on with an Employer.
The action by which the Employee enters an employment relationship.
The Contract_basis is the condition of employment with respect to permanency, hours per time period or payment arrangements.

A Recipient starts off without the Theme in their possession, and then comes to possess it. Although the Source from which the Theme came is logically necessary, the Recipient and its changing relationship to the Theme is profiled. I got two whistles from John.
The Recipient indicates the entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
The Theme is the object that changes possession.
The Source is the location that the Theme formerly occupied. Persons that begin in possession of the Theme may metonymically stand in for the Source.
The Place denotes where the Getting takes place.
The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
The Reason refers to the existing eventuality that the Recipient is responding to.
The Means is the action of the Recipient which results in their possession of the Theme.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an Agent intentionally acts.
The state that either the Recipient or the Theme end up in after the acquisition.

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause.
The Beneficiary is an entity which the Recipient passes the Theme to, or shares the Theme with.
In this scenario, the Recipient begins without the Theme, then acquires the Theme from a Source.
The Recipient indicates the entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
The Theme is the object that changes possession.
The Source is the location that the Theme formerly occupied. Persons that begin in possession of the Theme may metonymically stand in for the Source.
The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
The Reason refers to the existing eventuality that the Recipient is responding to.

A Self_mover begins the motion away from a relatively deprofiled Source location. The focus is on the motion rather than on the location that is being departed. The label Self_mover here also includes vehicles that are steered by an intentional agent. After a lunch of sandwiches on paper plates, we get under way. When I got going for the day I had horrible pain down my buttocks and leg. We got going via Tikul and after a light lunch finally found the pottery place recommended in the guide, I'll make this brief, as I need to head out for the bookstore in a bit. The band "Killers" is heading out on 25-date tour through Europe and Japan this week.
The Self_mover is the volitional agent that moves.
Source refers to the starting-point of the Self_mover's motion.
Path is any description of the Self_mover's trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal.
Goal is any expression that tells where the Self_mover ends up, or would end up, as a result of the motion.

A Manner expression describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion. Descriptions of speed, steadiness, grace, means of motion, and other things count as Manner expressions.
This FE identifies the Means by which a Self_mover begins the motion.
This FE identifies the Time when the Self_mover begins the motion away from the Source.
The Depictive is a phrase which describes the state of the Self_mover when she begins the motion away from the Source.
The length of time of the Self_mover's absence from the Source.
The Mode_of_transportation is the transportation device that a human Self_mover uses to travel.
The journey is the trip or expedition on which the Self_mover embarks.
The Direction in which the Self_mover begins to move.

A Protagonist leaves the place where they have slept, their Bed, to begin or resume domestic, professional, or other activities. Getting up is distinct from Waking up, which is concerned only with the transition from the sleeping state to a wakeful state. I rose from bed, threw on a pair of camouflage shorts and drove my little Toyota Corolla to a construction clearing a few miles away. One recent Monday, for example, Joe rose from bed extra early to catch an administrator at 8:30 am. In the summer I get up early and get some miles in on my bike before the kids and Ange wake up. INI He slept or threw up the whole day. He got up for 2 hours in the evening. INI When it snowed Smithers got up before everyone else at two o'clock and swept the walkways. INI
The person or animal that has slept in a particular place and now leaves it to engage in other activities.
The place where the Protagonist has slept.
The time when the Protagonist leaves their place of sleeping.
The Purpose for which the Protagonist gets out of Bed.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Protagonist that affect the action (eagerly, carefully).
The World_state is the situation the Protagonist finds him or herself in upon getting up from Bed.
The FE Circumstances encodes a setting, often temporal or spatial, within which the getting up event takes place.
A state of affairs that the Protagonist is responding to in getting up.
The length of the interval for which the Protagonist is not in Bed after getting up.
The location in which the Protagonist's Bed is situated.

A Driver prepares a Vehicle for travel by placing it in the normal location for the operation of the vehicle or by detaching it from a place where it was held. Throughout Irish history, countless generations of exiles have cast off from the shores of Ireland. "Good," said Matt as he pulled the car out of the parking space. The next day, after weighing anchor, we cleared Longboat Pass Bridge, and exited the ICW into the open waters of the Gulf of Mexico.
This is the being, typically human, that prepares the Vehicle for motion, and will control it once it is in motion.
The device--such as a car, boat, spaceship,. etc.--which is used for transport and is prepared for travel by the Driver.
Any expression which describes the location that the Vehicle has been stationed at.
The location that the Vehicle is intended to travel to.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Driver that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The state of the Driver or Vehicle during the preparations.
The action performed by the Driver by which they prepare the Vehicle for travel.
An individual or vehicle that is also involved in the preparations.
This FE indicates the Circumstances under which the preparation of the Vehicle takes place.
The Place describes the location where the Driver prepares the Vehicle for motion.
The length of the time that the Vehicle remains in the state of readiness.
The Time when the Driver prepares the Vehicle for motion.
This FE marks a proposition from which the main clause logically follows.

A Donor transfers a Theme from a Donorto a Recipient. This frame includes only actions that are initiated by the Donor (the one that starts out owning the Theme). Sentences (even metaphorical ones) must meet the following entailments: the Donor first has possession of the Theme. Following the transfer the Donor no longer has the Theme and the Recipient does. Barney gave the beer to Moe. $300 was endowed to the university.to build a new performing arts building.
The person that begins in possession of the Themeand causes it to be in the possession of the Recipient.
The entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
The Place where the Donor gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Reason for which the Donor gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Time is when the Donor gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Purpose for which the Donor gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Means by which the Donor gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Manner is the manner in which the Donor gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Circumstances are the conditions under which the Theme is given.
The Recipient's intended purpose for the Theme.
A description of the Donor, Recipient, or Theme given independently of the giving event per se.
The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.

A Capitulator who has been opposing a Force, which is typically exerted by a Compeller, ceases opposing that Force. As a result, the Force runs its course and an Issue is resolved against the interests of the Capitulator. Accordingly, there is no basis to conclude that Tazewell acquiesced in the rule against claim-splitting. Accordingly, there is no basis to conclude that Tazewell acquiesced in the rule against claim-splitting. My uncle continued trying to placate Nuayman until the latter relented. DNI DNI Genesis acquiesced to doing a short Q and A session. DNI The government would not yield to pressure , the spokeswoman promised . DNI
The individual that yields to the Force exerted by the Compeller.
The matter, usually concerning a course of action, in which the Capitulator has disagreed with the Compeller.
An individual that intentionally exerts Force on the Capitulator.
The time period during which the Capitulator yields to the Compeller on the Issue.
The Explanation is a proposition denoting a state of affairs from which the Capitulator's giving in on the Issue logically follows.
A state of affairs, typically brought about by a Compeller, that impinges on the Capitulator and eventually causes them to no longer pursue their own view on the Issue.
The location at which the Capitulator ceases to oppose the Force.
An action that the Capitulator intends to accomplish by ceasing their opposition.

Any description of the Giving_in which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Capitulator that affect the action (reluctantly, meekly).
A modifier expressing the deviation of how the Issue is resolved from the desires of the Compeller.
The action that the Capitulator engages in after giving in to the Force.
The sequence of events in which the Donor begins in possession of the Theme, then gives it to the Recipient, relinquishing possession.
The person that begins in possession of the Themeand causes it to be in the possession of the Recipient.
The individual that ends up in possession of the Theme.
The Purpose for which the Donor gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Manner is the manner in which the Donor gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Recipient's intended purpose for the Theme.

This frame contains general words denoting equipment where the Use or purpose is not specified by the lexeme but (typically) by a separate expression. The words are described with respect to the Use for which the item is used or its typical User. coffee machine dentist's equipment
This FE identifies the prototypical Use of a tool or device.
User identifies the person who (typically) uses a particular tool.
The Frame Element Power_sourcemarks expressions that indicate how a device is powered.
The complex artefact with a particular use.
A Theme, which may or may not have a default shape or configuration, goes into a particular shape. Depending on the type of shape, there may be a Locus about which the Theme changes shape.
Where the shape-changing event takes place.
The Reason for which the change into the shape occurs.
When the changing into a particular shape occurs.
