How long the event takes place.

Any description of the shape-changing event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
How often the shape changing occurs.
The Theme goes into a particular shape.
A Landmark (in combination with the image schema evoked by particular targets) serves to pick out the final location of a Trajector in a construed or actual motion event.
The relatively locatable entity which serves as a basis for determining the location of the Trajector using the Profiled_region.
The location (located with respect to the Landmark) which is profiled by the particular image schema pertaining to the locative relation.
The entity which is construed to be in motion, whose location at the end of the construed motion event is in question.
The time at which the Trajector is located in the Profiled_region.

A Protagonist has made a Commitment but does not honor it, thereby doing harm to an Affected_party. My buddy Tom's girlfriend backed out of going to the show with me. However, the employer then backed out of that statement and did not pay the STD! The government had reneged on promises to give them land. When she and her family went back on their police statement in the Vadodara court in May 2003, it stirred a huge controversy.
The Protagonist is the person who has committed themselves to do something and later does not follow through on it.
The individual or group to whom the Protagonist had made the Commitment and who is negatively affected by the Protagonist's not honoring the Commitment.
An expression of the commitment that the Protagonist has taken on earlier and which they fail to follow through on.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, secondary effects (quietly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Protagonist that also affect the action (coldly).
The time period during which the Protagonist fails to honor their commitment.
The location in which the Protagonist fails to honor the commitment they made.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the Protagonist's failure to honor the Commitment logically follows.
In general, this FE is used for phrases that describe the Protagonist's act of going back on their Commitment as a whole.
How much the Protagonist goes back on their Commitment.

This FE presents the current frame as an integral part of a larger conceptualization expressed by another frame. The frame expressed by the target typically corresponds to a Means action within the frame expressed by the Re_encoding, but not necessarily.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times the Protagonist backed out on a commitment.
The outcome of the Protagonist going back on a commitment.

An Entity has an implicit Value for an Attribute. Degree expresses either explicit comparison or the deviation of the Value when compared with other entities of similar kind. The Value may hold only relative to a particular Time or in particular Circumstances.
The Entity for which a particular gradable Attribute is appropriate and under consideration.
The feature of an Entity which is under discussion.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Value from the norm or from the value for another Entity.
The Time during which the Entity is in the state of having a particular Value for the Attribute.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity has a particular Value for the Attribute.
The generally implicit Value of the Attribute.
The location where the Entity is has the Attribute to a given Degree.

In this frame a Grantor (either a person or an institution) grants permission for a Grantee to perform an Action or for an Action to occur. This frame does not include situations where there is a state of permission granted by authority or rule of law. The permission for the Action may be limited to certain Circumstances. My mother let me go to the movies with Simon . The teacher gave the children permission to eat their lunch outside. The Church had sanctioned for recital after Mass a special prayer to St. Michael.
The Grantor is the individual or group of individuals vested with the authority to grant permission with respect to a specific domain and who grants permission to the Grantee.
The Grantee is the individual who is given permission to engage in a certain Action.
The Action is the activitiy of the Grantee that the Grantor permits.
The Circumstances are the conditions under which an Action is permissible, according to the Grantor.
The Time is when the Grantor gives permission.
The Place is where the Grantor gives permission.
The Purpose is the goal of the Grantor in granting permission.
The Reason is the cognitive cause of the Grantor's granting of permission.

Any description of the allowing which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of the Grantor that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
A category that the Action fits into, which dictates the Action's being permitted (in accord with some implicit Principle.)
An action of the Grantor whereby they communicate or enact the granting.
This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action.
The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.
How often the Grant_permission event occurs.

A Cognizer possesses knowledge about the workings, significance, or meaning of an idea or object, which we call Phenomenon, and is able to make predictions about the behavior or occurrence of the Phenomenon. The Phenomenon may be incorporated into the wider knowledge structure via categorization, which can be indicated by the mention of a Category. The Cognizer may possess knowledge only in part and this may be expressed in a Completeness expression. The Cognizer may also be realized as a cognitive-emotional Faculty that is conceived of as having understanding. Note that the knowledge may have been acquired either from instruction or from the Cognizer's own experimentation, observation, or mental operations. Words in this frame are frequently used metonymically to denote the transition into the state described above. I figured this out last week and now I really understand it. My father failed to comprehend that his explanations were based as much upon faith as mine The draughtsman must fully comprehend what he is drawing Nobody seems to have explained this to her, but finally she understands DNI I realized I had not properly understood my own needs The mind is often unable to comprehend the significance of what it perceives. Our sensations are in some sense to be understood in terms of a set of stimulation levels (spiking frequencies) in the appropriate sensory pathways. CNI
The sentient animate being who acquires new knowledge.
A state of affairs or dynamic system whose internal make-up and working the Cognizer comes to assimilate into their knowledge structure.
The extent to which the Cognizer has incorporated the workings and significance of a Phenomenon into their knowledge structure.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate the relative ease of the Cognizer in acquiring new knowledge (readily, easily).
A mental concept or domain to which the Cognizer relates their new knowledge.

This frame element expresses a general type or class of which the Phenomenon is considered an instance by the Cognizer, allowing them to make predictions about the qualities, occurrence, or behavior of the Phenomenon.
This FE indicates the when the Cognizer asssimilates the new knowledge.
A part of a person's cognitive-emotional faculties that is said to acquire knowledge.
Evidence marks expressions that indicate the source of the Cognizer's knowledge.

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause.
In this frame a Grinder or Grinding_cause causes an Undergoer to be broken into smaller pieces. A Result or Goal can be present.Bill ground the coffee beans into a fine powder.
An animate or inanimate entity, a force, or event that grinds. Volitionality is not a necessary characteristic.
The Grinder breaks the Undergoer into smaller pieces.
This FE identifies the Instrument with which the Grinder grinds the Undergoer.
The Locus is a description of the active zone of the Grinder, where the grinding most saliently takes place.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Grinder grinds the Undergoer.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Grinder grinds the Undergoer.
This FE identifies the Place where the Grinder grinds the Undergoer.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Grinder grinds the Undergoer.
The Result is the shape the Undergoer becomes.
This FE identifies the Time when the Grinder grinds the Undergoer.
The Undergoer is the entity which undergoes the change brought about by the Grinder or Grinding_cause.
The length of time for which the Grinder grinds the Undergoer.
This is where the Undergoer might end up, after undergoing the grinding process.
In this frame, an Agent engages in personal body care. An Instrument can be used in this process as well as a Medium.
The agent is the person who does the grooming.
The patient is the person who gets washed.
This is an object that aids the washing process.
This is the region of the body that gets groomed.
This is a region of the object, body or the body part that gets groomed.
Medium is the substance that is the grooming agent. Bobby washed his hair with shampoo.
The frequency with which the Agent groom himself/other.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an Agent intentionally acts.
This FE identifies the time when the event occurs.
How long the grooming takes place.
The state-of-affairs that the Agent is trying to bring about by grooming.
The action performed by the Agent to accomplish the grooming.
In this frame an Undergoer is in a state of having been broken into smaller pieces. We enjoy eating ground beef .
The Undergoer is the entity acted on and that undergoes a change.
The Result is the shape the Undergoer becomes.
A Grower endeavors to tend to and influence the environment of Food so as to foster its growth. I grow my own vegetables.
The Grower is the agent growing Food.
Food is the item grown by the Grower, which can include things not traditionally eaten, like flowers, etc., or items for other consumption-related uses, like medicines, smokables, etc.
The Instrument is used by the Grower as a tool grow Food. (This tool is not limited to typical artifacts and can be hands, arms, and other atypical hunting and fishing instruments.)
For what length of time the Grower is growing Food.
The Manner in which the Grower grows Food.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Grower grows Food.
The greater geographic location where the Grower grows Food.
An action that the Grower intends to accomplish by growing Food.
How often the Grower grows Food.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
This is the the physical background or context for the Food to which the Grower pays attention in his growing efforts.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
The starting state of the Food, e.g., a seed.

Two individuals, the Guest and the Host are in a temporary social relationship within which the Host provides use of a location or resources for the Guest at a location highly associated with the Host (in many cases, where the Host lives or works). The Guest is not expected to reciprocate the hospitality of the Host while the relationship holds, though may be expected to act as Host at a later time. Commander Silvers was the President's guest last week at the White House. Steve Stephens will be your host for the weekend.
The Host provides a location and/or resources for the Guest at the Host_location.
The Guest receives the hospitality of the Host.
Depictive phrase describing the Guest or Host.
An act whereby a focal participant achieves an action indicated by the target.
The location associated with the Host, where the Guest is staying, working, etc.
The time when the guest-and-host relationship holds.
A trait or characteristic of the Guest or Host.

An Accused individual is deemed by a (usually implicit) Judge to be involved (or not) in a Misdeed. I am innocent of this crime and so is James Griffiths . It is possible that the Frauleins Krabbe , Breuer and Moller are guilty of serious wrongdoing. Note that this frame is not limited to technical, legal uses. The use of guilty in this frame is also to be distinguished from that in the Contrition frame by not referring to an emotional state. Innocent has several other meanings that are distinct from the one it has in this frame. It can mean 'ignorant of'; 'innocuous'; 'pure and unsullied by experience'.
This is the person who is accused of a Misdeed.
The wrongful act which the Accused was purportedly involved in.
The individual whose point of view is taken in connecting the Accused to the Misdeed.
The extent to which the Accused is involved in the Misdeed.

Temporary or permanent Styles and Configurations of Hair, as well as its inherent Nature. Note that Attachment and Body Part will generally be incorporated in the lexical meanings. Subregions (e.g. roots, ends) are often not specified, and sometimes incorporated (e.g. in 'bangs') On either side her head gleamed coiled braids of dark-gold hair , almost pale copper in the subdued light of the room .
This FE is the hair itself
This FE is the Possessor of the body part.
A subregion of the body part referred to by the target, e.g.
Temporary Configurations of hair (eg braid, bun, ponytail). Something done to the hair merely by movement.
A property of the hair (eg curly, fine, brown). This acts much like "Descriptor" in the Observable_bodyparts Frame. Colors, styles, natural properties are described by this frame element.
Where the salient part of the hair is.
Items that are put in the hair as part of a Configuration or Style

A Theme ceases motion. Peter stopped immediately and span to see Aeryn frozen where she stood. He stopped at the door, not wanting to see what he knew must be on the other side As Lynn walked through the bedroom on her way to the shower she stopped to look at her sleeping husband
This FE identifies the Purpose for which a Theme stops the motion.
This FE identifies the Place where the Theme's motion stops.
This FE identifies the Time when the Theme stops.
This FE is used for a Depictive phrase describing the Theme.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Theme stops motion.
This FE identifies Theme whose motion ceases.
This FE identifies the length of Time during which the motion is stopped.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Theme stops motion.
This FE identifies the last Subevent of the stopped motion.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
The length of time from when the halting event began to be repeated to when it stopped.
Containing event is an event that is occuring at a time during which the Theme ceases motion.

The obtaining of a Requirement state of affairs or the presence of a Required_entity is profiled as a prerequisite for the obtaining or occurring of a Dependent state-of-affairs. This game demands great skill. The war on terror requires little sacrifice for most Americans. Glass art demands great patience from the student.
The state-of-affairs which cannot hold without the state of affairs of the Requirement or the presence of the Required_entity.
The state-of-affairs that must obtain in order for the Dependent to obtain.
The extent to which the Dependent depends on the presence of the Required_entity or the obtaining of the Requirement.
The state-of-affairs which militates that the Requirement is necessary for the Dependent to obtain.
The time at which the Requirement is necessary for the Dependent.
The conditions under which the the Requirement is necessary.
The field of endeavor whose nature imposes the Requirement.
An entity that has to be present for the Dependent state of affairs to obtain.
An individual that has to provide the Required_entity or to see to it that the Requirement state of affairs holds.
Place denotes a location in which the specified relation between Requirement and Dependent holds.

A Source_symbol in a Source_representation system is presented to be matched by a Target_symbol in a Target_representation in the ability to express a particular Content. A palintonon or palintone translates as "V-spring" and euthytonon or euthytone translates as "straight-spring" from Greek. It can be confusing if one word translates into several in Spanish, which don't have the same gender. Therefore, this word translates as "a male". Perak translates as "silver" in the Malay language. Sentences such as the following are actually to be handled in the Be_translation_equivalent frame, which has the reverse point of view from the current frame. We have just seen how each Bible program makes it easy to get a definition of the Greek or Hebrew word which a given English word translates. The difference is essentially between whether both speaker and addressee in the context where the word is used are starting with the Target_symbol in mind. When they are, the symbols are being compared for how they correspond and Be_translation_equivalent can be used. Otherwise, generally where the information conveyed by the predication is what the Target_symbol is, Have_as_translation_equivalent is used.
A symbol or set of symbols representing the Content in the Source_representation format.
The representation system in which the Content pre-exists.
The period of time during which the translation equivalence holds.
The Circumstances are the set of conditions in which the translation is made.
A symbol or set of symbols representing the Content in the Target_representation format.
The representation system within which the Target_symbol is equivalent in its signification to the Source_symbol within the Source_representation system .
The information that is meant to be represented by the Source_symbol and Target_symbol.
An assessment of how equivalent the Source_representation and the Target_representation are.
A text in which the Source_symbol is rendered by a Target_symbol to express a particular Content.

A Topical_entity has properties which are affected by the existence and association of an Entity. By the 1920s a characteristic book had black and white photographic illustrations only . Their schools had an improved and more balanced curriculum . With dual citizenship , Stephen now had two presidents he hated .
Some entity, abstract or concrete, which is stated to exist and be associated with the Topical_entity.
The time at which the Entity exists and is associated with the Topical_entity
The period during which the Entity exists in association with the Topical_entity.
A situation, force, or entity which brings about the existence of the Entity or its association with the Topical_entity.
The place where the Entity is associated with the Topical_entity.
Circumstances marks expressions that indicate a set of conditions under which the Entity is declared to exist in association with the Topical_entity.
The perspective of an individual who judges whether they consider the Entity to be associated with the Topical_entity.

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause.
This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action.
The entity under discussion, whose states and properties are impacted by its association with the Entity.
The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.

A Host, at a location strongly associated with him/herself (such as a place of employment or residence), temporarily hosts a Visitor so that the Visitor can achieve a goal. The purpose of the visit is often social in nature.

The Host allows the Visitor to enter his/her location (house, office, etc.) for a temporary period so that the Visitor can achieve a goal. The goal is often socially-motivated (e.g., socialization between the Visitor and the Host).
The Visitor is a guest of the Host at a location strongly associated with the Host.
The Purpose of the Host in hosting the Visitor.

The individual or individuals that form the more prominent (i.e. agentive) party of the commercial agreement, as compared with Party_2. That is, Party_1 is generally encoded as the External Argument of verbs, and peripheral FEs that do not make reference to the event itself generally make reference to Party_1. Thus manner expressions are construed to apply to Party_1, not necessarily to Party_2 or the group of Parties as a whole.
The semantically (and grammatically) less prominent participant (or group of participants) in the agreement. It is generally encoded within a prepositional phrase (e.g. headed by with).
An expression of the commitment which the Parties have to engage in a commercial transaction.
Topic is a description of the domain covered by the commercial agreement.
As with other frames in the Communication domain, the Medium of communication may be expressed. Medium is the physical entity or channel used to record or negotiate the Obligation.
The group of individuals portrayed as equally involved in having a commercial agreement.
This FE identifies the Place where an agreement was made.
This FE identifies the Time when the agreement was made.
A Theme has access to a Useful_location or is blocked from it by a Barrier.
The Theme whose motion is blocked or free.
The extent to which the Theme exceeds or falls short of the ability to move to the Useful_location
The Circumstances under which the Theme meets or fails to meet the pre-conditions for getting to the Useful_location.
An entity, event, or state that causes the Theme to be meet or fail to meet the pre-conditions for entering the Useful_location.
The place or thing that the Theme is headed towards, despite a potential or actual Barrier.
An entity that (at least potentially) prevents the Theme from getting to the Useful_location.
A Protagonist is sensitive to a Trigger, which has the potential to cause some kind of reaction in the Protagonist.
The Protagonist occurs as the External Argument of the targets in this frame. The Protagonist represents the one exhibiting the response to the Trigger.
The Trigger most commonly occurs in a PP Complement headed by to. The Trigger is that substance or element which causes a health response in the Protagonist.
Manner describes the way (or style) in which the Protagonist Health_response manifests itself.
The Degree describes the extent to which the health response occurs.
The Body_part identifies the part of the body that is responding to the Trigger.

The Hearer receives a Message or communication on a particular Topic. Words in this frame denote events of verbal communication, but express the Hearer rather than the Speaker as an External Argument. Teenage fans first heard about the tragedy on a popular radio show. Teenage fans first heard the tragic news on a popular radio show
This is the person who produces a Message. Typically, it is expressed in this frame as a PP-complement headed by from:
This FE is the person who receives a Message. It is expressed as an Exteranal Argument in this frame:
The Message is the content that is communicated from one person to another. It is normally expressed as an NP Object or a finite clause Complement:
Topic is the subject matter about which the Message is communicated. It is normally expressed as a PP-complement headed by about, with or without a quantificational noun:
Medium is the physical entity or channel used to transmit the Message. It is normally expressed as a PP-complement headed by on or in:
The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.
The Time the Hearer receives the Message.

An Insulator is judged for its potential to increase the body temperature of an Experiencer. The Activity that the Experiencer engages in to experience the heat and the Circumstances in which the Insulator is judged may also be provided. That looks like a really warm bed. This blanket is too toasty for me.
The object which provides warm. It does not have to radiate heat; it may provide warmth with heavy insulation.
The Activity the Experiencer engages in to feel heat.
The state of the world when the Experiencer feels warmth
The Degree to which the Experiencer feels a level of heat.
The sentient entity that utilizes the Insulator.

A Communicator announces (linguistically or non-linguistically) the imminent arrival of an Individual or the occurrence of an Event. Generally, the Communicator is attempting to inform the public. The unveiling of Alinghi's keel was heralded by alp horns A brass band heralded his arrival and he was flanked by secret service agents The telegram heralded him, but with boundless miles for hiding he had stolen in under the cover of night
The Communicator greets the arrival of an Individual or occurrence of an Event.
This FE identifies the place where the Communicator heralds.
This FE identifies the purpose for which a Communicator heralds.
This FE identifies the time when the Communicator heralds.
This FE identifies the Means by which a Communicator heralds.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Communicator that also affect the heralding ( eagerly, carefully).
The person who is greeted at their arrival by the Communicator.
The occurrence which is greeted by the Communicator.
The symbol-containing artifact whereby a Communicator heralds.

An Agent causes a Hidden_object to become perceptually inaccessible to potential perceivers by placing it in a Hiding_place or putting in place an Obstruction that screens the object. Therefore, as I passed the school, I hid the gun and holster in the mailbox Gruenwald hid the money at a local garbage dump then retrieved it the following morning. In later books Harry often tries to hide his scar with his hair.
The entity that the Agent uses to block the Hidden_object from being perceptible.
The Hidden_object is the entity which is blocked from view.
The Potential_observer denotes a person who might perceive the Hidden_object if it was not hidden.
The extent to which the Hidden_object becomes perceptually inaccessible.
The Agent is the person who causes the Hidden_entity to be not perceptually accessible to potential perceivers.
The location in which the Hidden_object is placed so as not to be perceptually accessible.
The Place is the spatial setting in which the hiding event takes place.
Time denotes the interval of time during which the Agent causes the Hidden_object to become hidden from perceptual access.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the occurrence of the hiding event logically follows.
An action of the Agent that brings about the hiding of the Hidden_object.
The state-of-affairs that the Agent hopes to bring about by hiding the Hidden_object.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).

In this frame a Hindrance makes it more difficult for a Protagonist to complete their intended Action or a Hindrance directly affects an Action where the Action can be a natural act or the actions of many individuals in a collective endeavor. Crucially, these lexical units do not entail that the Protagonist was unable to complete the Action or that the Action did not occur. The Hindrance may indicate a lack of enablement or an obstacle on the natural progression of the Protagonist or Action Malcolm was hindered by his drinking problem . A lack of money hampered our plans . Many candidates' progress is severely impeded because they have to resit for the exam. The new dam impeded the flow of water .
The Protagonist is the entity that tends towards or plans some Action which the Hindrance causes to be more difficult.
The Hindrance is the force which makes the Action more difficult or less likely to be successfully completed. The Hindrance may be a lack of enabling force:
The Action is what the Protagonist desires to do, which is made more difficult by the Hindrance. It can also be a natural act or collective endeavor, not linked to an overt Protagonist.
The Time is when the Hindrance affects the Protagonist or Action.
The Place is the location where he Hindrance affects the Protagonist or Action.
The Degree is the extent to which the Hindrance affects the Protagonist or Action.
This FE describes the means by which hindering occurs
This FE label is used for the cause of the Hindrance
The manner in which hindering occurs
The length of time over which the hindering takes place.

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause. In other words, given only the facts of the *Concessive, one would expect them to cause the world to be the opposite of what is protrayed in the main clause.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

An Employer hires an Employee, promising the Employee a certain Compensation in exchange for the performance of a job. The job may be described either in terms of a Task or a Position. In some cases, the Employee FE will also indicate the Position (see fourth example below). John was hired to clean up the file system. IBM hired Gates as chief janitor. I was retained at $500 an hour. The A's signed a new third baseman for $30M. The same sentence (above) should also have the FE Position on the second layer: The A's signed a new third baseman for $30M.
The person whom the Employer takes on as an Employee, obligating them to perform some Task in order to receive Compensation.
The person (or institution) that takes on an Employee, giving them Compensation in return for the performance of an assigned Task.
The Compensation is the payment that the Employee is set to receive for performing an assigned Task.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an Employer hires an Employee.
This FE identifies the place where the Employer hires the Employee.
This FE identifies the Time when an Employer hires the Employee.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Employer hires the Employee.
The action that the Employee is taken on by the Employer to do.
The label given to a particular type of employment.
The Field that the Employee is going to work in for their Employer.
An entity that the Employer uses to hire the Employee.
An action by the Employer whereby the hire is brought about.
The Contract_basis is the condition of employment with respect to permanency, hours per time period or payment arrangements.
The length of time from when the hiring event began to be repeated to when it stopped.

In the course of history, an Event or Entity is taken to have importance or significance. Throughout the campaign activists have made financial history as one by one major corporations have yielded to protester power The conference was historic for Atlanta's growth as a city. Many of the historic sites offer additional outdoor recreation activities. The James River is arguably the most historic river in the country and one of the most important rivers in the Southeast. Take in the history, the sawdust-covered floors, and the legendary backroom where the ale flowed during Prohibition.
This FE identifies the event which occurs to create history.
This FE identifies where the event takes place.
This FE identifies the time when the event occurs.
This FE identifies the Reason for which an event occurs.
This FE identifies the entity, concrete or abstract.
Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
The Domain is (a characterization of) the type of event that is part of the Event's history.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.
A recordable sequence of events is associated with a given Topic. And that is where the history of art begins.
The Topic is the subject about which the history is given.
The Domain is (a characterization of) the type of event that is to be included in consideration of the Topic's history.
The end of the span of time during which the Topic occurs.
The beginning of the time span over which the Topic occurs.
The span of time over which the events related to the Topic take place.
The Duration, often expressed in calendric units, of the history of the Topic.
When the events concerning the Topic occured.
This FE identifies the event which occurs to create history.
This FE identifies where the event takes place.
This FE identifies the time when the event occurs.

An Agent succeeds or fails to interact perceptually or physically with the Target or Target_location. The Instrument which is used to interact with the Target may stand in metonymically for the Agent. At first he shot very wide of his target . Because I programmed the scope wrong , I kept missing Jupiter . She scored two hits on the deer 's left side .
The individual who tries to interact with the Target.
The Target is the entity located in an indirectly accessible location relative to the Agent.
The Outcome is the failure or success of an attempt at interaction, incorporated in the LUs of the frame.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Agent achieves a Purpose.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the interaction takes place at the Target_location.
This FE identifies the Time when something hits or misses.
A description of the Agent during the event.
The place where the Agent manages or fails to interact with the Target.
Any description of how the details of the event compare to others, either generally (the same way), or in terms of a state of the Agent which influences the event (carelessly).
The reason for which the Agent attempts to interact with the Target

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which contextualizes the hitting or missing of the Agent but is not conceived of as caused by it.
The object manipulated by the Agent in order to interact with the Target.
The location that the Agent is attempting to access using the Instrument.
The number of times that the Agent hits or misses the Target.
The distance of the actual location from the Target_location.

An Agent causes the ballistic motion of a projectile and its subsequent impact on a Target. It looks like he hit the bull's-eye with his first arrow! If he shot her, he is fully culpable whether he meant to or not.
The entity which is hit by a Projectile directed by the Agent.
The individual that directs the Projectile such that it impacts the Target.
The state-of-affairs that the Agent hopes to bring about by hitting the Target
The time at which the Agent hits the Target.
The location where the event happens.
The part of the Target hit by the Agent.
The action performed by the Agent that accomplishes hitting the Target.
The entity, most often ammunition or a firearm, which the Agent manipulates to hit the Target.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).

An Agent decides temporarily not to perform a Desirable_action or not to interact with a Salient_entity. I have actually held off on buying some movies by WB because of those damned cases. We held off on reporting this because, by all accounts, the young Oscar-nominee has NOT been offered the role. This meant waiting with dinner until late. CNI I waited with going to him and in retrospect think that that was a mistake.
TheAgent decides not to engage in a Desirable_action for a while or not to interact with a Salient_entity.
Desirable_action identifies the event or activity in which the Agent does not engage for a while.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the temporary forgoing occurs.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the temporary forgoing occurs.
This FE identifies the Means by which the temporary forgoing occurs.
This FE identifies the Place where the temporary forgoing occurs.
This FE identifies the interval of Time during which the the forgoing occurs.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which the temporary forgoing occurs.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the Agent's decision to temporarily forgo a Desirable_action or to not interact with a Salient_entity logically follows.
This FE identifies the Circumstances under which the Agent does not engage in the Desirable_action.
An entity that evokes a contextually inferrable Desirable_action that the Agent is temporarily forgoing.
Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of the Agent's decision to forgo a Desirable_action to the point in time when the Agent engages in the action.
The point in time, defined either as a clock time or in terms of an event that takes place, at which the Agent engages in the Desirable_action or interacts with the Salient_entity.

A Host is judged regarding their attitude as a potential host in a guest-host relationship. The Host exhibits a Behavior that is judged as demonstrating a particular degree hospitality towards a Guest. Alternatively, the Host may reveal an Expressor that indicates a particular sort of attitude.
The Host is the person whose Behavior towards others as a (potential) host is evaluated.
The Guest is the entity which is positively or negatively treated by the Host.
The Behavior is the action of the Host on which the evaluation of the Host's character is based.
The Degree is the extent to which the Host exhibits the particular Behavior towards others.
The Topic is the situation or person that the Host's Behavior responds to or is related to.
The Expressor is the body part or action by a body part which indicates the character of the Host.
The Manner is the way in which the Host embodies the characters of a good or poor host.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the evaluation.

This frame consists of words that describe a hostile encounter between opposing forces (Side_1 and Side_2, collectively conceptualizable as Sides) over a disputed Issue and/or in order to reach a specific Purpose.
One of two participants in a hostile encounter. While the U.S.'s battle with terrorist-harboring nations is far off ...
One of two participants in a hostile encounter, usually the second mentioned.
The jointly expressed sides in a hostile encounter. They fought over the right to own land.
An unresolved question over which the two sides of a hostile encounter are in disagreement.
The desired result of the outcome of the hostile encounter for the Side_1 or for all the Sides collectively. It may either directly refer to the state of affairs that is desired, e.g.

Means describes the way in which a side engages in a hostile encounter. President Corazon Aquino of the Philippines is bracing herself for a legal battle over her decision to allow the remains of the former president, Ferdinand Marcos, to be returned home from Hawaii for burial.

Any expression which describes a property of the hostile encounter. Descriptions of the intensity count as Manner expressions. After Brundle's Jaguar took off like a scalded cat, it was Mass who hunted it down, an soon engaged it in a lurid battle.
The location at which the hostile encounter takes place.
The time at which the hostile encounter occurs.
Depictive phrase describing the actor of an action
The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
The Reason for which an event occurs.
The instrument with which an intentional act is performed.

The body movement may be prompted by either some outside phenomenon or occurrence, or by an Internal Cause, the Agent's mental or emotional state. Internal Cause is expressed in a PP Complement: Kim frowned in concentration. Kim threw her hands up in despair.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

A Hunter tries to gain Food by way of outsmarting or tracking a living. The Hunter hopes the attempt will result in the catching and killing of the living entity that is intended for human consumption. The act of seeking Food inherently involves the assistance of some tool, which can be an extension of the Hunter's body or an artifact fashioned or exploited for the use of food seeking, catching, and/or killing. In the Congo, he hunted big game for the first time. People still fish bass in the lake. Folks from Northern California hunt brilliantly. INI
The Hunter is the agent hoping to obtain Food.
Food is the sought-out item by the Hunter.
The Instrument is used by the Hunter as a tool to help obtain Food. (This tool is not limited to typical artifacts and can be hands, arms, and other atypical hunting and fishing instruments.)
For what length of time the Hunter attempted to obtain Food.
The Manner in which the Hunter makes the attempt for Food.
This FE identifies the Means by which an attempt at achieving a Food obtainment.
The failure or success of an attempt.
The greater geographic location where the Hunter attempts to obtain Food.
When the Time seeking action occurs.
An action that the Hunter intends to accomplish by seeking Food.
How often the Hunter attempts to obtain Food.
This FE identifies the amount of effort the Hunter puts into his attempt to obtain Food.
This is the entity to which the Hunter pays attention. It is referred to as Ground because it serves as the background or context for the Food.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

Co_participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the same event as the primary protagonist, regardless of whether the protagonist, and hence the Co_participant, is more agent- or more undergoer-like.

A Hunter endeavors to- and either fails or succeeds at finding and obtaining Food. This scenario occurs within the context of some Ground within which the preparation, hunt, and success or failure of it plays out.
The Hunter is the agent hoping to obtain Food.
Food is the sought-out item by the Hunter.
The Instrument is used by the Hunter as a tool to help obtain Food. (This tool is not limited to typical artifacts and can be hands, arms, and other atypical hunting and fishing instruments.)
For what length of time the Hunter attempted to obtain Food.
The Manner in which the Hunter makes the attempt for Food.
This FE identifies the Means by which an attempt at achieving a Food obtainment.
The failure or success of an attempt.
The greater geographic location where the Hunter attempts to obtain Food.
When the Food seeking action occurs.
An action that the Hunter intends to accomplish by seeking Food.
How often the Hunter attempts to obtain Food.
This FE identifies the amount of effort the Hunter puts into an attempt to obtain Food.
This is the entity to which the Hunter pays attention. It is referred to as Ground because it serves as the background or context for the Food.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
A Hunter succeeds or fails at capturing his sought-out or tracked Food. We bagged six roosters. Bottom trawlers catch fish that live on or near the seafloor.
The Hunter is the agent that has successfully obtained Food.
Food is the item obtained by the Hunter.
The Instrument is used by the Hunter as a tool to obtain Food.
The Manner in which the Hunter obtains the Food.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Food is obtained.
The greater geographic location where the Hunter obtains Food.
When the Food seeking action occurs.
An action that the Hunter intends to accomplish obtaining Food.
How often the Hunter obtains Food.
This FE identifies the amount of effort the Hunter puts into an attempt to obtain Food.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

A Current_instance of a certain Type is under discussion. This instance is evaluated as being the same instance or a different instance from a Previous_instance encountered in a Previous_context. Kim has a different hair color every week Kim has a different hair color every week Is this the same sofa as the one that used to be in the lobby? Is this the same sofa as the one that used to be in the lobby? Dracula and your neighbor are different people Dracula and your neighbor are different people
The kind of thing of which instances are under discussion.
The instance of the Type that is currently under discussion.
An instance of the Type that was encountered previously and which is now compared for identity with the Current_instance.
The situation in which another instance of the Type was encountered earlier.
The complete set of instances of the Type involved in the mentioned contexts.
The Time when the Current_instance is the same or different.

A certain Idiosyncrasy belongs to an Entity distinguishing it from other entities. If you have 32 totally idiosyncratic meanings for a term in a class, everyone will be very confused when they talk! DNI The art of change-ringing is peculiar to the English
An entity or characteristic belonging to the Entity.
The Entity that has a certain distinguishing Idiosyncrasy.
The extent to which the Idiosyncrasy differs from the norm.
A Profiled_region is picked out relative to a Ground.
A region of space located relative to a Ground.
An entity whose location is relatively well-known and which, thus, can serve as a land-mark to identify the Profiled_region.

An Agent displays a Characteristic of a Standard in his or her own way of behaving. I guessed he was trying to imitate the movements of a skier In a tv commercial last year, she aped male slobbiness in a singlet and Y-front-style underpants, kicking back on the couch, watching sport. 'You are all the same ,' he said, imitating not her voice but its angry cadence. Antony, after he had seen this man, imitated him in piety.
The Agent is the person that borrows a Characteristic behavior from a Standard.
The Characteristic is a behavior or property that the Standard possesses and which the Agent adopts in his or her own behavior.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (eagerly, carefully).
An act performed by the Agent that accomplishes the imitation.
The Standard is the entity that exhibits a certain Characteristic that the Agent models their own behavior on.
An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by performing the imitation.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the imitation event logically follows.
This FE describes a participant of the imitating event as being in some state. The depicted state does not necessarily or usually facilitate or cause the imitating event.
This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the imitation event occurs and of which the imitating event is taken to be a part.
The extent to which the Agent's way of behaving is similar to that of the Standard.
The time at which the imitation occurs.
The location where the Agent imitates some entity which acts as a Standard.
Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.
The Agent immobilizes a Patient optionally, to an Anchor. The junior officer handcuffed his commanding officer to his desk.
The instrument with which an intentional act is performed.
The Patient is immobilized by the Agent, optionally to an Anchor.
An act performed by the Agent that accomplishes the immobilization.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Agent immobilizes a Patient.
The Agent attaches the Patient to an Anchor, generally, an immobile object. Lisa handcuffed Mike to the refridgerator.
The extent to which the Patient is immobilized as a result.

Any description of the immobilizing event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). This FE also covers expressions that indicate salient characteristics of the Agent which also affect the action (carefully, eagerly).
While in motion, an Impactor makes sudden, forcible contact with the Impactee, or two Impactors both move, mutually making forcible contact. The massive metal foot hit the ground with a huge thud.
The reason for which an Impact occurs.
The entity that hits the Impactee.
The entity which is hit by the Impactor.
Subregion identifies the affected part of the larger whole.
The amount of force in the course of the impact.
The Time throughout which the impact repeatedly takes place.
The state of the Impactors or the Impactor during the impact.

An Agent moves Goods (or some other useful item) from an Exporting_area, across a boundary or border to a different area, the Importing_area. The Path along which the Goods pass may also be indicated. Depending on the lexical unit, the Agent 's point of view may be centered on the Exporting_area at the beginning of the process (e.g. export) or on the Importing_area and the end of the process (e.g. import) or on the Path (e.g. transship). In some sentences, a constituent which encodes the Agent FE also encodes information about the Exporting_area, Path, or Importing_area.
The conscious entity, generally a person, that moves the Goods.
An mobile entity directed by the Agent that holds the Goods and moves them along from the Exporting_area to the Importing_area.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An intentional action performed by the Agent that accomplishes the action indicated by the target.
The items of value whose location is changing.
This FE identifies the purpose for which the Agent moves the Goods.
A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in performing the action.
This FE identifies the time when the Agent moves the Goods.
This FE identifies the state of a participant during the action
The FE Importing_area is the place that the Goods end up as a result of motion.
Path identifies the location of the Goods during transit, i.e. after leaving the Exporting_area and before reaching the Importing_area.
The place where the Goods are initially, before the action.

This Frame Element is used for a characteristic or description of the Goods. Note that Descriptor is not an FE of the same character as other FEs. Specifically, rather than filling a slot, it identifies a modifier of its head noun.

A Factor affects the outcome of an Undertaking, which can be a goal-oriented activity or the maintenance of a desirable state, the work in a Field, or something portrayed as affecting an Interested_party. A Reason may be given for the importance of the Factor. The Degree of importance may also be specified. Temperature is the most critical factor in successful storage. Timing will be critical. Heathcliff is more important to me than myself . 1992 was of great importance to the business community.
Factor is used for the concrete or abstract entity whose importance is assessed.
This FE marks expressions that indicate the Degree to which the Factor is important to the Undertaking.
The Undertaking is a process or state or field of activity in which the Interested_party has a stake.
This FE identifies the Reason for which the Factor is important to the Undertaking.
Interested_party identifies the people who are affected by a particular Factor.
A Factor may be generally important to the people or the activities in a field of endeavour.
The Time at which the Factor is important to the Undertaking.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often.
The location at which the Factor is important.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.

An Importer receives Goods from an Exporting_area, across a boundary or border to a different area, the Importing_area. The Path along which the Goods pass may also be indicated. The U.S. imported some wheat in the period, although it exported about ten times as much. We import most of the Tahitian seashells through Japan. Importation of wildlife has gotten more difficult. INI INI INI
The conscious entity, generally a person, that brings the Goods into the Importing_area.
A mobile entity directed by the Importer that holds the Goods and moves them along from the Exporting_area to the Importing_area.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Importer that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An intentional action performed by the Importer that accomplishes the action indicated by the target.
The items of value whose location is changing.
This FE identifies the purpose for which the Importer moves the Goods.
A state of affairs that explains the Importer's importation of the Goods.
This FE identifies the time when the Importer moves the Goods.
This FE identifies the state of a participant during the action
The FE Importing_area is the place that the Goods end up as a result of motion.
Path identifies the location of the Goods during transit, i.e. after leaving the Exporting_area and before reaching the Importing_area.
The place where the Goods are initially, before the being moved.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative instance of the importing event , and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar importing events.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
The Result is the final state of the Goods when brought into the Importing_area.
This FE applies to participants who derive a benefit from the occurrence of the act of importation.

A Duty is imposed on a Responsible_party according to a Principle which regulates how the Responsible_party should respond to a Situation. The Situation may be expressed metonymically by reference to an Obligator, whose action invokes the Principle. It is only rarely the case that the Principle and the Situation/Obligator are both expressed overtly. They escaped total Soviet invasion and occupation only by entering into a separate agreement that obligated them to military action against the retreating German armies. The lease agreements bound them to make rent payments to Homeowners Rescue. It was also discovered that with out her knowledge, he had committed her to a new TV series and he had already taken an advance on the money. The Generality's invitation to give a conference on the theme obligated me to study Gaudí's work even more.
The person who must perform the Duty.
The action that the Responsible_party is obligated to perform.
This FE indicates the Conditions under which the Responsible_party is obligated to perform the Duty.
The time interval during which the Duty is imposed on the Responsible_party by the Obligator or the Situation.
A location in which the Responsible_party has a specified Duty .
The Obligator is the person who imposes the Duty on the Responsible_party.
A state of affairs that results in the Responsible_party being obligated to carry out the Duty in accordance with the Principle.
A regulating idea (which may be instantiated as a document) that the Responsible_party is subject to.
The state-of-affairs that the Obligator hopes to bring about by imposing the obligation.
Any holistic description of the details of the action, either comparing to another event or describing the action in terms of characteristics of the Obligator that affect the action holistically.
An event which brings about the obligation.

This frame describes the Impression which a Figure, which can be a person, an organization, or an object, leaves with an Audience. The Audience is often left unstated when it represents anyone who is aware of the subject. The Impression may be describe with a Descriptor; the effectiveness of the Impression may be provided by Degree. The Context indicates the domain in which the Impression is understood. He had an extremely fragile self - image My impression of the show was just the opposite
The entity (a person, organization, product, or event) for which the Audience has an Impression.
A person or group of people who have an Impression of a Figure.
The effect of the Impression left on the Audience.
The effectiveness of the Impression on the Audience.
A spatial, cultural, or personal delimitation within which a Figure leaves an Impression on an Audience.
A generalized conception of a Figure presented to or shared by an Audience.

The Authorities put a Prisoner in Prison as punishment for an Offense. US Drug Researcher Imprisoned for FDA Fraud. Men will be more likely to be put away for murder rather than manslaughter for killing their wives. However, any treatments may be years in the future and in the meantime, criminals will continue to be imprisoned for public safety. The government wrongfully imprisoned them in ?detention centers? (a nice term for concentration camps), tortured them mentally and physically
The person who is confined in a penal institution.
The Prison within which the Prisoner comes to be confined.
The Authorities are the institution or actors carrying out the imprisonment.
The action that the Prisoner is being punished for.
This FE identifies the Place where the Prisoner is kept.
The time when the imprisonment happens.
An intentional action performed by the Authorities that brings about the imprisonment.

Any description of the imprisoning event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Authorities that affect the action (ruthlessly).
The act or state of affairs that the Authorities respond to by imprisoning the Prisoner.
This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Authorities maintains the confinement of the Prisoner.
The legal classification which characterizes the Offense.
Iteration marks expressions that indicate the number of times the Prisoner was imprisoned.

An Item comes to be attached to a Goal, with a Connector forming a bond between the Handle of the Item and the Goal (or some part of it). Alternatively, multiple Items may form a bond between each other. According to plan, the front part of the hull quietly attached to the docking gear. The cells bind together.
Connector identifies the instrument used to attach, usually in a with-PP.
Handle identifies the point of attachment on the Goal to which the Item attaches.
Item identifies the entity that comes to be attached to the Goal.
Items identifies the plural items that are tied together, resulting in their mutual attachment.
Goal identifies the location to which the first Item is attached.
This FE identifies the Result of an attaching event.
This FE identifies the Manner in which an Item comes to be attached to a Goal.

In this frame, the temperature of an Item changes. An Initial_temperature, Final_temperature, or Temperature_change can also be indicated. The house had cooled off by a few more degrees by midnight, and we finally managed to eat a bite.
The temperature that the Item has prior to the event.
The temperature of the Item after the event.
The amount of difference between the Initial_temperature and the Final_temperature of the Item.
The Hot_cold_source is the source of the heat or coolness
An event or state-of-affairs that leads to the change in temperature of the Item.
This FE identifies the Container that holds the Item whose temperature is being changed.
The state of the Item during the temperature change.
The span of time in which the Item is changing temperature.
The time at which the change in temperature occurs.
The location at which the Item changes temperature.
A portion of the Item which is affected by the temperature change.
The manner in which the Item changes temperature.
This FE identifies the Circumstances under which the temperature change occurs
The state of the Item that results from being chilled.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

Due to internal forces/properties, an Entity is inclined towards a particular Behavior, which may be to perform an action or a to maintain a state. The underlying force is seen as being beyond the Entity's control. The Degree to which the Entity is inclined towards the Behavior may also be specified as well as the Basis for the inclination. My grandmother has criminal tendencies. "Smithers has always had a deplorable tendency to exhibitionism. Chuck was not very inclined to believe me. Smithers has a genetic predisposition for neural tube defects.
TheFrame Element Entity identifies the person or thing that has a tendency towards some Behaviour.
The FE Behavior marks expressions that indicate which state or action the Entity tends towards.
This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate how great the inclination of an Entity towards a Behavior is.
This FE marks expressions that indicate why the Entity has the propensity for some Behavior.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
A Total has a Part, either as a member of an aggregate or as a constituent part of a simple entity.
A complex entity, either an aggregate or a unit, of which a Part, a constituent or a component, is specified.
A component or constituent that is specified to form part of the Total.
This FE indicates the purpose for which some implicit (non-expressed) agent causes the inclusion of the Part within the Total.
This FE identifies the frequency with which the Part is included int he Total.
This FE indicates other elements that are included within the Total.
This FE indicates the sub-location of the Total in which the Part is included.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
Any description of the inclusion event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
The Time at which the Total includes the Part.
The location at which the Total includes the Part.
A Part is either a subset of a collection of items that make up a Whole, or is a subpart of a singular Whole. This frame covers both super/sub-set relations and part-whole relations.
The Whole is the larger entity that includes the Part.
The Part is either a subset or a constituent part of the Whole.
Any description of the inclusion event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
The Time at which the inclusion relation holds.
The location at which the inclusion relation holds.

A member or members of a Class have just been mentioned or are present in the discourse setting and now a different instance (or group of instances) of the same class is referred to. My husband left me for another woman -- and now wants to get back together again! My husband left me for another woman -- and now wants to get back together again!
The general category of entity which has been referred to.
The instance of the Class that is added to the Initial_set of entities in the Class.
The previously mentioned group of entities of the Class.
The number of entities within the Added_set.

A Communicator or Medium assigns linguistic meaning to an Unresolved_referent thereby identifying the specific actor or entity which fulfills the answer to this question. Can you name all the U.S. Presidents? No doctor can name the disease that's killing him. Every year, InfoWorld names 100 companies that have made the best use of technology.
The person who uses language in the written or spoken modality to convey the Unresolved_referent to another person.
The thing to which the Communicator or Medium refers for identification purposes.
The physical or abstract setting in which the Unresolved_referent is conveyed.
The amount of information exchanged when communication occurs.
The Depictive describes the state of the Communicator.
The Manner in which the Communicator makes the indication.
The Means by which the Communicator makes the indication.
When the the Communicator is makes the indication.
Duration is the length of time during which the indicating takes place.
How often the Communicator or Medium indicates the Unresolved_referent.
The reason why the Communicator is indicating the Unresolved_referent.
The location where the Communicator or Medium indicates the Unresolved_referent.
To what end the Communicator or Medium makes the indication.

An Entity began its existence in the context of a location of Origin, which is a discourse-salient place, or culture. Obviously there are species that are native to China or used in Chinese Medicine that aren't used in Western or Cherokee Medicine and vice versa. The indigenous people, women and the elderly are the most affected. DNI The Athenians believed that they were 'autochthonous' in Attica.
The item whose Origin is under discussion.
The discourse-salient place or culture where the Entity was produced.

This scenario describes a series of Events, associated a single Participant, i.e., the history of the Participant. The Events do not necessarily form a coherent whole (e.g., are not necessarily causally related), but merely occupy a period of time. In many cases the history is limited to what are considered the important or significant events. Words in this frame can also denote the time period over which the sequence of Events took place. Note: uses of words in this frame to describe a record of the series of events are not in this frame (e.g., we compiled a history of Rome). We've been worried about our recent hire's history of deceiving employers. The following sections document the entire 25-year history of the company. Our areas of strength are British, American and European History from 1492 to 2000.
The Participant is either an active participant in all of the Events (e.g., Agent or Patient), or is more peripherally associated with the Events (e.g., Location or Topic).
The Events which the Participant is a part of. This FE is used to mark the frame-evoking element.
The Domain is (a characterization of) the type of event that is to be included in consideration of the Participant's history.
The end of the span of time during which the Events occur.
The beginning of the time span over which the Events occur.
The span of time over which the Events take place.
The Duration, often expressed in calendric units, of the history of the Participant.
A characterization of the Participant or Events.
When the Events concerning the Participant occured.

A Stimulus inspires a feeling of awe and interest in a (generally implicit or generic) Experiencer due to desirable qualities which are difficult to explain. Alternatively, the Attribute of the Stimulus may be described instead. There is a certain je-ne-sais-quoi about that city .
The entity which inspires a feeling of amazement at its exceptionality.
The Experiencer experiences the emotion brought about by the Stimulus
An expression of how unusual the ineffability of the Stimulus is.
This FE marks expressions that indicate a set of conditions under which the Stimulus is able to bring about the emotion.
The Parameter is the area in which the Stimulus brings about an effect on the Experiencer.
The Comparison_set is the set of individuals the Stimulus is compared to when determining the Degree of the emotional reaction.
A feature of the Stimulus which causes a particular experience.
An expression of the attribute of ineffability.

A Situation or Protagonist creates conditions that push the Cognizer towards executing an Action, or which influence the Cognizer in an Activity. The words in this frame imply that the Cognizer actually does something. The murder of my brother influenced me to study Law. Her interest in history has largely influenced her in her work. Despite this huge variety, there were only two main factors that significantly influenced the artist's work. Despite this huge variety, there were only two main factors that significantly influenced the artist's work. Discuss the things that guided you in making your decision.
The Situation which motivates the Cognizer to execute the Action.
A person or self-directed entity whose actions may potentially change the mind of the Cognizer.
The sentient entity whose mind is moved in the direction of change.
The Action that the Cognizer is influenced to do.
The time when the Cognizer is influenced.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
An activity (or domain) rather than a single, particular action that the Cognizer is influenced in.
The extent to which a Protagonist or Situation influences the Cognizer.

A Cognizer knows or comes to know some piece of Information about a Topic. In this frame, many LUs encode a specific Means_of_Gathering and/or Source, but these may also be expressed separately. Also, the big problem is that our intel about WMD's has many times been wrong. Anyone got the straight dope on this? Get the inside scoop on sprint football player Austin Wilson. CNI I know him pretty well and I have a lot of dirt on him so I can always hold him over a barrel. What's the info about the new scanner chip? INI
The Information that the Cognizer possesses or comes to posess.
The Cognizer is aware of the Information.
The Topic is what the Information is about in general.
The Cognizer obtains the Information from the Source.
An action or method used by the Cognizer that results in the acquisition of the Information.

A group of entities exist (as an infrastructure) such that a particular type of Activity is either enabled or facilitated. The entities may or may not have been organized specifically for the Activity. The infrastructure is constituted by Resources that can be made use of by Users, and the infrastructure may be specified for its Place or Possessor. While the US transportation infrastructure continues to crumble, competitors in Brazil and Argentina are investing millions to improve their transportation The exacerbated sprawl like growth in the last decades has been a direct result of decisions taken in the creation, boost, and development of highway infrastructure. Mexico's Ministry of Tourism expects to see more than $1.78 billion invested to further develop the country's tourism infrastructure.
The Activity which is enabled or facilitated by the infrastructure.
The organization, institution, or individual who owns the infrastructure.
The infrastructure may be conceived of as consisting of Resources that can be made use of by Users in performing an Activity.
The people for whom the infrastructure is designed to be used by. In the cases where the constituent denoting the user also evokes the Activity, we annotate this on the second FE layer.
The collection of entities and/or institutions that help to promote an Activity of a public character.

In this frame an Ingestor takes a Substance into his or her body. The Delivery_device can appear as a direct object. You should refrain from taking vodka up the nose. Smoking a cigarette only takes a couple of minutes . CNI
The Manner in which the Ingestor ingests the Substance.
The Means by which the Ingestor ingests the Substance.
The Place where the Ingestor ingests the Substance.
The Purpose for which the Ingestor ingests the Substance.
The Time at which the Ingestor ingests the Substance.
The Delivery_device is the means by which the substance is ingested.
The Substance is the drug or other substance that is ingested by the Ingestor.
The Frequency with which the Ingestor ingests.
The Entry_path is the path along which the Substance enters the Ingestor's body.
The Duration is the length of time for which the Ingestor ingests.

An Ingestor consumes food or drink (Ingestibles), which entails putting the Ingestibles in the mouth for delivery to the digestive system. This may include the use of an Instrument. Sentences that describe the provision of food to others are NOT included in this frame.
The Ingestor is the person eating or drinking.
The Ingestibles are the entities that are being consumed by the Ingestor.
The Instrument with which an intentional act is performed.
Place from which the Ingestor takes the Ingestibles
An act performed by the Ingestor that enables them to accomplishes the whole act of ingestion.
The extent to which the Ingestibles are consumed by the Ingestor.
The action that the Ingestor hopes to bring about by ingesting.
The length of time spent on the ingestion activity.
A Material is used to make a Product. These cooking ingredients are readily available. An aberrant hemoglobin precursor has been discovered to be implicated.
The entity which is used to make a Product.
This FE indicates what subtype of the general category the Material belongs to.
The location that the Material comes from, including both extraction sites and emission/production sources.
The purpose for which the Material is intended.
The entity or substance that is created out of the Material.

An Agent restricts the movement of a Theme to within the vicinity of the Holding_location, despite the Theme's desire, plan, or tendency towards motion; the Agent may also use an Instrument. For many of these targets, the means is incorporated. For some LUs, the Theme is required to be a sentient entity. Several of these LUs may be used to describe punishment situations when the Theme is a sentient entity. They held the package for two months in the border-patrol locker room .
The area within which the Theme comes to be confined.
The Agent is the person performing the intentional act.
The instrument with which the confinement is carried out.
This FE identifies the Place where the event occurs.
An intentional action performed by the Agent that accomplishes the action indicated by the target.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Agent that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in performing the action.
This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Agent maintains the confinement of the Theme.
The Cause is the non-sentient entity which is responsible for restricting the movement or location of the Theme.

An Inspector directs his perceptual attention to a Ground to ascertain whether the Ground is intact or whether an Unwanted_entity is present. Alternatively, the desired outcome of the inspection may be presented as a Purpose. The police removed Flonnory and Barbour from the automobile and frisked them for weapons. Double-check the form to make sure all of the information has been entered correctly.
The person who inspects the Ground to see if it is intact or without blemish.
The entity that the Inspector inspects with his senses to ascertain whether it is intact.
An entity whose presence would impair the acceptability or usefulness of the Ground.
This FE is used for the Means by which the Inspector examines the Ground.

Some of the words in this frame occur with a constituent that expresses the desired outcome of the inspection. Normally this constituent is a PP Complement headed by for, or a to-marked VP Complement.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Inspector scrutinizes the Ground.
This FE identifies the extent to which the Inspector examines the Ground.
This FE is the position of the Perceiver during the act of perception. Typically, it is expressed in a from-PP.
