The desirable state of affairs which the Inspector hopes to find to obtain when inspecting the Ground.
The Time when the Inspector examines the Ground.
The circumstances under which the Inspector examines the Ground.
An entity used by the Inspector to scrutinize the Ground.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

An Agent places a Component in a Fixed_location so that the Component is attached and interconnected and thereby functional. Displays were given an overhaul in the 1950s, with canopies installed above the Christmas counters to allow calendar and gift bows to be displayed. CNI At the street an 8'' culvert will be installed under the driveway. CNI In the space where the piano was, right next to the washing machine, my grandmother installed her first dryer. My handyman installed it yesterday and then I sort of forgot about it. Now Marvin Odum, InterGen's Chief Executive Officer, has committed to moving up installation of the pollution control technology on its two other turbines.
The Agent is the person (or other force) that installs the Component.
The Component is the object that is placed in a Fixed_location.
This frame element specifies the location of the Agent (or of parts of their body) in cases where the Agent cannot manipulate the Component in straightforward fashion during the installation.
The Fixed_location is the location where the Component is placed and to which it is attached so as to be useful.

Any description of the installation event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Agent that affect the action (deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The Degree indicates the degree to which the installation is completed.
This FE identifies any Depictive phrase describing the Agent or Component that is installed.
The Means is an act whereby the Agent achieves the installation of the Component.
The Duration_of_final_state is the amount of time for which the Component is to remain part of the System.
The Place indicates where the installation occurs.
The Explanation indicates why the installation occurs.
The time period in which the Component is installed.
The Area is the setting into which multiple Components or a complex Component is installed.
This is a second component that is installed alongside the primary Component or an individual performing the installation together with the Agent.
An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by perform the installation.

This frame concerns transparent nouns that denote Instances of Types of entities or events. The survey confirmed that management interference in team operations had increased , and instances of management decisions being taken without team consultation had also increased .
A thing or episode of a certain Type.
The category of thing or event of which an Instance is picked out.

A Patient is committed to the care of a medical Facility by a proper Authority. Regardless of whether the Patient agrees or does not agree with their placement in the Facility, the Authority judges that it is in the best interest of the Patient or his environment that the Patient receive treatment in the Facility. Ten years after Abraham Lincoln's assassination, a Chicago court declared his 56-year-old widow Mary insane and committed her to a mental institution. A pregnant woman was hospitalized with gunshots to her shoulder and abdomen. CNI INI Arberg issued a two-sentence statement saying Rehnquist was hospitalized for a fever and undergoing tests. CNI INI The hospitalization of the Saudi king upset the skittish oil markets. INI INI
The person who is committed to a facility with a view towards helping them mentally or physically.
The facility where the Patient is taken for treatment.

The Authority is the actor carrying out the institutionalization with proper legal authorization, either invested into them in general by the government or granted due to power of attorney over the Patient.
The condition exhibited by the Patient, which is deemed to merit institutionalization by the Authority.
The time interval during which the institutionalization happens.
An intentional action performed by the Authority that brings about the institutionalization of the Patient.

Any description of the institutionalization event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Authority that affect the action (ruthlessly).
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the occurrence of the institutionalization event logically follows.
This FE identifies the length of the time period for which the Authority has placed the Patient in the Facility.
The location in which the Facility is situated.
This FE describes a participant of the institutionalization as being in some state during the action.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
This FE marks the amount of times the Patient is committed to the Facility per unit of time.

This frame concerns permanent organizations (the Institutions) with a public character, meaning that they are intended to affect the lives of the public at large in a particular Domain. In some cases, most or all members of the public have a direct relationship with the Institution, but in many cases, the effect on the populace is indirect.
A permanent organization with a socially important purpose.
The concern of the Institution-- broadly speaking, the aspect of society that they affect.
The individuals that make up an Institution.
The Place where the Institution is located.

A Self_mover intentionally moves in a Directionon a Path relative to landmark that is neither the Source nor the Goal of the overall motion. The shape or configuration of the Path may be expressed with a Path_shape Ambrose Powell forded over on one horse, and we drove the others after him. We repassed the first day's battlefield and ascended the road to the city. Jeff Manor and I climbed the North Face of Mt Shuksan, with cold, clear weather and solid ice.
This is a sentient being or a vehicle steered by a sentient being which moves.
Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion expresses the frame element Source.
Any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal expresses the frame element Path, excluding directional expressions:
Any expression which indicates where the Self_mover ends up as a result of the motion expresses the frame element Goal.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of a Self_mover that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
Any expression which characterizes the extent of motion expresses the frame element Distance.
An event involving the Self_mover that results in their moving in the specified way.
The Speed is the rate at which the Self_mover moves.
This is a second moving object, expressed as a direct object or an oblique, relative to which the Self_mover moves.
The Place is where the motion (which is specified by a Source, Path or Goal) is located.
The configuration formed by the entire Path of the Self_mover, taken simultaneously.
The direction in which the Self_mover goes.
The time at which the motion takes place.
The state-of-affairs that the Self_mover wishes to bring about.
The device or bodypart that serves to move the Self_mover.
The length of time that the Self_mover spends in motion.
A factor which explains the particular motion or manner of motion of the Self_mover.
An event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at the time the Intentional_traversing occurs and which the Intentional_traversing is taken to be a part of.
The number of times that an action occurs in a given time.

A larger conceptualization that includes the Intentional_traversing as an integral part. The Intentional_traversing expressed by the target typically corresponds to a Means action in this larger conceptualization.
An unexpected event that affects some agent (usually the Self_mover), which is enabled by, and occurs after, the Intentional_traversing.

The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the Traversing event itself and any of its participants, and is merely peripherally related to the event as a whole.
The Source and Goal of either a single or a repeated motion taken together as Endpoints of the Path.

Co_participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the same event as the primary protagonist, regardless of whether the protagonist, and hence the Co_participant, is more agent- or more undergoer-like.
This is an abstract frame for acts performed by sentient beings. It exists mostly for FE inheritance.
This FE identifies the Act that the Agent performs intentionally.
The Agent performs the intentional act.
This FE identifies the place where the intentional act occurs.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent performs an intentional act. John flattered her to receive a raise.
This FE identifies the time when the Agent acts intentionally.
This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent acts intentionally.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The Domain within which the Agent acts.
The Frequency with which the Agent does the Act in a given period of time.
The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the state of affairs expressed by the target, but not in all cases.
This FE gives a description of the Intentionally_act event.
An Agent causes a Patient to be affected, sometimes by a particular Means or by use of an Instrument. A professional dishwasher doesn't do dishes with a rag anymore!
An intentional action performed by the Agent that accomplishes the action indicated by the target.
This FE identifies the act that the Agent performs intentionally.
The conscious entity, generally a person, that performs the intentional act that affects the Patient.
An entity directed by the Agent that interacts with an Patient to accomplish the action indicated by the target.
This FE identifies the place where the Agent performs the intentional act.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent intentionally affects a Patient.
This FE identifies the time when the Agent intentionally affects the Patient.
Patient is the entity acted on and that may, but need not, undergo a change.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in performing the action.
The extent to which the Patient is affected by the Event.
The Creator creates a new entity, the Created_entity, possibly out of Components.
The Creator creates a created entity.
This FE identifies the place ehere the Agent intentionally creates the new entity.
This FE identifes the Time when an Agent intentionally creates a new entity.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent intentionally creates a new entity.
This FE identifies the Components that are attached together to form a Created_entity.
This FE identifies a depictive phrase describing the actor or undergoer of an action.
This FE identifies the entity that the Agent intentionally creates.

Any description of the creation event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of a Creator that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
This FE identifies the Means by which a Creator intentionally creates a new entity.
This FE identifies the instrument with which an Agent intentionally creates a Created_entitiy.
A secondary agent with whom the Creator intentionally creates the Created_entity.

A volitionally acting Interceptor takes control, without being authorized to do so by the sender, of a Theme that is underway from a sender to a recipient. The Interceptor (or somebody on whose behalf they act) believes that the Theme reaching its goal would be against their interest. The Theme may be a physical thing that is being conveyed, a self-moving entity, or information that is broadcast. Police intercepted the call and raided the address. The vessel got intercepted in the Mediterranean by the German navy . A Royal Navy frigate intercepted his yacht off Gibraltar.
The volitional agent who without authorization of sender or recipient takes control of a Theme that is en route to a destination.
The entity, physical or abstract, construed as traveling from a sender to a goal location, which is taken hold of by the Interceptor without permission.
The location at which the Interceptor takes control of the Theme.
The time period during which the Interceptor takes control of the Theme.
This FE describes a participant of the intercepting event as being in some state during the action.

Any description of the Intercepting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may indicate also salient characteristics of the Interceptor that also affect the action (carefully).
The circumstances under which the interception takes place.
The state of affairs that the Interceptor hopes to bring about by intercepting.
The action performed by the Interceptor that results in success.
A Cause (or associated Actor) causes an ongoing Process to temporarily stop.
A force, process, or event that produces the interruption.
The Process goes into a paused state due to the Cause or Actor.
The Reason for which the interruption occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the interruption occurs.
An entity which participates in a Cause, perhaps volitionally and perhaps not, but effectively causing the interruption.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
Any holistic description of the event, including overall depictions (the same way) and descriptions pertaining to the Actor or Cause's influence on the character of the event.
The natural reason for which the interruption occurs.
An action or sub-event through which the Actor or Cause interrupts the Process.

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause.
An Intoxicant is ingested in order to achieve an altered state of consciousness. A Type or Descriptor may be indicated as well. We smoked some high-grade marijuana. They smoked freebase cocaine.
Type identifies the kind or sort of Intoxicant.
Descriptor describes a quality of the Intoxicant.
Country_of_origin identifies where the Intoxicant is grown or originates.
This frame concerns people being in an altered mental state that is induced by an Intoxicant. Cory was drunk. Nutty stormed in drunk as a fiddler.
The mental state of the Cognizeris changed by an Intoxicant.
The Intoxicant alters the Cognizer's mental experience.
This Fe identifies the Degree to which the Cognizer is altered by the Intoxicant.
Evaluation indicates the Cognizer's reaction to the intoxicatoin.
This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the intoxication holds.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Cognizer is intoxicated.
The Time when the Cognizer becomes intoxicated.

The Invader enters a Land in an aggressive attempt to cripple or dominate its people and its government. In August 1990 ,Iraq was invading Kuwait , which led to the Gulf war . Some towns in Russia were ravaged by barbarian invasions in the thirteenth century.
The political area that is being crippled by the Invader's entry.
An entity used by the Invader to assist in the invasion of the Land.
The army or other self-directed entity that is entering the Land in a hostile manner.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Invader that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An intentional action performed by the Invader that accomplishes the assault.
This FE identifies the location where the Invader invades the Land.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Invader attacks the Land.
A state of affairs that the Invader is responding to that leads them to make an assault on the Land.
This FE identifies the time when the Invader invades Land.

The starting-point of the motion of the Invader or projectiles of the Invader as they move toward the the Place that the Land is occupying in the attack. In prepositional phrases, the prepositional object expresses the starting point of motion. With particles, the starting point of motion is understood from context.
This FE is used for any Depictive phrase describing the state of the Invader or Land while the Invasion occurs.

This FE presents the current frame as an integral part of a larger conceptualization expressed by another frame. The frame expressed by the target typically corresponds to a Means action within the frame expressed by the Re_encoding, but not necessarily.
The Result of the invasion on the Land by the Invader.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held. Form: once, twice, Cardinal expression + /it times, /it lots/a lot
In general, this FE is used for phrases that describe the clause of the target as a whole and describes and describes the event more generally.
The Path refers to (a part of) the ground over which the Invader travels.
How often the Invader invades the Land.
This FE indicates the subtype of invasion into the Land.
This FE describes how intense the invation of the Land is.
The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.
For how long the Land is invaded by the Invader.
An Invader enters a land in an attempt to dominate the Attacked and they either fail or succeed.
The Invader is the entity that overtakes the Attacked.
The Attacked is the land, government, and its people that is seized by the Invader.
This FE describes the intensity and extent of the invasion event.
The manner in which the Invader takes over the Attacked.
The action by which the conquering event is made possible through the efforts of the Invader.
The location where the Invader takes over the Attacked.
The Time at which the Invader seizes the Attacked.
The reason why the Invader seized the Attacked.
The tool used by the Invader to seize the Attacked.
A Place is located far off from centers of population, culture, and/or trade.
The town or area that is in a remote location.
A place with respect to which the Place is located.

A Cognizer makes a judgment about an Evaluee. The judgment may be positive (e.g. respect) or negative (e.g. condemn), and this information is recorded in the semantic types Positive and Negative on the Lexical Units of this frame. There may be a specific Reason for the Cognizer's judgment, or there may be a capacity or Role in which the Evaluee is judged. This frame is distinct from the Judgment_communication frame in that this frame does not involve the Cognizer communicating his or her judgment to an Addressee. JUDGMENT: She admired Einstein for his character. JUDGMENT_COMMUNICATION: She accused Einstein of collusion. Currently, however, some lexical units and annotation for both remain in this frame.
The Cognizer makes the judgment. This role is typically expressed as the External Argument (or in a by-PP in passives).
Evaluee is the person or thing about whom/which a judgment is made. With verbs this FE is typically expressed as Object:
Typically, there is a constituent expressing the Reason for the Judge's judgment. It is usually a for-PP, e.g.
Role is used for the capacity in which theEvaluee is judged, and is expressed in as-PPs.
Expressor is the body part or action by a body part that conveys the judgment made by the Cognizer.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the judging occurs.
Depictive identifies any expression describing the state of a participant in the event.
This FE identifies the Manner of judging.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Cognizer judges the Evaluee.
Topic identifies the entity to which the proposition or propositions conveyed relate.
The Extent_of_acclaim is a description of the number or locales of the Cognizers.
The Result of the judgement event.

A Communicator communicates a judgment of an Evaluee to an Addressee. The judgment may be positive (e.g. praise) or negative (e.g. criticize), and this is indicated by the semantic types Positive and Negative attached to the lexical units. This frame does not contain words where Evaluee and the Addressee are necessarily the same . I commended his handling of the crisis. Gaston denounced him to the committee. This is distinct from the Judgment frame in that it involves the communication of an evaluation, rather than merely forming and holding a particular evaluation.
The Addressee hears the judgement from the Communicator.
The Communicator uses language in the written or spoken modality to convey his or her evaluation of the Evalueeto another person.
Medium identifies the physical or abstract setting in which the evaluation is conveyed.
Topic identifies the entity to which the proposition or propositions conveyed relate.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the Communicator judges the Evaluee to be good or bad.
A judgment is made about the Evaluee With verbs this FE is typically expressed as Object:
Expressor is the body part or action by a body part that conveys the judgment made by the Communicator.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the judgmental communication occurs.
This FE identifies the Means by which a judgmental communication is accomplished.
Typically, there is a constituent expressing the Reason for the Communicator's judgment. It is usually a for-PP.
Role is used for the capacity in which theEvaluee is judged, and is expressed in as-PPs.
This FE identifies the Result of an event.
Depictive identifies any expression describing the state of a participant in the event.
The Grounds is the standard by which the Evaluee is judged.
The Extent_of_acclaim provides a description of the number or whereabouts of the Communicator.
When the communication of the judgment takes place.
Where the communication of the judgment takes place.
The emotional or physical state of the Communicator that leads to their communication of a judgment.
This FE describes the frequency with which the specified communication occurs
In this frame, a Communicator judges the Addressee and then communicates that appraisal directly to the Addressee. The judgment is given for a particular Reason or about a particular Topic.
The Communicator communicates a judgment to the Addressee.
The Addressee is jduged by the Communicator and receives the message of approval or disapproval.
The Topic is the subject on which the Addressee is being judged.
The Reason is why the Communicator forms the type of judgment they form.
The Medium identifies the physical or abstract entity in which the judgment is conveyed.
The Degree is the severity of the judgment.
The Depictive describes the state of the Communicator or Addressee.
The Grounds describes the basis for the judgment.
The Manner is the way in which the judgment is communicated.
The Means is the method employed to communicate the judgment.
The location where the Communicator admonishes the Addressee.
The point in time at which the Communicator berates or compliments the Addressee.
The laudable or reprimandable status held by the Addressee.
An action or entity under the control of the Communicator that expresses the criticism or praise directed towards the Addressee.

A Source_of_authority, typically a government, relies upon a set of institutions specialized for the administration of justice. These Judicial_body s hear cases that originate within their Jurisdiction and relate to the Task given to them by the Source_of_authority. Often, a Judicial_body is part of a larger system within which its Rank can be specified. The Judicial_body is typically located in a specific location, the Seat. The federal judiciary's certification process is the foundation of the interpreter program. INI DNI The city files an appeal with the state's Eastern District Court of Appeals. The case, tried in the US District Court in Boston, involved technical and financial issues regarding the feasibility of the project. INI On Oct. 31, the Alaska State Superior Court granted Chugach Electric Association's Oct. 3 request to dissolve the stay. INI
A permanent organization with the socially important purpose of administering justice.
The concern of the Judicial_body-- broadly speaking, the aspect of society that they affect.

The responsibility that a Judicial_body has, either defined in terms of the type of cases that they can hear, or more specifically by reference to an action that the authority constituting them wishes the Judicial_body to achieve.
The degree of authority invested in a Judicial_body relative to other courts in the same system.
The location (typically a city) in which the Judicial_body hears cases.,
The geographical area within which the Judicial_body has authority and responsibility.
The political entity under whose laws the Judicial_body is constituted and whose laws are applied.
The individuals that make up the Judicial_body.
The place where the Judicial_body is located.
The Jury discuss the Case and its Charges in order to evaluate the Possible_sentence of the Accused.
The group that debates the case.
The amount of time for which the deliberation is ongoing.
The legal label for the crime that the defendant is accused of.
The Case which a Trial is convened to decide.
A sentence that the jury considers during deliberation.

An Experiencer, Expressor, or State can be described as having a surprised emotion as evoked by a Stimulus or concerning a Topic. I was more shocked about the child than she was. Mrs Nowak was surprised by the amount of money Mills left her. I think the shock of that recognition drove me a little crazy.
The Experiencer is the person or sentient entity that experiences or feels the emotions.
The Topic is the general area in which the emotion occurs. It indicates a range of possible Stimulus.
The Stimulus is the person, event, or state of affairs that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.
The extent to which the Experiencer's emotion deviates from the norm for the emotion.
The Empathy_target is the individual or individuals with which the Experiencer identifies emotionally and thus shares their emotional response.
The body part, gesture, or other expression of the Experiencer that reflects his or her emotional state. They describe a presentation of the experience or emotion denoted by the adjective or noun.
The Reason is the explanation for why the Stimulus evokes a certain emotional response.

The Circumstances is the condition(s) under which the Stimulus evokes its response. In some cases it may appear without an explicit Stimulus. Quite often in such cases, the Stimulus can be inferred from the Circumstances
The State is the abstract noun that describes a more lasting experience by the Experiencer.
The Parameter is a domain in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus.

Any description of the way in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). Manner may also describe a state of the Experiencer that affects the details of the emotional experience.
The Time when the Experiencer, Expressor, or State can be described as having said emotion.
Type describes the kind of response the Stimulus or Topic invoke in the Experiencer.
Medium is the physical entity or channel used to transmit the experience invoked by the Stimulus.

An Agent has done or omitted to do an Act or is responsible for the obtaining of a State_of_affairs, which a Judge deems to constitute a violation of an obligation or a moral guideline. The Agent gives a Reason why the Act or omission or State_of_affairs was licit despite appearances.
The person or organization that is held responsible for a prior Act or for a State_of_affairs.
The set of facts or circumstances that the Agent offers in explanation of their earlierAct or of the State_of_affairs
An action for which the Agent is held responsible, frequently one that the Agent has taken themself.
A State_of_affairs that the Agent is held responsible for.
The person or institution that holds the Agent responsible for an Act or State_of_affairs.
An intentional action, typically an act of speaking, which the Agent performs in order to justify an Act or State_of_affairs.
This FE denotes the number of times the Act or State_of_affairs are justified.
The general spectrum of reasoning that the Agent uses to explain the Act or State_of_affairs.
The Time of the justifying event.
The words in this frame describe situations in which a Perpetrator carries off and holds the Victim against his or her will by force.
The Perpetrator is the person (or other agent) who carries off and holds the Victim against his or her will.
The Victim is the person who is carried off and held against his/her will.
Source is the initial location of the Victim before it changes location.
Goal is the place in which the Victim ends up.
Manner in which the kidnapping takes place.
An act performed by the Perpetrator that helps them accomplish the kidnapping.
The Purpose is what the Perpetrator hopes to accomplish by kidnapping.
The Reason is why the Perpetrator commits the kidnapping.
The abduction of a Victim by a Perpetrator.
An additional abductee taken along with the Victim.
The period of time for which the Victim is held by the Perpetrator
The number of times that the Victim is kidnapped.
A Killer or Cause causes the death of the Victim. John drowned Martha.
The person or sentient entity that causes the death of theVictim.
The living entity that dies as a result of the killing.
An inanimate entity or process that causes the death of the Victim.
The state of affairs that the Killer is trying to bring about by killing.
The method or action that the Killer or Cause performs resulting in the death of the Victim.
The preexisting state of affairs that the Killer is responding to.
The location where the death took place.
The point or period of time within which the Victim is killed.
The state of the Killer or Victim during the killing.
The state of the Victim that results from being killed. (Normally this is somewhat redundant.)
The device used by the Killer to bring about the death of the Victim.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of a Killer that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The Degree appears with adjectives to describe the killing potential of an object or with nouns to describe how widespread the killing is.
This extra-thematic FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the occurrence of the event specified by the target predicate.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often.

This frame contains words that denote Kinship relations. In annotating the directional uses of these words, we use the standard terms from anthropology, Ego and Alter. Matilde is Gilberto's cousin once removed
The person who fills the role named by the Kinship term with respect to the Ego.
The person from whose perspective the Kinship relationship is defined.
The combination of Alter and Ego together.
An expression of the closeness or distance of the relation. We do not go into full anthropological detail in measuring the distance of the relation, but simply annotate all such expressions as Degree
This FE describe some characteristic of the Alter or the Ego.

An Agent creates a Knot (possibly in a Place and/or with an Instrument).Loretta ties the most beautiful bowline I've ever seen.If you can tie a half-hitch around the table leg with only that much string...
The Agent is the person performing the intentional act.
The Instrument with which a Knot is produced..
The purpose for which an intentional act is performed. John flattered her to receive a raise.
An act performed by the Agent by which the creation of the Knot is accomplished.
The stable configuration of a String which results from tying.
This FE identifies a depictive phrase describing the actor or undergoer of an action. We wandered around naked. Cicadas screech unseen from within.
An Agent manipulates a long thin object (the Rope and creates a Knot.
The Agent is the sentient being who manipulates the Rope.
The Instrument with which the Rope is manipulated.
Where the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
The Purpose for which the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
When the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
The Means by which the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
The Reason for which the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
The basically linear object which is manipulated by the Agent to produce a Knot.
The stable configuration of a Rope which results from tying.
Manner in which the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
Where the manipulation of the Rope takes place.

A Speaker uses as a Label to refer to an Entity. The Label is not a conventional name for the Entity but a description categorizing the Entity and thereby expressing a judgment. Some labeled him a womanizer. During her lifetime, her enemies branded her as a prostitute.
The Speaker is the person who conventionally uses a linguistic sign to refer to an Entity.
The concrete or abstract thing with which the Speaker has associated a particular linguistic sign.
The linguistic sign that the Speaker uses to designate the Entity.
A time period in which a Speaker uses the Label.
A physical space whose occupants use the Label to refer to the Entity.
A text whose author applies a particular Label to an Entity.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
Duration_of_final_state denotes the length of time from the beginning of a state resulting from the activity denoted by the target until the state no longer holds.

An Agent or a Cause mentally or physically expends energy rendering an Input, whether implicit or explicit, into a Output. Erosion is the work of wind and water on rock. NB: The Input in the case of artistic Output, or an " artistic work" as more commonly referred to, is usually INI, because the material at hand being rendered is usually an idea or artistic material that is taken as common foreground knowledge by the semantics of the Agent's professional role. One of Chinua Achebe's greatest works was Things Fall Apart. INI
A sentient entity whose physical and mental faculties are directly expended on the Input to create the Output.
A non-sentient entity whose physical faculties are directly expended on the Input to create the Output.
The mental or physical faculties onto which the Agent or Cause expends energy.
The end product, either a concept or physical object onto which the Agent or Cause has exerted its mental or physical faculties from the rudimentary state of Input.
A word or phrase that characterizes the target.
The time at which the Output was committed into reality.
The place where the Output was birthed.
The entity for whom the Output is created.
The place where the target or Output is presented.
A Descriptor is a chracterization or description of the Output that is not covered by any more-specific FE.

An Agent acts to begin the life of a Process. After discovering her knack for organization, she decided to try to launch a career in human resources. The City of Bratislava has launched a pilot project of providing internet access in the city centre.
This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate the process that the Agent initiates.
This FE identifies the Place where the Process is initiated.
The Means is the way in which the Agent initiates the Process.
This FE is for the Time when the Agent initiates the Process.
Medium is the physical or abstract setting in which the Agent initiates the Process.
The Agent is the actor responsible for starting the Process.
To what end the Agent initiates the Process.
This FE identifies the first Subevent of the started Process.
The way in which the Agent initiates the Process.
This FE modifies the target to indicate the legal- or "by rule" domain within which the event if initiating the Process is considered true.
The reason why or the way in which the Agent initiates the Process.
The state of the world at the time when the Agent produces the Process.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
A consecutive event to the starting of the Process of the Agent.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause.
This FE identifies the Depictive phrase describing the actor or undergoer of an action.
This FE applies to appraisals of the event, typically a judgment of its expectedness.
The party for who's benefit the Process is launched.

This FE presents the current frame as an integral part of a larger conceptualization expressed by another frame. The frame expressed by the target typically corresponds to a Means action within the frame expressed by the Re_encoding, but not necessarily
How often the Process is launched.

A Law regulates activities or states of affairs within a Jurisdiction, dictating what Required states should be the case and what Forbidden states should not. Often it also indicates negative consequences for individuals that violate it, and these negative consequences are generally enforced by some official authority. They may or may not be created by some official legislative body.
This FE identifies the rule designed to guide activity, deprecating some types of activity and/or requiring other types of activity.
The use for which a law is intended.
An individual or individuals that bring the Law into existence.
The time at which a Law comes into existence.
The term used to refer to a Law.
An indication of the subtype of Law.
Any indication of what makes up the Law.
The state-of-affairs which is disallowed by the Law.
A state-of-affairs which the Law declares must be maintained.
The location where a given Law is in force.

These are words referring to control by a Leader over a particular entity (the Governed) or an Activity. The frame contains both nouns referring to a title or position (e.g. director, king, president), and verbs describing the action of leadership (e.g. rule, reign). With verbs, it is possible to mention the Role played by the Leader (often a name of a leading position, e.g., king) Sebek em hat was a Leader of Priests. ca. 1780 BC In 1789 Fletcher Christian led the mutiny on HMS Bounty Louis XIV ruled over his people as king for the longest period of any European monarch.
The Leader is the one who has the role of leading. With verbs, and with predicate nominals linking an individual to a Role, the Leader is usually the External Argument:

The role played by the Leader in a given situation, often an official title; incorporated in most noun LUsin this frame. When expressed separately from the target, Role usually occurs in a PP Complement headed by as.
Leadership by any particular individual is frequently limited in time, which is noted here as Duration. Duration usually occurs in a PP Complement.
Depictive refers to that which describes one of the participants in the leadership relationship.
Manner refers to the style/way in which the leadership is asserted.
Means identifies act(s) performed by the Leader through which leadership is maintained.
The Degree to which leadership is asserted.
Time refers to the point in time that the leadership took place.
The entity whose actions or beliefs the Leader directs in the context of a joint activity or movement. This entity can be a political body, a person, or a group of people.
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Leader.
This FE indicates what subtype of the general category the Leader belongs to.
The relevant Domain within which the Leader rules.

A Process of using or modifying is scheduled to be applied to a group or mass. At a certain Time, the Remainder that is still left to be processed can be identified. The Agent who is in line to work on the Remainder is usually deprofiled but may sometimes be expressed. Three more cars remain to be fixed. We have done the first twenty so there are only five more letters remaining DNI
The activity that is being applied to the mass or the set of entities.
The mass or group that has not yet been processed.
The time when the Remainder is assessed.

The individuals who are scheduled to apply the Process to the Remainder. The Agent may be the same or a different individual who applied the process to the part that has already undergone the Process.

Words in this frame describe the status of an Action with respect to a Code of laws or rules. An Object may also be in violation or compliance of the Code by virtue of its existence, location or possession. Illegal drug use is on the rise. Scores of illegal immigrants cross the border every year. Feeding the buffalo is prohibited according to Code 138 .
The Action is the behavior which complies with or violates the Code.
The Code is the set of rules, laws or regulations that determine whether the Action is allowed or prohibited.
The Object complies with or violates the Code by virtue of its existence, location or possession.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.

An Emitter emits a Beam of light from a Source, along a Path, and/or towards a Goal. Essentially, this frame denotes the (semi-)fictive motion of the the Beam. Avoid allowing light to shine into neighbors' gardens. Clear yellow sunlight shone through the window-panes. She thinks the sun shines out of his backside. ...when the candles shine out. It shines in my eyes. ('It' is both Beam and Emitter, though only one will show up in the display.) ...light shines down on the world. The moonlight shone off the fields. The candlelight glinted from pearls and rubies.
Degree to which the light movement occurs
Depictive phrase describing the external argument.
This FE identifies the entity at the Source from which the Beam originates.
The Source is the location the Beam occupies initially before its change of location.
The light that travels from a Source along a Path to a Goal.
Path refers to where the Beam travels over or to a landmark the Beam travels by.
Goal is the location the Beam ends up in.

This frame is concerned with the likelihood of a Hypothetical_event occurring. The Hypothetical_event is its only core frame element. It is likely that he'll arrive late. Notice that in the case where a noun phrase is the subject of the Support Verb, that NP is also tagged as Hypothetical_event. He is likely to arrive late.
The state of affairs or occurrence whose likelihood is assessed.
This FE expresses a reason the speaker has for making judgment about the likelihood of an event.
The Circumstances under which the Hypothetical_event is likely.

A linguistic Form has a particular Meaning, possibly restricted to a particular Context. Some linguistic Forms, nouns and nominal expressions, also can refer to an object in the real or an imagined world, a Referent.
Form is the formal pole of a linguistic sign.
Meaning is the sense of a linguistic Form.
The FE Context is used for expressions that indicate under which semantic, collocational, pragmatic or other circumstances a Form has a particular Meaning.
Referent identifies an object in the real (or a hypothetical) world that a linguistic expression is used to talk about.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute of the Form and modifies the expected value for it.
A Location is characterized by a high amount of (often goal-oriented) Activity, or metonymically, with Individuals who are engaged in the activity.
The Location where a lot of activity is taking place, or prototypically takes place.
A modifier expressing the deviation in amount of activity from the norm or from the amount for another Location.
The Time during which the Location is characterized by a lot of activity.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Location has some degree of activity or liveliness.
The larger or general area where the Location is lively.
The Activity that is conceptually filling the Location.
The Individuals are engaged in the Activity, creating a lively Location.

Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end. In many cases, the continuous situation is a dynamic action which is ongoing, while in others it is simply an undifferentiated state.
The way in which the Individuals or Location is engaging in the Activity.

The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the state of affairs expressed by the target, but not in all cases.

This frame contains general locale words, and is mostly a place-holder in the hierarchy. Words in this frame designate relatively stable bounded ares of the world which have permanent Relative_locations with respect to other locales, and thus are useful as permanent landmarks. It is inherited by Locale_by_use, which has to do with places that are named according to their intended use, or some habitual use, such as factory.n, dance floor.n, village.n, field.n. It is also inherited by Locale_by_event, which covers places that are names according to some event which took place there, such as concerts, battles, and meteor impacts.
A stable bounded area. It is typically the designation of the nouns of Locale-derived frames.
Salient parts that make up a Locale.
A place that a Locale is located with respect to.
Indicates the action (or causer) which brings the features of the Locale about. This FE should also include words that indicate that there was no salient formation.
The location that the Locale is a part of.
ULTIMATELY TO BE REPLACED BY MULTIWORD TARGETS (in almost all cases). This FE is used for the Names of Locales.
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Locale.

An event related to the locale in some way other than (1) Formational_cause (which is a separate FE) or an intended use (which would place the instance in Locale_by_use), or (3) a defining event (which would place the instance in Locale_by_event).
The activity that is carried out in the Locale.

A place defined in terms of an event which occurred (or will occur) there. Woodstock, NY was the site of the most important rock concert of 1969. Our meeting site was chosen for its solitude. In the second example, the event FE is labeled with two labels, because the two words do not form a syntactic constituent; the first would be GF Genitive PT Possessive, and the second, GF Dependent and PT NP.
A stable bounded area. It is typically the denotation of the nouns in Locale_by_event, which will be annotated on the target word.
Salient parts that make up a Locale.
A place that a Locale is located with respect to.
The event for which the locale is known or is named
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Locale.
A place defined by an Owner. Get off my property!
A stable bounded area. It is typically the designation of the nouns of Locale-derived frames.
A place that a Locale is located with respect to.
The individual or group of individuals who hold posses the Locale.
Salient parts that make up a Locale.
Any feature or characteristic of the Locale not covered by more specific FEs.
The location that the Locale is a part of.
The activity that is carried out in the Locale.

Geography as defined by use. You must land in the next airfield, as this one is currently having difficulties. The new sports complex was the tallest building on campus, oddly enough. Cities of the Northeast tend to be dingier.
FN: Salient parts that make up a Locale.
The location that the Locale is a part of.
Indicates the action (or causer) which brings the features of the Locale about.
A stable bounded area. It is typically the designation of the nouns of Locale-derived frames.
ULTIMATELY TO BE REPLACED BY MULTIWORD TARGETS (in almost all cases). This FE is used for the Names of Locales.
A place that a Locale is located with respect to.
The activity that is carried out in the Locale.
Any feature or characteristic of the Locale not covered by more specific FEs.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent Locale itself and any of its participants.
A Perceiver determines the Location of a Sought_entity within a Ground. Kim found his hat on the far side.
The individual that determines the Location of the Sought_entity.
The entity that the Perceiver succeeds in finding.
The general set of entities that the Perceiver examined in order to find the Sought_entity.
The word(s) in this frame detail a particular moment in time.
Relative_time denotes words that locate the time with respect to an identifiable reference point.
Name denotes the name of the particular point in time.
The Whole describes the larger unit of which the target word describes one part.
The particular point in time, as denoted by the target word.
Salient_event is an event that is associated with the given point in time.
Measurement marks a specific point in time relative to a 24 hour time system.
A Descriptor is any characterization or description of the point in time that is not covered by a more specific FE.

A perceptible Figure shows up against a Ground location due to Light shining on/from it, its salience possibly dependent on a Cause_of_shine. The grass glistened with dew. Still glowing from the forge... The oily mud gleamed wetly under his feet. Something was shimmering on the shore. The quartz glowed with a fitful, internal light. The walls glowed in the sun. Note that in this last example, the PP 'in the sun' is both the Ground on the primary FE layer and Light on the secondary layer. This frame is similar to the frame Light_movement. In both, there is a very consistent metaphorical conception of emotions as shining in eyes or forth from eyes, including the associated pattern of eyes shining with an emotion. The sense in such cases is that the eyes (or the muscles and features around the eyes) are in such a configuration as to saliently convey the emotion. Such sentences should be tagged with the metaphor tag to differentiate them from literal sentences like "His eyes glistened with tears."
Degree to which the Light is emitted, usually indicating the brightness.
The state of a focal participant during the emission of Light .
The percept which is perceived at a certain Ground location.
The Result of the emission of the Light .
This is the cause of the shininess of the phenomenon, generally introduced by 'with'.
The Light which is emitted. In this frame, it is usually incorporated in verbs and adjectives, and is the denotation of many of the nouns.
The period for which the Figure shows up against the Ground due to Light falling on it.
The spatial setting in which the Figure shows up against a Ground location.
The Time when the Figure is observed against the Ground location due to Light shining on it.

A Figure is located relative to a Ground location. The location of the Figure may be further specified by its Distance from a reference location (generally, the deictic center) and the Direction in which the Figure lies from a reference location (generally, the deictic center). The cat is on the mat. The kitchen, with its breakfast / snack bar, adjoins on one side while the dining area adjoins on the other side. DNI
The Ground serves as a basis for describing the location of the Figure.
The Figure is perceived as located relative to a certain Ground location.
This FE identifies the Distance between the Figure and some reference location (generally, the deictic center or the Ground).
This FE identifies the Direction from a reference location (generally, the deictic center) of a path to the Figure.
The period of time during which the locative relation between Figure and Ground obtains.
The Figures are items which mutually serve to identify the location of the other items.
A Host provides a Residence for a Lodger to temporarily stay.
The Host is the individual (or group of individuals) that own or control the Residence and allow the Lodger to temporarily stay there.
The Lodger is the individual who is given permission to lodge in the Residence.
The Time is when the Host provides a Residence to the Lodger
The Place is where the Host provides a temporary Residence.
The location controlled by the Host which the Lodger stays at temporarily.

A common finance market concept that involves a Lender who lends some form of Assets to an Intermediary who in turn will sell those Assets to the Market. The eventual intent is for the Intermediary to repurchase the Assets from the Market for profit and return them to the Lender.
The original owner and soon to be Lender of the Assets.
The entity that is the borrower to the Lender and the seller and later repurchaser to the Market.
The aggregate selling place of many types of financial stocks, bond, securities, etc. The Market is also a metonym for the people who buy the Assets.
Subframe of Transfer in which the Donor begins by possessing a Theme and finishes by not possessing the Theme.
The Place is where the Relinquishing occurs.
The Reason indicates what the Donor is trying to accomplish by the Relinquishing.
The Time indicates when the Relinquishing occurs.
The person that begins in possession of the Theme and causes it to be in the possession of the Recipient.
The Theme is the object that changes ownership due to the Relinquishing.
The Purpose indicates the purpose for which the intentional Relinquishing takes place.
The Recipient is the entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
This is the Frame which binds together the initial state of the Donor possessing the Theme, the transfer, and the final state of the Donor not possessing the Theme.
The entity that began by owning the Theme.
The thing which was originally owned by the Donor. (This does not include bodyparts or medical conditions, but does include intellectual property, etc.)

This frame describes a situation in which an Owner loses his or her Possession. The Owner may have failed to keep ownership of their Possession (i.e. robbery or gambling) or may have unintentionally misplaced their Possession. I misplaced my watch. He lost his wedding ring while playing cards.
The original Owner of the Possession.
The object that is possessed by the Owner.
The Time when the Possession is lost.
The Place where the Possession is lost.
This FE describes how the Owner loses the Possession.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the event of losing a Possession logically follows.

An Protagonist goes from a default state of mental and emotional equilibrium into a temporary state of disequilibrium, often a state of anger. A Reason for the change of state may be given. Likewise, Actions that the Experiencer takes as a result of their new emotional state may be expressed. Both Reasons and Actions may be introduced just as coordinated clauses. The lexical units also are frequently accompanied by expressions of an Affected_party. This frame is populated by many lexical units that are based on the emotion-heat/pressure metaphor. Note also that many phrases with equivalent meaning to targets of this frame are compositional, e.g. 'go insane', which we treat as the LU insane.a (of the Mental_property frame) plus the inchoative support go.v.
This is the person (or people) whose mental state changes.
Something done by the Protagonist as a result of losing mental equilibrium.
Degree marks the extent to which the Protagonist's mental state changes.
Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, especially general descriptions comparing events.
A person (or persons) who is saliently affected by the Protagonist's Actions.
The cause for the Protagonist to go crazy.

This frame describes a Sufferer who experiences the loss of someone through death. The LUs in this frame imply a strong emotional connection between the Sufferer and the Deceased. She lost her husband in the war.
The being or entity that emotionally experiences the death of the Deceased.
The Place where the Deceased passed away.
The Time when the Deceased passed away.
This FE describes how the Deceased passed away.
This non-lexical frame describes a scenario in which a Perceiver fails to keep sight of a Theme.
The Perceiver is the entity who fails to keep the Theme in sight.
The Theme is the object that becomes unperceivable.
The Time when the Perceiver loses perception of the Theme.
The Place where the Perceiver loses perception of the Theme.
This FE denotes a proposition from which the loss of perception logically follows.

This frames describes a Theme who evades the sight of a Perceiver. The focus of this frame is the Theme, which appears in subject position. This frame contrasts with the opposing perspective in Losing_track_of_theme, where the Perceiver is the subject and the Theme is the object. The burglar lost the police as the thief turned the corner.
The Theme is the object that becomes unperceivable.
The Perceiver is the entity who fails to keep the Theme in sight.
The Place where the Perceiver loses perception of the Theme.
The Time when the Perceiver loses perception of the Theme.
This FE denotes a proposition from which the loss of perception logically follows.

This frames describes a Perceiver who fails to keep sight of a Theme. The focus of this frame is the Perceiver, which appears in subject position. This frame contrasts with the opposing perspective in Losing_track_of_perceiver, where the Perceiver is the object and the Theme is the subject. The police lost the burglar as the thief turned the corner.
The Perceiver is the entity who fails to keep the Theme in sight.
The Theme is the object that becomes unperceivable.
The Place where the Perceiver loses perception of the Theme.
The Time when the Perceiver loses perception of the Theme.
This FE denotes a proposition from which the loss of perception logically follows.

A State_of_affairs is evaluated as good (or bad), against a background assumption that previously, the State_of_affairs was thought to be unlikely to occur. The State_of_affairs holds for a particular Protagonist.
The State of affairs that is evaluated.
The Protagonist is the one for whom the destiny is evaluated.
A description of the sort of State_of_affairs.
The Role filled by the Protagonist.
The time for which the Protagonist's destiny is good.
The Degree to which the State_of_affairs is lucky (either a degree of goodness or a degree of unexpectedness, or both).
The location where the Protagonist has luck.

Individuals first encounter each other and make introductions at a particular Time, Place, or Context. The Individuals may have known of each other before making introductions. The Individuals may be separately construed as Individual_1 and Individual_2. In some cases, there is a Explanation of the circumstances which lead to the Individuals' meeting. Impressed when he first met Nixon, he had always thought of him as an intelligent man, and believed that Nixon would take a stand for civil rights We met each other in the university, worked in the same city and came to KSU together! Horatio Nelson and Emma Hamilton first met in Naples in September 1793 Her name was Jenny and I met her through an online dating service.
The time when the Individuals make each other's acquaintance.
The location where the Individuals make each others acquaintance.
The persons (or in rare cases animals) that make each other's acquaintance.
The Event, frequently a social occasion, during which the Individuals make each other's acquaintance.
The semantically more prominent one of the two parties when the Individuals are realized separately.
The semantically less prominent of the two parties when the Individuals are expressed separately.
A person or social group that connects both of the Individuals, with a group member typically introducing the Individuals to each other.
The state of affairs that leads to the Individuals' making each other's acquaintance.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.

This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action. The depicted state does not necessarily or usually facilitate or cause the state of affairs reported by the target.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

Two (or more) people (the Parties, also encodable as Party_1 and Party_2) negotiate an agreement. Both sides are construed as making a commitment to assume an Obligation--the process is understood to be symmetrical or reciprocal. Instead of a specific mention of the Obligation, a Topic expression may be used to indicate the domain covered. So far , we have agreedto cede 100km of coastline to Kiribati . DNI At common law, the parties could make an oral agreement to submit a dispute to arbitration and such oral agreement would be valid.

The individual or individuals that form the more prominent (i.e. agentive) party of the agreement, as compared with Party_2. That is, Party_1 is generally encoded as the External Argument of verbs, and peripheral FEs that do not make reference to the event itself generally make reference to Party_1. Thus Manner is construed to be that of Party_1, not necessarily that of Party_2 or the group of Parties as a whole.
The semantically (and grammatically) less prominent participant (or group of participants) in the agreement. It is generally encoded within a prepositional phrase (e.g. headed by with).
An expression of the commitment made by the Parties .
Topic is a description of the domain covered.
As with other frames in the Communication domain, the Medium of communication may be expressed. Medium is the physical entity or channel used to record or negotiate the Obligation.

Any description of the act of making an agreement which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of either Party_1 or Parties that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The group of individuals portrayed as equally involved in making an agreement.
This FE identifies the Place where the Agreement occurs.
This FE identifies the Place where the Agreement occurs.
This FE describes a characteristic of the Obligation.

Using Evidence, which may or may not be expressed, a Cognizer recognizes or proves that Concept1 is associated causally or collocationally with another concept, Concept2. These may be expressed collectively as associated Concepts.
Concept1 is the phenomenon which is believed to be related to Concept2.
The phenomenon which is believed to be linked to Concept1.
The phenomenon which proves the causal connection.
The sentient entity that recognizes the causal connection.
The phenomena which are believed to be related.
This FE describes how often the connection is made
The Time when the Cognizer make the connection.
The location where the Cognizer makes the connection.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

A physical entity, construed as a point-Sound_source, emits a Sound. This includes animals and people making noise with their vocal tracts. Sometimes the sound itself is referred to with a nominal expression, in which case it is called the Sound. Manner expressions may also be relevant in this frame, if they describe properties of the sound as such. A path-schema can be overlaid on the simple noise-making scene, adding a Location_of_source and/or a Path. This frame does not cover scenarios where objects create sound by coming into forceful contact with one another or rubbing against each other. Such scenarios are covered by the Impact and Friction frames. The current frame also does not cover cases where an animate Agent or a natural Force or Cause causes a single Source or several Sources (moving or rubbing against each other) to make noise. Such scenarios are covered by the Cause_to_make_noise, Cause_impact and Cause_friction frames (the latter of which is not yet existent). Cases where the major emphasis of the portrayed scene is on the motion of a Theme, with sound emission only an accompaniment, are covered by the Motion_noise frame. Likewise, cases where the Sound itself is portrayed as moving through space are not covered in this frame but rather in Sound_movement. Finally, all nouns used to evoke Sounds have been placed in the Sounds frame. We have done this because these nouns do not denote sound emission/production events but only the Sound itself (*The siren's blare occurred right on time).

The frame element Sound_source is assigned to a constituent referring to a physical entity which emits a sound. Such an entity must have an appropriately complex internal structure such that it can create a sound. For example, a machine or some other thing with moving parts can create sound by itself.
This FE identifies the Reason that the Sound_source produces the sound. Generally, this is some external stimulus that prompts the Sound_source to make noise.

The frame element Sound is incorporated in the meaning of the verbs of this frame. Otherwise, this FE is assigned to NPs which actually refer to a sound in the presence of the target. This typically occurs when the target is a verb used as a modifier in its -ing form, e.g.:
Manner expressions may be of lexicographic interest if they describe properties of a sounds as such: loudly, shrilly, etc.
The location of the Sound_source by which the Sound is emitted.
State of the Sound_source during the action.

The noise-making may be prompted by either some outside phenomenon or occurrence, or by an Internal_cause, the mental or emotional state of an animate Sound_source. Internal_cause is expressed in a PP Complement:
The Subregion is the sulocation of the Sound_source from which the sound is emitting.
Addressee identifies the intended audience of an event of making a noise as a communicative signal.
An event in which one or more Sound_sources participate and which is accompanied by Sound.
The Path along which the Sound travels away from the Sound_source.
The location of the Sound_source. This FE differs from Location_of_source only in terms of point of view; the latter FE implies a point of view that is not on the Sound_source.
A state or location of the Sound_source which contributes to the Sound_source's making noise.
The time when the Noisy_event occurs.
The number of times the noise-making event takes place.
This FE indicates that the noise-making event is embedded within a series of similar events.

An Enablement provides the circumstances for an Enabled_action to occur. Technology has permitted firms to link together more closely. Any membrane which will permit the passage of oxygen will also permit the passage of water . Unlike DOS , Windows lets you get on with something else when sending a fax. Liberalization allows easier entry into particular markets . Mesh allows the water to circulate normally through the aquarium.
The Enabled_action is that which depends on the Enablement in order to be possible to occur.
The Enablement is the physcial entity or state of affairs that, through its existence, makes possible the Enabled_action.
Time is when the Enablement makes the Enabled_action possible.
The location where the Enablement makes the Enabled_action possible.
The way in which the Enablement makes the Enabled_action possible.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

An Agent makes a particular facial expression, generally in response to some Internal_cause (generally an emotional state). Sometimes the Body_part involved in the expression is mentioned in lieu of the Agent.
The individual that assumes a particular facial expression.
The emotion or other mental state that leads the Agent to assume a facial expression.
The particular part of the face that the Agent moves into a facial expression.
The amount to which the expression on the face of the Agent matches the prototypical image for the indicated facial expression.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The individual that the Agent intends to see the facial expression; often the Intended_perceiver is also the focus of the emotional Internal_cause of the Agent.
The point in time at which the change in facial_expression takes place.
The location relative to some viewer (often the Intended_perceiver) at which the Agent makes an expression.
A path expression that describes a line from the Agent to the Intended_perceiver.
The facial expression of the Agent.
The state of the Agent during the event.
An event experienced by the Agent that leads them to make an expression.

A Manipulator gets his Victim to perform a Resulting_action against what their better judgment would have been at the time. The means by which the Manipulator overcomes or bypasses the Victim's resistance to act need not be linguistic expression. In some cases, the Goods may stand in for a Resulting_action of the Victim giving the Manipulator the Goods.
The person who gets the Victim to act against their interest.
The person who the Manipulator gets to do something they would not have done had no pressure or deception been applied.
What the Manipulator intends to make the Victim do and the Victim actually does.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an event occurs.
An act of the Manipulator that enables them to alter the action of the Victim.
The FE goods is anything (including labor, time, or legal rights) that can be taken away.
An entity that the Manipulator uses to get the Victim to perform the Resulting_action.
A state-of-affairs that the Manipulator is hoping to bring about by manipulating the Victim.
The time when the manipulation occurs.
The location where the Manipulator manipulates the Victim.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including metaphorical force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of a Manipulator that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An Agent manipulates a Theme so that it ends up in a particular shape or configuration.
The Agent is the volitional actor who manipulates the Theme.
The Instrument with which the Theme is manipulated.
Where the manipulation of the Theme takes place.
The Purpose for which the manipulation of the Theme takes place.
When the manipulation of the Theme takes place.
The Means by which the manipulation of the Theme takes place.
The Reason for which the manipulation of the Theme takes place.
The object which is manipulated by the Agent into a particular shape.
The Manner in which the manipulation of the Theme takes place.
Where the manipulation of the Theme takes place.

The words in this frame describe the manipulation of an Entity by anAgent. Ian squeezed Mara's hand. A number of lexemes listed in this frame also occur in the frame Cause-to-move (for example, push, yank). Only the non-motion uses of these words belong in this frame, e.g., combinations such as push at, push on, yank at.

The Agent manipulates an object. Agent typically refers to animate beings, but is also extended to mechanical and other inanimate objects. Agent is most frequently expressed as the external argument of verbs:
The Entity being manipulated often occurs as the direct object of verbs:
The Agent's manipulation of an Entity may be further specified as being localized to some part of the Entity, a Locus. The Locus is usually expressed as a PP Complement.

The part of the Agent's body being used to manipulate the Entity may also be expressed. While the default is for an Agent to use his/her hands, other body parts may be specified. This frame element usually occurs as a PP-complement.
This FE identifies the Duration of the manipulation.
This FE identifies the Result of manipulation.
The Agent's purpose in performing the manipulation.
An entity directed by the Agent that interacts with the Entity to accomplish the action indicated by the target.
An action by the Agent to accomplish the desired manipulation.
The spatial setting in which the manipulation takes place.
This FE identifies a depictive phrase describing the Agent or Bodypart_of_agent that holds throughout the action.
A state of affairs leading to the manipulation
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
A Manufacturer produces a Product from a Resource for commercial purposes. They produced only half of the units after an injunction to follow the environmental policy.
The person or company that produces the Product.
The Product is produced by the Manufacturer.
Resource is the material that the product is made from.
This FE identifies the Place where the Product is manufactured.
This Fe identifies the Time when the product was produced.
Factory identifies the particular plant where the Product is manufactured.
The Manufacturer produces the Product for the Consumer.
A phrase that describes the state of the Manufacturer or the Product during the manufacturing process.
This FE identifies the Instrument with which a Manufacturer produces a Product.
This FE identifies the Manner in which a Manufacturer creates a Product.
This FE identifies the Means by which a Manufacturer creates a Product.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Manufacturer produces a Product.
This FE identifies the Circumstances under which the the product was produced.
The number of manufacturing events in a given time period.
The Locus is a description of the active zone of the Manufacturer, where the manufacturing most saliently takes place.
A Mass_theme, generally made up of many individuals, moves from a Source to a Goal with some Path.
The mass of entities which moves.
