The place where the overall motion event takes place, thus including Source, Path, and Goal locations. Letters streamed in all over the country.
The Speed is the rate at which motion occurs.
The Source is the location the Theme occupies initially before its change of location.
Path refers to (a part of the) ground the Mass_theme travels over or to a landmark the Mass_theme travels by.
Goal is the location the Mass_theme ends up in.
The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.

This FE is any expression which characterizes the extent of motion. This frame element occurs throughout the motion domain but is very infrequent in Motion.Noise. The engine spluttered forward a short way and stopped.

The Mode_of_transportation expresses how the motion of the Mass_theme is effected, by its body or by a vehicle which holds and conveys the Mass_theme. Vehicles can move in any way and in any medium. They are usually expressed obliquely with 'in' or 'by'.

Any description of the motion event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Mass_theme that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully)
The spatial setting in which the Mass_motion takes place.

This FE is used for expressions that indicate motion along a line from the deitic center towards a reference point (which may be implicit) that is neither the Goal of the posture change nor a landmark along the way of the moving part of the body. Often Direction is defined with reference to the canonical orientation of the Mass_theme, or the orientation imposed by an implicit observer.
In cases wherein the Mass_theme is construed as a sentient entities, this FE denotes the state of affairs that the entities wish to bring about by mass movement.

An Agent makes use of a Means (either an action or a (system of) entities standing in for the action) in order to achieve a Purpose. (This frame may be broadened to include non-agentive intermediate actions.) The primary means of gas detection is mass spectroscopy . They learned of the attack by monitoring the allied communications channels .
The Agent uses the Means to acheive a Purpose.
The action performed by the Agent.
The goal or purpose of the Agent.
The Time when the Agent uses the Means.

An Entity has a particular scalar Attribute with a value exceeding a contextually-specified or generally-understood standard. Except where there is a difference in FEs, we place all adjectives related to measurable quantities in this frame. Note that when an adjective appears with a quantity expression (e.g., 6 feet long), it belongs to the Dimension frame. That ladder is really tall. After his back injury, he won't lift heavy boxes.
The Entity for which a particular gradable Attribute is appropriate and under consideration.
The feature of an Entity which is under discussion.
A quantity or other characterization of the Entity's state with respect to the Attribute.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Value from the norm.
The Time during which the Entity is in the state of having a particular Value for the Attribute.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity has a particular Value for the Attribute.
This transparent noun frame is concerned with Units for measuring the Area of regions.Hillary lives in the middle of 10 acres of wheat.Paul owns 20 hectares of land.
The region whose surface is being measured.
Things that occupy the Area that is being measured.

This frame involves words that provide a measure for some undelimited (mass) Entity by referring to an Event that a prototypical quantity (or duration) of the Entity stereotypically participates in. The Entity is not necessarily a physical entity, but may instead be an undelimited type of event (such as a noise, or an activity). He put two splashes of cologne on his face. Sorry--there's only two bites of cake left. Add a pinch of salt.
An abstract or concrete undelimited entity that is measured by the Event.
The event that a delimitable quantity or duration of an Entity participates in.
The number of iterations of the Event.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

This frame contains (transparent ) nouns that are Units of measurement for time. The frame elements are Count, Unit and Process. The final total was 606, scored in only 10 hours of excellent batsmanship. In this frame, we will NOT annotate deictic, calendric uses of nouns like week, month, etc. as in "next week, this month, in the 21st century".
The number of Units of the measured entity.
The standardized quantity in terms of which other quantities are measured.
The activity or state that takes place during the period of time under discussion.
The Agent either brings about or is the most involved in the Process.

This frame is concerned with nouns that denote Units of measurement for linear extent. The Frame Elements are Unit, Count, and Stuff.The shirt is made from 12 miles of pure cotton.81 miles of dyke are still visible from this point.
The number of Units of the linear extent.
The Stuff whose linear extent is being measured.
The standardized quantity in terms of which other quantities of the same kind are measured.
This FE marks constituents which express what property is being measured.
This frame is concerned with nouns that denote Units of measurement for masses. The Frame Elements are Unit, Count, and Stuff.Jelena bought three kilos of apples.Add a pound of sugar.
The number of Units of the measured mass.
The standardized quantity in terms of which other quantities of the same kind are measured.
The Stuff whose weight is being measured.

An Entity has a particular Value for an Attribute which may be described in several different ways, including: Degree of deviation from the Value expected for the kind of Entity seen in a particular instance, or in comparison to some other explicit comparison set. Absolute quantification in terms of the number of Counts of a particular Unit which equal the Value for the Attribute.
The Entity for which a particular gradable Attribute is appropriate and under consideration.
The feature of an Entity which is under discussion.
A quantity or other characterization of the Entity's state with respect to the Attribute.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Value from the norm.
The Time during which the Entity is in the state of having a particular Value for the Attribute.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity has a particular Value for the Attribute.
A standard measure, having a known value for the Attribute.
The number of Units which are equivalent to the Value of the Entity.

This frame is concerned with nouns that denote Units of measurement for volumes. The Frame Elements are Unit, Count, Stuff, and Size. The frame will be split soon into container-derived volumes (box, bottle etc.) and pure volumes (gallon, quart). For the moment we tag things as follows: Greg drank two 2 liter bottles of lemonade. Sue drank two liters of beer. This frame necessitated the introduction of the GF: Quant and the PT: Num used for expressions such as the following: two cups of coffee FE: Count, GF: Quant, PT: Num Note that we treat cardinal numbers and "a" (= 1) in the same way. a cup of coffee FE: Count, GF: Quant, PT: Num For the present, we prefer not to annotate "many cups of coffee" many cups of coffee FE: Count, GF: Quant, PT: Adj
The number of Units of the measured volume.
The Stuff whose volume is being measured.
The standardized quantity in terms of which other quantities of the same kind are measured.
A specification of the volume of the container.

An Entity is measured in some (implicit) Attribute by quantifying the Count of a particular Unit whose value for the Attribute is known. LUs and constructions whose meanings inherit from Measures are used in a relatively small, delimitable set of constructions. They may be complements of particular lexical constructions (a lengthof 20 ft., measures 20 ft.) or parts of non-lexical constructions (including Transparent Noun constructions and Measurement_plus_adjective and Measurement_plus_PP).
The number of Units of the measured Entity.
The known quantity with respect to an Attribute.
The item which is quantified in terms of the Attribute.
The aspect of the Entity which is being described and quantified.

Words in this frame name medical conditions or diseases that a patient suffers from, is being treated for, may be cured of, or die of. The condition or disease may be described in a variety of ways, including the part or area of the body (Body_Part) affected by the condition (e.g. liver cancer, cardiovascular disease), the Cause of the condition (e.g. bacterial meningitis, viral pneumonia), a prominent Symptom of the condition (e.g. asymptomatic stenosis, blue ear disease), the Patient or population (originally) affected by the condition (e.g. bovine tuberculosis, juvenile diabetes), or the (proper) Name used to identify the condition (e.g. Munchausen Syndrome, Lou Gehrig's Disease). Annotation in this frame is done in respect to the name of the condition or disease. John died of pancreatic cancer.
This FE is used for the patient, entity, or population (originally) affected by the condition or illness.
Body_Part is used for the part or area of the body affected by the condition or disease.
This FE is used for the cause of a condition or disease.
This FE is used for a prominent symptom of the condition or disease.
This FE is used for the Name that identifies the condition or disease.
The extent to which the Ailment diverges from the norm.
The location where the Ailment is effecting the Patients.
This frame includes words for medical instruments--i.e. Instruments designed for an institutional function or Purpose. Use thestethoscope to check his lungs.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which an Instrument is used.
This FE identifies the medical Instrument.

This frame includes words that name medical professionals and is closely related to the Medical_specialties frame. The FE Type characterizing a Professional's sub-specialty may also be expressed. Ralph is a paediatrician. Paediatric oncologists treat children with leukemia.
This FE identifies the Type of medical professional.
This FE identifies the medical Professional.
The particular disorder that the medical Professional treats. Most words in the frame inherently indicate this information.
The part of the body that the medical Professional treats. This is usually indicated by the Lexical Unit itself.
The length of time the Professional has been alive.
The payment that the Professional recieves for working.
The Contract_basis describes the conditions of employment with respect to permanency, hours per time period, or payment basis.
The Employer gives compensation to the Professional for working.
The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Professional belongs.
The place where the Professional works.
Rank is the position in a hierarchy that the Professional occupies within an organization.
The Origin is the place where the Professional was born or lived a salient part of her or his life.

This frame includes words that name medical specialties and is closely related to the Medical_professionals frame. The FE Type characterizing a sub-are in a Specialty may also be expressed. Ralph practices paediatric oncology.
This FE identifies the medical Specialty that someone practices.
This FE identifies the Typeof medical Specialty.
The sub-part or sub-system of the body which is studied. This is normally incorporated in the LUs of the frame.
The disease or disorder that a specialist attempts to treat. This concept is normally incorporated in the name of the Specialty.

Words in this frame describe a relationship in which an Item is expressed through a Text. The act of murder is rampant in the Bible. In his State of the Union Address, President Bush committed our nation to achieving three great goals of our time. Linnaeus in his writings often quotes his great predecessor.
The written source, body of work, or linguistic utterance in which the Item is found/expressed.
The piece of information or expression that is contained within the Text.
How often the Item appears in the Text.
When the Item appears in the Text.

An Agent or Entity becomes sufficient enough to meet a Standard. Alternatively, an action or occurrence can be thought of as Event that fulfills a Standard. In this frame, the Agent, Entity, or Event can be conceptualized as being on a scale where a change of value or circumstances brings it in line with the position of the Standard on the scale. This paper does not meet the requirements for graduation. Will Ben fulfill his obligation to Margaret ?
The intentional Agent acts to meet to a Standard.
The non-intentional Entity becomes sufficient enough to meet a Standard.
An act or occurence that changes circumstances sufficiently so as to meet a Standard.
A condition or requirement that the Agent, Entity, or Event attempt to meet.
The Manner in which the Agent or Entity become sufficient in regards to the Standard.
The Means by which the Agent or Entity become sufficient in regards in to the Standard.
The Time when the Agent, Entity, or Event becomes sufficient in regards to the Standard.
The extent to which the Standard is exceeded or not by Agent, Entity or Event.

In this frame Party_1 meets with Party_2 at a prearranged Time and Place. If expressed, Purpose only applies to Party_1. The Purpose of the meeting is usually discussion over a certain topic. I met with my professor to talk about my midterm.
Party_1 is the grammatically more prominent participant in the meeting event. It can refer to either a single individual or a larger party separate from Party_2 before the meeting.
A grammatically less prominent participant in the meeting event. It can refer to either a single individual or a larger party separate from Party_1 before the meeting.
An action that Party_1 and Party_2 plan to engage in upon meeting.
The Place where the meeting happens.
The Time when the meeting happens.
The Means descibes the way in which Party_1 and Party_2 convene.

Any description of the meeting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of Party_1 or Party_2.
A Trigger elicits a Response. The Response may either be some kind of action meant to address the Trigger event or an expressed judgment of the Trigger event. Our proposal met with harsh criticism.
The event that elicits a Response.
The means action or judgement in response to the Trigger.
A characterization of the Response action.
The location in which the Response action takes place.
The point in time when Response is made to the Trigger.
A Member is semi-permanently part of a socially constructed Group. Victor is part of the Red Crescent
The person who belongs to a Group.
A set of people standing in a semi-permanent relationship together.
An indication of the Member's status within the Group.
Any description of the inclusion event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
The time at which the Member is a member of the Group.
The location where the membership relationship holds.

A Cognizer applies oneself to commit a Pattern to memory, so that the Cognizer would recognize future examples of the Pattern or be able to reproduce it. A gaggle of students were frantically memorizing the answers out in the hall. It is possible to memorize by rote and at the same time have a full grasp of the underlying meaning. CNI INI This frame differs from Education_teaching in that the Cognizer is construed as acting alone, with no indication of an interacting individual that provides guidance.
The sentient being that focuses on a Pattern so that it will remain in the memory.
The phenomenon that the Cognizer observes and commits to memory.
The time when the Cognizer memorizes the Pattern.
The location wherein the Cognizer memorizes the Pattern.

Any description of the memorization event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of a Cognizer that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The exactness of the match between the Cognizer's memory and the Pattern.
An intentional action performed by the Cognizer by which they achieve memorization.
The goal that the Cognizer has in mind, which they believe will be accomplished by memorization.
This frame is concerned with Cognizers remembering and forgetting mental Content.
The Cognizeris the person whose mental Content is at issue.
The Content is the mental content that a Cognizer retains or forgets.
The Topic is the subject the Cognizer mental Content is about.
Depictive phrase describing the actor of an action.
An act whereby the Cognizer manages to remember or forget the Content.
The Result represents the consequences of the remembering or forgetting of the mental Content.
The Duration is the amount of time for which the mental Content is remembered or forgotten.
The Place is where the remembering or forgetting takes place.
The Reason for which the remembering or forgetting occurs.
The Time is when the remembering or forgetting of mental Content occurs.
An event (or period of time standing in for events) that the Cognizer has experienced that leads to the Cognizer remembering the Content.
The situation which surrounds a Cognizer remembering a Content or Topic.

In this frame, a Sentient_entity has some activity of the mind operating on a particular Content or about a particular Topic. The particular activity may be perceptual, emotional, or more generally cognitive. This non-lexical frame is intended primarily for inheritance.
The individual whose mind has a particular piece of Content in it, or, more generically portrayed, whose mind is focussed on a particular Topic.
The situation or state-of-affairs that the Sentient_entity's attention is focussed on.
The source of awareness or knowledge of the Content.
A description of the kind of Content in the Sentient_entity's attention in terms of an idea which is salient throughout the Content.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an event occurs.

Any description of the cognitive act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of a Sentient_entity that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
Expressor is the body part that reveals the Sentient_entity's state to the observer.
The category that an element of the Content is considered to belong to.
The system of knowledge which serves as the basis for the Sentient_entity's awareness.
The time interval during which the Sentient_entity has the Content in their attention.

The adjectives and nouns in this frame are all based on the idea that mental properties may be attributed to a person (Protagonist) by a (usually implicit) Judge on the basis of that person's Behavior, as broadly understood. Though on a conceptual level these words always attribute mental properties to people, they may be applied to Protagonist's Behaviors as well, with the understanding that the Behavior is revealing a (usually temporary) property of the Protagonist responsible for it. For example, while we may speak of a stupid person, we may also speak of a stupid thing to say/do/think. In addition, we may mention both the Protagonist and the Behavior, as in It was stupid of me to do that. Some of the words in this frame also have slightly different uses, in which there is a constituent expressing the Practice with respect to which the mental property holds of the Protagonist, as in: She is astute at math. While Practice expressions do not co-occur with Behavior expressions, they seem sufficiently different semantically to warrant a distinct frame element (FE) name. Also, while the FE Behavior usually occurs in sentences expressing judgments that are based on specific events, Practice occurs in sentences that are about general capabilities. In addition to the frame elements which are expressed, there is an understood judge (usually the speaker) in the background who forms the opinion of the Protagonist's mental properties, judging the Protagonist or the Protagonist's Behavior to be stupid, brilliant, etc.

This is the person (or people) to whom a mental property is attributed. The FE may be expressed as External Argument of a predicative use of the adjective, as a PP Complement, or as the head noun modified by an attributive use of the adjective:

The Behavior refers to any action, utterance, belief, or artifact thereof on the basis of which a mental property is attributed to the Protagonist. The meaning of the English word behavior should not be taken to constrain the identity of this frame element too much---conceptually, this frame element includes things that would not normally be described using the word behavior. Note the following examples:

Some of the words in this frame have a slightly different use in that they evaluate someone only with respect to their mental performance in some particular domain or capacity. We call this domain or capacity Practice. E.g., She is astute at math. Note that this does not mean she is considered to be astute in general for doing math. Rather, she is astute with respect to math, but may be dumb with respect to other things. These uses probably belong in a different frame with words such as skilled, but for the time being they are marked with the FE Practice. General Grammatical Observations: The adjectives in this frame may exhibit Extraposition of a to-marked infinitive VP, with an optional Protagonist expressed in an of-PP: It was brilliant (of you) to invite the clowns to the party.
Degree marks the extent to which the Behavior or Practice is exhibited or attributed.
Manner refers to the method or way in which the Mental_property is attributed to the Protagonist.
The domain in which the Behavior or Protagonist has a given mental property.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.

An Experiencer has an emotion as caused by a Stimulus or concerning a Topic. I fall asleep hours later to the sound of their engrossed murmuring. Most of these great lords are downright infatuated with Italy.
The Experiencer is the person or sentient entity that experiences or feels the emotions.
The Topic is the general area in which the emotion occurs. It indicates a range of possible Stimulus.
The Stimulus is the person, event, or state of affairs that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.
The extent to which the Experiencer's emotion deviates from the norm for the emotion.
The Empathy_target is the individual or individuals with which the Experiencer identifies emotionally and thus shares their emotional response.
The Reason is the explanation for why the Stimulus evokes a certain emotional response.

The Circumstances is the condition(s) under which the Stimulus evokes its response. In some cases it may appear without an explicit Stimulus. Quite often in such cases, the Stimulus can be inferred from the Circumstances
The State is the abstract noun that describes a more lasting experience by the Experiencer.
The Parameter is a domain in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus.

Any description of the way in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). Manner may also describe a state of the Experiencer that affects the details of the emotional experience.
The Time when the Experiencer is has a feeling about the Stimulus.
The body part, gesture, or other expression of the Experiencer that reflects his or her emotional state. They describe a presentation of the experience or emotion denoted by the adjective or noun.
The Duration is the amount of time for which the Experiencer is affected by theStimulus, Topic, or State.

A Stimulus serves to bring about an emotion of mental stimulation in an Experiencer. You will not easily find a more absorbing box-set of piano discs. New classes of free radical are particularly interesting to chemists.
The Experiencer is the person or sentient entity that experiences or feels the emotions.
The Stimulus is the person, event, or state of affairs that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.
The extent to which the Experiencer's emotion deviates from the norm for the emotion.
The Empathy_target is the individual or individuals with which the Experiencer identifies emotionally and thus shares their emotional response.
The Reason is the explanation for why the Stimulus evokes a certain emotional response.

The Circumstances is the condition(s) under which the Stimulus evokes its response. In some cases it may appear without an explicit Stimulus. Quite often in such cases, the Stimulus can be inferred from the Circumstances
The Parameter is a domain in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus.

Any description of the way in which the Experiencer experiences the Stimulus which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). Manner may also describe a state of the Experiencer that affects the details of the emotional experience.
The Time when the Experiencer can be described as having said emotion.
How often the Stimulus Stimulus affects the Experiencer.

A Communicator or Medium briefly references something in a Message, in which only a subpart of the full content is profiled. The General Secretary mentions some of them in his report. The Queen 's Speech also mentions the importance of making sure that Iraq complies with United Nations resolutions. When Barack Obama's name was mentioned, boos filled the room. CNI
The person who uses language in the written or spoken modality to convey a Message to another person.
The Addressee receives a Message from the Communicator.
A proposition or set of propositions that the Communicator wants the Addressee to believe or take for granted.
The physical or abstract setting in which the Message is conveyed.
The Depictive describes the state of the Communicator.
The Manner in which the Communicator communicates.
The Means by which the Communicator communicates.
When the the Message is mentioned.
Duration is the length of time during which the communication takes place.
The number of times the Message is mentioned by the Communicator.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
How often the Communicator mentions the Message.
The relevant entity or state-of-affairs that the Communicator mentions.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
The state of the world when the Communicator mentions the Message or Specified_content.

Some Possessor, either a nation, institution, or private individual, controls a Force whose primary functions to defend the Possessor (or, in the case of an institution or individual, some area of land significant to them) and to carry out offensive actions for the Possessor. The Domain of operation of the Force may be expressed.
The Force is the body of soldiers that acts in military capacity for the Possessor.
The Possessor is the nation, institution, or individual who possesses and/or controls the Force.
The consituent members of the Force.
The Domain in which the Force operates.
A (permanent or temporary) Goal of the Force.
The length of time that the particular military organization has existed.
A Miner attempts to obtain a desirable Resource, rocks and minerals, located in a Source, usually by digging in the ground.
The Miner searches for mineral Resources.
The Resource is usually buried in the ground, and is searched for by the Miner.
The area where the Miner searches for the Resource
A Wrongdoer engages in a Misdeed. You have sinned for the last time, Stephen!
This is the person whose Misdeed is being judged with respect to its morality.
The assessment of the Wrongdoer is based on his or her Misdeed.
The Severity is the degree to which the Misdeed offends the moral sense of the Judge.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.
The time at which a Misdeed is performed.
The location where a Misdeed occurs.
The state-of-affairs that the Wrongdoer is hoping to accomplish through their Misdeed.
An action taken by the Wrongdoer which accomplishes the Misdeed.

Any description of the Misdeed which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of a Wrongdoer that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An individual who is harmed by the Misdeed of the Wrongdoer.
How often the Wrongdoer commits the Misdeed.

Money is a medium used for exchanging goods and services. It is in most cases issued by a government (its Creator) in the form of coins and banknotes. Particular amounts of it may have a designated or planned Use, or may have come from some Origin. The money for our daughter's college education is currently earning interest in a savings account. The entire project ended up being funded with Swiss funds. The use of paper money really caught on in Europe in the 1700s
Money is used as a medium of exchange.
The use for which the Money is intended or designed.
The government (or possibly other organization) that mints, issues and guarantees the legal use of the Money.
The time at which an Money comes into existence or begins to be circulated.
The term used to refer to the Money.
An indication of the subtype of Money.
Any indication of what makes up the Money, including components, ingredients, etc.
The process or means by which the Money comes to be possessed.
The Possessor has control over the use the Money.
In this frame an Evaluee is described by a (usually implicit) Judge with respect to the morality or rightness of his or her Behavior.
This is the person whose Behavior is being judged with respect to its morality.
The assessment of the Evaluee is based on his or her Behavior.
The Degree to which the evaluation holds.
The Expressor is the body part or action by a body part which is the basis of the evaluation of morality.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.

Some entity (Theme) starts out in one place (Source) and ends up in some other place (Goal), having covered some space between the two (Path). Alternatively, the Area or Directionin which the Theme moves or the Distance of the movement may be mentioned. That kite you see just to the right of his head was moving around pretty fast but the camera seemed to catch it ok. There are several accounts of the stench drifting to shore from the ships in the middle of the river Dust particles floating about made him sneeze uncontrollably. The grill, unsecured, rolled a few feet across the yard. The swarm went away to the end of the hall. The frames that inherit the general Motion frame add some elaboration to this simple idea. Inheriting frames can add Goal-profiling (arrive, reach), Source-profiling (leave, depart), or Path-profiling (traverse, cross), or aspects of the manner of motion (run, jog) or assumptions about the shape-properties, etc., of any of the places involved (insert, extract). A particularly complex area in the vocabulary of Motion is the depiction of the relation of Vehicles to the Theme. In some cases, no separate Theme is expressed: The plane flew over the city. In this case, the sentence is annotated in Self_motion. When the Vehicle is profiled as being operated by a Driver, the sentence is annotated in the Operate_vehicles frame: Don't try to fly an F-16 without training! This is very similar to the Bringing frame which covers cases where the Vehicle is necessarily involved, but the movement of the Theme (something carried by the Vehicle) is profiled: It's scary flying hundreds of people over thousands of miles of ocean every day. Some of the same vocabulary is also used to describe the situation where Passengers Ride_vehicle or Operate_vehicle (each of these a perspective on Use_vehicles): I flew to Chicago on the red-eye. I flew my plane across the Canadian border Finally, there are cases where, despite the use of similar vocabulary, there is no self-propelled Vehicle involved at all: The ball flew over the fence. This last type is annotated in the simple Motion frame.
The Theme is the entity that changes location. Note that it is not necessarily a self-mover.
The Source is the location the Theme occupies initially before its change of location.
The Path refers to (a part of) the ground over which the Theme travels or to a landmark by which the Theme travels.
The Goal is the location the Theme ends up in.
Area identifies the setting in which the Theme's movement takes place without a specified Path.
Distance is any expression which characterizes the extent of the Motion.
This FE is used for the Speed at which the Theme moves.
The Carrier is the means of conveyance of the Theme.
This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Motion takes place.
This FE identifies the Time when the Motion occurs.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Motion takes place.
Result identifies the ultimate effect of the Motion.
This FE is used for any Depictive phrase describing the state of the Theme while the motion is occuring.
The Place is the general area in which a specific motion (with Source, Path, or Goal) occurs.
The extent to which the Theme cross a boundary as it moves away from a Source region or into a Goal region.

This FE is used for expressions that indicate motion along a line from the deitic center towards a reference point (which may be implicit) that is neither the Goal of the posture change nor a landmark along the way of the moving part of the body. Often Direction is defined with reference to the canonical orientation of the Protagonist, or the orientation imposed by an implicit observer.
In cases wherein the Theme is construed as a sentient entity, this FE denotes the state of affairs that the entity wishes to bring about by moving.
The shape of the overall Path travelled by the Theme.
An event that the described motion forms an integral part of.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.

In this frame a Theme moves in a certain Direction which is often determined by gravity or other natural, physical forces. The Theme is not necessarily a self-mover. The paper fell to the floor. The girl dropped 13 stories to her death.
This FE identifies the general Area in which motion takes place when the motion is understood to be irregular or not to consist of a single, linear path.
This FE identifies any Depictive phrase describing the the state of the Theme during the motion.
Distance identifies a phrase that characterizes the extent of motion of the Theme.
Duration is used for the length of time for which the Motion takes place.
The Goal is the location the Theme ends up in (often unintentionally).
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Motion takes place.
Path refers to (a part of) the ground over which the Theme travels or to a landmark past which the Theme travels.
This FE identifies the Speed at which the motion occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the Motion occurs.
The Carrier is the means of conveyance of the Theme.
The Theme is the entity that changes location.
The Source is the location the Themeoccupies before the Motion occurs.
This FE identifies the Result of the motion.
This FE identifies the Place where motion specified by Source, Path or Goal occurs.
The extent to which the Theme crosses boundary as it enters a Goal region or exits a Source region.
This FE is used for expressing some part of the Theme participant that makes contact with a horizontal surface.
The shape formed by the path followed by the Theme.
An event whereby the motion of the Theme comes about.
The direction of motion of the Theme. Direction characterizes the Path of motion according to some system of orientation, most often that imposed by gravity.
Any state of affairs or event from which the particular direction motion logically follows.
The state of affairs that the agentive Theme hopes to bring about by moving in a particular direction.
The state of the world as the action occurs.

This frame pertains to noise verbs used to characterize motion. Motion_noise verbs take largely the same Source, Path and Goal expressions as other types of Motion verbs. The reception doors banged open. Guillemots and razor bills whirred rapidly out to sea. The limousine purred forwards into the traffic. Loose guns rumbled all over the ship's deck . The train clanged along for over a thousand miles.
TheCause describes the reason for the motion.
The Theme is the entity that changes location. In sentences containing a Cause, the Theme is typically the NP Object. In other sentences, the Theme is normally the External Argument.
The Source is any expression which implies a definite starting-point of Motion.
The Path is any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal.
The Goal is any expression which tells where the Theme ends up as a result of the Motion.
This FE identifies the general Area in which motion takes place, used particularly if the motion is understood as following a complex or non-linear path.
The Distance is any expression which characterizes the extent of Motion. This frame element occurs very infrequently with Motion_noise verbs.
The Speed is the rate at which the motion occurs.
The Depictive indicates the state of the Theme during Motion.
The Manner is the way in which the Motion takes place.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Theme moves in the specified way.
The Result is the ultimate effect of the Motion.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the Motion occurs.
The Place describes the location of a more specific motion (which has Source, Path or Goal).
The period of time for which the Theme moves under accompaniment of noise.
TheTime when the motion event takes place.
This frame binds together the various parts of movement, from setting out, to traveling, to arriving.
The amount of time for the movement is ongoing.
This FE identifies the Time when the motion occurs.
The Area is the setting in which the Theme's movement takes place.
The Cotheme is the second moving object, expressed as a direct object or an oblique.
The Distanceis any expression which characterizes the extent of motion.
The Goal is the location the Theme ends up in.
The Path refers to (a part of the) ground that the Theme travels over or to a landmark the Theme travels past.
The Source is the location the Theme initially occupies before its change of location.
The Speed is the rate at which motion occurs.
The Theme is the entity that changes location.

The Mode_of_transportation expresses how the motion of the Theme is effected, by its body or by a vehicle which holds and conveys the Theme. Vehicles can move in any way and in any medium. They are usually expressed obliquely with 'in' or 'by'.
A Theme moves with respect to a Fixed_location, generally with a certain Periodicity, without undergoing unbounded translational motion or significant alteration of configuration/shape.
A physical entity that is participating in non-translational motion.
The point or set of points that define the limits of motion for the Theme. For spinning motions, it is the axis, for vibrating it is a boundary, for swinging it is a point.
The number of times the Theme returns to a state in a given duration.
The amount of rotation that the Theme undergoes.
The time at which the Theme is in bounded motion.
The location where the bounded motion happens.
The direction of rotation of the Theme.
TheManner describes the way in which the Theme moves in place.
The Result describes the end state brought about by the motion in place.
The Cause_external describes the force which sets into motion the motion.
A description of the Theme during the action.
The state of affairs that the agentive Theme hopes to bring about by moving.
The shape formed by the path that the Theme follows.

This frame contains words that talk about how Speakers name Entities. They drove through an area nicknamed Sniper's Alley His parents named him Winston after the British prime minister. In this frame we will ignore uses of words like baptize and christen that don't clearly bring out the name conferral but talk about the meaning of baptism etc. as a sacrament: They christened the child on December 4th. Method was baptized into the church soon thereafter. Cyril was baptized as a Methodist.
The entity that Speakers refer to by using the Name.
The linguistic expression by which Speakers refer to the Entity.
The person who uses the linguistic expression (Name) to refer to the Referent.
The instrument with which an intentional act is performed.
The Reason for which an intentional act is performed. We did it for the hell of it.
The purpose for which an intentional act is performed. John flattered her to receive a raise.
This frame element is the person or thing whose name was chosen by the Speaker to give to the Entity. They named their daughter Carol after Paul's grandmother.
An action the Speaker takes in order to accomplish the name conferral.

An Entity shares a name with its Namesake. Note that the shared name is not a frame element as it cannot be directly expressed as an argument of the target lexical units in this frame. Alberta's namesake caught in royal scandal namesake caught in royal scandal Instead, the eponymous character is a mildly retarded woman, Martha (Winger), whose simplistic view on life places her in ethically compromising positions. DNI He is my namesake, one amongst the many described in my homepage, and is much better qualified to write a page like this.
The Entity about whom it is asserted that they share a name with a Namesake.
The person or thing that has the same name as the Entity.
A domain, often a place or time, in which the Namesake of the Entity is located.
Any temporary or permanent property of the Namesake.
The Locale is a geographical location as defined by shape. This frame includes natural geographic features, including land/ice forms and bodies of water. We climbed up the rock cliff.
The location that the Locale is a part of.
Indicates the action (or causer) which brings the features of the Locale about.
A stable bounded area. It is typically the designation of the nouns of Locale-derived frames.
This FE is used for the Names of Locales.
A place that a Locale is located with respect to.
The Type is the subtype of natural feature.
Any description, characteristic, or property of the Locale which is not covered by more specific FEs.

The speaker believes that some state of affairs or entity (the Requirement) must be present in order to cause some other dependent state of affairs to occur (the Dependent). In the typical case, the Cognizer desires the occurrence of the Dependent and so also desires the obtainment or occurrence of the Requirement. I need one more bolt. DNI I need one more nail to finish building the cabinet. In order to complete the treaty, the United States will require several more diplomats. He needs everyone to leave his office to finish his work.
The Cognizer requires or believes he/she requires the Requirement to hold so that the Dependent will occur.
The entity or state-of-affairs that must be present or obtain in order for the Dependent to obtain.
The state-of-affairs which cannot hold without the Requirement.
Some specification of the conditions under which the Requirement is likely to be needed.
The extent to which the Dependent depends on the presence of the Requirement.
The Time at which the Cognizer requires the Requirement.
The location of the Cognizer when he/she requires the Requirement.
An undesirable state-of-affairs that results if the Requirement is not met.
This frame element is defined as the number of times the Cognizer has a need per some unit of time.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
The reason why the Cognizer needs the Requirement.

A set of entities of the same or similar types (Nodes) are linked to each other by Connections to form a Network allowing for the flow of information, resources, etc. For the most part, the Interstate System is a connected network of highways bounded by the Canadian and Mexican borders, the Gulf of Mexico, and the Atlantic. Through our worldwide network of representatives and agents, Lozenger Inc. was able to serve customers in countries around the globe.
The system functioning as a unit that is constituted by the Nodes and Connections.
The entities that are connected into a Network.
The relationships or physical entities that connect the Nodes.
Any characterization or evaluation of the Network.
A person or organization that possesses or owns the Network or a larger entity of which the Network itself is a part.

The Noise_maker is an artifact used to produce sound, especially for musical effect. The church bells rang The car alarm went off again I have never played an acoustic guitar. Each artist personally owns a Steinway and has chosen to perform on the Steinway piano professionally
This FE identifies the entity or substance that is designed to produce sound.
The use for which an Noise_maker is intended.
An individual or individuals that bring the Noise_maker into existence.
The time at which a Noise_maker comes into existence.
The term used to refer to an Noise_maker.
An indication of the subtype of Noise_maker.
Any indication of what makes up the Noise_maker, including components, etc.
The location with which the Noise_maker is associated.

LUs in this frame describe a non-commutative process (as opposed to a generic statement) of arithmetic, e.g. subtraction and division, involving two numbers, labeled Term_1 and Term_2. Because of the non-commutative nature of these processes, Term_1 and Term_2 are not separated on a grammatical basis but rather on a mathematical basis (see FE definitions). When referencing the process, the numbers can be vague and are often omitted through indefinite null instantiation.
Term_1 is the first operand in the non-commutative arithmetic that is modified by Term_2 (e.g. subtracted by or divided by Term_2).
Term_2 is the second operand of the non-commutative arithmetic which modifies Term_1 (e.g. subtracts from or divides Term_1).
The Calculator is the agentive entity that combines Term_1 and Term_2.

LUs in this frame describe a non-commutative statement of arithmetic, e.g. subtraction and division, involving two numbers, labeled Term_1 and Term_2. This frame contrasts with Arithmetic_non-commutative_process in that the statement frame emphasizes the relationship between the terms in combining to form some Result. Because of the non-commutative nature of these processes, Term_1 and Term_2 are not separated on a grammatical basis but rather on a mathematical basis (see FE definitions). When referencing the process, the numbers can be vague and are often omitted through indefinite null instantiation.
Term_1 is the first operand in the non-commutative arithmetic that is modified by Term_2 (e.g. subtracted by or divided by Term_2).
Term_2 is the second operand of the non-commutative arithmetic which modifies Term_1 (e.g. subtracts from or divides Term_1).
The Result of the non-commutative process combining Term_1 and Term_2.
The judge or other court officer (the Authority) informs the Accused of the Charges against him/her, i.e. the alleged actions and the relevant laws.
The judge or other authority of the court in which the accused person is arraigned.
The person being charged with an offense against the law.
The crime with which the Accused is charged
The larger event which contains the Notification of Charges event.

An Initial_element is converted into a Final_element via a process of decay, fusion, or fission which changes the number or type of hadrons (protons or neutrons) in the nucleus of the atoms that make up the Element. 5.5 percent of nucleii decay from tritium to He3 in a year .
A substance definable in terms of the kind(s) of atoms that make it up.
The type of Element that results from the process.
The type of Element that begins the process.
The time at which the Elementundergoes the transformation.
Any description of the Change event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
The extent to which the Element's substance is converted to the Final_element.
The physical or abstract Circumstances under which the change takes place.
An event or state that causes the change to take place.
The number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.
The location where the nuclear process occurs.

An Influencing_variable, an Influencing_situation, or an Influencing_entity has an influence on a Dependent_entity, Dependent_variable, or a Dependent_situation. More and more doctors realise that diet can influence disease. Our subject is the body clock; how it influences our physiology and behaviour and how it interacts with the rhythms in our environment. But it is more likely that a physical restraint influenced the swirling liquids. It claimed, perhaps hollowly, that NT had yet to impact its business. This kind of elementary boo-boo would certainly impact video speed.
A thing or person whose behavior has an effect on an Dependent_situation, Dependent_variable, or Dependent_entity.
An entity, usually a thing, that is influenced in its behavior by an Influencing_entity or an Influencing_situation.
A scalar variable (with unspecified value) which has an effect on the Dependent_entity, Dependent_variable, or Dependent_situation.
A situation that whose temporal or other characteristics are influenced by an Influencing_entity, Influencing_event, or Influencing_variable.
A scalar variable, whose value depends on the behavior of an Influencing_entity, a Influencing_variable, or an Influencing_situation.
The Degree to which the Influencing_entity effects the Dependent_entity.
The time at which the influence occurs.
The location at which the influencing occurs.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Influencing_entity that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

Under some, usually implicit, Condition a Duty needs to be fulfilled by a Responsible_party. If the Duty is not performed, there may be some undesirable social Consequence for the Responsible_party. This Consequence may or may not be stated overtly.
The person who must perform the Duty.
The action that the Responsible_party is obligated to perform.
This FE indicates the Conditions under which the Responsible_party is obligated to perform the Duty.
The undesirable Consequence that will result if the Duty is not performed.
The time interval during which the Responsible_party is obligated to fulfill the Duty.
A location in which the Responsible_party has a specified Duty .
The deviation of the requirement from the norm.
The desirable situation which can be brought about by fulfilling the Duty.

An Entity is obscure, unnotable, and in general little-known. In the case of an eventive Entity, lack of fame entails a large number of people not being aware of the event's occurence; in the case of a concrete Entity, including humans, lack of fame entails non-awareness of existence. Geoffrey Rush was little known outside his native Australia when he soared to international prominence.
The Entity which is not widely known and rather obscure.
A modifier expressing the degree of fame of the Entity.
The Time during which the Entity is not well known.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity is considered not to be famous.
A state of affairs that provides an explanation (via reasoning, causation, etc.) for the level of fame of the Entity.
The reason that the Entity is not famous.
The length of time during which the Entity is not famous.
The location where the Entity is not famous.

This frame covers words for Body_part(s) (BP) belonging to a Possessor (Poss), which may be characterized by a Descriptor (Desc). The location of the BP may be identified in terms of its Attachment or its Orientational_Location. A Subregion of a BP may also be indicated. The constructions in which body part words occur include the following:
This Frame Element denotes the Possessor of the Body_part.

This Frame Element is used for a characteristic or description of the Body_part. Note that Descriptor is not an FE of the same character as other FEs. Specifically, rather than filling a slot, it identifies a modifier of its head noun.
This Frame Element is the Body_part.
This FEidentifies the Subregion of the Body_part referred to by the target.
This Frame Element describes the location of the Body_part with respect to the inherent orientation of the body (or the larger body part) the Body_part is attached to.
The Attachment is the larger body part to which the BP is attached.

A Phenomenon is portrayed with respect to the Degree of likelihood that it will be perceived and known, given the (usually implicit) Evidence, Perceiver, and the Circumstances in which it is considered. For several of the LUs, such as visible, audible, etc., the type of the Evidence is fixed by the targets themselves being a perceptual experience. It's abundantly obvious that we'll need to spend more time on public perception. Are you certain that the shovel was visible from the door of the apartment? I think they miss some of the important impacts of the work that are not visible just from looking at the vote tally. That the defense will declare a mistrial regardless is quite evident from their consistent obstructionist tactics. In late July 2000 it was barely visible to the unaided eye.
The entity or facts that are undeniable given the Evidence.
The gradable aspect of a Phenomenon which concerns how likely it is that the Phenomenon be known. This frame element is incorporated by the lexical units in this frame.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Phenomenon from the norm or from the value for another Phenomenon in terms of how likely the Phenomenon would be known.
The Time during which the Phenomenon is obvious
Some specification of the conditions under which the Phenomenon is likely to be known.
The sentient entity for whom perception or cognition of the Phenomenon is judged to be more or less likely.

A state-of-affairs that has a bearing on whether the Phenomenon will be perceived or apprehended cognitively. Evidence is often metonymically indicated by the mention of an entity whose existence or whose properties are relevant.
The likelihood of a Phenomenon to be observed perceptually or cognitively in a particular Group of comparable background items may be contrasted, implicitly or explicitly, with different groups.
The physical location of a Perceiver of the Phenomenon or a metaphorical point-of-view location of a cognizer relative to the Phenomenon.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.

This frame element is used for all path-like expressions, except those indicating the location of the perceiver (see above), that describe how the perceiver's attention is directed during the act of perception.
This frame is about Items in the state of occupying a certain Rank within a hierarchy. He ranks second in his class in mathematics.
The Rank which the Item occupies.
The Item which occupies the Rank in the hierarchy.
The dimension along which the ranking is defined.
The time at which/period over which the Item occupies the Rank
The Comparison_set is the set of entities ranked in a hierarchy. The Item is a member of the set.
Words in this frame describe acts in violation of a legal code.
This FE broadly picks out the degree of offense.
The Specification is an additional aspect of the main crime being commited.
This FE denotes the person or entity that is badly affected by the Offense.
This FE denotes the Punishment that is specified by the statute in which the offense is defined.
The individual who commits the Offense

An Offerer indicates that he or she is able and willing to give a Theme to a Potential_recipient. In the absence of further qualifications, it is often understood that the Potential_recipient accepts the Theme. The host graciously offered us food and drink.
The person that begins in possession of the Themeand offers it to the Potential_recipient.
The entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
The object which is offered for transfer.
The Place where the Offerer offers the Theme to the Potential_recipient.
The Reason for which the Offerer offers the Theme to the Potential_recipient.
The Time is when the Offerer offers the Theme to the Potential_recipient.
The Purpose for which the Offerer offers the Theme to the Potential_recipient.
The Means by which the Offerer offers the Theme to the Potential_recipient.
The Manner is the manner in which the Offerer offers the Theme to the Potential_recipient.
The Circumstances are the conditions under which the Theme is offered.
The Potential_recipient's intended purpose for the Theme.
A description of the Offerer, Potential_recipient, or Theme given independently of the giving event per se.
The length of time from when the offer began to be repeated to when it stopped.

One phenomenon, Phenomenon_1 is an indication of the current or future existence of another phenomenon, Phenomenon_2. There is no Cognizer present on the scene, in distinction to the Expectation frame where a Cognizer takes (the equivalent of) Phenomenon_1 as evidence for (the equivalent of) Phenomenon_2. Many words in this frame also allow a slightly different understanding, whereby Phenomenon_1 provides clues as to the good or bad Outcome of an expected Phenomenon_2. Instead of Phenomenon_2 an Interested_party that will be involved in the event or state that is Phenomenon_2 may be mentioned. In both construals, the two phenomena are asymmetrical and consequently they have no joint syntactic realization. Such potential augurs well for the 1990s Its appearance was an ill omen. Cold-blooded words do not necessarily betoken a callous nature. I wish I could say my success bodes well for him.
Phenomenon_1 provides evidence for the existence or the nature of the Outcome of Phenomenon_2.
Phenomenon_2 is that phenomenon whose existence or quality is at issue.
The FE Outcome identifies those expressions that indicate how Phenomenon_2 is expected to turn out based on the evidence of Phenomenon_1.
Interested_party marks expressions that indicate people who are interested in the Outcome of Phenomenon_2.
The degree to which the Phenomenon_1 predicts the occurrence of Phenomenon_2.
The Time at which the omen is occuring.
The reason for which Phenomenon_1 is an omen for Phenomenon_2 or the Outcome.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
A Useful_location is accessible to some (possibly generic) Theme despite a potential Barrier, or is not accessible because of the Barrier.
The Theme whose motion is blocked or free.
The place or thing that the Theme is headed towards, despite a potential or actual Barrier.
An entity that (at least potentially) prevents the Theme from getting to the Useful_location.
The extent to which a Theme can easily access the Useful_location

The words in this frame describe motion involving a Vehicle and someone who controls it, the Driver. Some words normally allow the Vehicle to be expressed as a separate constituent. Tim drove his car all the way across North America. Tom paddled my canoe across the Canadian border. Other words in this domain are based on the names of vehicles, and do not normally allow the Vehicle to be expressed as a separate constituent. The group biked all the way across the country. However, a separate Vehicle constituent can occur if it adds information not included in the verb. Tim biked across the country on an old 10-speed.
This is the being, typically human, that controls the Vehicle as it moves.
This is the means of conveyance controlled by the Driver. It may move in any way or medium. With verbs, Vehicle is usually expressed as Object:

Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion expresses the frame element Source. In prepositional phrases, the prepositional object expresses the starting point of motion. With particles, the starting point of motion is understood from context.
Any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal expresses the frame element Path. This includes directional expressions and "middle of path'' expressions, e.g.:

Any expression which tells where the moving object(s) ends up as a result of the motion expresses the frame element Goal. Some particles imply the existence of a Goal which is understood in the context of utterance.

Any expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion expresses the frame element Manner. Descriptions of steadiness, grace, and other things count as Manner expressions.
Any expression which characterizes the extent of motion expresses the frame element Distance.

This frame element is used for expressions which describe a general area in which motion takes place when the motion is understood to be irregular and not to consist of a single linear path. Locative setting adjuncts of motion expressions may also be assigned this frame element.
The state of the Driver or Vehicle during the Transportation.
An event that the Driver is also participating in while directing the Vehicle.
The action performed by the Driver by which the Driver achieves directed Transportation.
This is a second moving object, expressed as a PP headed by with.
The Speed is the rate at which the Vehicle moves.
The Route is the road or path that the Vehicle regularly travels on.
This FE indicates the Circumstances under which the operation of the Vehicle takes place.
The Place describes the location of a more specific motion (which has Source, Path or Goal).
The length of the time interval during which the Driver operates the Vehicle.
The Time when the Driver operates the Vehicle
The extent to which the Vehicle crosses a boundary or the extent to which the Vehicle completes a course.
The state-of-affairs that the Driver tries to bring about by the way that they direct the Vehicle.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
The reason for which the Operate_vehicle event occurs.

An Operator manipulates the substructure of a System such that the System performs the function it was created for. This frame differs from the Using frame in that this frame does not profile the purpose of an agent but rather their manipulation of an entity (System/Instrument). In the case of using, the Agent need not manipulate the Instrument at all, as in: Mrs. Adams used the room as a place to hang the family laundry to dry. This true story of domestic bliss was related to me by a friend of mine who for a time operated a bar in San Francisco. A California man has plead guilty to federal charges that he ran a pyramid scam which defrauded nearly 7000 investors.
The entity that the Operator gets to perform its intended function.
The invididual who manipulates the substructure of the System.
This FE identifies the place where the Operator runs the System.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Operator runs the System.
This FE identifies the time when the Operator runs the System.
This FE identifies the Means by which an Operator runs the System.

Any description of the running of the System which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Operator that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
Duration denotes the length of the time interval in which the Operator runs the System.

A Tester uses a concrete or conceptual Product in order to determine either whether it works or to find out how well or in which manner it works. The Tester may have particular Unwanted_characteristics in mind that they are specifically looking for. The operational test may also be carried out under a particular set of Circumstances that are typically relevant to the functioning of the Product. Sun has (hopefully) already tested it for compliance. The Velcro hook and loop closure system has been tested under wet conditions and retains its holding power after 10,000 open and close functions. CNI INI Roe revisited the compound and tested it as a mosquito repellent.
The person who uses the Product to see if it is intact or to ascertain its characteristics during operation.
The entity that the Tester uses to ascertain whether it is intact.
An entity or property whose presence would impair the acceptability or usefulness of the Product.
This FE is used for a Means action which the Tester carries out in testing the Product.
An action that the Tester intends to accomplish subjecting the Product to a test of its functioning.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Tester uses the Product in order to evaluate its functioning.
This FE identifies the extent to which the Tester examines the Product.
This FE is the position of the Tester during the act of testing. Typically, it is expressed in a from-PP.
The desirable state of affairs which the Tester hopes to find to obtain when using the Product.
The Time when the Tester uses the Product to evaluate its functioning.
The FE Circumstances is used for circumstances that obtain during the test procedure. These are typically relevant to how the Product functions.
The length of the time period during which the Tester continuously or repeatedly operates the Product to determine its operational characteristics.
The location in which the test is carried out.
A use to which the Product is put .
A variable of behavior of the Product which is specifically evaluated.
The length of time from when the testing event began to be repeated to when it stopped.

A Cognizer holds a particular Opinion, which may be portrayed as being about a particular Topic. John thinks that it looks better back . Well, my opinion about that is none of your business. What 's your take on the recent oil crisis ? Your view of Smithers as an excellent secretary is not shared by the rest of the UN.
The Cognizer is the person whose Opinion is in question.
The Cognizer's way of thinking, which is not necessarily generally accepted, and which is generally dependent on the Cognizer's point of view.
The events or states-of-affairs that form the basis for the Cognizer's Opinion.
A phenomenon that the Cognizer is considering with respect to their Opinion. Note that this extra-thematic frame element occurs freely with nouns, but only in very restricted contexts with verbs.
The level of firmness with which the Cognizer holds an opinion. It refers to the amount of convincing that they would need to change their mind.

Any description of how the Cognizer holds an opinion which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quiet(ly)), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of a Cognizer that also affect their thinking (presumptuous(ly), cold(ly)).
Role describes the presuppositional terms of the Opinion by placing the Topic or the Cognizer of the Opinion into a category.
The aspects of the Opinion (and its Topic, if any) which are under consideration.
The Time at which the Cognizer has the Opinion.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

An Agent has a choice of whether or not to participate in some Desirable_event because of an Opportunity, a situation not completely under the Agent's control and usually of a limited duration. It would be pleasant in the opportune absence of the clergyman to have a dance . DNI Her opportunities to apply to a good school are then limited . Now was their big chance ! DNI
The situation during which the Desirable_situation is possible.
The sentient agent that may or may not participate in the Desirable_situation.
A situation or event that the Agent can participating in during the period of the Opportunity.

This frame describes non-artifact Images resulting from an interation between light and some kind of matter, usually a Source entity. I could see John's silhouette in the corner as I entered the dimly lit room.
The optical representation of the Source.
The entity from which the Image's form is based on.

An Item is picked out either by the order in which the members of a set would be encountered by an implicit cognizer, or by the order in which the members of a set participate in an event or state which serves as the Basis_of_order. The former case usually involves a Starting_point for going through the set, while the latter involves a Basis_of_order, which is normally an event that the Item along with other members of its Comparison_set has participated in. Note that Item should be annotated on a second layer, except in cases when the noun structure the ordinal participates in is predicative. The first car from the left is a Magosix. The first car from the left is a Magosix. Barney was only the second Asian student at my college. Felix was the first of my cats to realize that human food was tastier. Felix was the first of my cats to realize that human food was tastier.
The kind of entity that the Item belongs to.
A usually spatial reference point from which the implicit cognizer scans across the members of the Comparison_set.
A kind of event in which the members of the Comparison_set, including the Item, participate in a certain order.
The entity picked out by the implicit cognizer as occupying a certain place in the ordered Comparison_set.
A set of entites of which the Item is a member and which are ordered either by the Basis_of_order or by the order in which the implicit cognizer focuses attention on them.

This frame describes intentionally formed human social groups (here termed Organizations) with some definite structure and Members. They may be relatively informal, consisting only of a group of individuals who are aware of who is and who is not a fellow member, or they may be complex and long-lasting, such as the Roman Catholic Church or the Conservative Party.
The entity of which the individuals are Members.
A person belonging to an Organization.
The reason for which an Organization is formed.
The interval during which the Organization exists.
A name given to the Organization for identification.
The location or political locale that the Organization is contained within.
This FE describes the general location where the Organization operates, but does not indicate the possessor of the Organization.
Any description of the Organization not covered by a more specific frame element.
An Entity began its existence in the context of a Origin, which can be a place, culture, text etc. The Christian origin of this quote is from Isaiah 22. Dinosaurs originated from Antarctica?
The item whose Origin is under discussion.
The place or culture where the Entity was produced.

An Experiencer feels an emotion as evoked as an Other. One might pity the frail old man in East Berlin. She appealed for compassion for sufferers. I feel for women who also long to have children but can't.
The Experiencer is the person or sentient entity that experiences or feels the emotions.
The Other is the person that evokes the emotional response in the Experiencer.
The extent to which the Experiencer's emotion deviates from the norm for the emotion.
The Reason is the explanation for why the Other evokes a certain emotional response.
The Circumstances is the condition(s) under which the Other evokes its response.
The Parameter is a domain in which the Experiencer experiences the feelings of the Other.

Any description of the way in which the Experiencer experiences the feelings of the Other which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). Manner may also describe a state of the Experiencer that affects the details of the emotional experience.
The Time when the Experiencer feels for the Other.
The Situation is the circumstances or topic about which the Experiencer feels an emotion.
How often the Other gets sympathy from the Experiencer.
An Entity has ceased to exist. Theses termites are history. Hillary is toast after Texas and Ohio. They are gone because you killed them all.
Concrete or abstract entity that does not exist after the event.
This is the Place where the Entity (saliently) does not exist.
A point at which the Entity (saliently) does not exist.
This FE labels the Cause of the destruction or disappearance of the Entity.
This FE identifies the length of time before the Entity comes into existence again.
The aspect of the Entity which no longer exists.
The way in which the Entity disappears.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

An Authority excuses an Offense that an Offender has committed, with the effect of ending or preventing any punishment. President Ford pardoned her after it came to light she was being held in Japan as an "enemy alien" and was secretly working to subvert the broadcasts DNI President John Quincy Adams granted them a pardon and remission of the fine. DNI
This FE denotes the offender that seeks or gets the pardon.
Authority is the organization or person taht grants the pardon.
This FE denotes the the illegal act that the Offender is pardoned for.
Reason is the cause for pardoning an Offender.
This FE denotes the time when the pardon is given
An intentional action performed by the Authority that accomplishes the pardon.

Any description of the act of pardon which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of an Authority that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The location at which the pardoning takes place.
An action that the Authority intends to accomplish by pardoning

This describes a part_whole relationship where the Part provides the boundary between the Whole and what is not that object. The Part can exist along a continuum of width. It can be modified by an Orientation that specifies the particular portion of the edge of a Part_prop which describes a property of the Part. We came to the southern edge of the town .
This is a property of the Part that determines the portion of the Part.
An undivided entity having all its Parts.
A property relating to the Part of a Whole.
Part is that which forms a boundary between the Whole and what is not the object.

This frame concerns Parts of objects that are defined relative to the center or edge of the object. The Part is a part of the Whole and the Part_Prop describes a property of the Part. She discarded the exterior of the walnut. She preferred a sparse church interior . . In cases where the Target is an adjective, it has a special relationship with the noun that it modifies such that a phrase which is a syntactic argument of the noun is semantically available to fill the argument structure of the adjective, as in "the outside row of the class"The inner shelf of the bookcase was lying on the floor.
This element describes the Part of the larger Whole.
An undivided entity having all its Parts.
A property relating to the Part of a Whole.

In this frame a Part is part of a larger Whole comprised of parts that are ordered. The Part can be modified by the Part_prop or the number of the part can be given by Ordinality. I sat through the first interminable act of the play . Tess finished a dissertation chapter .
This is the number of the sequence of Parts.
A property relating to the Part of a Whole.
A part of a larger Whole.
An undivided entity having all its Parts.

In this frame, there is a Part of a Whole in which the Part is defined with respect to the canonical or inherent orientation of the Whole. In cases where the Target is an adjective, it has a special relationship with the noun that it modifies such that a phrase which is a syntactic argument of the noun is semantically available to fill the argument structure of the adjective, as in the front row of the class The top shelf of the bookcase was lying on the floor. The bottom was missing. My left hand was numb. He rested on the clifftop
A piece of a larger Whole.
A property relating to the Part of a Whole.
