An undivided entity having all its Parts.
This frame is concerned with transparent nouns denoting a Piece of a Substance. Also present is Piece_prop which is a property of the Piece, e.g. relating to its size. Kim ate a tiny morsel of cake .
A Piece made of a substance.
A property relating to the Piece.
The Substance is what the Piece is made of and may describe the type of larger whole from which it came.

This frame is concerned with nouns denoting a part or parts of a Whole entity . The Part is not defined relative to the Whole's orientation, center, or edge and is not ordered. We also annotate properties of the Part, e.g. relating to its size. Kim forgot a large part of the story. Abby ate only the top half of the cake.
A Part of a larger Whole.
An undivided entity having all its Parts.
A property relating to the Part of a Whole.
This is a property of the Part that determines the portion of the Part.

This frame has to do with the bias or lack of bias of a Judge making an assessment concerning two or more Sides. The Sides may stand opposed to each other in a dispute or be alternatives in a situation of choice. The Domain in which the Judge is partial or impartial may be expressed as well as the Degree of bias or lack thereof. In sentences in this frame one may also find expressions of Manifestation_of_bias, i.e. expressions that tell us how the Judge's bias is realized.
This Frame Element marks the person whose objectivity in making assesment is being evaluated.
This Frame Element marks one of the Sides in a dispute or one of the alternatives in a situation of choice.
This Frame Element marks phrases jointly expressing both Sides in a dispute or all of the alternatives in a situation of choice.
The second-mentioned of the Sides to a dispute or alternatives in a situation of choice.
This Frame Element marks expressions of a Domain or parameter with respect to which the Judge exhibits bias or lack thereof.
This Frame Element marks expressions that tell to what extent the Judge exhibited or lacked bias.
This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate how the bias of the Judge expresses itself in their behavior or actions.
The Dispute is the situation in which there is some conflict between two sides.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.
This FE denotes the time when the partiality occurs.
The Expressor is the body part or action by a body part which indicates the character of the Decision_maker.
The Manner is the way in which the Decision_maker embodies the bias associated with him or her.

An Event with multiple Participants takes place. It can be presented either symmetrically with Participants or asymmetrically, giving Participant_1 greater prominence over Participant_2. If the Event is engaged in intentionally, then there is typically a shared Purpose between the Participants. It is, however, possible that an expressed Purpose only applies to Participant_1. MATAC looks forward to your participation in helping promote telework in the Mid-Atlantic region. FOAP provides participants with comprehensive clerical skills. DNI FOAP provides participants with comprehensive clerical skills. Our eight-year-old son was recently peripherally involved in an incident which resulted in him being threatened with the strap. A New York press agent must scramble when his major client becomes embroiled in a huge scandal. In his time as a first-team all-league player, Rife was in on 86 solo tackles.
The individuals or entities that have been participants in an Event.
Participant_1 is the grammatically more prominent participant in an Event with multiple Participants.
A grammatically less prominent participant of an Event with multiple Participants.
An Event with multiple Participants, who may or may not be involved intentionally.
The Time when the multiple-participant Event occurs.
The location where the Event involving multiple Participants occurs.

Any description of the Event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). When the Participants are understood agentively frames, it may indicate salient characteristics of them that also affect the action (deliberately, eagerly).
An action that the Participants or Participant_1 intend to accomplish by performing the action indicated by the Event.
An intentional action performed by Participant_1 or the Participants that contributes to bringing off the Event.
The extent to which Participant_1 contributes to the Event's coming off.
A group, location, or institution conventionally associated with an Event.
This FE describes the length of time for which participation occurs (usually appears as a for-PP)

A Subset is profiled against the Group it belongs to. The Subset may consist of a single member. Frequently, the Group is actually a generic sample of a full population, and the Subset is representative of the relative proportion. Of all scenes that evoke rural England, this is one of the loveliest. As of 5:30 p.m. Moscow time, 23 out of 46 miners stranded in the Zapadnaya-Kapitalnaya mine have been rescued 1.5 out of 10 respondents preferred Shrub over Ferry
A Subset belonging to the Group.
The Group of entities which includes the Subset.

An Agent physically transfers a Theme to a Recipient. The Agent is not under control of the Theme's motion after the initial input of energy. Compare with Bringing and Sending. In the former, the Carrier is in constant control (even physical contact) with the Theme. In the latter, the Sender plans the motion of the Theme and places it in circumstances such that it travels along the specified path (or to the specified goal), but under the power of a separate individual.
The Agent is the one who passes the Theme. The Agent is generally realized as the External Argument.
The FE Theme is generally an NP Object that is passed to the Recipient.
The FE Source is the starting point of the passing action
The FE Path is any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor Goal.
The FE Recipient is the entity which possesses the Theme as a result of the passing.
The FE Distance is any expression characterizing the extent of motion of the Theme.

The FE Area is used for expressions which describe a general area in which passing takes place when the passing is understood to be irregular or not to consist of a single, linear path. Locative setting adjuncts may also be assigned this frame element.
The state of a participant during the passing action.
The FE Means indicates the action that is taken that results in the motion of the Theme

The FE Manner is any expression which describes a property of the motion of the Theme which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion. Descriptions of steadiness, grace, and other things count as Manner expressions.
An entity saliently involved in the transmission of force from an Agent to a Theme. It may be the Agent's bodypart, or some kind of device.
The Place is the general area that provides a setting for a specific motion (with Source, Path, or Goal).
The time at which the passing of the Theme occurs.
A resultant state that the Theme is in at the end of its motion.
A previous state that the Theme was in before the beginning of its motion.
This FE denotes a proposition from which the main clause logically follows.

An Agent acts in such a way as to cause others to think that an Item is an instance of a particular kind of Simulated_entity. He had, under the name of Armitage, passed her off as a member of one of the most distinguished families of the capital. He undoubtedly believes you are the impostor who palmed himself off at Bar Harbor as the Baron von Kissel. Knowing his likeness to the family of Lord Polperro she palmed him off on them as a distant relative.
The Agent is the person who acts in a misleading way to create the impression that the Item is a particular (kind of) Simulated_entity.

Any description of the passing off event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way) and salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (deliberately, eagerly).
An intentional action performed by the Agent that contributes to the Item being perceived as a (particular kind of) Simulated_entity.
The Item is the concrete or abstract entity that the Agent misleadingly represents as a particular (kind of) Entity.
An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by passing the Item off as a (particular kind of) Simulated_entity.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the passing-off event logically follows.
The Simulated_entity is a particular individual or a token of a particular type that the Item is represented as.
The Place is the location that is the setting for the passing off event.
The Audience denotes the people that the Agent intends to mislead into thinking that the Item is a particular (kind of) Simulated_entity.
The time at which the Agent gives the impression that the Item is the Simulated_entity.

The words in this frame describe the "fictive" motion of a stationary Road. Some of the targets cast the scene primarily in terms of the Path_shape: The long mountain road meandered through the woods. Some of the words in this frame imply a Source or Goal which is expressed by a direct object: The path entered the garden on the west side. Other members of the frame refer to a Direction: Then the path bears a little to the right. Yet others indicate a Path which requires mention of a landmark: The otherwise arrow-straight highway veers north and skirts the lake.

Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of the Road. In prepositional phrases, the prepositional object expresses the starting point of motion. In particles, the starting point of motion is understood from context.
The trajectory that would be followed by one moving on the Road.
Any expression which tells where the fictive mover travelling along a Road would end up.
A physical path that a virtual moving entity can be imagined to travel along. The bike trail zigzagged through the woods.

Any expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion expresses the frame element Manner. Descriptions of the kind of motion a hypothetical mover would have (including steadiness, grace, and general comparisons) count as Manner expressions.
Any expression which characterizes the extent of motion expresses the frame element Distance.
This frame element is used for expressions which describe a general area in which motion takes place when the motion is understood to be irregular and not to consist of a single linear path.
Extent to which the described configuration deviates from the norm for a Road.
An state of affairs involving the Road that allows the Road to be in the specified configuration.
The Speed is the rate at which an imaginary traveler on the Road would move.
Depictive phrase describing the character of the Road.
The Place is where the motion (which is specified by a Source, Path or Goal) is located.
The configuration formed by the entire Path along the Road.
The direction in which a "fictive" mover would travel along a Road.

The time when the fictive motion takes place. This may describe the time when the Road or a particular piece of the Road existed, or it may implicitly describe the time when an actual motion event occurred on the Road.
The state-of-affairs that the Road brings about by being in a particular configuration.

A Path, a series of connected locations, is traversed by a Theme, moving under its own power or under the influence of a physical force. The Path may be described in various terms depending on whether it is bounded or not. If it is bounded, the Path may be identified by its Endpoints, which may be presented separately as Source and Goal. For Earth, these perturbations slowly change the eccentricity of the planet's orbit around the Sun. From the eyewitness accounts, as well as satellite data, videos and photos, Brown and his team have worked out the meteor's path through space. Its period around Saturn is just under one Earth day, meaning that it really barrels along, to cover its 700,000 mile orbit in such a short time.
The series of interconnected locations that the Theme traverses.
The Source is one of the Endpoints treated as a source.
The Goal is the endpoint of the Path.
The Endpoints are two (or more) named endpoints of the Path.
The Characteristic is a characteristic(s) of the Path.
An entity relative to which the Theme moves on its Path .
The Direction is the direction or directions the Path runs.
A setting location through which the Path goes.
The Length is the distance the Path extends.
The moving object whose motion describes the Path.

This frame describes the interrelation of a collection of Entities; they may be physical entities or shapes in a recognizable configuration, a pattern of events, or a relation among abstract entities. The pattern is not the individual Entities nor the set of Entities, but an abstraction of their interrelations, as a gestalt. The Cougers are playing in a Wing-T formation tonight. The auditors noticed a suspicious pattern of withdrawals from the maintenance account . The digits of irrational numbers do not repeat in any kind of pattern
The entities whose interrelations form the pattern.
The name of the pattern, such as "wing-T".
A descriptor of the pattern, such as "regular".

This frame contains general words for Individuals, i.e. humans. The Person is conceived of as independent of other specific individuals with whom they have relationships and independent of their participation in any particular activity. They may have an Age, Descriptor, Origin, Persistent_characteristic, or Ethnicity. A man from Phoenix was shot yesterday. She gave birth to a screaming babyyesterday. I study 16-year-old female adolescents. I am dating an African-American man. She comforted the terrified child. I always thought of him as a stupid man.
The Origin is the place where the Person was born or lived a salient part of her or his life.
The Person is the human being.
The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Person which is concieved of as persisting over time.
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Person.
The Age is the length of time the Person has been alive.
The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Person belongs.
An expression indicating the context with which the Person is associated.

An Individual belongs to a group that is categorized in terms of the political views on particular issues that the members of the group tend to share, in opposition to other groups that hold different beliefs on the issues. The views on particular issues that the Individual shares with the other members are assumed to result from general principles or beliefs rather than being accidental or temporary. Leftists vow huge protests during inauguration
The Individual who is referred to in terms of their place along the political spectrum.
The location in which the Individual resides.
A set of issues that is used to identify a sub-set of the group members.
The Origin is the place where the Individual was born or lived a salient part of her or his life.
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Individual.
The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Individual which is conceived of as persisting over time.
The Age is the length of time the Individual has been alive.
The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Individual belongs.
A phrase that indicates more precisely the location in political space of the Individual relative to the center of the region designated by the target.

This frame contains words for individuals as viewed in terms of their age. The Person is conceived of as independent of other specific individuals with whom they have relationships and independent of their participation in any particular activity. They may have a Descriptor, Origin, Persistent_characteristic, or Ethnicity. A specific Age may sometimes be specified as well.
The Origin is the place where the Person was born or lived a salient part of her or his life.
The human being of a certain age.
The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Person which is concieved of as persisting over time.
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Person.
The Age is the length of time the Person has been alive.
The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Person belongs.
An expression indicating the context with which the Person is associated.

This frame contains words for individuals, i.e. humans, who are governed by virtue of being registered in a certain Jurisdiction. Alternatively, they may be conceptualized with respect to their governance by a political or religious Authority They may have an Age, Descriptor, Persistent_characteristic, or Ethnicity.
The Jurisdiction is the place where the Person typically resides and by whose Authority he is governed.
The Person is the human being.
The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Person which is concieved of as persisting over time.
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Person.
The Age is the length of time the Person has been alive.
The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Person belongs.
The politically or religiously legitimated persons who govern the Jurisdiction.

This frame contains general words for Individuals, i.e. humans, whose specific acts or general behavior is evaluated against standards of morality or rightness. The Person may have an Age, Descriptor, Origin, Persistent_characteristic, or Ethnicity. Columbus: Was he a Hero or a Villain? There are endless disputes about this sort of thing, both in and out of the courts, because wrongdoers will say and do anything to avoid getting punished. There are endless disputes about this sort of thing, both in and out of the courts, because wrongdoers will say and do anything to avoid getting punished.
The Origin is the place where the Person was born or lived a salient part of her or his life.
The Person is the human being.
The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Person which is concieved of as persisting over time.
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Person.
The Age is the length of time the Person has been alive.
The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Person belongs.
An expression indicating the context with which the Person is associated.
A domain of activity in which the Person exhibits behavior on which they are judged in terms of its morality.

This frame contains words for individuals, i.e. humans, with respect to their Origin. The Origin is generally incorporated, but may occasionally be specified separately. The Person is conceived of as independent of other specific individuals with whom they have relationships and independent of their participation in any particular activity. They may have an Age, Descriptor, Persistent_characteristic, or Ethnicity.

The Origin is the place where the Person was born or lived a salient part of her or his life. In this frame, it is generally incorporated in the lexical item, but may be separately specified as in the following:
The Person is the human being whose Origin is specified.
The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Person which is concieved of as persisting over time.
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Person.
The Age is the length of time the Person has been alive.
The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Person belongs.
An expression indicating the context with which the Person is associated.

This frame contains words for individuals, i.e. humans, with respect to their Religion. The Religion is generally incorporated, but with some lexical units it is specified separately. The bells call the faithful to evensong DNI A 90-year-old Baptist claims to have seen God personally in his backyard.
The Origin is the place where the Person was born or lived a salient part of her or his life.
The Person is the human being.
The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Person which is conceived of as persisting over time.
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Person.
The Age is the length of time the Person has been alive.
The Ethnicity is the racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Person belongs.
The religious belief system that the Person follows.

This frame contains words for individuals, i.e. humans, with respect to their proximity of residence. This relationship may be defined either symmetrically (as Residents) or asymmetrically (in terms of a Known_resident and a Indicated_resident). The Residents or the Indicated_resident may have an Age, Descriptor, Persistent_characteristic, or Ethnicity specified. The dead included homeowner Todd Underfoot, 33, his wife Spring Back Underfoot, 32, their housemate, Luisa Life, 46, and two of the Underfoot's three children. I have a Swedish roommate that translated for me!
The individual(s) that serve(s) as a reference point for the definition of the Indicated_resident due to the proximity of residences.
The place in which the Residents or the Indicated_resident reside.
A person or group of people defined in terms of the fact that they reside in the proximity of the Known_resident.
The Age is the length of time the Indicated_resident has been alive.
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Indicated_resident.
The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Indicated_resident which is concieved of as persisting over time.
The individuals who reside in proximity to each other.
The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Indicated_resident belongs.

This frame contains words for Individuals as viewed in terms of their vocation. The Person is conceived of as independent of other specific individuals with whom they have relationships and independent of their participation in any particular activity. They may have a Descriptor, Origin, Persistent_characteristic, or Ethnicity. A specific Age may sometimes be specified as well.
The Origin is the place where the Person was born or lived a salient part of her or his life.
The Person is the human being.
The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Person which is concieved of as persisting over time.
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Person.
The Age is the length of time the Person has been alive.
The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Person belongs.
An expression indicating the context with which the Person is associated.
Rank is the position in a hierarchy that a Person occupies within an organization.
This FE identifies the Place where the Person works.
The Employer gives compensation to an Person for their work.
This FE identifies the Type of the vocation that the Person practices.
The Compensation is the payment that the Person receives for performing a task.
The Contract_basis describes the conditions of employment with respect to permanency, hours per time period, or payment basis.

A Perceiver perceives a Phenomenon. The general Perception frame is an inherited background to all frames that have to do with some sentient being responding to changes in the environment, independently of the sensory modalities. The inheriting frames may specify the modalities (see, hear, taste, smell), or may emphasize the experiences or acts of the perceiver (peek, eavesdrop), or the properties of the perceived phenomena (clank, rattle, thump).
The FE Perceiver refers to someone whose cognitive state or experience (e.g. knowledge, beliefs, ideas judgments or classifications) is being described.
The Perceiver is the entity or event which causes the perceptual experience of the Perceiver.
Phenomenon is experienced by the Perceiver.

This frame contains perception words whose perceivers intentionally direct their attention to some entity or phenomenon in order to have a perceptual experience. For this reason we call the perceiver role in this frame Perceiver_agentive. She gazed upon him fondly. Comparing the Perception_active frame to the Perception_experience frame, we note that for some modalities there are different lexical items in each frame. For instance, whereas Perception_active contains the verb phrase look at, Perception_experience contains see. For other sense modalities, we find the same lexical item in both frames. To illustrate, consider the verb smell. This first sentence exemplifies the Perception_active use of the verb smell:Smell this to see if it's fresh.CNI This second sentence exemplifies its Perception_experience sense: I smell something rotten.
The Perceiver_agentive performs some action in order to have a perceptual experience. It is expressed as an External Argument:

Phenomenon indicates the entity or phenomenon to which the Perceiver_agentive directs his or her attention in order to have a perceptual experience. Typically, it is expressed as an Object with verbs.
Body_part identifies the part of the body used as a sensory organ of the Perceiver_agentive, typically expressed in a with-PP.
This FE is the position of the Perceiver during the act of perception. Typically, it is expressed in a from-PP.

Direction is used for all path-like expressions that describe how the perceiver's attention is directed during the act of perception, with the exception of those indicating the location of the Perceiver_agentive (which would be marked Location_of_perceiver)
State is used for predicate expressions that apply to the Phenomenon, providing some information about the state it is in while the perceiver's attention is directed to it:
State is the location, activity, or other characteristic of the Phenomenon.
Manner expressions may be of lexicographic interest if they describe properties of active perception as such: closely, carefully, etc.

The Means indicates the tool or method the Perceiver_agentive is using to actively perceive the Phenomenon. May be confused with Direction in cases with through-PP, but is referring more to the instrument used than the path used.
When the activity of attempting to perceive occurs.
Some action that the Perceiver_agentive is trying to accomplish by directing their own attention.
The general location within which the act of perception takes place.
This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Perception takes place.
An entity or state-of-affairs that the Perceiver_agentive hopes, fears, or expects to find within the Phenomenon.
Ground is the perceptual background against which the Phenomenon is experienced by the Perceiver_agentive.

The Obscuring_medium is the medium through which the Phenomenon makes itself perceivable to the Perceiver_agentive. This is similar to the Direction, but occurs in the opposite direction and implies a movement of the Phenomenon.

This frame contains words describing physical experiences that can affect virtually any part of the body. The body part affected is almost always mentioned with these words. It is typically expressed by the noun heading the external argument, and this noun is typically accompanied by a possessive determiner that refers to the possessor of the body part: My head hurts!.

The Experiencer is the being who has a physical experience on some part of his or her body, or internally. Often information about this frame element is incorporated as a possessive determiner into the constituent expressing the Body Part, in which case it is not tagged separately (from Body Part), as shown below: My legs hurt! Sometimes, however, this frame element is expressed as an External Argument in its own right: I hurt all over! Here, the phrase all over can be considered a kind of generalized Body Part expression, and the pronoun I expresses the Experiencer independently. With nouns and adjectives in this frame, the separate expression of the Experiencer is more common: I have a pain in my leg.

This FE is the location on the body where the physical experience takes place, typically expressed as External Argument, often as PP complement: My legs are a little sore. I'm a little sore in my legs.
The Reason describes the cause of the perception the body is experiencing.
The Subregion is the specific area of the Body_part which experiences the sensation.

This frame contains perception words whose Perceivers have perceptual experiences that they do not necessarily intend to. For this reason we call the Perceiver role Perceiver_passive. Comparing the Perception_experience frame to the Perception_active frame, we note that for some modalities there are different lexical items in each frame. For instance, whereas Perception_experience has see, Perception_active has look at. For other sense modalities, we find the same lexical items in both frames. To illustrate, consider the verb smell where I smell something rotten exemplifies its Perception_experience use and Smell this to see if it's fresh exemplifies its Perception_active sense. This frame also includes words which are not specific to any sense modality, including detect, perceive, perception, sense.
This FE is the being who has a perceptual experience, not necessarily on purpose. It is typically expressed as an External Argument.
This FE is the entity or phenomenon that the perceiver experiences with his or her senses. It is typically expressed as Object with verbs.
The Body_part is the location on the Perceiver_passive's body where the perceptual experience takes place. It is typically expressed in a PP.
This FE identifies the Location_of_perceiver during the perceptual experience. It is typically expressed in a from-PP.

This frame element is used for all path-like expressions, except those indicating the location of the perceiver (see above), that describe how the perceiver's attention is directed during the act of perception.
The State indicates predicate expressions that apply to the Phenomenon, providing some information about the state it is in while the Perceiver_passive experiences it.
State is the location, activity, or other characteristic of the Phenomenon.
Manner expressions may be of lexicographic interest if they describe properties of perception as such: clearly, loudly, etc.
The Degree indicates the degree to which the Perception is experienced.
The action whereby the Perceiver perceives.
The Time at which the Perceiver_passive or the Body_part perceives the Phenomenon.
Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end.

An element of the discourse that serves to contextualize the Phenomenon, with which it is directly related (i.e. filling a frame-element role of the Phenomenon or vice-versa). It contrasts with other contextually relevant elements that potentially (but do not actually) fill the same role.

This FE signifies that the state-of-affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state-of-affairs would be expected given the state-of-affairs in the concessive clause.

A situation which pertains during the event. This frame element is primarily used to highlight the event denoted by the target against a (potentially partially) causal or concessive background state-of-affairs.
An expression of how often the event occurs.
The general location within which the act of perception takes place.

The Ground is the perceptual background against which the Phenomenon is experienced (or not experienced) by the Perceiver_passive. It can be distinguished from locative postnominal modifiers of the Phenomenon in negative contexts.

The Obscuring_medium is the medium through which the Phenomenon makes itself perceivable to the Perceiver_passive. This is similar to the Direction, but occurs in the opposite direction and implies a movement of the Phenomenon.

This frame contains words for Individuals as viewed in terms of their participation in artistic performances. The Person is conceived of as independent of other specific individuals with whom they have relationships. They may have a Descriptor, Origin, Persistent_characteristic, or Ethnicity. A specific Age may sometimes be specified as well.
The Origin is the place where the Person was born or lived a salient part of her or his life.
The Person is the human being.
The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Person which is conceived of as persisting over time.
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Person.
The Age is the length of time the Person has been alive.
The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Person belongs.
An expression indicating the context with which the Person is associated.
Rank is the position in a hierarchy that a Person occupies within a performance.
This FE identifies the Place where the Person works.
The Employer gives compensation to an Person for their work.
This FE identifies the Type of performer the Person is.
The Compensation is the payment that the Person receives for performing a task.
The Contract_basis describes the conditions of employment with respect to permanency, hours per time period, or payment basis.

A Performer has a certain Role in a Performance and plays their part by following the directions in the Script for that particular Role. Margaret Thatcher played Juliet in a school play. "Pulp Fiction" starred John Travolta and a lot of other big names. Mel Gibson starred in "Braveheart" as the leader of a Scottish rebellion. I play the character of Yusuf in this film.
Medium is the physical entity or channel used by the Performer to transmit the Performance to the Audience.
The Performers generates the Performance which the Audience perceives.
The Performer provides an experience for the Audience.
The music which may be performed in the Performance, either in isolation or accompanying actions and speech.

The (usually written) directions which instruct the Performers on what actions to perform, when, and how. It has many different names depending on the Type of Performance including script, screenplay, libretto, book, and choreography.
This FE indicates the subtype of Performance, including dance, theater, film, etc.

Role identifies one of the possible relations that the Performer can have to the Performance. The Role(s) a Performer has in the Performance will determine which parts of the Script should be performed by the Performer, as the Script is written in terms of which Role(s) each set of instructions applies to. In the fields of theater, movies, ballet, and opera, a Role generally corresponds to a character in the story of the Script, while other types of performance may use more general Roles like lead violinist.
This FE identifies the Time when an event occurs.
This FE identifies the Place an event occurs.
The person that performs alongside Performer2.
The person that is also in the Performance, alongside Performer1.
How long the Performer is in the Performance.
This is an appraisal or description of the performance event.

The Performers, together with behind the scenes Personnel, execute a Performance according to a Script and/or Score. The purpose of the Performance is to create an experience for an Audience, who then judge its merits. Performances may be in many different Mediums and be of various Types. This frame is very elaborate in modern society and there are a number of traditions and practices typically (but not necessarily) related to Performances: The Performance is preceded by many practice sessions in which the Performers and other Personnel attempt to improve the quality and/or fidelity of their individual and collective performances to the Script and/or Score. The Audience members pay a fee to experience the Performance. The Performers (and Personnel) receive payment for contributing to the Performance. Often there are other individuals involved in the specifically financial aspects of the Performance and Performers. Critics act as part of the Audience and then write reviews that evaluate the merits of the Performance, describing the Performance to other potential Audience members. Due to the high quality of previous Performances, Performers can become famous, i.e. well known and liked. Those who like them particularly well become fans of the Performer. (Shared with writers...)
The Performer provides an experience for the Audience.
The Personnel, including writers, producers, stage hands, key grips, etc., contribute to the Performance without actually being directly perceived by the Audience.
The experience generated by the Performers and perceived by the Audience.

The (usually written) directions which instruct the Performers on what actions to perform, when, and how. It has many different names depending on the Type of Performance including script, screenplay, libretto, book, and choreography.
The Score may be performed in the Performance, either in isolation or accompanying actions and speech.
This FE indicates the Type of Performance, including dance, theater, film, etc.
Medium is the physical entity or channel used by the Performer to transmit the Performance to the Audience.

In this frame a State_of_affairs is permitted by a Principle. Raising constructions are common in this frame. In this frame the Principle which sanctions the State_of_affairs is not an agent who grants permission to a specific individual or group of individuals, and thus differs from the Grantor in the Grant_permission frame. Children were not permitted in the office . Code 1425 allows us to deduct interest payments. No religion accepts discrimination against women.
The State_of_affairs is the situation that is permitted by the Principle.
The Principle is the code or authority which permits the State_of_affairs.
The Place is where the State_of_affairs is sanctioned.
The Time is when the Principle permits the State_of_affairs.
The Circumstances are the conditions under which the State_of_affairs is permitted.

The words in this frame have to do with people and the personal Relationships they are or can be a part of. Some of the words denote people engaged in a particular kind of Relationship, others denote the Relationship, yet others the events bringing about or ending the Relationships. Many of the words presuppose an understanding of states and events that must have occurred before another event takes place or before a person can be classified in a certain way.
That partner in the Relationship who is realized as the subject of verbs in active form sentences, or of adjectives in predicative uses.
That partner in the Relationship who is not expressed as the external argument.
The joint construal of both Partners in the Relationship.
An act whereby a focal participant achieves an action indicated by the target.

A physical object, the Artifact, is produced by a Creator to stimulate the perceptions, emotions, or cognition of an audience. Though it need not, in many cases, the created Artifact is intended to represent an actual or imagined entity or event, the Represented. The Represented may be specifically shown in a particular state (State_of_represented). Sir Denis Mahon is the owner of the most important private collection of Italian Baroque paintings. He presented Eddie with a watercolour painting and a bouquet of flowers to his wife Frances I just took a picture of the screen and plan to share it with 6.4 billion of my closest friends on the Internet tonight.
This FE identifies the entity or substance that is designed to have a particular Use.
The use for which the Artifact is intended.
An individual or individuals that bring the Artifact into existence.
The time at which an Artifact comes into existence.
The term used to refer to an Artifact.
An indication of the subtype of Artifact.
Any indication of what makes up the Artifact, including components, ingredients, etc.
The entity--which may be a thing, an action or a state--that is represented by the Artifact.
A characterization of the state in which the Represented entity is portrayed.
This FE identifies a characteristic, description, or evaluation of the Artifact.
The location where the Artifact is presently located.
An Entity exists in some Place at some time.
Salient parts that make up a locale.
A thing (either abstract or physical) that exists with some degree of permanence.
Indicates the action (or causer) which brings the features of the locale about.
ULTIMATELY TO BE replaced BY MULTIWORD Targets (in almost all cases). This FE is used for the names of locales.
This FE indicates what subtype of the general category the Entity belongs to.
A place that a physical Entity is located with respect to.
The words in this frame describe situations in which a Perpetrator forcibly seizes control over a Victim's Vehicle to gain some end.
This is the person (or other agent) who forcibly seizes control over a vehicle to gain some end.
This is the means of transportation which gets under the control of the perpetrator. Example: The terrorists hijacked the plane.
This FE describes the people that are suffering as a result of the Perpetrator's action.
The unlawful seizure of a Vehicle by a Perpetrator.
An act performed by the Perpetrator by which the seizure of the Vehicle is accomplished.
The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
This is the place to which the vehicle is directed.
This is the place from which the vehicle is taken away.
The action that the Perpetrator is trying to accomplish by piracy.
The situation that the Perpetrator had in mind which lead to the decision to perpetrate the particular act of piracy.
An object that the Perpetrator uses in taking control of the Vehicle.
The number of times that the Vehicle is seized in acts of piracy.

An Agent who is engaged in an Undertaking accords a Degree of importance to a Consideration that influences the success of an Undertaking. As a consequence, the Agent acts in a way that reflects that judgment of importance. Our company emphasizes marketing tried and true products and services.INI In fact, most search engines place little weight on words placed in meta tags when creating their relevancy rankings.INI The emphasis is on the fundamental principles from which the automotive technologies of the future will develop, rather than on present-day processes. Our emphasis on quality does not stop with our products. INI When shooting in my studio, I emphasize a relaxed atmosphere.INI
An event or state of affairs, an attribute, or an entity whose properties have the potential to influence the success of the Agent's Undertaking.
This FE marks expressions that indicate the Degree to which the Consideration is important to the Undertaking.
The Undertaking is a process or state or field of activity in which the Agent participates.
This FE identifies the Reason for which the Consideration is important to the Undertaking.
The Agent is the individual who devotes time, concentration, or other resources to a Consideration that is important for the success of a larger Undertaking.
An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by assigning the specified level of importance to the Consideration.
An intentional action performed by the Agent that allows the Agent to respond to the importance of the Factor to the Undertaking.
The Competing_consideration is another factor that is relevant to the Undertaking to which the Agent devotes less attention or effort.
The time period during which the Agent attaches a specified degree of importance to the Consideration to further the success of the Undertaking.
The location in which the Agent attaches the specified level of importance to the Consideration.
Any further description of the Agent's placing of importance on the Consideration.
The Artifact is a physical object designed with some Consideration in mind, such that it functions to facilitate the Undertaking.
The Action is performed with importance placed on the Consideration.

This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often. It is to be distinguished from Iteration, which pertains simply to the number of times an event occurs-Iteration expressions answer the question how many times. In the future, we will further distinguish Particular_iteration, which is intended to pick out a particular iteration from a series.

Generally without overall (translational) motion, an Agent places a Theme at a location, the Goal, which is profiled. In this frame, the Theme is under the control of the Agent/Cause at the time of its arrival at the Goal. David placed his briefcase on the floor. This frame differs from Filling in that it focuses on the Theme rather than the effect on the Goal entity. It differs from Removing in focusing on the Goal rather than the Source of motion for the Theme.
The Agent is the person (or other force) that causes the Theme to move.
The Theme is the object that changes location during the Placing.
The Source is the initial location of the Theme, before it changes location.
Any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal expresses the frame element Path. In this frame, Path expressions almost always have a via-sense.
The FE Goal is the location where the Theme ends up. This FE is profiled by words in this frame.

Any expression which describes a property of the placing action which is not directly related to the trajectory of the Theme's motion expresses the frame element Manner. Descriptions of speed, steadiness, grace, means of motion, and other things count as Manner expressions.
The Degree indicates the degree to which the placing occurs.
This FE identifies any Depictive phrase describing the Agent or Theme of the placing.
The Means is an act whereby the Agent achieves the placing of the Theme.
This FE identifies the Result of the Placing.
The Duration is the amount of time for which the Theme is to stay in the Goal location.
The Place indicates where the Placing occurs.
The Reason indicates why the Placing occurs.
Time is when the Placing occurs
The Area is the setting into which the Theme is placed.
This is the second moving object, expressed as a direct object or an oblique.
This FE is any expression which characterizes the extent of motion.
The Speed is the rate at which Placing occurs.
An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by perform the placing action.

This extrathematic FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the occurrence of the event specified by the target predicate. Further, the target predicate should involve some sort of Agent that intends that the benefit go to the Beneficiary.
This frame represents the abstract scene in which an Agent manipulates a Theme's location, thus affecting a Goal which ends up co-located with the Theme. This frame is primarily for Inheritance.
The Agent is the actor who instigates the filling.
The Theme is the physical object or substance which changes location.
The Source is the location where the Theme begins its motion.
The Path is the trajectory of the motion.
The Goalis the area or container being filled. Goal is generally the NP Object in this frame.
Degree to which the filling occurs.
Depictive phrase describing the Agent of the filling action.
The Manner in which the filling occurs.
The Means by which the filling occurs.
The Result is the resultant state after the filling has occurred.
The Reason for which the Agent fills or covers the Goal.
The Instrument with which the filling occurs.
The Subregion is the smaller area of the Goal where the filling or covering occurs.
An event which brings about the filling of the Goal.
This frame describes a situation in which the Agent puts the Theme into the Ground for the purpose of growing. He recently planted some old apple trees. INI
Theme is the item planted by the Agent.
The Instrument is used by the Agent as a tool to help obtain the Theme. (This tool is not limited to typical artifacts and can be hands, arms, and other atypical hunting and fishing instruments.)
For what length of time the Agent plants the Theme.
The Manner in which the Agent plants the Theme.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Agent plants the Theme.
The failure or success of an attempt.
The greater geographic location where the Agent plants the Theme.
An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by planting the Theme.
How often the Agent cultivates the Theme.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.
The Ground is the background or context to which the Agent pays attention in his agricultural efforts.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
The Depictive describes a participant in the Planting action.
The Co-Participant is an entity that participates in the planting event in a coordinated way with another participant.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the planting event logically follows.

The answer to a Question is under discussion in a Group, which still has a difference of opinion among its members. The prominence of the Question relative to others can be indicated by a Status expression. Firstly, it is quite clear the issue in this context was not so much apostasy as much as it was treason. The question in Finucane's case is this: will an inquiry bring out the truth? It remains an issue of central importance to women . Democracy in Serbia was blocked by the unresolved national question.
The Question is an open proposition the answer to which is under dispute.
The Group are the persons or organizations who have different points of view on the Question.
The Frame Element Status is used for expressions that indicate the relative importance of a Question with respect to the other topics that are disputed.
A characterization of the Question, often with regard to its complexity or whether it has been resolved or not.
The area of human experience which the Question concerns.
A state or event within which the Question arises as a problem for the Group.
The time interval during which the Question exists as a problem for the Group.
An individual or individuals from whose point of view the Question is a point of dispute within the Group.
This frame covers words that name Locations as defined politically, or administratively.
The materials or Constituent_parts that make up a Locale.
The location that the Locale is a part of.
A stable bounded area. It is typically the designation of the nouns of Locale-derived frames.
ULTIMATELY TO BE REPLACED BY MULTIWORD TARGETS (in almost all cases). This FE is used for the Names of Locales.
A place that a Locale is located with respect to.
Any description, characteristic, or property of the Locale which is not covered by more specific FEs.
The people living in the jurisdiction of the locale.

An Evaluee, which can be a person or an object, has an amount of acceptability or utilization based on general (often non-aesthetic) desirability. The Judge who determines the Evaluee's desirability may be mentioned. Frank Sinatra is cool again. Web 2.0 is so in right now.
The person or object that is being evaluated for its desirability.
A description of how desirable the Evaluee is.
The person who decides how desirable the Evaluee is.
The time when the Evaluee is judged to be desirable.
The geographic area where an Evalueeis considered desirable.

An Agent behaves as if they were a particular individual or type of Simulated_entity with the intent of misleading observers of their behavior. This is generally accomplished by altering their normal appearance (especially dress), mannerisms, voice, and other observable characteristics. The belfast bank robbers posed as police. These groups are masquerading as mainstream groups, yet after taking a closer look you see they are the most extreme.
The Agent is the person who acts in a misleading way to create the impression that they are a particular individual or type of Simulated_entity.

Any description of the posing event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way) and salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (deliberately, eagerly).
An intentional action performed by the Agent that contributes to the his or her being perceived as a particular (kind of) Simulated_entity.
The type or individual that the Agent gives the impression of being.
An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by posing as a particular (kind of) Simulated_entity.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the posing event logically follows.
The location where the Agent gives the impression that they are the Simulated_entity.
The time at which the Agent impersonates the Simulated_entity.
This frame contains words that describe an Item's static position on a scale with respect to some property Variable.
Item identifies the entity whose scalar property is specified.
Variable is the scalar property that the Item possesses. Soda is high in sugar.
The Value is the position or range of positions on the scale that the Item occupies. This is normally implicit in the LU.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the scalar property of an Item holds with respect to some Variable.
Domain describes the set of Items for which the Variable's position is determined.
An Owner has (or lacks) a Possession.
The entity that owns a posession.
The thing which is owned by the Owner. Ex.: I have twenty bucks. (This does not include bodyparts or medical conditions, but does include intellectual property, etc.)
State of the Owner or Possession.
The way that the Owner possesses the Possession.

Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end. In many cases, the continuous situation is a dynamic action which is ongoing, while in others it is simply an undifferentiated state.
This FE indicates the Time interval during which the Owner has a possession.
The reason for which the Owner has the Possession.

There exist a number of different possible Events that may happen in the future. In most cases, there is an Agent involved who has to consider which of the possible Events will or should occur. A Salient_entity which is deeply involved in the Event may also be mentioned. You have but two choices for your daughter .
Something that may happen in the future.
An individual involved in the Event.
The number of different future Events under consideration.
An entity intimately involved in the Event.
The state-of-affairs that the Agent hopes to bring about which is associated with some of the possible Events but not others.

A Possible_event is deemed to have some probability of occurrence, if some (generally implicit) further Condition pertains. The Condition, whether overt or implicit, usually concerns the decision of an agent to attempt to bring the Possible_event about. The primary implication is that certain other aspects of the situation that might have been expected to prevent the Possible_event, usually lack of capability or permission, do not pertain. You ca n't burn glass . INI You can have two more if you want . This sense of lack can never be satisfied . We just ca n't stand it anymore . INI
The Possible_event has met its preconditions, and will occur if some further Condition holds.
The Circumstances under which the preconditions of the Possible_event are met.
An entity, event, or state that brings about the possibility of the Possible_event.
The state-of-affairs that does not hold, but if it did, the Possible_event would occur.
The time at which the Possible_event can occur.
The stage after which the Recipient has acquired the Theme.
The individual that has just come into possession of the Theme.
The entity which has just come into the possession of the Recipient.
The way that the Recipient has the Theme
This FE indicates the Time interval during which the Post_getting event occurs.
The stage immediately after the Donor gives the Recipient the Theme, i.e. when the Recipient has possession of the Theme and the Donor no longer does.
The individual that has just given the Theme to the Recipient and no longer has the Theme.
The entity that the Donor has just given to the Recipient.
The way that the Donor lacks the Theme.
The individual that has just come into possession of the Theme.
This FE indicates the Time when the Post_giving event occurs.
The subframe of Relinquish in which the Owner (= Donor) no longer has the Possession (=Theme).
The entity that no longer owns the posession.
The thing which was owned by the Owner. (This does not include bodyparts or medical conditions, but does include intellectual property, etc.)

Any description of the possession state which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
This FE indicates the Time when the Post_lose_possession event occurs.
The state-of-affairs immediately after the Recipient has come into possession of the Theme offered by the Donor.
The person who has just acted to come into possession of the Theme.
The person who has just given the Theme to the Recipient.
The entity that changes possession, beginning in the possession of the Donor and ending up with the Recipient.
The way that the Recipient has the Theme
This FE indicates the Time when the Post_giving event occurs.
The stage after the Theme is in the possession of the Recipient.
The individual that has just given the Theme away.
The entity which has ended up in the possession of the Recipient
The way that the Donor possesses the Theme.
The individual that has ended up with the Theme.
This FE indicates the Time when the Post_transfer event occurs.

An Agent supports their body in a particular Location. The LUs of the frame convey which body part is the Point_of_contact where the Agent is supported, what orientation the body is in, and some overall arrangement of the limbs (especially the legs) and the torso. He knelt down Location , hand on heart .
The Agent is the individual whose body is in a particular posture. The Agent FE is generally expressed as the external argument of verbs:
A description of the position of the Agent. The Location of the Agent is frequently expressed and generally occurs as a PP Complement:
The Agent's state throughout the time they are in a particular posture.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
A state of the Agent which crucially depends on their posture.
This FE indicates the Time interval during which the Agent held a certain posture.
The Purpose for which the Agent holds the posture.
The length of time for which the Agent holds the posture.
The part of the body that provides support to the Agent's body in the posture.
An Agent enacts an Action that is intended to be performed again at one or more later Occasions. The goal of practicing is to ensure that the action at the later Occasion(s) comes off flawlessly.
This FE identifies the Action that the Agent performs intentionally in order to prepare for a later Occasion.
The Agent performs the Action in preparation for later performances of the same type.
This FE identifies the place where the practicing occurs.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent performs an intentional act.
This FE identifies the time when the Agent practices.
This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent practices.

Any description of the practicing which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the Action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The later enactment or enactments that the Agent expects to perform. Note that the Agent does not have to have specific Occasions in mind.
The period of time during which an Action is repeatedly practiced.
The number of times that the Action is practiced.
A person who participates in a practice event along with the Agent.
The Behavior of an Evaluee is described in terms of the reaction it deserves from somebody, such as praise, blame or admiration.
The Behavior of the Evaluee is being judged as worthy of a particular reaction.
This FE indicates the Behavior on which the assessment of praiseworthiness is based.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the judgement or reaction is deserved.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.
The state of the Recipient prior to the acquisition, i.e. before the Recipient gains possession of the Theme.
The individual that is about to gain a possession.
The entity which is about to be acquired by the Recipient.
A description of the way that the Recipient has the Theme
This FE indicates the Time when the Post_getting event occurs.
The stage of giving just before the Donor discontinues possession of the Theme, yielding it to the Recipient.
The individual that has possession of the Theme and is about to transfer possession to the Recipient.
The entity which is in the possession of the Donor, which later ends up in the possession of the Recipient.
The way that the Donor possesses the Theme.
The individual who is about to come into possession of the Theme.
This FE indicates the Time when the Pre_giving event occurs.
Subframe of Relinquish where the Owner (=Donor) has the Possession (=Theme).
The Owner is the entity that owns the Possession.
The Possession is the thing which is owned by the Owner.

Any description of the possession state which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
This FE indicates the Time when the Post_lose_posession event occurs.
The state-of-affairs immediately before the Recipient gets the Theme which describes the Recipient's possession of the Theme.
The person who acts to come into possession of the Theme.
The person who has the Theme and is about to give it to the Recipient.
The entity that changes possession, beginning in the possession of the Donor and ending up with the Recipient.
A description of the way that the Recipient has the Theme.
This FE indicates the Time when the Pre_receiving event occurs.
The stage before the transfer has taken place, with the Theme in the possession of the Donor.
The individual that is about to transfer the Theme to the Recipient.
The entity which is in the possession of the Donor.
The way that the Recipient or Donor possesses the Theme.
The individual who is about to receive the Theme.
This FE indicates the Time when the Pre_transfer event occurs.

Water in some solid or liquid form (the Precipitation) falls from the sky at a particular Place and Time, lasting for a particular Duration. The Rate or Quantity of precipitation may also be indicated.
The water in liquid or solid form that falls from the sky is the Precipitation.
The Quantity of Precipitation that falls within a certain Duration.
The Quantity is the amount of Precipitation that has fallen in a precipitation event or events. It is usually measured as the height that the Precipitation attains if prevented from further movement.
The amount of time for which the precipitation event lasts.
The Cause is the reason for the precipitation event.
The way in which the precipitation falls.
This FE identifies the temperature of the precipitation.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.

An Experiencer is in an undesirable Situation, whose Cause may also be expressed. The insurers ended up in the bind of having to pay 15 years' taxes. He was in a bit of a pickle and make no mistake! What a mess we 're in now!
The Experiencer is in an undesirable Situation.
This FE identifies the undesirable Situation the Experiencer is in.
This FE identifies the Cause of the Situation.
Thiis FE identifies the Time when the Situation is in effect.
The location where the Situation occurs.
The Domain in which the Experiencer has the problem.

A Speaker states or makes known a future Eventuality on the basis of some Evidence. The Weather Centre predicted that it would be warmer but wet for the weekend. The OECD forecast that UK interest rates would be 13 per cent by the end of 1989. Another seer who forecast a Tory majority -- without compromising his impartiality -- was Sir Robin Day . The European market is forecast to grow 18.1% by the end of next fiscal year.

This FE marks expressions that indicate an event or state that is predicted to occur or hold at a future time. A single Eventuality may be expressed discontinuously in a raising construction. This FE is also used for expressions that denote entities with variable attributes about which the Speaker makes predictions.
This Frame Element marks expressions that denote a set of facts on the basis of which the Speaker makes the prediction.
This FE identifies the Time when the prediction is made.
The Place where the Speaker makes the prediction.
Manner marks any description of the Speaker's prediction making that is not covered by more specific FEs.
This frame element marks expressions that indicate forwhat future time an Eventuality is predicted.
This FE indicates the Accuracy of the prediction.
This FE describes a characteristic of the Eventuality.

An Experiencer has a greater desire to participate in some Event, as against another (contextually recoverable) event which exhibits a specific Contrast with the Event. Alternatively, the Experiencer may have a greater desire that some Focal_participant participate in the Event. The Location_of_Event may also be mentioned. Why do women prefer manly faces? I prefer open source programs over proprietary ones. Other customers prefer to send us an order together with a cheque. I prefer my tartar sauce on fish.
The Experiencer is the person (or sentient being) who wishes for the Event to occur.
The change that the Experiencer would like to see.
This is the entity that the Experiencer wishes to be affected by some Event.
The Degree is the extent of the Experiencer's Desiring.
The way in which the Experiencer desires something.
The Explanation shows why the Experiencer wants the Event to occur. This FE occurs frequently as a PP complement headed by for.
The Purpose_of_Event is the purpose pertaining to the desired Event.
The time that the Event would ideally occur.
The Location_of_Event is the place involved in the desired Event.
The Time is when the Experiencer desires something.
Where the event takes place. Note that this FE is of extremely rare occurrence in this frame.
The amount of time for which the Experiencer has desired something.
An alternative Event or Focal_participant that is less desirable for the Experiencer.

This frame describes means actions (Preparatory_acts) that are taken by an Agent for the purpose of preparing for a later act. Contrast this frame with a scenario involving earlier versions of some entity being superseded by later versions (e.g., preliminary results, advance copy).
The Agent uses the Preparatory_act to acheive a Purpose.
The action performed by the Agent that is a preliminary to the achievement of the Purpose. The Preparatory_act may also be expressed by a result of such an act.
The ultimate goal or purpose of the Agent, which the Preparatory_act enables.
A characteristic of the Preparatory_act, Agent, or other participant.
The extent to which the Preparatory_act is distant from the achievement of the Purpose.
The area, field, or domain for which the preliminary action is relevant.
The time at which the Preparatory_act takes place.
The place where the Preparatory_act takes place.
The part of the larger process that is preliminary to the achievement of the Purpose.

An Entity exists at a particular Location, at a particular Time, as observed by an implicit observer. A Depictive and/or Duration phrase is often found. This frame differs from Existence in that the Location is profiled as a ground where an observer is conceived of as confirming the Entity's existence. Liquid water was present on the surface of Mars billions of years ago. Urate was present in varying concentrations in the bathing solution only. No one was present. DNI Your presence is appreciated. DNI In some cases, the Location may be recoverable from phrases that primarily express peripheral information: Was the senator present for the committee vote? Was the senator present for the committee vote?
The Entity whose existence at the Location is confirmed.
The Location of the Entity. The Location is conceived as a ground for an event of inspection to determine the presense of the Entity.
The time when the Entity is present at the Location.
A separate description of the state of the Entity when it is present.

The time period during which the Entity is present. In this frame, Duration may be expressed with for preceding an event which stands for the duration of the event. In cases where the Entity is sentient, there may be an inference that the Entity's intent is to be present so as to participate in the event.
In this frame an Agent preserves an Undergoer in order to prevent it from decaying. A Medium may be used. Bill mummified John. Tess pickled the beets in vinegar. The Smiths dried the apples.
The Agent is the person performing the intentional act that leads to the preservation.
Medium is the substance in which the Undergoer might be submerged to be preserved.
The Undergoer is organic matter that undergoes the preservation.
The Instrument with which an an Agent performs the Preserving.
The Means by which the Agent preserves the Undergoer.
The Manner in which the Agent preserves the Undergoer.
The Place where the preserving occurs.
The Time when the Agent preserves the Undergoer.
The Purpose for which the Agent preserves the Undergoer.
The amount of Time for which the process of Preserving is ongoing.
The Depictive phrase describing one of the participants.
The extent to which the Undergoer is preserved from decaying.
A Speaker communicates about a Topic in such a way as to mislead an Addressee, either by telling outright lies or by presenting a message in a misleading form.
The person who uses language in the written or spoken modality to convey a deceptive Message to the Addressee.
The person that receives a Message from the Speaker.
Topic is the entity to which the proposition or propositions relate, that they are about.

An Agent or Preventing_cause keeps a Protagonist from having a State_of_affairs that they need or desire. His parents deprived him of food for days on end. Our lonely city starves us of original live music. Employees were denied overtime pay and meal breaks. CNI
The Preventing_cause is the agent or force which keeps the Event from happening.
The is the situation, state-of-affairs, or state of having a possession that the Protagonist is kept from having.
The Time is when the Preventing_cause keeps the Event from taking place.
The Place is where the Preventing_cause keeps the Event from taking place.
The Agent is the person who keeps the Event from happening.
The Protagonist is the person who is kept from having the State_of_affairs.
The reason why the Agent keeps the Protagonist from having the State_of_affairs.
The length of time for which the Protagonist is denied the State_of_affairs.
How it is possible that the deprivation event occurs.
This FE marks the frequency with which the Protagonist is prevented from having the State_of_affairs.
An event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at the time of prevention and which the prevention is taken to be a part of.

A Preventing_cause or an Agent (via their actions) keeps an Event from taking place. Unlike in the Thwarting frame, the Preventing_cause does not directly prevent the actions of an individual, but rather affects the world in such a way that an Event cannot occur. Some lexical units, like avert and avoid indicate that the Preventing_cause would have been affected if the Event occurred. Rain prevented the ball game from taking place. He could have stopped the riot . The government narrowly averted a coup .
The Preventing_cause is the force which keeps the Event from happening.
The Event is prevented from occurring by the Preventing_cause.
The Time is when the Preventing_cause keeps the Event from taking place.
The Place is where the Preventing_cause keeps the Event from taking place.
The Agent is the agent which keeps the Event from happening.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.

This Frame deals with Penal_institutions. They are run by an Operator and may be intended to hold certain kinds of Inmates. Penal_institutions may have a special Name and their Location may also be indicated.
The Frame Element Operator marks expressions that indicate which level of government operates the Penal Institution.
Inmates marks expressions that indicate the group of people a Penal Institution is intended to hold.
This FE marks expressions that are the Name of a Penal Institution.
This FE marks expressions that indicate the Location of the Penal Institution.
The level of security maintained at the prison.
The locale which serves to confine individuals, generally for the purpose of punishment.

This frame characterizes the likelihood that a Hypothetical_event will happen as a position on a scale of impossible to inevitable. The likelihood can expressed as numerical Odds or a metaphorical representation of the Position on a scale. There's a 20 % chance that you'll succeed. The odds that he'll actually do it are one in a million.
A numerical representation of the probability that a Hypothetical_event will occur.
A metaphorical representation of the position on the scale of likelihood that the Hypothetical_event will occur.
The event that is expected to happen with a certain likelihood.

This frame describes a complex event which lasts some amount of time, consisting of a beginning stage, a stage where the process is ongoing, and a finish or end. In some cases the process may pause, and then possibly resume. In this frame and its subframes, the distinguished argument is a Process, and there is no reference to an Entity which undergoes this Process or an Agent which initiates this Process. In formal terms, this frame refers to an overall controller x-schema (Narayanan 1997) with subframes corresponding to parts of the x-schema.
The Reason for which an event occurs.
Name of the Process which occurs.
The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
A Process is finished and can no longer proceed.
This FE identifies the name of the Process that occurs.

An Event continues at a certain Place through Time. (Note that often when 'continue.v' occurs with definite time points, it denotes Resumption, which is out of frame here.) NB: Refer to Process frame.
Depictive phrase about the state of a focal participant.
Manner in which the Event is continuing.
This FE identifies the Duration of time over which the Event is ongoing.
Name of the Event which is continuing.
The Reason for which the Event occurs.
The Next_subevent of the overall Event.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause.
A Process comes to an end.
Name of the event which occurs.
The Reason for which the event ends.
Degree to which the event occurs.
Depictive phrase describing the actor of the event.
The number of times that the event is repeated.
The amount of time it takes for the Process to end.
The initial State of an Entity in an event; part of the Event X-schema. NB: Refer to Event frame.
The overall process which is about to begin.
The point at which the Process begins.
The length of time that the Process remains ready to begin.
The Process stops making progress towards completion, but should resume and continue.
This FE identifies the Cause of the pause.
When the pause in the Process occurs.
Degree to which the event occurs.
Depictive phrase describing the actor of an action.
The Reason for which a pause occurs.
The amount of time that a Process remains stopped.
The number of times that the Process stops.,
An event resumes at a certain Place and Time. NB: Refer to Event frame.
The amount of Time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
The Process which is being resumed.
The Reason for which an event occurs.
The number of times that the Process resumes.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
An Event begins at a certain Time and Place. Reason may also be indicated. NB: Refer to Event frame.
Name of the Event which occurs.
The Reason for which an Event occurs.
Depictive phrase describing the actor of an action.
Manner in which an action is performed.
The period of time for which the Process is ongoing after it has started.
The number of times that the specified type of Event begins.

A Process stops at a certain Time and Place. Reason may also be specified. A Duration may be included in order to indicate the length of the persistence of the Paused-state before action resumes. NB: Refer to Process frame.
This FE identifies the Cause of an event occur.
Degree to which the event occurs.
Depictive phrase describing the actor of an action.
The Reason for which an event occurs.
The amount of time that a process remains stopped.
The number of times that the Process stops.,
The State of an Entity after an Event has stopped, i.e. part of an X-schema. NB: Refer to Event frame.
The overall event which is stopped.
The point at which the Process is not continuing.
The length of time that the Process does not resume.
A Process is in a state where it can no longer be completed.
This FE identifies the name of the Process that occurs.

An Agent alters some Material in some useful way by means of some chemical or physical Alterant.
