A holistic description of the event (e.g. the same way), including depictions of the Agent in terms of how the state of the Agent affects the overall action (e.g maliciously).

Meaning: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often. It is to be distinguished from Iteration, which pertains simply to the number of times an event occurs--Iteration expressions answer the question how many times.
The length of time that the Artifact is (or has been) rendered nonfunctional.
This FE is used for any Depictive phrase describing the state of particpant while lack of functionality is being rendered.
A Lessee gains the use of Goods owned by a Lessor by payment to the Lessor.
The individual that gains temporary use of the Goods by paying the Lessor
The FE Goods is an item which is temporarily exchanged for Money in a transaction.
The means by which a commercial transaction occurs.
Money is the thing given in exchange for tempory use of the Goods.
In isome cases, price or payment is described per unit of Goods.
The individual who has permanent ownership of the Goods and allows them to be used by the Lessee temporarily.
This FE is any unit in which goods or services can be measured. Generally, it occurs in a by-PP.
The location the renting takes place.
The purpose for which the renting is performed.
A state-of-affairs from which the renting logically follows.

Any description of the purchasing event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Lesseethat affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The individual intended by the Lessee to receive the Goods.
The length of time that the Goods are (or have been) in the Lessee's possession.
The Lessee's intended purpose for the Goods.
A Lessor who owns some Goods allows a Lessee to use the Goods temporarily in exchange for Money.
The Lessee has Money and wants the Goods.
The FE Goods is the item which is temporarily exchanged for Money.
The means by which a commercial transaction occurs.
Money is the thing given in exchange for Goods in a transaction.
In some cases, price or payment is described per unit of Goods.
The Lessor has possession of the Goods and temporarily exchanges them for Money from a Lessee.
This FE is any unit in which goods or services can be measured. Generally, it occurs in a by-PP.
The location where the leasing takes place.
The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
A state-of-affairs from which the renting logically follows.
The time at which the renting takes place.

Any description of the renting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Lessor that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The state of the Lessor after the sale has occurred.
The length of time that the Goods are (or have been) in the Lessee's possession.
The Lessee's intended purpose for the Goods.
This FE indicates that the selling act reverses an earlier separate act in which the current Lessor rented or bought the Goods from the current Lessee.
This FE indicates that the current leasing constitues a re-lease by the current Lessor of Goods that they bought or rented earlier from a third person (not the Lessee of the current leasing act).

A Speaker declares that they will no longer be involved with the Content. Such a declaration implies that the Speaker has decided that association with the Content is somehow undesirable. That will only be possible if and when the IRA renounces armed struggle.
The Speaker is the person who communicates their cessation of association with the Content.
The Addressee is the person to whom the Speaker is communicating. When this FE is expressed, it often appears in a prepositional phrase introduced by "to", or as a direct object.
The idea that the Speaker no longer associates with, whether it be an activity, a propostion, or a group.

Any description of the renunciation which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Speaker that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An act whereby the Speaker makes a statement of renunciation.
The emotional or physical state of the Speaker that leads to their renunciation.
Medium is the physical entity or channel used by the Speaker to transmit the statement of renunciation.
The state of the Speaker during the statement.
The time when the statement is made.
The FE specifies the place where the statement takes place.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.

The words in this frame describe the process of making amends for some (wrongful) action (the Injury) committed by the Wrongdoer. In this process, in order to appease the Injured_party or to follow laws or customs, the Wrongdoer performs some Benefiting_action for the Injured_party or gives the Injured_party some Gift. I will make it up to you. Sinn Fein said that the marchers had to make restitution to the Catholics for the disruption and violence. The tribesmen tried to make amends to us with handfuls of their most precious seashells.
The Injured_party was affected by some previous wrongful act of the Wrongdoer and who should benefit from the reparations.
The Injury is the injurious action that the Wrongdoer committed against the Injured_party. Although conceptually present, this FE need not always be realized.
The Wrongdoer makes amends to the Injured_party for the Injury.
The Benefiting_action is performed by the Wrongdoer to make amends.
Gift identifies the entity that the Wrongdoer gives to the Injured_party.

Manner marks any description of the Wrongdoer's making of reparations not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification, (e.g. probably), and general descriptions comparing events (e.g. the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of a Wrongdoer that also affect the action ( e.g. presumptuously).
This FE identifies the Place where the Wrongdoer makes amends.
This FE identifies the Time when amends are made.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Wrongdoer makes restitution to the Injured_party.
The extent to which the Wrongdoer makes amends for the Injury .
A Debtor gives a Loaner Money in return for having borrowed Money at an earlier time. Alternatively, the type of Loan can be expressed as the object of repayment.
The person who is owed Money by the Debtor.
The person who is giving Money to the Loaner to return an earlier borrowed amount.
The amount of Money that the Debtor gives to the Loaner, which may or may not be the full amount of the Loan.
A situation or a representative of a situation prior to repayment in which the Debtor uses the Loaner's money.
The level to which the Loan can be considered repaid in its entirety.
When the Debtor gives the Loaner money.
The state of the world when the Money is transfered.
How the Debtor gives Money to the Loaner.
The physical location where the repayment takes place.
What the Debtor does in order to repay the Loaner.
A Defender successfully repels the aggressive attempt of takeover by an Enemy.
The Enemy is the entity that fails to overtake the Defender.
The Defender is the land, government, and its people that the Enemy fails to seize.
This FE describes the intensity and extent of the repelling event.
The manner in which the Defender repels the Enemy.
The action by which the repelling event is made possible through the efforts of the Defender.
The location where the Defender repels the Enemy.
The Time when the Defender succeeds to repel the Enemy.
The reason why the Defender repels the Enemy.
The tool used by the Defender to repel the Enemy.
This FE refers to the Invasion_act perpetrated by the Enemy.
This FE describes the outcome of the repelling event.

An Agent changes the filler of a Role by placing a New filler in the position after the Old filler ceases to occupy the position. Often this entails the Agent removing the Old filler. In most cases the Role is implicit. If you replace me with a robot, who's gonna make excuses to your wife for you? Following Keating 's resignation from the Cabinet Hawke immediately replaced him as Deputy Prime Minister with Brian Howe , Minister for Community Services and Health.
An intentional action performed by the Agent that accomplishes the replacement.
The conscious entity, generally a person, that performs actions resulting in the New entity occupying the position.
An entity directed by the Agent that interacts with an New entity so that it ends up in the position.
This FE identifies where the Agent installs the New entity.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent places the New entity in a position.
This FE identifies the time when the Agent installs the New entity.
The New entity is the person or thing that the Agent sets to fill a Role.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics or states of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in placing the New filler in a position.
The extent to which the New entity is affected by the Agent. Degrees of replacement are generally only possible when there are multiple New and Old entities.
The entity that formerly occupied the position.
The category that the New and Old entities fit into as a result of the function they serve.

In this frame an Informer informs the Authorities of the illegal or otherwise improper Behavior of the Wrongdoer. Tony reported Michael to the police for breaking into his car . The teacher reported the bathroom vandalism .
The Informer reports the activities of the Wrongdoer to the Authorities.
The Wrongdoer has his or her activities reported to the Authorities.
The Authorities are the officials, government or otherwise, who handle misbehavior.
The Behavior is the action or actions for which the Wrongdoer is reported.
The Time when the Informer reports the Behavior of the Wrongdoer.
The Place is the location where the reporting occurs.
The Purpose is the purpose for which the Informer reports the Wrongdoer.

An Entity represents some Phenomenon through its existence and/or defining characteristics. Sometimes a Cognizer, a people or group of people who believe in the representation, is expressed. A bear symbolizes strength in some cultures.
The event, idea, or emotion evoked by the Entity.
This FE describes the Degree to which the Entity represents the Phenomenon.
The time period in which the representing occurs.
This FE describes the means through which the representing occurs.
An object that has some association with a Phenomenon.
The Cognizer is the person or group of people who believe in the representation.
The Frequency denotes how often the Entity is associated with the Phenomenon.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the represenation logically follows.
The Place where the representing event occurs.
In this frame a Speaker asks an Addressee for something, or to carry out some action. The customer demanded a refund. I begged my parents to let me stay up late.
The Speaker, as in other communication frames, is generally an External Argument.
In this frame the Addressee can either occur as an NP Object (usually with a following complement clause) or as a PP Complement of verbs or nouns.
The Message is the content of the request that can be expressed as a quote, in a finite or non-finite clausal Complement, an NP Object or PP Complement.
The Topic is rarely expressed in this frame but can occur as a PP Complement headed by about.
The is the physical entity or channel used to transmit the Message. The Medium is frequently expressed as a PP Complement headed by on or in.
Manner indicates the manner in which the Message is delivered.
An act performed by the Speaker that results in a request being made and received.
The interval during which the Speaker makes the request.
This extra-thematic FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the occurrence of the event specified by the target predicate.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.

This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action. The depicted state does not necessarily or usually facilitate or cause the state of affairs reported by the target.

Unless a particular Required_situation obtains, Negative_consequences will follow. Alternatively, the Required_situation is required to achieve a Purpose (which avoids Negative_consequences). A set of Circumstances may be specified under which the requirement holds. You must turn in your test by 5 p.m. You better have that fixed by tomorrow or else we'll fire you. The book needs to be shorter to sell to such a young audience.
An event or state of affairs that results if the required Required_situation does not occur and which impacts some deprofiled entity in a way that the speaker finds undesirable.
The FE Circumstances encodes a setting, often temporal or spatial, within which the requirement holds.
The event or state of affairs that is achieved by bringing about the Required_situation and which entails the non-occurrance of Negative_consequences.
The period during which the Required_situation is necessary to prevent negative consequences.
The location within which the Required_situation is required.
The reason why the Required_situation is necessary.

The degree to which the Required_situation is necessary. The Degree may either imply a modification of the direness of the Negative_consequences, the probability of the Negative_consequences (if the Required_situation is not made to hold), or both.

One state of affairs, the Dependent, cannot occur without another state of affairs, the Requirement, also obtaining. This Requirement is construed to be under the control of some implicit force or actor. In an alternative construal, the Dependent state of affairs may be presented as depending on the presence of a Required_entity. Individual that profit from the occurrence of the Dependent state, Dependent_individuals, are backgrounded. The same goes for individuals (Required_individual) that are required to provide any Required_entity or to see to the occurrence of the Dependent state of affairs. The nexus between Requirement and Dependent can be qualified further in terms of the Degree of strength of the link between the two eventualities, the Place and Time where this nexus obtains, the Reason for its existence, or a specification of Condition when it applies.
The state-of-affairs which cannot hold without the Requirement.
The state-of-affairs that must be present or obtain in order for the Dependent to obtain.
The extent to which the Dependent depends on the presence of the Requirement.
The state-of-affairs which militates that the Requirement is necessary for the Dependent to obtain.
The time at which the Requirement is necessary for the Dependent.
The conditions under which the the Requirement is necessary.
The field of endeavor whose nature imposes the Requirement.
Place denotes a location in which the specified relation between Requirement and Dependent holds.
The individual in whose interest it is to have the Required_entity or for the Requirement state of affairs to obtain.
An entity that has to be present for the Dependent state of affairs to obtain
An individual that has to provide the Required_entity or see to it that the Requirement state of affairs holds.

A Researcher (an individual a group or institution) attempts to answer a Question by means of consulting literature, observation, or conducting experiments in a particular Field pertinent to the Question. The Question may be underspecified in the form of a Topic. Simmons and Nadel did research pertaining to Ardea purpurea and Egretta garzetta in 1998
The people engaged in a research endeavor.
A significant unanswered open proposition which the Researcher is attempting to resolve.
A phenomenon or idea involved in a Question.
The time when the research is carried out.
The experimentations, observations, or other procedures performed by the Researcher in order to find an answer to the Question.
A group of entities that are studied by the Researcher to answer the Question. The studied group need not be the only kind of entity that provides evidence for answering the research Question.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of the Researcher that also affect the action (deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
Purpose indicates an action that the Researcher intends to accomplish by performing research.
The Duration_of_state is the period of time over which the research takes place.
The physical place where the research is carried out.
The Type, or subclass of research.

In this frame an Deformer deforms an Undergoer possibly against a Resistant_surface such that it undergoes a shape-change from its canonical or original shape into the Result, a new shape. Some of these words indicate that the Result is an undesirable alteration of the norm, and in such cases the lexical unit is marked with the semantic type Negative. This frame does not include senses that specifically indicate causing harm to a living being. Ellen crumpled the paper into a ball. Michael flattened the can against his head. Mix butter and sardines very thoroughly , mashing them with a fork until you have a smooth paste. CNI A killer hurricane nearly flattened Sylvester Stallone's five luxury homes in Hawaii.
The Deformer is the one who does the reshaping.
This FE identifies the Instrument with which the Deformer affects the Undergoer.
The FE Manner identifies the manner in which an Deformer intentionally affects the Undergoer.
The FE Means identifies the means by which the Deformer intentionally affects the Undergoer.
The Undergoer is the entity acted on and that undergoes a change.
The Place indicates where the Deformer intentionally affects the Undergoer.
This FE identifies the purpose for which the Deformer intentionally affects the Undergoer.
The FE Time identifies when the Deformer intentionally affects the Undergoer.
The Result is the shape the Undergoer becomes.
The Resistant_surface is the surface against which a Deformer presses the Undergoer.
The Locus is the locus of the reshaping action; it is essentially a simultaneous Instrument and Resistant_surface.
The Cause is an animate or inanimate entity, a force, or event that produces an effect. Volitionality is not a necessary characteristic of Causes.
The FE Iterations indicates the number of times the reshaping has occurred.
The Reason indicates a state of affairs that the Deformer is responding to in performing the reshaping.
The degree to which the Undergoer is reshaped.
The part of the Undergoer which is directly affected by the reshaping.
This frame has to do with people (the Residents) residing in Locations, sometimes with a Co-resident. Peter lives in New York. Sue is an inhabitant of Los Angeles.
The individual(s) that reside at the Location.
The place in which somebody resides.
A person or group of people that the resident is staying with or among.
The state of a Resident during their residence.
An act of the Resident that enables them to reside in the Location.
This FE refers to the Time when the Resident resides.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
An Agent and their Action succeed or fail inasmuch as the result of an Action matches the Goal that they hope to bring about by the Action.
The Agent makes an attempt to achieve a Goal.
The Goal is what the Agent attempts to achieve.
This FE identifies the means by which the Goal is achieved (or not).
This FE identifies the Time when the attempt succeeds or fails.
The Depictive is a phrase which describes the Agent during the Action.
The place where an attempt succeeds or fails..
A participant function in a particular event or in events of a particular kind.
This FE is applied to expressions which indicate the prevailing physical conditions for the event, or some concurrent states of affairs.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the success or failure logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the success or failure, but not in all cases.

This FE denotes an event or state of affairs that occurs or holds at a time that includes the time during which the success or failure reported by the target occurs and of which the success or failure is taken to be a part.
The extent to which the Action succeeds or fails.

An Agent resolves an outstanding Problem by finding its solution, explanation, answer, etc. Alternatively, some non-agentive Cause may resolve the Problem. The Means, Degree, Time and Place may also be expressed. As it turns out, putting all of my eggs in one basket completely solved all of my problems. Students finally worked through all of the difficult problems by working together.
The Agent finds the solution or explanation to the outstanding mystery or Problem.
The Problem is the predicament or mystery that is resolved.
The Cause is the non-Agentive event or state of affairs that brings about the resolution of the Problem.
The Means is an intermediate action taken by the Agent in order to resolve the Problem.
This FE indicates the Time at which the Problem is resolved.
This FE indicates the location at which the Problem is resolved.
The Degree to which the Agent or Cause resolves the problem.

Any description of the resolution, such as secondary effects ( quietly ) or comparisons of events ( the same way ). In agentive cases, Manner may also describe salient characteristics of the Agent which affect the action. ( carefully, dilligently, deliberately etc. )
The Resultant_Situation is any situation which arises as a result of resolving a Problem .
The Outcome is the failure or success of resolving a Problem .
The Containing_Event denotes an event or state of affairs that occurs or holds at a time that includes the time during which the resolution of the Problem occurs.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Problem is resolved.
The Instrument is an entity used for resolving the Problem .
This FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the resolution of a Problem .
This FE identifies the length of time taken to resolve a Problem . The government resolved the beach ball crisis in just 22 hours.
Role is used for the capacity in which the Agent resolves a Problem or the role of the Problem in being resolved, and is expressed in as-PPs.
Frequency describes how often the Agent or Cause resolves this problem.
This FE identifies the physical or abstract setting in which the Problem is resolved.
A person who participates in resolving a Problem along with the Agent.
The state of affairs that the Agent is trying to bring about by solving the Problem in the specified way.

A Speaker addresses a Proposal made by an Interlocutor, either agreeing to it or rejecting it. Agreeing entails a social responsibility on the Speaker to bring about some state of affairs encoded in the Proposal. They were rebuffed again in the larger city of Provo. CNI Last month Mr Duisenberg delivered a sharp rebuff to Mr Welteke. He rebuffed Singh's every overture, relentlessly pursuing a cap on India's nuclear capability.
The Speaker is the person who communicates the reply or response.

This is the person who made the Proposal to the Speaker and to whom the Speaker communicates their response. This frame element stands in for the Proposal and is only licensed when the Proposal can be understood from the context.
As with Medium in other Communication frames, the physical entity or channel used to communicate can be expressed, usually as a PP Complement headed by "on" or "in".
The Proposal is the prior communication or action to which a response is given.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of the Speaker that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly).
This FE identifies the Meansby the Speaker responds to the Proposal.
The response may be prompted by either some outside phenomenon or occurrence, or by an Internal_cause, the Speaker mental or emotional state.
The location in which the Speaker makes a verbal response.
The time interval during which the Speaker makes their verbal response.
An action that the Speaker intends to accomplish by making a verbal response.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of response events.
Role denotes the capacity in which the Interlocutor is judged.
The Group is the set of people within which the Respond_to_proposal is occuring.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the success or failure logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the success or failure, but not in all cases.
An Agent performs a Response action in consequence of a Trigger event. In many cases, a non-agentive Responding_entity causes the Response after the Trigger occurs.
The means action whereby the Agent responds to the Trigger.
A non-agentive entity that is impinged upon by a Trigger event to which they respond.
An event that impinges upon the Agent or Responding_entity and produces a Response from it.
The point in time when the Agent or Responding_entitymanifests its Response to the Trigger.
A characterization of the Responding_entity, Agent, or their Response action.
The location in which the Response action takes place.
An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by performing the Response action.
The intentional Agent that is impinged upon by a Trigger event to which they respond.
A particular feature of the Responding_entity or Agent that is involved in the Response action.
The capacity of of the Agent is their Response act.
A Trigger elicits a Response by some Responding_entity or an Agent.
A non-agentive entity that is impinged upon by a Trigger event to which they respond.
An event that impinges upon the Agent or Responding_entity and produces a Response from it.
The means action whereby the Agent responds to the Trigger.
The intentional Agent that is impinged upon by a Trigger event to which they respond.
A characterization of the Responding_entity, Agent, or their Response action.
The location in which the Response action takes place.
An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by performing the Response action.
The point in time when the Agent or Responding_entitymanifests its Response to the Trigger.

One Part of a larger Whole has been mentioned, is inferrable, or is available in the discourse setting and the previously unmentioned part, the Rest, is now mentioned. The lenses , like the rest of the exoskeleton, are made of calcite. They see social policy work as a natural complement to bureau work.
A Part of a larger Whole that has been mentioned in prior discourse or is available in the discourse setting.
The previously unmentioned part of the Whole.
The larger entitiy or group that is fully made up of the Part and the Rest.
A Protagonist which had been dead returns to life. He'll come back from the dead at 11:03PM exactly, since that's what his suicide note indicated.
The being or entity that becomes living again.
The time at which the resurrection occurs.
An explanation of how the state-of-affairs came to pass.
The state of the Protagonist before resurrection.
The state of the Protagonist which results from resurrection.
The state of the Protagonist during the resurrection.
The location at which the Protagonist returns from the dead.

A Speaker reveals Information that was previously secret to an Addressee. In some cases, the Addressee is expected to keep the Information from other parties. The Information may be damaging to the reputation of the Speaker. Some lexical units in this frame imply that the Speaker has already been confronted with the Information. Could it be true that Martin himself was the one who spilled the beans on Pops and Brad's planned wedding?
The Speaker is the sentient entity that reveals the Information (whether spoken or written).
The Addressee is the person to whom the Information is revealed.
The Information is the FE that identifies the content of what the Speaker is revealing to the Addressee. It can be expressed as a clause or as a noun phrase.
The Topic is the subject matter about which the Speaker is speaking. It normally only appears with noun targets, or in special constructions.

Any description of the revelation which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Speaker that also affect the revelation (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully, maliciously).
The degree to which Information is revealed.
An act whereby the Speaker makes a revelation.
The emotional or physical state of the Speaker that leads to the revelation.
Medium is the physical entity or channel used by the Speaker to transmit the statement.
The state of the Speaker during the statement.
The time when the revelation is made.
The FE specifies the place where the Information is revealed.
An alternative description of expressed action

This frame element is used to indicate the location of a participant in cases where the multiple participants of an event are not co-located in the typical fashion. In Release 1.2, this FE has various frame-specific names including Location of perceiver, or Location of participant; it was even (incorrectly) labelled Place in some frames.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
The medium in which the secret Information origninally resided.
In general, this FE is used for phrases that describe the clause of the target as a whole especially any descriptions of the state of affairs denoted by the target as role fillers in other frames.
This FE describes the length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.
Frequency is defined as the number of times the Reveal_secret event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question "how often."
A characteristic of the revealed secret.

This frame concerns the infliction of punishment in return for a wrong suffered. An Avenger performs a Punishment on a Offender as a consequence of an earlier action by the Offender, the Injury. The Avenger inflicting thePunishment need not be the same as the Injured_Party who suffered the Injury, but the Avenger does have to share the judgment that the Offender's action was wrong. The judgment that the Offender had inflicted an Injury is made without regard to the law. (1) They took revenge for the deaths of two loyalist prisoners. (2) Lachlan went out to avenge them. (3) The next day, the Roman forces took revenge on their enemies..
The Avenger exacts revenge from the Offender for the Injury.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an event occurs.
Depictive identifies a phrase describing the actor of an action.
The Offender has committed the earlier Injury for which the Avenger seeks revenge.
This FE identifies the Instrument with which the revenge is performed.
This frame element refers to the Manner in which the Avenger exacts their revenge from the Offender.
The Avenger carries out a Punishment in order to exact revenge on the Offender.
This FE identifies the Place where the revenge occurs.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which the revenge is performed.
The Injury is the injurious action committed by the Offender against the Injured_Party. This Frame Element need not always be realized, although it is conceptually necessary.
This FE identifies the Result of inflicting punishment for a wrong suffered.
This FE identifies the Time when the revenge occurs.

This frame element identifies the constituent that encodes who or what suffered the Injury at the hands of the Offender. Sometimes, an abstract concept such a person's honour or their blood is presented as the element that has suffered the Injury. These also constitute instances of Injured_Party
The length of time that the Avenger seeks revenge for the Injury.

An Agent (the punisher or rewarder) performs a Response_action on an Evaluee for a Reason, the Evaluee's actions or beliefs. Means and Instrument may also be indicated. The goal of the punishment/reward is to discourage/encourage the actions or beliefs. Words in this frame presuppose that a judgment of the Evaluee has occurred and that the Evaluee is (or becomes) aware of the judgment. This judgment was performed by a cognizer which is either the same as the Agent, or, minimally, a representative of the same institution. His punishment of the prisoners was too harsh. Her punishment was too harsh. The penalty for this crime is death. I believe that this behaviour should be subject to disciplinary action.
Evaluee is the person or thing about whom/which a judgment has made and to whom reward/punishment is dealt. With verbs, the Evaluee is typically expressed as Object.
Manner of performing the reward or punishment.
The action that is taken that results in punishement/reward.
Typically, there is a constituent expressing the Reason for theAgent's judgment. It is usually a 'for'-PP, e.g.
Result of the reward or punishment.
The Agent is the person doing the rewarding or punishing.
The Instrument with which the reward or punishment is carried out.
The Purpose of the reward or punishment.
The reward or punishment given to the Evaluee by the Agent.
Depictive phrase describing the Agent of the reward or punishment.

In this frame a Theme is moved by a Vehicle which is not directly under their power. The Source, Path, Goal, or Area of the motion may be indicated. The Distance traveled or the Speed of motion may also be indicated. A Route or Roadmay be present and the Manner in which the Theme moves may be given. Mrs. Smith rode on the train. Sally flew 3000 miles from San Francisco to New York. Every day, Martin rode the bus on highway 880. Mr. Bigglesworth rides route 51. There is shared vocabulary between this frame and Carrying and Operate_vehicle. It is differentiated from Operate_vehicle in that the vehicle is not under the subject's control. It is differentiated from Carrying because the vehicle is not being used to transport goods.
The Theme is the entity which moves by means of the Vehicle.
The Vehicle is the means of conveyance of the Theme. It is usually expressed in a PP-complement or the direct object.
Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion expresses the frame element Source.
The Manner describes a property of the motion not related to its trajectory.
The Path describes the trajectory of the motion.
The Goal is the endpoint of the trajectory of motion.
The Distance is the extent of the motion.
The Duration is the amount of time the motion takes.
The Speed is the rate at which the motion occurs.
The Area is the location where the motion takes place.
The Road is the thoroughfare on which the Vehicle travels.
The Route is the usual path that the Vehicle travles.
The state of the Theme or Vehicle during the motion.
A theme that rides in the same Vehicle as the main Theme.
The Purpose for which the Theme rides a vehicle.

A Protagonist, by exerting great effort, comes to meet the pre-conditions for participating in an Activity that is judged to be difficult for them to participate in, either due to their inherent properties or due to temporary Circumstances. In conclusion, our staff rose to the challenge in developing the necessary training programs and delivery methods. Dr Runcie rose to the occasion with a simple address. DNI There was still clearly much to do, but the governor and his staff had begun to rise to the task. Pacers say they'll rise to the pressure.
The Protagonist who is exerting effort to meet the pre-conditions for participating in the Activity.
The Activity that the Protagonist expends efforts towards.
The extent to which the Protagonist exceeds or falls short of the minimum requirements for participating in the Activity as a result of expending effort to get themselves ready.
The Circumstances under which the Protagonist exerts effort to meet the pre-conditions necessary for engaging in the Activity.
An entity, event, or state of affairs that causes the Protagonist to expend the effort necessary to meet the pre-conditions for participating in the Activity.
A characteristic or behavior of the Protagonist that is considered when judging whether the Protagonist might participate in the Activity.
An action performed by the Protagonist which enables them to overcome the difficulties and engage in the Activity.
The time at which the Protagonist through expenditure of effort becomes capable of engaging in the Activity.
The location in which the Protagonist expends effort to become capable of engaging in the Activity.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Protagonist that also affect the action (eagerly).
An Asset is in a particular Situation, which has a likelihood of leading to or inviting a Harmful_event which will negatively affect the Asset.
Something judged to be desirable or valuable which might be lost or damaged.
An event that may occur or a state which may hold which could result in the loss of or damage to the Asset.
The Situation under which the Asset is safe or unsafe.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the actual level of security from the expected value given the Asset, the Situation, and state indicated by the target itself.
The Time during which the degree of safeness holds.
The Place at which the degree of safeness holds.

A particular Situation is likely (or unlikely) to result in a harmful event befalling an Asset. The Situation may be a state, an activity, or some focal entity that must be inferred to be part of some larger Situation involving both it and the Asset. Although the idea of a harmful event is crucial to the understanding of this frame, it is not expressible as an argument of the LUs in this frame. Is climate change dangerous for mankind? Customers can make complaints about unsafe products. The primary risk is to our infrastructure. See the Run_risk frame for discussion on differentiation regarding the noun risk.
The Situation which may lead to a harmful event.
Something judged to be desirable or valuable which might be lost or damaged.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the actual level of security from the expected value given the Situation and the state indicated by the target itself.
A particular location for which the Situation is safe. Frequently, it is to be inferred that the characteristics of the location make various Situations safe or unsafe.
The time period during which the Situation has the specified level of safety.
The Domain in which the Situation is safe.
A concrete or abstract entity which may come to cause the loss of, or damage to the Asset.
How often the Asset encounters the Risky_situation.
The Circumstances in which an Asset is at risk.

This frame concerns rituals performed in line with religious beliefs or tradition. In certain fertility rites in Burma , a woman desirous of offspring is required not only to approach the King Cobra but to plant a kiss on its mouth . He was ordered a priest in 1944. CNI
This is the religious or cultural leader who performs and/or leads the rite.
The FE Member describes the member of the religious or cultural group who participates in/undergoes the rite.
Organization identifies the institution in which the rite is prescribed.
The action that is taken to perform the ritual.
This FE identifies the Instrument used to perform a particular rite.
This FE identifies the state which the rite is hoped or intended to bring about.
The type of ritual or ceremony being performed.
This FE indicates an object on which a rite is performed.
Rites may confer a New_Status on a participant (e.g. rank, membership).
The Guardian is the member of the Organization who instigates the rite for someone of which they are a guardian.

This frame involves stable Roadways which connect two stable Endpoints, the Source and the Goal. Being physical objects, these Roadways may have Names and Characteristics; they are also made of a Material. They also cover ground, so they may have a Path or a Relative_location that the travel occurs in. We crossed the brick road. I prefer to travel on highway I-80. This is the only highway between Lodi and Sonoma. She dreaded turning onto the busy street.
The Roadway is the roadway that connects locations.
The Source is one of the Endpoints treated as a source.
The Goal is one of the Endpoints of the Roadway treated as a goal.
The Endpoints are two (or more) named endpoints of the Roadway.
The Characteristic is a characteristic(s) of the Roadway.
The Name is the name of the Roadway.
This is the setting through which the Roadway goes.
The Use is the purpose of the Roadway.
The Direction is the direction or directions the Roadway runs.
The Relative_location is where the Roadway is located.
The Material is what the Roadway is constructed from.
The Frequency_of_use is the state of the Roadway with regard to the number of people who are using the Roadway or typically use it.
The Abundant_entities are the entities which occupy the space denoted by the Roadway.
The Length is the distance the Roadway extends.

These are words describing situations in which a Perpetrator wrongs a Victim by taking something (Goods) from them. In some cases, the Source location from which the Goods were taken is used to metonymically refer to the Victim. The robbery can be done in a particular Manner (for example, forcefully) and via a specific Means (for example, by threatening the Victim). Half of the team held up the tellers while the others were stationed to report the arrival of police. As opposed to Theft, Robbery focuses on the harm to the Victim and on the Source location from which the Goods have been removed, rather than the Goods themselves.
The Perpetratoris the person (or other agent) that takes the Goods away by force or threats.
The Victim is the person (or other sentient being or group) that owns the Goods before they are taken away by the Perpetrator.
The Goods are anything (including labor, time, or legal rights) that can be taken away.
Source is the initial location of the goods, before they change location.
The Means indicates the means by which the Robbery takes place.
The Manner describes the way in which the Robbery took place.
The Place is where the Robbery occurs.
The Time indicates when the Robbery occurs.
The action that the Perpetrator is trying to accomplish by the robbery.
The state of affairs that the Perpetrator has in mind which leads to the decision to commit the robbery.
The number of times a robbery event occurs.
Co_participant denotes a person that participates in a coordinated way in robbery event as the primary protagonist, the Perpetrator.
An Agent manipulates a linear entity (the Rope) to form a Knot. Harry tied the rope into a slipknot. Patty and Selma knotted the ties of their aprons.
The Agent is the sentient being who manipulates the Rope.
The Instrument with which the Rope is manipulated.
Where the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
The Purpose for which the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
When the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
The Means by which the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
The Reason for which the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
The basically linear object which is manipulated by the Agent to produce a Knot.
The stable configuration of a Rope which results from tying.
Manner in which the manipulation of the Rope takes place.
Where the manipulation of the Rope takes place.

In this frame an Undergoer, which is an organic substance, undergoes the natural process of decaying from an Initial_state to a Result. The leaves rotted into a mass of slime. The dresses decayed from their former beauty.
The Undergoer is the entity that undergoes a change.
The Place is where the rotting occurs.
The Time indicates when the rotting occurs.
The Reason indicates the reason for which the Undergoer rots.
The Result is the result of the change of phase of the Undergoer.
The Initial_state is the original state of the Undergoer.
The Duration indicates the amount of time for which the Undergoer rots.
The Speed is the rate at which the Undergoer changes.
The Subregion describes which part of a larger whole is being affected.
The Degree expressions that indicate to what degree the Undergoer has changed.
The number of times that a rotting event takes place.

Any description of the Rotting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (horribly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
A state of affairs that entails the Undergoer decaying.

An Authority with the power to make decisions hands down a Finding over a question presented in a formal or informal Case. The judge ruled yesterday that the revisions were not adequate. DNI A high court in London ruled on the case that a vulture fund can extract more than $20 million from Zambia for a debt. In the California case, a judge ruled Oct. 12 that Tendler must pay the bloggers' legal fees.
The Authority (which may be the jury, judge, magistrate or court) decides on the Finding.
This FE identifies the outcome of the Authority's deliberation or consideration.
This FE describes the question on which the Authority gives a Finding.
When the Authority gives his Finding.
This FE indicates the basis in law of a Finding.
The Circumstances under which the ruling was reached.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Authority acts.
This FE identifies the purpose why the Authority returns a particular Finding.
This FE identifies an action that the Authority performs in order to return the verdict.

This FE presents the current frame as an integral part of a larger conceptualization expressed by another frame. The frame expressed by the target typically corresponds to a Means action within the frame expressed by the Re_encoding, but not necessarily

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
The domain within which the ruling event is considered to be true.
The amount of time that a Finding holds.

A Protagonist is described as being exposed to a potentially dangerous situation that may end in a Bad_outcome for him- or herself. An Asset which is in danger of loss may stand in for the Bad_outcome. There is no implication that the Protagonist intentionally exposes themselves to the risky situation. The Protagonist may be attempting to achieve some Purpose, which involves being in a dangerous situation. The Severity of risk involved may also be expressed. There was a risk of fire. Original thinkers incur greater risks to their careers than their pedestrian colleagues. NOTE: This Frame is currently in the process of being changed so that some instances of at risk.n will be moved to the Being_at_risk frame, and some will be moved to the Risky_situation frame. In the Being_at_risk frame, risk is almost always supported with at, and its external argument is the Asset. Risky_situation uses of risk include the following: Smoking poses a risk to your health. Smoking is a health risk. The most imminent risk is to our infrastructure. but (possibly ; still under discussion) not: The most imminent RISK is that our infrastructure may not be able to handle the load. In the Risky_situation frame, the external argument is the Situation, and the Bad_outcome in not expressible. The verb risk.v will remain in the Run_risk frame, in the sense of he risked his life for his country. The construction run risk also will remain in the Run_risk frame.
The person who is at risk of some Bad_outcome
The place where there is risk.
The probability of something bad happening to the Protagonist.
The time when the risk pertains.
A situation that the Protagonist would like to avoid.
Something desirable possessed by or directly associated with the Protagonist which might be lost or damaged.
The Action that creates the risk.
The Frequency with which the Protagonist runs risks.
The desired action or goal that the Protagonist hopes to bring about.
An Explanation for why the Protagonist has put the Assetis in a dangerous situation.
The number of times that the Protagonist risks an Asset.
The Circumstances indicates the state of affairs under which the risky situation holds.
The Protagonist intends for his/her actions to benefit Beneficiary in some way.

This frame describes an Agent or an Entity that does or does not meet a Standard. Alternatively, an action or occurrence may be construed as an Event that meets or fails to meet the Standard. Will my coursework satisfy the requirements for admission? He satisfied his son's wish by buying him a Wii.
The volitional Agent who is in line with a Standard.
The non-agentive Entity that is in line with a Standard.
An occurrence or action that brings about the satisfaction or nonsatisfaction of a Standard.
The condition or requirement that the Agent, Entity, or Event satisfy (or not).
The Manner in which the Standard is satisfied.
The Means by which the Standard is satisfied.
The Time in which satisfaction of the Standard occurs.

The Quantity of a Collection occurring in a Place has a particular Measure, which is related to the amount generally needed. There is evidence that volatile materials have always been scarce on the Moon . A global effort to tackle water scarcity is getting underway. INI It is the scarceness of these precious metals that adds to their luster. INI
The Collection whose Quantity is under consideration.
The feature of an Collection which is under discussion. This FE is incorporated by all the lexical units in this frame.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Measure from the norm or from the value for another Collection.
The Time during which the Collection is in the state of having a particular Measure for the Quantity.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Collection has a particular Measure for the Quantity.
The measure of the Quantity, which is incorporated by the lexical units.
The location in which the Collection occurs.

An Event is described in terms of the diversity of entities that are affected or considered in the Event. Alternatively a Salient_entity which enables or brings about the Event can be similarly described. The U.S. government believes that China has not revealed the full scope of its program. A key question is how U.S. deployment of ballistic missile defense will affect the pace and scope of Chinese strategic modernization.
The state-of-affairs that affects a set of entities.
The feature of an Salient_entity which is under discussion.
The entity which enables or causes the Event being judged.

A Searcher looks all over a Ground in order to find a Sought_entity. The Sought_entity is not presupposed to exist. The search activity is not concerned with the state of the Ground, which is the case in the Inspecting frame, but only with the finding of the Sought_entity, which is desirable. The newcomers combed the area looking for minerals Scientists scoured the ice samples for signs of life. Mulder rummaged through his toilet kit for a plastic razor.
The person who is looking all over the Ground for the Sought_entity.
The location that the Searcher covers in looking for the Sought_entity.
The entity that the Searcher wants to find.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Searcher scrutinizes the Ground.
This FE specifies the length of the interval during which the scouring activtiy takes place.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the Searcher scrutinizes the Ground.
An entity manipulated by the Searcher to examine the Ground.
The action of the Searcher that allows them to search the Ground.
The state-of-affairs that the Searcher hopes to bring about by searching a Ground.
The Time when the Searcher scoures the Ground.
A Cognizer examines a Ground closely, alert to the presence of a Phenomenon.
The Cognizer pays attention to an entity in order to discover something about it.
The Cognizer pays attention to the Ground, so named because it serves as the background or context for the Phenomenon.
The entity that the Cognizer is alert for in the Ground.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Cognizer scrutinizes the Ground.
The action of the Cognizer which allows them to scrutinize the Ground.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the Cognizer scrutinizes the Ground.
The event that the Cognizer hopes to bring about by looking for the Phenomenon.
An entity directed by the Cognizer that interacts with the Ground to accomplish the scrutiny.

This frame concerns a Cognizer (a person or other intelligent being) paying close attention to something, the Ground, in order to discover and note its salient characteristics. The Cognizer may be interested in a particular characteristic or entity, the Phenomenon, that belongs to the Ground or is contained in the Ground (or to ensure that such a property of entity is not present). Some words in this frame allow alternate expressions of the Groundand the Phenomenon: We searched the yard for my contact lens.
The Cognizer pays attention to an entity in order to discover something about it. The FE is normally expressed as an External Argument:
The Cognizer pays attention to the Ground, so named because it serves as the background or context for the Phenomenon. This FE can be expressed as an NP Object or as a PP Complement.
Phenomenon identifies the property that belongs to an entity or that the entity contains. Typically, it is expressed as a for-PP.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Cognizer scrutinizes the Ground.
This FE is used for the Means by which the Cognizer to scrutinize the Ground.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the Cognizer scrutinizes the Ground.
Direction is used for all path-like expressions, except those indicating the location of the perceiver, that describe how the perceiver's attention is directed during the act of perception.
Some of the words in this frame occur with a constituent that expresses the desired outcome of the Scrutiny. Normally this constituent is a PP Complement headed by for or a to-marked VP Complement.
The Medium is the piece of text or work in which the Cognizer pays attention to an entity in order to discover something about it. The FE is normally expressed as an External Argument:
An entity directed by the Cognizer that interacts with the Ground to accomplish the scrutiny.
The Time when the Cognizer is scrutinizing the Ground.
A Cognizer seeks a Phenomenon within the Ground.
The Cognizer pays attention to the Ground in order to find instances of a type of Phenomenon.
The Cognizer pays attention to the Ground, so named because it serves as the background or context for the Phenomenon.
The entity that the Cognizer is alert for in the Ground.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Cognizer scrutinizes the Ground.
The action of the Cognizer which allows them to scrutinize the Ground.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the Cognizer scrutinizes the Ground.
The event that the Cognizer hopes to bring about by looking for the Phenomenon.
An entity directed by the Cognizer that interacts with the Ground to accomplish the scrutiny.

A Phenomenon, which may be an activity, state or object, is purposefully hidden from the awareness of a potential Cognizer. The person responsible for the hiding of the Phenomenon is not part of this frame and cannot be syntactically realized. The potential Cognizer may be realized, but is in fact rarely expressed. A period of Time during which the Phenomenon is secret may be indicated. Few people would use ATMs if the content of their transaction was secret from their bank and there was no paper trail verifying the transaction. . The protesters were not on her list, and weren't allowed in, despite the fact that the meeting was public. Student disciplinary matters are confidential and should only be discussed with appropriate university officials
The Phenomenon is the activity, state or object that is purposefully hidden from the awareness of a potential cognizer.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the Phenomenon is hidden from cognizers.
A period of Time during which the Phenomenon is hidden from the awareness of potential cognizers.
The Cognizer is the person who might become aware of the Phenomenon if it was not concealed.

This FE modifies the target to indicate the legal- or "by rule" domain within which it is true or operational. This legal domain is in contrast to reality, which may or may not reflect the "official" state-of-affairs. This FE can be realized in words like "formally" and"officially" plus maybe "technically" and "in law."

A Cognizer_agent attempts to find some Sought_entity by examining some Ground. The success or failure of this activity (the Outcome) may be indicated. NB: This frame should be compared to the Scrutiny frame, in which the primary focus is on the Ground.
The person who attempts to find the Sought_entity. John looked for his pencil.

This is the entity to which the Cognizer pays attention. It is referred to as Ground because it serves as the background or context for the Phenomenon. This FE can be expressed as an NP Object or as a PP Complement: Leslie examined the glass for cracks. Kim searched in the woods for mushrooms.

This is the entity that the Ground may contain. Typically, it is expressed as afor-PP. Leslie examined the glass for cracks. Kim searched in the woods for mushrooms. Some words in this frame allow alternate expressions of the Ground and the Sought_entity: We searched the yard for my contact lens. We searched for my contact lends in the yard.
An act of the Cognizer_agent that allows them to look for the Sought_entity.
The failure or success of an attempt.
A spatial setting larger than the Ground in which the Seeking event occurs.
This FE identifies the time when the Seeking occurs.
An action that the Cognizer intends to accomplish by performing the search.
This FE identifies the amount of effort put into an attempt.

An Agent intends and takes steps towards bringing about a State_of_affairs or, metonymically, towards acquiring a Sought_entity . Libya sought nuclear weapons in the 1960s. North Korea sought several billion dollars in cash from the US during bilateral missile talks. The talks in Berlin ended without agreement after Bora Bora sought to link large-scale economic assistance to joint recovery operations. India had sought her extradition for forging documents to procure a passport.
The Agent makes an attempt to achieve a State_of_affairs or to obtain a Sought_entity.
The entity that the Agent attempts to acquire.
The Outcome is the failure or success of an attempt to acquire a Sought_entity.
This FE identifies the Means by which an attempt at achieving a State_of_affairs or at acquiring the Sought_entity is made.
This FE identifies the amount of effort put into an attempt.
This FE identifies the Time when the attempt occurs.
The Depictive is a phrase which describes the Agent.
The place where the Agent is seeking to achieve a particular State_of_affairs or to acquire a Sought_entity.
The Manner in which the Agent makes the attempt.
The time period over which the attempts at achieving a State_of_affairs or acquiring the Sought_entity take place.
An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by bringing about a particular State_of_affairs or acquiring the Sought_entity.
A state or event that the Agent wants to bring about. The Agent may but need not be a participant in that State_of_affairs.
A proposition from which the occurrence of the seeking event follows.
An individual or organization that helps the Agent bring about the State_of_affairs or delivers the Sought_entity to the Agent.
This FE introduces the underlying situation(s) in which seeking occurs.
This FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the Sought_entity or State_of_affairs .
The Self_mover, a living being, moves under its own power in a directed fashion, i.e. along what could be described as a Path, with no separate vehicle.
Self_mover is the living being which moves under its own power. Normally it is expressed as an external argument.

Source is used for any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion. In prepositional phrases, the prepositional object expresses the starting point of motion. With particles, the starting point of motion is understood from context.
Path is used for any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal. This includes "middle of path'' expressions.
Goal is used for any expression which tells where the Self_mover ends up as a result of the motion.

Any expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory or rate of motion expresses the frame element Manner. Descriptions of steadiness, grace, means of motion, and other things count as Manner expressions.
Any expression which characterizes the extent of motion expresses the frame element Distance.

Area is used for expressions which describe a general area in which motion takes place when the motion is understood to be irregular and not to consist of a single linear path. Note that this FE should not be used for cases when the same phrase could be used with the same meaning with a non-motion target, since these should be annotated with the Place FE.
The time when the motion occurs.
An entity whose motion is correlated with that of the Self_mover, following and tracking the Self_mover, being followed and tracked, or with both parties mutually matching Paths.
The rate at which the location of the Self_mover changes with respect to time.
Depictive phrase describing the actor of an action
An act whereby the Self_mover achieves movement.
The emotional or mental state of the Self_mover which motivates them toward motion or the particular manner of motion.
The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
This FE identifies the purpose for which a Self_mover moves.

The Place is the location within which a defined motion takes place. Any specified or implied Source, Path or Goal should designate a location contained with the Place. This FE can be differentiated from Area by the fact that the annotated phrase can be used in the same meaning with non-motion targets.
The state of affairs that leads to the particular motion that the Self_mover adopts.
External_cause is something in the external environment that causes the Self_mover to move.
The direction that the Self_mover heads in during the motion.

The label Coordinated_event is to be used for phrases denoting an event-it does not allow states-that the Traversing is rhythmically aligned with. The Coordinated_event is conceived of as independent: it would occur regardless of the event expressed by the target, which is not even an incidental or optional sub-part of the Coordinated_event.
The shape of the overall Path travelled by the Self_mover.
An event or circumstance that would not be expected given the nature of the particular Self_motion event.

A Sender plans the Path (along with Source and Goal) of a Theme and places it in circumstances such that it travels along this Path under the power of some entity other than the Sender. This frame also has a Recipient distinct from the Goal, as both can be present: I sent the manuscript to England to Bill. I forwarded the grain to a dealer in Frankfurt. This frame contains verbs that participate in the ditransitive construction, with a recipient as the direct object, as in the following: I sent Bill the manuscript. Certain Verbs in this Frame focus on the initial sending act, while others do not. For example, I sent it rapidly can either mean the act of sending was initiated quickly or that it moved quickly. However, the in following sentence: I exported/dispatched it rapidly, meaning that the act was begun quickly, both types of verbs are included.
This is the person who initiates the movement of the Theme and, unlike Carrying, does not accompany it.
Path along which movement occurs. I shipped the books along Interstate 65.
The end of the path and intended goal of the sending. I sent the logs to the shed.
The beginning of the path, similar to source except that it serves to define the path. I sent wood from Illinois to California.
The objects being sent. I mailed the books to Alaska. Note that Theme may be multiply instantiated. They maileda questionnaire with a return envelope.
The mode of sending employed. I shipped the crops by bigrig .
Depictive phrase describing the Sender or Theme
This FE is any expression characterizing the extent of motion of the Theme. Pat threw the Javelin 50 meters.
This is the recipient of the sent Theme. Tess mailed a letter to Abby
An additional theme sent along with the main Theme.
A container in which the Theme is sent.
A spatial setting encomnpassing the Source location, where the Sending event takes place.

This frame contains nouns that refer to sensations in different modalities. The FE Source is used for the phenomenon that gives rise to the sensation in question. The FE Percept is used for the characteristic quality of the sensation. In cases of veridical perception these are not typically distinguished from one another; we use the FE Percept as the default in these cases. With some nouns in this frame it is possible to express the being who experiences the sensation, or the part of the body of such a being. We mark such expressions with the FEs Perceiver_passive and Body_part, respectively. (The -passive part of this label serves to distinguish this FE from the Perceiver-Agentive FE used in other frames.)
This FE is only expressed with certain nouns in this frame, and then only with the help of a support verb, such as have:

This is the entity or phenomenon which gives rise to the sensation. In cases of veridical sensation, this FE is not typically distinguished from Percept. Most of the phrases that express this FE can be paraphrased as from-phrases, e.g.

The FE Percept is used for phrases that express the characteristic property of a sensation. Typically this characteristic property is described with reference to the entity or phenomenon that produces the sensation---that is why this FE can be difficult to distinguish from Source. It is possible for Source and Percept to be expressed separately, however:

This FE is assigned to phrases expressing the body part in which a sensation is located. Since touch is the least localized of sense modalities, words relating to haptic sensations are the ones most likely to occur with this FE:
A characterization of the sensation not covered by a more specific FE.
This FE is the perceptual background against which the Phenomenon is experienced by the Perceiver.
The Time when the sensation is perceived.
This FE describes how strong the sensation is.

A Sent_item is prepared for, received after, or involved in a process of Sending, which may involve a particular kind of Transport_means. The Sent_item has an (intended or actual) Sender and Recipient (or a Source and Goal). As a physical object, the Sent_item can be located in a Place. The shipment from Romania is destined for the Iraqi Police Forces. Postage became more affordable and mail to the President gradually increased. I 'll arrange for her to collect Bertha 's mail. i am looking for a penpal for email or snail mail. He had plenty of time to read all his fan mail from Australia while there.
This is the person or organization who initiates the movement of the Sent_item and, unlike in the case of Carrying, does not accompany it.
The end of the path and intended goal of the sending.
The beginning of the path, similar to source except that it serves to define the path.
This is the recipient of the sent Sent_item
When an interaction with the Sent_item occurs.
The place in which the Sent_item is located.
Any characterizations or evaluations of the the Sent_item that introduce another frame, in which the Sent_item figures.
During a court appearance, a Sentence, generally a punishment, is imposed on the Convict by a Court, usually represented by a judge.
The Convict is given a Sentence by the Court.
The Court imposes a Sentence on a Convict.
The Sentence is imposed on the Convict by the Court.
This FE denotes the type of sentence.
This FE denotes the duration of the sentence.
The Time when the Convict is sentenced.
The illegal action of which the Convict has been found guilty and for which they are punished.
The location of the sentencing Court.
The state that the Convict is in at the time of their sentencing.

These words refer to separating a Whole into Parts, or separating one part from another. The separation is made by an Agent or Cause and may be made on the basis of some Criterion. I divided the class into groups in alphabetical order .
The Whole is a single entity or an aggregate of entities which is separated into Parts. It is usually the NP Object of a target verb.
This refers collectively to the Parts resulting from separation of a Whole:
Part-1 is the first of two Parts mentioned. This is most often the Object of a verb.
Part_2 is the second of two Parts mentioned. This is usually a PP Complement. First,
With causative uses of these verbs, an Agent separates or divides something. The Agent is usually expressed as the External Argument:

This frame element expresses a property of the Parts or components of the Whole which is used as the basis for separation. Criterion is typically expressed as a PP headed by by, or as a complex PP of the form on the basis of....
This FE identifies any Depictive phrase describing the Agent who separates or the undergoers of the separation.
An act of the Agent that accomplishes the separation.
This FE identifies the Result of an event.
The Cause is the non-agent that brings about the separation.
The Recipients are the groups who come into possession of the Parts of the Whole.
This FE identifies the Time when the separation occurs.
The Instrument used to cause the separation.

The words in this frame describe entities that occur in some temporally-ordered sequence. The entities thus have some sort of relation between them that might be described by the Relative_time frame. However, at this time, this frame has no Frame Relation with that frame (though this is still under discussion). Additionally, it should be noted that the words in this frame have a metaphorical link to the words in Shape. Describe in detail the sequence of steps taken during an emergency.
This entity occurs in some sequence with Entity2.
This entity occurs in some sequence with respect to Entity1.
Entities that occur in some temporal order.
A characterization of the sequence in which the entities occur.

A group of Component_entities along with their interrelations is viewed as a Complex. By definition, no external forces act upon an isolated system of particles. Earth is a contained system which receives energy from the sun.
The entities that function together as a unit.
The unit formed by the Component_entities.
Any characterization or evaluation of the Complex.
A person or organization that possesses or owns the Complex or a larger entity of which the Complex itself is a part.
A Superset has several members, a part of which is the Subset. This frame exists largely for the purposes of inheritance.
The Superset is the larger collection of entities that includes the Subset.
The Subset comprises a part of the Superset.
Any description of the inclusion event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
The Time at which the set relation holds.
The location at which the set relation holds.
This frame describes either the creation of a Flame by a Kindler or the igniting of Flammables by a Kindler. Taliban militants recently set fire to several schools. The fire ignited.
The Kindler is the person performing the intentional act.
The Flame is what is created by the Kindler.
The Flamables is the the object that is set on fire by the Kindler.
This FE identifies the Time when the event occurs.
This FE identifies the Place where the event takes place.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of a Kindler that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An event brought about by the Cause or the Kindler that actually makes the Flammables catch fire.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
This FE describes the Kindler as being in some state during the action.

A Self_mover begins a journey at a Source location, in a particular Directiongenerally setting out with an Intended_goal in mind. At about 1:00 in the morning, climbers set out for the summit. The expedition set out from Granada early in March, leaving only one hundred men to garrison the fort which overlooks the city. After that the earl set out south with his host, and Kari went with him, and Njal's sons too.
This is the entity which moves under its own power.

Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion expresses the frame element Source. In prepositional phrases, the prepositional object expresses the starting point of motion. In particles, the starting point of motion is understood from context.
A relation to a landmark that describes the trajectory in the midst of the motion. (It is thus neither a Source nor the Intended_goal.)
Any expression which tells where the Self_mover intends to end up as a result of the motion.

Any expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion expresses the frame element Manner. Descriptions of steadiness, grace, means of motion, and other things count as Manner expressions.
An event involving the Self_mover that results in the Self_mover moving in the specified way.
The Speed is the rate at which the Self_mover moves.
A second moving object which the Self_mover moves to follow.
The state of the Self_mover during the action.
The Place is where the motion (which is specified by a Source, Path or Goal) is located.
The configuration formed by the entire Path of the Self_mover, taken simultaneously.
The direction in which the Self_mover goes.
The time at which the motion takes place.
The state-of-affairs that the Self_mover wishes to bring about.
The device or bodypart that serves to move the Self_mover.
The length of time that the Self_mover spends away from the Source.
The state of the Self_mover at the end of the event.
A factor which explains the particular motion or manner of motion of the Self_mover.

An event paired with the motion, which explains why the motion is expected. In particular, Reciprocation is used to indicate an action that is being rewarded or punished by the motion, and/or is paired with the motion as the other side of an agreement.
An event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at the time of departure and which the departure is taken to be a part of.
The number of times that an action occurs in a given time.
A larger conceptualization that includes the departing as an integral part. The departure expressed by the target typically corresponds to a Means action in this larger conceptualization.
An unexpected event that affects some agent (usually the Self_mover), which is enabled by, and occurs after, the departing.

The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the departing event itself and any of its participants, and is merely peripherally related to the event as a whole.

The label Coordinated_event is to be used for phrases denoting an event (it does not allow states) that the departing is rhythmically aligned with. (This would then further require that the departing be iterated.) The Coordinated_event is conceived of as independent: it would occur regardless of the event expressed by the target, which is not even an incidental or optional sub-part of the Coordinated_event.
The distance from the Source that the Self_mover ends up.
In this frame an Offense is described in terms of the legal or other punishing action that can be taken in response to the offense. He committed an indictable crime .
The Offense is the action, crime, or event which is described in terms of what legal or punishing action can be taken against the offender.
The legal Code under which the severity of the offense is determined.

An entity is a shaped Part of a larger Whole. The Part may correspond in form and function to a part of another entity. For instance, the leg of a table supports the weight of a table like the leg of an animal or person supports their weight. The Orientation of the Part relative to the Whole may be expressed.
