I removed the brim of the hat Bill likes to chew the waxy rind of the cheese
A shaped Part of a larger Whole.
A Whole which has a shaped Part.
A property relating to the shaped Part of a Whole.
This is a property of the shaped Part that situates the Part within the Whole.

This frame contains words which describe the dimensional extent and Shape of a Substance. These words do not make reference to a Part-whole relationship. There can also be a descriptor of the Shape, Shape_prop. She held a square of cloth .
A Substance of which pieces can be extracted.
This is the Shape that the Substance is in.
This describes a property of the Shape, e.g. it's size.
The number of units of the measured Substance.
An Entity has a Sharpness characterized by its capability to cut. The Sharpness is a value of the Attribute of sharpness. That axe seems dangerously sharp.
The Entity to which the Sharpness attribute is related.
The sharpness feature of the Entity.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Sharpness from the norm or from the value for another Entity.
The Time during which the Entity is in the state of having a particular value for Sharpness.
Some specification of the Circumstances under which the Entity has a particular value for the Sharpness.
The Sharpness value of the Entity. This FE is denoted by the adjectives of the frame.

An Agent causes a Firearm to discharge which induces the rapid motion of the Projectile. The bank robber shot at the clerks with an AK-47. Shooting a cannonball isn't as easy as it looks. CNI Note that usages with the Firearm as object are out of frame, belonging to Use_firearm.
The device used by the Agent to cause the motion of the Projectile.
The entity whose rapid, dangerous motion is caused by the Agent and/or Firearm.
The Agent is the person performing the intentional act causing the motion of the Projectile.
This FE is any expression characterizing the extent of motion of the Theme. Pat threw the Javelin 50 meters.
This FE is the point at which the Theme ends up as a result of the motion. Kim threw the cat into the garden.
An act of the Agent whereby the rapid motion of the Projectile is achieved.
This FE is any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor Goal. I pushed the trolley along the street.
This FE is the starting point of motion. Pat dragged the box out of the cupboard.
A description of the state of the Agent or Projectile during the event.

This frame element is used for expressions which describe a general area in which motion takes place when the motion is understood to be irregular or not to consist of a single, linear path. Locative setting adjuncts may also be assigned this frame element. Kim pushed the lawnmower around the garden.
The location in which the shooting event takes place.
The Time when the shooting event takes place.
The Agent's purpose in launching the Projectile
A firearm is discharged, causing the motion of a projectile. This frame exists primarily to relate frames.
The device used by the Agent to cause the motion of the Projectile.
The entity whose rapid, dangerous motion is caused by the Agent and/or Firearm.
The Agent is the person performing the intentional act causing the motion of the Projectile.
This FE is any expression characterizing the extent of motion of the Projectile.
This FE is the point at which the Theme ends up as a result of the motion. Kim threw the cat into the garden.
An act of the Agent whereby the rapid motion of the Projectile is achieved.
This FE is any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor Goal. I pushed the trolley along the street.
This FE is the starting point of motion. Pat dragged the box out of the cupboard.
A description of the state of the Agent or Projectile during the event.

This frame element is used for expressions which describe a general area in which motion takes place when the motion is understood to be irregular or not to consist of a single, linear path. Locative setting adjuncts may also be assigned this frame element. Kim pushed the lawnmower around the garden.
The location in which the shooting event takes place.
The Time when the shooting event takes place.
The Agent's purpose in launching the Projectile
A Shopper looks for Goods in order to purchase them.
The person who attempts to find the Goods.

This is the entity to which the Cognizer pays attention. It is referred to as the Ground because it serves as the background or context for the Goods. This FE is usually expressed as a preposition phrase.
This is the entity that the Ground may contain. Typically, it is expressed as afor-PP.
The Manner in which the shopping action is done.
An act of the Shopper that allows them to look for (and perhaps purchase) the Goods.
The failure or success of an attempt.
A spatial setting larger than the Ground in which the Shopping event occurs.
This FE identifies the time when the shopping occurs.
An action that the Shopper intends to accomplish by performing the search.
This FE identifies the amount of effort put into shopping.
This FE describes a participant of shopping scenario as being in some state during the action.
The Co_participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the shopping event with the Shopper.

An Astronomical_entity comes into view above the horizon as part of a regular, periodic process of (apparent) motion of the Astronomical_entity across the sky. In the case of the sun, the appearance begins the day. Venus rose at 5:23 AM, twenty minutes before the sun which reached the horizon at 5:43 AM. At the time of the new moon, the moon rises at about the same time the sun rises, and it sets at about the same time the sun sets. And, as the sun came up over the trees, it became golden, and then turned again into a silvery path; and the water came alive Each day the sun's rise offers us a new day.
This FE identifies any Depictive phrase describing the the state of the Astronomical_entity during the motion.
The Goal is the location above the horizon that the Astronomical_entity ends up in.

This FE identifies the Manner in which the motion of the Astronomical_entity takes place. It covers any description of the appearance which is not covered by more specific FEs such as Speed, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way), and aesthetic judgements of the event .
The sequence of locations that the Astronomical_entity traverses as it comes over the horizon.
This FE identifies the Speed at which the Astronomical_entity comes into view.
This FE identifies the Time when the Astronomical_entity appears.
An entity which is periodically visible from the earth's surface.
The Source is the location the Astronomical_entity is construed to occupy before coming above the horizon.
This FE identifies the Result of the Astronomical_entity's motion.
This FE identifies the Place from which the motion of the Astronomical_entity is viewed.
The extent to which the Astronomical_entity comes into view above the horizon.
A setting, often temporal or spatial, within which the appearance of the Astronomical_entity takes place
An event that takes place simultaneously with the Astronomical_entity's appearance.
FN: The amount of times the Astronomical_entity appears per unit of time.

A phenomenon, the Indicator, exists as an indication of another phenomenon, the Indicated. The relationship is asymmetric: the Indicated is not necessarily a sign for the existence or presence of an Indicator. The Indicated can be a past, present, or future entity or eventuality. The relationship between Indicator and Indicated is not one of symbolization or iconicity. Rather the Indicator is an index of the Indicated.
This FE indicates the Degree to which the Indicator is a sign of the Indicated.
A Signatory signs an Agreement document, thereby taking on a commitment encoded in the Agreement. . During this time, 84 countries (including the United States) signed the Protocol.
The entity signifying the identity of the Signatory, resulting from the act of writing on the Agreement document.
An expression of the state of the Signatory at the time of signing.
An entity directed by the Signatory that interacts with the Agreement document so as to produce the Signature.
The place where the signing occurs.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of the Signatory that also affect the action (happily, eagerly).
This FE identifies the action whereby the Signatory achieves the signing of the Agreement.
The purpose for which the Signatory commits to the Agreement.
This FE identifies the Time at which signature is given.
The Reason for putting signature to paper.
The document which encodes the commitment of the Signatory.
The Co_participant signs the Agreement along with the Signatory.

his extrathematic FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the occurrence of the event specified by the target predicate. Further, the target predicate should involve some sort of Agent that intends that the benefit go to the Beneficiary.
The category of the Signatory in the Sign_agreement event.
An Agent causes a Speaker to become silent, sometimes about a particular Topic.
The Agent is the person performing the intentional act.
The instrument with which an intentional act is performed.
The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
An act whereby the Agent silences the Speaker.
The sentient entity that is not communicating.
This is the subject matter to which the Message pertains. It is typically expressed as a PP Complement headed by about.
The Reason for which an intentional act is performed.
The Result is the final state of the Speaker.
The Expressor is theSpeaker's voice or other communicative noise emitted by the Speaker.

Any description of the silencing event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
The extent to which the Agent succeeds in creating silence.

Two or more distinct entities, which may be concrete or abstract objects or types, are characterized as being similar to each other. Depending on figure/ground relations, the entities may be expressed in two distinct frame elements and constituents , Entity_1 and Entity_2, or jointly as a single frame element and constituent, Entities. The similarity may be based on appearance, physical properties, or other characteristics of the two entities. However, no such Dimension has to be specified explicitly. The Entities may be like each other to a greater or lesser Degree. Rather than specifying the Dimension of difference, a Differentiating_fact may be mentioned. Notice that, although similarity presupposes the notion of a judge who assesses similarity, that judge is not part of the frame of similarity. A mulberry is very similar in shape to a loganberry Recovering it afterwards can also be similar to collecting an unsecured loan Great Britain and Germany were only alike in one respect. Lothlorien is quite like most of their other war games really.
This FE marks constituents that express the set of objects or types whose similarity is at issue.
When there is an asymmetry, Entity_1 is the entity characterized by its similarity to Entity_2, whose characteristics are assumed to be known. Entity_1 is often an external argument.
When the Entities are expressed separately, Entity_2 is the one whose characteristics are assumed to be known; it serves as a basis for establishing characteristics of Entity_1.
This FE marks constituents which express a property in respect to which the similarity of the entities is assessed.
The extent to which entities are similar to each other, in general or with respect to some Dimension(s)
This FE identifies the Time when the similarity occurs or exists.
The Place is the general area in which similarity occurs or exists
This FE identifies the Manner in which Dimension is similar or different
An inanimate entity or process that causes the similarity.
This FE is used for any Depictive phrase describing the state of the Entities
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
A fact about Entity_1 or the Entities that reveals how Entity_1 is the same or different from other entities. (Note the contrast with 'as to'.)

A Term is the linguistic sign conventionally used by a Speaker to refer to a type of Entity. Perianth is a collective term for the outer whorls of the flower, which protect the reproductive parts during development. The Polish word for it is czarnuszka
The linguistic sign that is used for referring to a type of Entity.
The type of Entity that is conventionally referred to by a Term.
A speaker or speech community that uses a Term to refer to a particular Entity.
A Speaker conventionally uses a particular Term to refer to an Entity. The pattern of conservation is similar to that found in C1_1, therefore we have termed this domain DC1 for divergent C1 domain.
The type of Entity that is conventionally referred to by a Term.
The linguistic sign that is used for referring to a type of Entity.
The speaker or speech community that uses a Term to refer to a particular Entity.
A reason for why the Term used for the Entity is the one chosen.
How often the Speaker uses the Term referring to the Entity.

Two Events happen at the same time. This may either be construed symmetrically as a relation holding between the Events, or asymmetrically as holding between a Landmark_event whose known occurrence is used to describe when a Profiled_event took place.
The event which is asserted to occur at the same time as the Landmark_event.
The event or time period whose timing the Profiled_event is judged against.
The states-of-affairs which are asserted to be co-timed.

The size of an Entity is assessed in terms of the Degree by which it deviates from the norm. The size refers to the amount of three-dimensional space that is occupied by the Entity. I own a very small home. Where is my little notebook? That dog is huge!
The thing whose size is being considered.
The extent to which the size of the Entity deviates from the norm.
The size of the Entity may be compared to the size of a Standard.
The Sleeper stays in an altered state of consciousness with greatly reduced external awareness.
This FE identifies the Duration of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
This FE identifies the Time when the sleep occurs.
The degree to which the Sleeper is asleep.

Any description of the sleeping event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, noisily), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
A Sleeper enters a state of consciousness of reduced external awareness, remains in this state for some amount of time, and (normally) returns to full wakeful consciousness.
This FE identifies the Duration of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
This FE identifies the Place where the event occurs.
The Sleeper is the entity that is sleeping.
This FE identifies the Time when the event occurs.

The words in this frame describe situations in which the Perpetrator secretly takes Goods into or out of a country or other area which are prohibited by law or on which one has not paid the required duty.
This is the person (or other agent) that illegally takes the goods into or out of a country.
The FE Goods is anything (including labor, time, or legal rights) that can be illegally taken into our out of a country.
The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
The Reason for which an event occurs.
The source is the location the goods occupy initially before change of location.
The path refers to (a part of the) ground the Goods travel over or to a landmark the Goods travel by.
Goal is the location the Goods end up in.
An act of the Perpetrator which allows them to smuggle the Goods.

A description of the Event not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In most cases, it indicates salient characteristics of a Perpetrator that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The action that the Perpetrator is trying to accomplish by the act of smuggling.
The number of times that a smuggling event occurs.
The container, vehicle, or other entity that the Goods move with and remain stationary with respect to.
The distance travelled by the Goods.
The amount of time per distance travelled by the Goods.

In this frame, an Agent places the Theme in the Medium for an extended period of time, with the intent that the Theme will be affected by and absorb some of the Medium. Ellen soaked the beans in the water for 30 seconds.
The Agent is the person performing the soaking.
The Theme is the entity that changes location.
The amount of time for which the Theme is soaked.
The Manner in which the Agent soaks the Theme.
Medium is the substance in which the Theme is submerged.
This FE identifies the Container that holds the Theme which is submerged and the Medium that it is in.
The Place where the submerging occurs.
The Time when the Agent soaks the Theme.
The action of the Agent that brings about the soaking.
The situation that the Agent hopes to bring about by soaking the Theme.
An Item works to become imbued with a Substance. Paper and board absorb moisture in the winter. A stable soil soaks up water.
The Item is the absorbant friendly thing that takes in the Substance.
The Substance is the material that is taken in by the Item.
The location where the Item takes in Substance.
When the Item takes in Substance.
For what length of time the Item is imbued with Substance.
The way in which the Item soaks in the Substance.
Degree describes the extent to which a particular absorption event deviates from the norm.

These words describe how outgoing or sociable a Protagonist is judged to be by a (usually implicit) Judge, often in a particular context, either with certain people (the Company), or about a particular situation, topic or event (the Content). As opposed to the Social_interaction_evaluation frame, this frame talks about how much someone interacts, not how well.
The Protagonist is the person whose sociability is being described.
The Protagonist may be sociable, shy, outgoing, etc. when with particular Company (specific people or types of people). Company usually occurs in a PP Complement with a target adjective:
The Protagonist may be sociable, shy, outgoing, etc. when in a particular situation, or about performing some action.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.

In this frame the Behavior is judged by the speaker (or, in some cases, a separate Judge) against pre-existing social standards for that type of behavior. An Individual who is involved in the Behavior is assigned the same evaluation as the Behavior. This is an abstract frame that encodes the relationship between such frames as Mental_property, Sociability, Social_interaction_evaluation, Stinginess, and Volubility.
The Behavior is the action of the Individual on which the evaluation of the Individual's character is based.
The Individual is the person whose Behavior is being evaluated.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.
The extent to which the described Behavior deviates from the norm.

A mutual social and personal relationship that keeps people involved in each other's lives comprises a Connection of Individual1 to Individual2 or between Individuals. They wanted to strengthen their family ties.
Individuals have a Connection with each other.
Individual1 has a social Connection to Individual2.
Individual2 has a relationship to Individual1.
Connection is the personal relationship between Individuals that keeps them involved in each other's lives.
Type is the sub-category to which the Connection belongs.
This FE identifies the Degree (strength or closeness) of the Connection.

A Social_event occurs at which Attendees are present to conduct a social function or joint activity. The Social_event is often a party or celebration, in which case it is possible to express someone who is being honored (the Honoree) or its function may be to celebrate an Occasion at which Attendees are present. Often, a specific Attendee, the Host, provides a venue for people to gather. Sue threw a party for Bob's birthday. Who will host the Olympic games in eight years?
This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the Social_event is ongoing.
This FE identifies the Social_event itself.
This FE identifies the Place where the Social_event occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the Social_event occurs.
The Host is the person or organization that hosts the Social_event. In cases where an individual stands in for an organization, the host may be marked twice.
The person for whom the Social_event is held.
The Occasion for which the Social_event is held.
Attendee is used for the people who come to the Social_event.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the Social_event occurs.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Social_event occurs.
Refreshment is used for the meal, food or drinks that are served at the Social_event.
This FE identifies the Style of the Social_event and its level of formality, indicating appropriate dress for participants and/or the kind of activities in which they engage.
COD: The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.
This FE describes how often the Social_event occurs.

This frames describes a social event where there may or may not be a permanent or semi-permanent relationship between participants. Additionally, participants in this frame are expressed in one representative FE, Attendees. Note the difference between this frame and Social_event_individuals, where participants are grammatically separated. Our date yesterday was interrupted by my ex-boyfriend!
The Attendees are the collectively construed participants of the social event.
This FE identifies the Degreeto which the social event occurs.
This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the social event is ongoing.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the social event occurs.
This FE identifies the Place where the social event occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the social event occurs.
Expressions marked with Particular_iteration modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

This frames describes a social event where there may or may not be a permanent or semi-permanent relationship between participants. Additionally, participants in this frame are expressed separately, as Party_1 and Party_2. Note the difference between this frame and Social_event_collective, where participants are grouped into one collective grammatical constituent and FE. I went out with him on Friday.
Party_1 is the grammatically more prominent participant in the social event. Party_1 can be one or more individuals.
Party_2 is the grammatically less prominent participant in the social event. Party_2 can be one or more individuals.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the social event occurs.
This FE identifies the Duration of time for which the social event is ongoing.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the social event occurs.
This FE identifies the Place where the social event occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the social event occurs.

In this frame an Evaluee is judged by a (usually implicit) Judge to be of a certain character based on her or his Behavior towards other human beings; a specific Affected_party may be overtly mentioned along with the Degree to which the Evaluee behaves appropriately towards others. TheBehavior alone may be mentioned with the understanding that these behaviors characterize a property of the unmentioned Evaluee. The Evaluee's Behavior may be in the context of a Topic. It was nice of you to send a card. Jim was thoughtful to email the directions. For Martha to smoke in the car was extremely inconsiderate. It was cruel that he continued to call her. Mary was cruel to her friends. Samson was a thoughtless person. Mrs. Robinson was always considerate of her students. The press was always kind about Madonna. Lee was nice about my car accident. I appreciated his kind offer of the car.
The Evaluee is the person whose Behavior towards other human beings is being evaluated.
The Affected_party is the entity which is positively or negatively treated by the Evaluee.
The Behavior is the action of the Evaluee on which the evaluation of the Evaluee's character is based.
The Degree is the extent to which the Evaluee exhibits the particular Behavior towards others.
The Topic is the situation or person that the Evaluee's Behavior responds to or is related to.
The Expressor is the body part or action by a body part which indicates the character of the Evaluee.
The Manner is the way in which the Evaluee embodies the characteristic ascribed to her or him.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the evaluation denoted by the target.
A series of Events are important to humankind and its culture.
This FE identifies the event which occurs to create history.
This FE identifies where the event takes place.
This FE identifies the time when the event occurs.
Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
The Domain is (a characterization of) the type of event that is part of the Event's history.
An Item is the only instance of its Type. Steven is the sole survivor in his family.
An Item is alone in its category.
Type specifies a category which in principle could apply to multiple items, but which is limited to the Item.
An Entity is judged by a sound Attribute of some perceived level of Volume intensity.
The Entity for which the sound level Attribute is under consideration.
The feature of an Entity which is under consideration.
A quantity or characterization of the Entity's sound output with repspect to its Attribute.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Volume from the norm.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Entity has a particular Volume for the Attribute.
The Time during which the Entity is in the state of having a particular Volume for the Attribute.
The place where an Entity is located.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.

A Sound emitted by a Sound_source, which construed as a single point, moves along a Path. Rather than the Sound_source itself, the Location_of_sound_source may be mentioned. Essentially, this frame denotes the (semi-)fictive motion of the the Sound. Given the spreading nature of sound vibrations, it is not surprising that there usually is no expression of any particular goal.
A percept produced in hearing organs by vibrations which travel through the air or another medium.
The location of the Sound_source from which the Sound travels
The Path of the Sound's movement is any description of its trajectory of motion which is neither a Location_of_sound_source or a Goal.
A setting in which Sound movement happens.
The time when the Sound movement occurs.
The point-like entity which produces the Sound.
The Manner in which the Sound moves.

This frame is concerned with the percepts that vibrations which travel through the air or another medium produce in hearing organs. Sounds are a subtype of sensation. In talking about sounds, speakers often provide information about how the sound was produced. A Noisy_event may be mentioned which gives rise to the sound. Alternatively, the sound may be attributed to a Sound_source, which is construed as a point source emitting the sound. A further possible specification of what gives rise to the sound is for speakers to talk about two physical entities coming into contact by motion, resulting in either friction or impact.
An event during which sound is produced.
An entity that is construed as a single point source emitting sound.

One of two entities which is construed as moving relative to the other, resulting in either friction or impact. This entity is given greater syntactic prominence--it is either a possessor or an of-complement of the noun phrase head.

An entity construed as stationary on or against which the Theme moves, resulting in either friction or impact. This entity is given less grammatical prominence compared to the Theme and is usually encoded in a spatial prepositional phrase.
Two entities that are both moving against each other, resulting in either friction or impact.
The place from which the sound emanates.

The location at which sound is produced. This FE differs from Location_of_sound_source in that it does not highlight the sound's spreading from its source to the perceiver's location, which is usually indicated by the preposition "from".
The noise-making may be prompted by either some outside phenomenon or occurrence, or by an Internal_cause, that is the mental or emotional state of an animate Sound_source.
Certain properties of the sound relating to its production, loudness, etc may be of lexicographic interest if they describe properties of a sounds as such: loudly, shrilly, etc.
The sound percept may be characterized in terms of Component_sounds.
Expressions that indicate the loudness of the sound.
This FE idntifies the Reason that the Sound_source produces the sound. Generally, this is some external stimulus that prompts the Sound_source to make noise.
The Path along which the sound travels away from the Sound_source.

A Goal has a Source from which it has gotten a Theme. The Goal may be a sentient recipient who has actively obtained the Theme but it may also be a non-sentient entity that gets the Theme as a result of natural or other processes that it does not control. she is my friend...not to mention my source for French madeleines! Pakistan informed IAEA and US officials investigating the network that North Korea was the source of the uranium shipment DNI. The state remains the dominant source of research funding. INI This is not true according to our source. DNI Note that we also take this frame to cover as metaphorical uses those cases where a person has obtained information from another person or a textual source, which they typically intend to disseminate further. Crews was held in contempt and ordered to jail after refusing to reveal his source for the claim that Big Basket Weaving is circumventing import tariffs on reed.
The abstact or concrete thing acquired by the Goal from the Source.
A concrete or abstract entity from which the Goal has gotten the Theme.
An entity or individual that has acquired a Theme from the Source.
Any evaluative or descriptive characterization of the Source, pertaining either to temporary or permanent properties.
Basic Image Schema: the Trajector moves (or is conceived as moving) from the Source along the Path to the Goal using the Means.
The entity that moves (or is conceived of as moving) from the Source, along the Path to the Goal.
A description of the initial location of the Trajector, before a motion event begins.
A description of the intermediate position of the Trajector, after departing the Source and before arriving at the Goal.
A description of the location that the Trajector ends up.
The action or state-of-affairs that causes the Trajector to change location.

A Speaker addresses an Audience on a particular Topic. The Audience is generally passive, although for many types of address (including academic talks and press conferences), a discussion or question-answer period is virtually always required.
The person or persons to whom the Speaker delivers their text.
The person who orally delivers a text about a Topic to a passive Audience.
What the text that the Speaker produces is about.
The Manner is a description of the Speaker's speech.
This frame element is the Medium through which the Speaker communicates.
The Occasion is the reason a public statement is given.
The Time describes when the speaking occurs.
The Place describes the location where the speaking occurs.

Denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically followes. This often means that the Explanation causes the complaint, but not in all cases. In particular, there are cases when the connection is a bit weaker than normal for causation. In these instances, cause is mediated by some actor responding in a complex way to the situation. Such cases are not paraphrasable in the language of direct causation.

An Entity is capable of motion at a particular Speed or actually in motion at a particular Speed. The car went by real fast. The car is really fast. Oh yeah, Maseratis are fast! INI The speed of the car was 25 mph when it ran into the obstacle.
The Entity whose Speed is under consideration.
The feature of an Entity which is a function of the distance that the Entity moves in a given duration. With the adjectives of this frame this Frame Element is generally incorporated.
A quantity or other characterization of the Entity's speed.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Speed from the norm.
The Time during which the Entity is in the state of having a particular Speed.
Some specification of the Circumstances under which the Entity has a particular Speed.
The reason why the Entity or Attribute is ata certain speed.

A Speaker realizes a Sign, usually a linguistic one, in some Formal_realization. The Formal_realization may be described as correct or incorrect in a Judgment expression, or it may be partially indicated as a Part_of_form. Manner may be used as a more general indication of the Formal_realization A person doesn't always pronounce a word the way they say it in context I can't spell. INI INI Stephanopolous spells his name with a "ph". On page 87465, you spelled the name of my dog incorrectly as "Checquers". In German, the word for 'peace' is written "Friede" CNI
The language user who produces a Sign in some modality.
An evaluation of whether the Formal_realization that the Speaker produced matches the standard or standard range.
The written string, gesture, or vocalized sound sequence that the Speaker produces.
A constituent part of the Formal_realization.
The way that the Speaker produces the Formal_realization.
The time when the Speaker produces the Formal_realization.
The context wherein the Speaker produces a particular Formal_realization.
The person that the Speaker is producing the Formal_realization for.
Denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically followes.
The amount of times the Sign is spelled or pronounced per some unit of time.
This FE marks any state that the Speaker is in while spelling or pronouncing.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.

An Entity is at a particular stage of its development. The Next Generation Internet (NGI) Program has been successfully completed. Osama bin Laden, prime suspect in the US terror attacks, is outfoxing intelligence agencies with his low-tech communication methods. Kids are much more advanced today than they were in our era that is for sure.
The object that has reached a particular stage of its development.
The time at which the progress occurs.
A description of the stage of progress, frequently an evaluation.
The amount of advancement that the Entity has attained.
An Entity persists in a stable situation called a State
Despite some implication that a State would be interrupted, the Entity remains in the specified State. Note that State includes locative relations. Online security remains elusive.
The time when the State is found to still persist.
The location where the Entity is in the State.
The state of affairs that explains why the State persists.
The time period over which the State continues to hold of the Entity.
The circumstances under which the State continues.
The reason why the State continues.
This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action.

An Entity is in a specified State. When not explicitly specified, the State usually concerns the Entity's health, repair of functioning. The State is also often assessed with an Evaluation and it may be specified to apply only to a particular Parameter of the Entity. Some of the classics were in excellent condition. She was taken home , where her condition worsened. They soon reduced the Indians to a CONDITION of abject slavery . They had regressed beyond any help and could never be cured of their "bestial" STATE of utter dependency on poor relief. Evil is the outer result of a mental condition of fear, ignorance, doubt, unbelief.
The entity whose State is specified and/or evaluated.
An assessment or characterization of the Entity's State.
A relation in which the Entity participates or a property that the Entity possesses.
A subpart or characteristic of the Entity that is in a specified State.

This frame contains verbs and nouns that communicate the act of a Speaker to address a Message to some Addressee using language. A number of the words can be used performatively, such as declare and insist. I now declare you members of this Society.

The Speaker is the sentient entity that produces the Message (whether spoken or written). It is normally expressed as the External Argument of predicative uses of the target word, or as the Genitive modifier of the noun.
The Addressee is the person to whom the Message is communicated. When this FE is expressed, it often appears in a prepositional phrase introduced by "to", or as a direct object.
The Message is the FE that identifies the content of what the Speaker is communicating to the Addressee. It can be expressed as a clause or as a noun phrase.
The Topic is the subject matter to which the Message pertains. It is normally expressed as a PP Complement headed by "about", but in some cases it can appear as a direct object.
An act whereby the Speaker makes a statement.
The emotional or physical state of the Speaker that leads to their speaking.
Medium is the physical entity or channel used by the Speaker to transmit the statement.
The state of the Speaker during the statement.
The time when the statement is made.
The FE specifies the place where the statement takes place.
The Occasion is the reason a public statement is given.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE indicate that the particular Statement event referred to is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. Most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
This FE modified the target to indicate the legal- or "by rule" domain within which it is true or operational.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.
The Group of Speakers or Mediums within which the statement is made.
This FE describes the Statement event.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.

In this frame either a Stimulus brings about a particular emotion or experience in the Experiencer or saliently fails to bring about a particular experience. Some words indicate that the Stimulus is characterized by the experience it is likely to evoke in an Experiencer and for these, the Experiencer may rarely be present. There may also be a Degree to which the Stimulus affects the Experiencer and Circumstances under which the experience occurs. There may also be a Comparison_set to which the Stimulus is compared and a Parameter that indicates the area in which the Stimulus has its effect. The view is breathtaking in January. That movie was quite fascinating. That was certainly a gratifying experience. The report was very alarming to me.
The Stimulus is the object or event which brings about the emotion in the Experiencer.
The Experiencer experiences the emotion brought about by the Stimulus
Degree to which the Stimulus evokes the emotion in the Experiencer
This FE marks expressions that indicate a set of conditions under which the Stimulus is able to bring about the emotion.
The Parameter is the area in which the Stimulus brings about an effect on the Experiencer.
The Comparison_set is the set of individuals the Stimulus is compared to when determining the Degree of the emotional reaction.
This FE indicates a Property of the Stimulus which causes a particular experience.

In this frame, a Resource_controller is judged by a Judge (who is usually implicit) according to how freely they allow the Recipient access to their Resource. The Resource_controller may exhibit this attitude with an Expressor. John is mean with money. Sally has always been generous to her children.
The Resource_Controller is the individual who controls access to the Resource.
The Resource_controller controls the Recipient's access to the Resource.
The Recipient is the individual or individuals who receive or should receive the Resource from the Resource_controller.
The Degree is how generous or stingy the Resource_controller is judged to be.
The Behavior is an action of the Resource_controller which is judged to be generous or stingy.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.
The Expressor is the body part or action by a body part which indicates the character of the Resource_controller.
A characterization of the way in which the Resource_controller exhibits stinginess.
A Supply of a Resource is kept safe and available for a future Use. The Supply may be under the control of a Possessor.
This FE denotes the Supply of Resources.
The goods or commodity that is being stored in a Supply.
The future Use for the Resource.
The entity that possesses the Supply.
A characterization of the Supply itself, rather than the Resource.
An Agent has placed a Theme in an accessible but somewhat out of the way Location for the purposes of maintaining it free from harm and illegitimate use while it is not being used.
The Agent is the person who has placed the Theme in the Location.
The Theme is the object that is kept in a Location by the Agent
The location where the Theme is kept.

Any description of the storing state which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way) and salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (deliberately, carefully).
This FE identifies any Depictive phrase describing the Agent or Theme of the storing event.
The Duration is the amount of time for which the Theme remains in the Location.
The Place indicates where the Storing occurs.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the storing event logically follows.
Time is the time period during which the Theme is stored.
The Area is the setting into which a mass Theme is placed.
Co_participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the storing event either as a co-agent or a co-theme.
An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by perform the storing action.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.

These adjectives describe the degree of strictness or tolerance of an Agent, usually with regard to another person (the Controllee) and often with regard to a particular Issue. The strictness/lenience with respect to the Issue may be manifested in (expressed by) an Agent or by some Medium (e.g., laws), or by some behavior of the Agent, i.e., the Controlling_act. Court says judge too lenient in rape case.INI Sonny was indulgent of her admirers and allowed their attention for a time before she disappeared into the small back room. Some laws are just too strict. Don't be strict about cross-posting.CNI

The Agent is the person who is strict or liberal in his/her control over another. This FE is usually the External Argument with predicate adjectives, or the head noun if the adjective is used attributively: The school is very liberal in approach and curriculum. I attended a very liberal school.

The Agent's strictness may be directed towards or limited to some particular person or group over whom he/she has control. The Controllee generally occurs in a PP Complement. Grandparents are often indulgent with their grandchildren.
The Agent's strictness may be manifested in particular behavior: The judge was lenient in dealing with the offender.
The Agent may be strict or lenient with respect to a particular matter or situation. Issue occurs in PP Complements, usually headed by about: The city council is strict about pollution control.

A Medium of control, such as rules, may also be described as strict or lenient. Medium may occur with or without the Agent who ultimately has control (i.e. the one who implements or enforces the rules). The club has strict rules about who can become a member. Immigration law is very strict.
The Area is the arena in which the Agent is or is not strict.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.
The body part or expression of the Agent that indicates their strictness.
The Manner is the way in which the Agent embodies the strictness associated with him or her.

A Student enrolls and then remains at an Institution for the purposes of education within a Subject. They may receive instruction from a particular Teacher at the Institution. The Place, Time, and Duration of the study may also be specified. He spent ten years studying physics at the lycee before he flunked out.
One who instructs a Student in some area of knowledge or skill.
One who receives instruction from a Teacher or Institution.
An educational establishment, such as a school or college.
The area of knowledge or skill which is taught to a Student.
This FE identifies the Level of a student in his/her education.
A state which describes the Student during the process of study.
The manner of studying that the Student has.
The time when the student is studying.

The Place is the location within which the studying takes place. NOTE: Consider whether a possible Place phrase is really where the training took place or is rather part of a description of the Institution.
The amount of time for which the process of study is ongoing.
The reason for which the Student studies the Subject.
Co_participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the Studying event.

A Speaker expresses through language his wish to get the Addressee to act and as a result the Addressee forms an intention do so. There is no implication that the Addressee actually acts upon the intention formed. In the case of convince and persuade, the act that the Speaker wishes the Addressee to perform can be the adoption of a belief, which may be expressed as a that-clause or as an of-PP complement. This frame differs from Attempt_suasion in that in Suasion, the Addressee has changed their mind in accord with the Speaker's wishes, whereas in Attempt_suasion, the only implication is that the Speaker communicates with the intent of changing the mind of the Addressee.
The person that the Speaker seeks to influence to act.
The person who intends through the use of language to get another person to act.
The wish for action on the Addressee's part that the Speaker expresses.
A piece of written or spoken material that changes the mind of the Addressee.
The general item or items that are the focus of the Content of the Speaker's message.
An act of the Speaker that accomplishes the persuasion.
The way in which the Speaker suades the Addressee.
When the Speaker suades the Addressee.

An Agent, Situation or Entity has an influence on a Cognizer. The influence may be general; or it may be manifested in the Cognizer's engaging in an Action as a consequence of the influence; or the Cognizer may be influenced in how they carry out a Behavior that they are engaged in already. Alternatively, a Product may be specified whose production or design was influenced by the Cognizer's experience of the Situation or Entity. The mediation of the Cognizer's psyche distinguishes this frame from the Objective_influence frame, where dependent events occur automatically given the appropriate kind of influencing force. In this frame, by contrast, a Cognizer may perceive an influence yet not respond to it in any way. These works had a profound effect and influenced her in the creation of a successful series capturing this sun-drenched region. I'm sure if I asked Mattel what inspired this car I would be told it's an original design, and not supposed to represent any actual car.
The person who is influenced by the Situation or Entity.
A state of affairs--- which can be an event, state or conditions---that has an influence on the Cognizer.
A person or thing that has an influence on the Cognizer.
An Action that the Cognizer decides to carry out as a consequence of the influence of a Situation or Entity.
A Behavior that the Cognizer is engaged in independently but whose execution is subsequently influenced by the Situation or Entity.
An entity that stands metonymically for the actions and considerations that produced it.
The Time at which the Subjective_influencing event occurs.
This FE applies to appraisals of the Subjective_influence event.
The Agent acts to influence a Cognizer.

An Experiencer senses different degrees of warmth that may or may not be related to the ambient temperature. The level of warmth is usually compared against the Experiencer's subjective standard of comfort. My feet are cold. The fire will keep you warm. I'm too hot with this sweater on.
The entity which perceives a level of warmth.
How much the actual feeling of temperature deviates from a certain level of warmth.
A part of the body of the Experiencer in which the sensation of a temperature is located.

A Submittor gives Documents to an Authority so that they can be processed as part of an application, evaluation or other official or bureaucratic process. I was sure I had passed as soon as I handed in the test. DNI She stated that she turned in the paperwork yesterday. After the applicant's submission to the department, the department chairperson must evaluate. I acknowledge my submission of the Material to you shall not lead to a concurrent review by any of your affiliate and subsidiary channels.
The person that begins in possession of the Documentsand gives them over into the possession of the Authority for processing.
The individual or organization that ends up in possession of the Documents and processes them.
The artifacts containing content, typically in the form of text and images, that the Submittor gives to the Authority.
The Place where the Submittor gives the Documents to the Authority.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which event of the Submittor's giving the Documents to the Authority logically follows.
The time period during which the Submittor gives the Documents to the Authority.
The Purpose for which the Submittor gives the Documents to the Authority.
The Means by which the Submittor gives the Documents to the Authority.
The Manner is the manner in which the Submittor gives the Documents to the Authority.
The Authority's intended purpose for the Documents.

This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action. The depicted state does not necessarily or usually facilitate or cause the state of affairs reported by the target.

This extra-thematic FE applies to participants that derive a benefit from the occurrence of the event specified by the target predicate. Further, the target predicate should involve some sort of agent that intends that the benefit go to the Beneficiary.

Two individuals, the Subordinate and the Superior have a relationship such that the Subordinate generally follows orders given by the Superior and has the best interests of the Superior in mind. The archduke and several of his henchmen got out of the carriage, looking around nervously.
The individual in charge of the Subordinate.
The individual under the command of the Superior.

This frame concerns internally undifferentiated Substances. As their gut bacteria ferment cellulose , they generate methane gas , which escapes from the rear ends of the insects. The pipes are leaking noxious gas. Some CH-47 "Bombers" were equipped to roll-out riot control gas or napalm onto Viet Cong bunker complexes from the rear cargo ramp.
The frame element expresses substances/ingredients that make up the Substance.
The undifferentiated entity which is presented as having a permanent existence.
This FE indicates what subtype of the general category the Substance belongs to.
The location that the Substance comes from, including both extraction sites and emission/production sources.
The purpose for which the Substance is intended.

A Counter_actor or Cause impedes an Agent in an Activity or impedes the unfolding or continuation of a State_of_affairs. The opposing force applies without first being noticed, often in a secret or an underhanded fashion. However, as this story goes on the Queen of Sodom has a brother who plans to undermine his sister and take the throne of Sodom. Diotrephes withstood John's words, and would not submit to his authority; in fact, he undermined John's authority. I don't want to get a reputation for punishing disagreement. On the other hand, he undercut me pretty badly and I can't just let it slide.
An event or state_of_Affairs that successfully impedes an Agent or a State_of_affairs.
A person who intentionally or not acts in such a way that an Agent or State_of_affairs is impeded.
A person who is intentionally engaged in some Activity and who is impeded in that Activity.
An Activity that is being impeded.
A state or event that is ongoing and whose continuance or unfolding is impeded.
The extent to which the Cause or Counter_actor impede the Agent or the State_of_affairs.
The state-of-affairs that the Counter_actor hopes will result from his undermining.
The location where the Counter_actor subverts an Activity.
The time at which the Counter_actor or Cause works agains the Agent.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of a Counter_actor that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
This FE denotes the number of times the Counter_actor or Cause subverts the Agent per unit of time.
This FE denotes the number of times the subversion event has occurred.

An Agent has attempted to achieve a Goal, and the actual outcome of the Agent's action has been resolved, so that it either specifically matches the Agent's intent (e.g. success) or does not match it (e.g. failure). He pulled off his April Fool's Day prank by the barest of margins . Unfortunately, we were n't successful. DNI We failed miserably at getting the gay rights bill passed .
The Agent makes an attempt to achieve a Goal.
The Goal is what the Agent attempts to achieve.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Goal is achieved (or not).
This FE identifies the Degree to which an attempt occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the attempt succeeds or fails.
The Depictive is a phrase which describes the Agent.
The place where an attempt succeeds or fails.
A participant function in a particular event or in events of a particular kind.
This FE is applied to expressions which indicate the prevailing physical conditions for the event, or some concurrent states of affairs.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the success or failure logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the success or failure, but not in all cases.

This FE denotes an event or state of affairs that occurs or holds at a time that includes the time during which the success or failure reported by the target occurs and of which the success or failure is taken to be a part
Re_encoding presents the success or failure event as an integral part of a larger conceptualization expressed by another frame.

The Means action by which a deprofiled agent (the Protagonist) has attempted to achieve a Goal is finished and the actual outcome of the Means action has been resolved, so that it either specifically matches the Protagonist's intent (e.g. success) or does not match it (e.g. failure). In an alternative construal, an Instrument stands for the Means action that the deprofiled agent undertakes in order to achieve the Goal. Why our bid was successful. DNI Your attempt to unsubscribe was unsuccessful, please try again later. DNI Well I did end up replacing the old co axial cables with new monster ones and it did the trick. DNI The hammer did it, not a scratch or dent in the parts as they came apart DNI. What has failed in Palestine, will fail in Iraq. DNI
The action that the agent undertakes to achieve the Goal.
The Goal is what the agent attempts to achieve by performing the Means action.
An entity directed by the agent as part of the Means action in order to accomplish the Goal.
The place where Means action succeeds or fails.
This FE identifies the Time when the attempt succeeds or fails
An event or state of affairs that causes the success or failure of the Means action.
The FE Circumstances encodes a setting, often temporal or spatial, within which the successful action expressed by the target takes place.
The Protagonist is the deprofiled individual who makes an attempt to achieve a Goal by performing the Means action, which may involve using an Instrument.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an attempt involving a particular Means or Instrument succeeds.
A participant function of an Instrument or Means in a particular event or in events of a particular kind.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the success or failure logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the success or failure, but not in all cases.

This FE denotes an event or state of affairs that occurs or holds at a time that includes the time during which the success or failure reported by the target occurs and of which the success or failure is taken to be a part

A Communicator speaks to an Addressee in such a way that the Addressee understands and fully appreciates the truth and/or relevance of the Message. Marred by overblown writing , this first novel by Wilbur Smith 's wife effectively conveys some of South Africa 's problems .INI He conveys vividly the absurdity of a situation , but he is incurious about the underlying processes which shape it. INI We've got to get the message through to them before they become sexually active. Have you been using PowerPoint (PPT) for years and feel you don't always get your point across to the audience? It 's impossible to convey how lost I felt. CNI INI But , alas , the printed word can not adequately convey the panting , gasping misery of this particular torment. INI
The person who uses language in the written or spoken modality to convey a Message to another person.
The Addressee receives a Message from the Communicator.
Message A proposition or set of propositions that the Communicator wants the Addressee to believe or take for granted.
The physical or abstract setting in which the Message is conveyed.
The Depictive describes the state of the Communicator.
The Manner in which the Communicator communicates.
The Means by which the Communicator communicates.
The time at which the communication takes place.
The degree to which the Communicator's efforts are effective at making the Addressee understand and appreciate the Message.

An Item is located on a Scale relative to a critical value which is determined by some Enabled_situation. Generally, when the Enabled_situation is left unexpressed the Enabled_situation is interpreted to be the desirability of the Item being located within a particular range on the Scale. With many of the adjectives of this frame, the Scale is not explicitly mentioned; in such cases, the Scale is usually the quantity, incorporated in the meaning of the targets themselves, though in the case of adequacy, etc. the Scale referred to is quality. I probably have enough. DNI DNI I was mad enough to scream. I was too mad to keep myself from screaming. I was way too hot. DNI The particles are sufficiently small in diameter that they may be considered points.
The entity whose scalar property is specified.
The Scale is the attribute of theItem that is being described.
This FE identifies the Enabled_situation by which the critical value is judged.
The Degree frame element indicates a modification of the value indicated by the target.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

This Frame is concerned with evaluating an Evaluee as being suitable for a Purpose or a User, presupposing some choice that is being made about which Evaluee to use for the Purpose or User. An LU like suitable.a thus implies that, given a particular Purpose or User, the Evaluee is one which could be or ought to be chosen. The Evaluee may be deemed suitable to a greater or lesser Degree. This frame has some similarity to the compatibility frame where two Items are evaluated with respect to their compatibility with each other against some background. (1) We need to build more houses suitable for local residents. (2) These chips are not verysuitable for parallel processing. (3) We are not sure about the Cathedral's suitability for Philharmonic concerts.
This Frame Element marks constituents expressing the entity that is judged to be more or less suitable for some Purpose or User.
This Frame Element marks constituents that express the Degree to which the Evaluee is suitable for the Context.
This Frame Element marks constituents that express the Purpose for which the Evaluee is judged to be suitable or unsuitable.
This FE marks expressions that indicate a User to whom

A Communicator processes some information (either from textual or real-world/perceptual sources) regarding a State_of_affairs into a concise form (a summary) that contains the essential content in briefer form, and communicates this summary to an Addressee, or records it in a Medium. The State_of_affairs may be represented directly (e.g., outline what happened, the situation abroad), or as a textual source (summarizing the documents), or metonymically as some focal entity (a synopsis of the candidates). Frank has already summarized some of the reactions on his weblog. Director Van Auken gave a brief informational synopsis of each applicant. He boiled down the argument for domestic wiretapping in one plainspoken and effective, if also deceptive, line... You should be able to summarize your findings to a lay audience. In her materials, she also outlined the situation and major problems facing the company. Some LUs, such as summarize and synopsis entail a preexisting body of information that has been processed into a briefer form by the Communicator. Others, such as outline and blueprint are compatible with, but do not entail, a preexisting, fully fleshed-out concept. E.g., Her book outlines a new proposal for handling grammaticalization, though she doesn't flesh it out entirely.
The Communicator creates and communicates the summary of the Information.
The Communicator communicates the summary to the Addressee.
The State_of_affairs is summarized by the Communicator.
The textual or other Medium through which the Communicator summarizes.
The content that results from the summarization.
The time at which the Communicator makes the Summary.
The location where the Communicator communicates.
Any description of the details of the action beyond the identity of the participants and the setting, especially descriptions of the Communicator that affect the action.
An action performed by the Communicator that brings about the communication.
The state-of-affairs that the Communicator is attempting to bring about by communicating.
The amount of time taken by the Communicator in creating and conveying the Summary.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

A Supplier gives a Theme to a Recipient to fulfill a need or purpose (Purpose_of_recipient) of the Recipient. Habituating the ground nesting chimp groups is done by provisioning them with sugar cane. CNI INI I have equipped my leech troopers with tiny subspace displacement thingummies. INI She sat down on her bed, carefully folding her clothing and packing it into the small carryall Starfleet had provided her for the journey.
The person that begins in possession of the Themeand causes it to be in the possession of the Recipient.
The entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
The object that is given to the Recipient .
The Place where the Supplier gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Reason for which the Supplier gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Time is when the Supplier gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Purpose for which the Supplier gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Means by which the Supplier acquires or gives the Theme to the Recipient.

Any description of the supplying event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Supplier that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The Circumstances are the conditions under which the Theme is supplied.
The Recipient's intended purpose for the Theme.
The period over which the Supplier engages in (multiple) supplying acts.
An additional theme which is supplied along with the main Theme.

A Supporter assists to strengthen the Supported by lending itself in material aid (or abstract assistance in the case of metaphorical uses). The bottom of the wall is supported by the foundation. Many legislators have supported the industry in the past. The revetment layers buttressed the mud-mortared cobblestone core wall. Online gambling can bolster the US economy.
The Supporter acts to benefit the Supported by providing additional strength or stability.
The Supported is given strength through the assistance of the Supporter.
The measure to which the Supporter's assistance brings the Supported added strength and support.
The time period during which the Supporter supports the Supported.
An entity used by the Supporter in service of the Supported's strength by support.
This FE identifies the Manner in which a Supporter supports the Supported.
An action that the Supporter undertakes in service of the Supported's strengthening.
This FE identifies the Place where the support occurs.
This FE identifies when the support occurs.
The situation that the Supporter wishes to bring about by supporting the Supported.
A state-of-affairs from which the accomplishment would be predicted.
A clause describing the event as a whole.

In this frame a Profiled_item is higher that its Standard_item on a scale with respect to some Attribute. The Extent of the difference between the Standard_item and the Profiled_item may also be mentioned. Furthermore, the particular value of the standard or profiled item on a certain scale may be given by the Standard_attribute of the Profiled_attribute respectively. Notices for the Shield Theater's production of Macbeth surpassed all previous reviews . Radio WKRR far surpasses all radio stations among rural radio stations as the leading source of regional news . We surpassed father's skills before we were 12 . The current price surpasses the price this time last year.
The FE Standard_item denotes the entities that are exceeded by the Item with regard to the Attribute.
The Profiled_item is the entity that is located closest to the end of the scale evoked by some Attribute.
The Attribute is a property that evokes a scale along which the Item is located closer to one extreme in comparison to the Standard_item.
The Extent is the degree to which the Item surpasses the Standard.
This FE identifies the Time when the Item is higher on the scale than the Standard.
The Standard_attribute is used when the standard is a specific value on a scale.
The Profiled_attribute is a particular value on a scale which is being compared to an Attribute or Standard_item.
The Comparison_set includes the Standard and is what the Item is judged with respect to.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

In this frame a Fugitive presents himself or herself to the Authorities to be subject to the criminal process. The bank robber surrendered to Berkeley police. Norte is expected to surrender to police tomorrow on tax fraud charges .
The Fugitive is wanted by the Authorities and turns himself or herself in to the Authorities.
The Authorities are the officials, government or otherwise, who are in charge of initiating the criminal process.
The Place is the location where the surrendering occurs.
The Time is when the Fugitive surrenders.
The Charges is the offense for which the Fugitive is wanted.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Fugitive surrenders to the Authorities.
This FE denotes a proposition from which the surrendering event logically follows.

A Surrenderer is compelled to transfer a Theme to a Recipient. Shortly after the boy surrendered the gun, the three remaining warriors made a rush for liberty. He finally surrendered the item after cops and Secret Service agents showed up at his home Saturday. D?Augustino yielded the weapon to Herrick.
The person compelled to transfer the Theme to the Recipient.
The entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
The Place where the Surrenderer gives the Theme to the Recipient.
This FE denotes a proposition from which the surrendering event logically follows.
The Time is when the Surrenderer gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Purpose for which the Surrenderer gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Means by which the Surrenderer gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The Manner is the manner in which the Surrenderer gives the Theme to the Recipient.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the Surrendering event itself and any of its participants.
This FE modifies a clause with an iterative interpretation, which may be signified by the simple present tense on the main verb.
In general, this FE is used for phrases that describe the clause of the target as a whole. There are two somewhat distinct subgroups of sentence modifiers that cover this function.
This FE presents the current frame as an integral part of a larger conceptualization expressed by another frame.

This FE describes the legal- or "by rule" domain within which the surrendering event is true or operational and may be expressed by words like ?formally? and ?officially? plus maybe ?technically? and ?in law.?
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.

This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often. It is to be distinguished from Iteration, which pertains simply to the number of times an event occurs-Iteration expressions answer the question how many times.
This FE identifies the Result of an surrendering event.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.

A Survivor manages to avoid being negatively affected, despite encountering a Dangerous_situation. The negative effect is most often death, destruction, or a metaphorical construal of one of these. Wilderness Survival: Could You Survive the Wild? More than 400 of the 600 residents rode out the hurricane in Gulfport's 11-story high-rise beachfront facility.
The Survivor lives through a Dangerous_situation.
The Dangerous_situation is one in which people are likely or expected to be negatively affected.
The location where the Survivor (primarily) lives during the Dangerous_situation.
The time at which the surviving takes place.
An action performed by the Survivor that enables them to live throug hthe Dangerous_situation.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the Survivor survives.
Depictive is a description of the Survivor, during or after the Dangerous_situation.
A person or group, the Authority, believes that another person, the Suspect is a participant in a criminal Incident. The police suspect Noah Rogers of aiding the robbery last night at Shop-n-drive.
The Authority is the group or person who suspects the Suspect of criminal activity.
The Suspect is the target of the Authority's suspicion.
The (typically criminal) Incident in which the Suspect is suspected of being involved.

In this frame, an Entity or Behavior is suspicious or otherwise subject to question. The general implication is that the Entity or Behavior provides evidence for some (as yet unproven) socially undesirable conclusion about a (usually implicit) Social_actor. (Such conclusions often include the idea that some individual is lying, or that a crime was committed.) We found some suspicious checks lying on his desk. It was rather suspicious of you to leave the party just before the police arrived.
The Behavior is the state of affairs or action of the social actor that is regarded as susipcious.
The extent to which the Behavior is suspicious.
An individual that is suspected of wrongdoing because of the Behavior.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.
The Entity metonymically stands in for a Behavior that saliently involves the Entity.

A Complex with a particular Function is formed out of Component_entities. The function may be expressed by reference to a Salient_entity involved in the working of the Complex. The body's immune system can be mobilized against cancer. The sewer system carries wastewater from homes and businesses to the Water Pollution Control Plant for treatment.
The entities that function together as a unit.
The unit formed by the Component_entities.
The activity that the Complex entity performs by virtue of its Component_entities interacting.
Any characterization or evaluation of the Complex.
A person or organization that possesses or owns the Complex or a larger entity of which the Complex itself is a part.
The kind of entity that the Complex operates on as part of its Function.

A New filler occupies a Role or serves a Function after the Old filler ceases to occupy the position. In many cases, the Role or Function is implicit. Gas can substitute entirely for petrol. Sometime in the 1880s gas replaced oil for manufacturing fuel. Twelve years later, oil replaced coal as the energy of choice. Honey can replace sugar in this recipe.
The new filler of the Role that was previously occupied by the Old filler.
The category that the New and Old entities fit into as a result of the Function they serve.
The (generally desirable) state of affairs that the New and Old entities are involved in bringing about.
The entity that occupied the Role or served the Function before the New filler.
The time at which the New takes up the Role previously occupied by the Old.
A Degree of replacement is generally only possible when New entities replace Old entities in multiple contexts.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). The rapidity of replacement is also indicated as Manner.
The domain in which the New and Old entities function.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows.
An Agent removes a Theme from a Source so that the it is in the Agent's possession.
The person who takes possession of the Theme.
The Agent takes possession of the Theme.
The location of the Theme prior to the taking.
The intermediate action taken by the Agent to take the Theme.
The larger event which contains the Taking event.

A Cognizer has a relatively fixed positive or negative point of view towards an Issue. A Side in a debate concerning an Issue or an Action of a Side may stand in for the Issue. The Cognizer's Degree of alignment may also be specified. In interviews , it seems like everyone is completely against this expenditure .
The individual that holds an opinion on an Issue or Side.
The matter, usually concerning a course of action, which the Cognizer has an positive or negative opinion about.
The party or individual (generally associated with a particular position on an Issue) that the Cognizer sides with.
The Degree to which the Cognizer supports or opposes something.
The time period during which the Cognizer has the indicated point of view towards the Issue.
The Explanation is a proposition denoting a state of affairs from which the Cognizer's taking the indicated view on the Issue logically follows.
An action taken by a Side or a view that the Side takes on an issue which the Cognizer either supports or opposes.
This FE describes the person or element that is taking a side.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
