Any description of the Taking_sides which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Capitulator that affect the action (reluctantly, meekly).

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause.
The location where the Cognizer takes Sides on an Issue.

An Activity takes some Time_length to complete. If an Agent is involved they may stand in metonymically for the Activity. For some LUs (e.g., fast, speedy) the Degree to which the Activity is conceived of as taking less time than usual can be expressed. How long will this take? The ride was speedy and often bumpy. Under high-pressure situations, police officers are very fast at reacting to danger.
The event which requires some Time_length for completion.
The durational feature of the Activity.
The amount of time required for the Activity.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Time_length from the norm.
The Time at which the Activity takes place.
Some specification of the Circumstances under which the Activity takes a particular amount of time.
The individual who performs the Activity.
Duration is the length of time from the beginning of the Activity to its end.
A Speaker expresses through language his wish to get the Addressee to act. The Addressee forms an intention to act and does so.
The Speaker intends through the use of language to get another person to act.
The wish for action on the Addressee's part that the Speaker expresses.
The person that the Speaker seeks to influence to act.
Act of the Speaker that enables them to persuade the Addressee.
An entity that the Speaker gets the Addressee to give to them.
The state of affairs that the Speaker hopes to bring about.
An entity that the Speaker manipulates to get the Addressee to perform the Content.
The location where the Speaker talks the Addressee into performing the Content.

An Agent ingests or begins to ingest a Food item that they have not had before with the intention of determining its quality on some scale. A Purpose for trying the Food may be explicitly mentioned. Most people will never try dog. I tasted the soup to see if it had enough salt.
The person who eats or drinks the Food.
The entity being tasted or ingested by the Agent.
The method in which the Food is eaten or drunk if not covered by the FE Instrument.
The object that the Agent uses to try the Food.
A more specific description of what the Agent hopes to determine by trying the Food.
The time at which the Agent tries the Food.
The location where the scene of an Agent trying Food occurs.\
A characterization of the Agent as they try the Food.
A Speaker addresses an Addressee with a Message, which may be indirectly referred to as a Topic.
The Speaker is the sentient entity that produces the Message.
The Addressee receives the Message from the Speaker.
The Message is the communication produced by the Speaker.
The Topic is a general description of the content of the Message.
The Manner describes the way in which the Speaker delivers the Message.
The Means describes the way the Speaker accomplishes the task of giving the Addressee the Message.
This frame element is the Medium in which the Message is expressed.
The time period during which the Speaker informs the Addressee of the Message.
The location in which the Speaker informs the Addressee of the Message.
This FE identifies a characteristic or description of the telling event.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.

An Entity has a Temperature characterized by the target. The Temperature is a value of the temperature Attribute. The pan is already too hot to touch. The walk-in was freezing, but it was better than hanging out in the kitchen. Note that in this frame, the Entity does not experience the temperature, but is merely described as being in a certain externally verifiable state. Thus Open a window; I'm too hot. is not in frame but rather in Subjective_temperature.
The Entity for which the temperature Attribute is under consideration.
The feature of an Entity which is under discussion.
A quantity or other characterization of the Entity's state with respect to the temperature Attribute.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Temperature from the norm.
The Time during which the Entity is in the state of having a particular Degree for the temperature Attribute.
Some specification of the Circumstances under which the Entity has a particular Temperature.
A part of the Entity that has the specified Temperature value.

A Trajector is identified as occurring at the same time as some better-known Landmark. We consider sequenced calendric units (e.g. Tuesday, 1987, January) as periods for the purposes of this frame. Some lexical items allow certain types of frame elements while disallowing others (e.g. *During Tuesday...). Several words of this frame (e.g. now.adv) have deictic incorporation of the Landmark_period. He tried to take care of that on his last visit . I especially like brunch on Sunday. Dinosaurs lived in prehistoric eras. He did it then.
The entity that occurs at some time.
The event which designates the time at which a trajector occurs.
This FE describes the state of affairs reported by the target is understood to play a role in the state of affairs of the modifier.
The period that occurs with respect to some other time.
The period in which a trajector takes place. This period can be cyclical and, in that case, is interpreted contextually.
The event that occurs at some time.
The entity which designates the time of some trajector. Note: this FE is infrequent or non-existent in English and is included for completeness.
A salient Subevent has a Pattern of recurrence within a larger Process. Tony's fingers tapped rhythmically on the keyboard
The larger event that is characterized by the recurring Subevents.
The salient, punctual event that is construed as part of a Process.
A characterization of the Pattern in which the Subevents recur.
The Pattern that can be detected in the recurrence of the Subevents of the Process.
An indication of a conventionally recognized subtype that the Pattern belongs to.

A Sub_part of a Time_period is picked out. In some cases, the part (as opposed to the entire Time_period) may be described by a Sub_part_property. The Time_period may be indicated by an event which takes place during the Time_period. I nearly kicked my TV this afternoon after watching the shambolic end of the Austrian Grand-Prix . Jack Yan looks at how the branding profession will be affected in the early 2000s by globalization .
The part of the Time_period which is profiled.
Some description which pertains specifically to the Sub_part (rather than the Time_period.
A temporal span conceived of as a whole.
This FE indicates the Time that is being referred to.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.

A Guest stays for a time at a Location, which is not his or her permanent residence, for some Duration. The Location is often the permanent residence of a Host. I usually stay with my aunt at her summer house when I go to Seville. For a few days my father lodged at a hotel with a buddy who was a biology student.
The Guest remains for a relatively short period of time in the Location.
The Location where the Guest spends a short amount of time.
The length of time that the Guest remains at the Location.
Another person who, along with the Guest, is temporarily living at the Location.
The time at which the temporary stay takes place.
The Host is living at the Location on a permanent basis, and is allowing the Guest to stay there.
The activity that the Guest hopes to achieve by the stay.
An action of the Guest that brings about their ability to stay at the Location.
Any description of the type of event by comparison to other events (the same way) or by characterizing a state of the Guest that affects the action.
The average number of times the event occurs over a period.
The number of times that the event occurs.
A description of one of the participants in the temporary stay, or of the staying state-of-affairs in general.
The Place indicates the larger physical setting of the temporary stay.
A state of affairs that provides an explanation for the temporary stay.
This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time of the temporary stay, and which is taken to be a part of the stay.

A condition that is set out in an Agreement imposes Requirements on a Party or parties, with respect to some Regulated_entity. If the conditions are not met, the Agreement as a whole ceases to be valid or, more specifically, a Desired_state_of_affairs cannot occur. (The Desired_state_of_affairs typically is an interaction between the parties that benefits one or both sides.) Breach of contract occurs where one of the parties fails to perform any one of the contract terms . Breach of contract occurs where one of the parties fails to perform any one of the contract terms . What are your conditions for a peaceful settlement? Please read our Conditions of Sale carefully Please read our Conditions of Sale carefully We will verify compliance with the financial terms of the contract. We will verify compliance with the financial terms of the contract. The Engineering Division has violated the seniority provision of the collective bargaining agreement. The Engineering Division has violated the seniority provision of the collective bargaining agreement.
A mutual commitment to an obligation made by two or more parties.
A salient entity, an activity or behavior by the parties to the agreement to which a particular stipulation pertains.
The Requirements that a particular stipulation of the Agreement imposes on one or both of the parties.
An event or state of affairs that is desirable to some or all of the parties to the Agreement and which is conditional on the Requirements being met.
A party who demands that certain Requirements be met before they will enter into an Agreement or allow a Desired_state_of_affairs to be realized.
A description of the Requirements that are imposed by the Agreement.

A Terrorist commits a violent or otherwise harmful Act upon a Victimin order to coerce or terrorize a government or populace. The Act may be committed in particular for political or ideological reasons, and is often directed at civilians, as opposed to government or military officials. It is most often in violation of one or many laws.
The Terrorist commits the Act of terror for political or ideological gains.
The Act is the harmful action performed by the Terrorist or terrorist organization.
The Victim is most directly affected or harmed by the Act of terrorism.
A Terrorist may be part of a larger group or Organization of such people.
Any characterization or evaluation of the Terrorist or Act.
The Manner in which the Terrorist commits the Act.
The intermediate action performed by the Terrorist in order to comit the Act.
The location in time when the Act takes place.
The location where the Act takes place.
The action or state-of-affairs that the Terrorist is trying to accomplish by commiting the Act.
The Instrument is used by the Terrorist in order to inflict harm or commit the Act.

A Text is an entity that contains linguistic, symbolic information on a Topic, created by an Author at the Time_of_creation. It may be a physical entity that is made of a certain Material etc. It may be constructed for an Honoree.
The Author is the person who produced a particular Text.
The Text is the entity that contains linguistic information.
The person for whom the Text is produced.
The Time at which the Text was created.
What a Text is made of (if applicable).
This is a text in which the Text is located.
The Genre or sub-Genre of the Text.
The use for which the text was produced; its purpose.
The smaller texts that make up the Text.
Topic is what the Text is about.
The Medium is the language in which a text is composed, or the physical medium (radio, ink) in which it is distributed.

An Author creates a Text, either written, such as a letter, or spoken, such as a speech, that contains meaningful linguistic tokens, and may have a particular Addressee in mind. The Text may include information about its topic, although the latter is not an FE in this frame. I penned a letter concerning racism to Congress. The brothers said not two words to each other. Jot any notes you need below the line in red pen only.
The Author produces a particular Text.
The Components are the parts that the Author uses to construct the Text.
The entity which results from the act of writing or speaking.
Depictive phrase describing the actor of an action
The instrument with which an intentional act is performed.
Manner of performing an action. This frame includes some peculiar examples of manner phrases. Write it in pen. Write it in ink.
This FE identifies the Means by which a Text is created.
The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
This FE identifies the Time at which the text is created.

This is the person to whom the Message is communicated. When this FE is expressed, it often appears in a prepositional phrase introduced by to, or as the direct object, or as the first object in a double object construction.
Honoree identifies the person in whose honor or for whose benefit the Text is created.
This FE describes the form in which the text is presented.
The Reason for creating the text.
The Topic is what a Text is about.
A set of propositions that is coherent in being about a Topic.
The Communicator is the person who has produced a Text on a Topic.
This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate to which Degree the Text is about the Topic.
This FE marks expressions in which Manner the Topic is treated.
The Frame Element Status is used for expressions that indicate the relative importance of a Topic with respect to the other topics that a Text is about.
The time at which the Communicator produces Text on a Topic.

These are words describing situations in which a Perpetrator takes Goods from a Victim or a Source. The Means by which this is accomplished may also be expressed. I can't believe he pickpocketed my gold watch ! I had to pilfer from the office just to get by . INI Snatching purses from little old ladies is not a living . CNI
Perpetrator is the person (or other agent) that takes the goods away.
Victim is the person (or other sentient being or group) that owns the goods before they are taken away by the perpetrator.
Goods is anything (including labor, time, or legal rights) that can be taken away.
Source is the initial location of the goods, before they change location.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the theft occurs.
This FE identifies the Means by which a Perpetrator takes the Victim's Goods.
This FE identifies the Place where the theft occurs.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which a theft occurs.
This FE identifies the Reason for which a theft occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the theft occurs.
An object used by the Perpetrator in taking possession of the Goods.
The number of times that a theft occurs.

An Entity is in a state such that it participates in a preponderance of states and events which are desirable for it. For living entities, this may entail a proliferation of instances of the entity, or of desirable properties associated with the (single) entity. For non-living entities (economies, political locales, academic topics, etc.), this entails a proliferation of instances, or of activities that lead to instances, or any attribute that would prevent the entity from disappearing. This state is conceived of as temporary, or at least contingent on a number of changeable factors. Words expressing the opposite state, i.e., a lack of such positive activity, are also in this frame. In the 1920s the peach industry flourished in Upson County. Construction companies thrive on public projects.
The Entity is experiencing a period of desirable events or states.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
The Time during which the Entity thrives.
The Place where the thriving takes place.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
The category in which the Entity thrives.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation to its end. In many cases, the continuous situation is a dynamic action which is ongoing, while in others it is simply an undifferentiated state.
The Explanation for why or how the Entity thrives.

In this frame a Preventing_cause interferes with the ability of a Protagonist to complete an intended Action. The Protagonist may not be mentioned in the sentence, in which case the Action is an endeavor that an individual or group of individuals hopes to accomplish. In this frame it is necessary that the Protagonist is unable to successfully complete the Action. Noriega's troops foiled a coup attempt. He prevented her from running away. He was foiled in his attempt to overthrow the government.
The Preventing_cause is the agent or force who keeps the Protagonist from completing her or his planned Action.
The Protagonist is the individual or group of individuals who have a planned Action which is prevented by the Preventing_cause
The Action is the action or event certain individuals desire to bring about which is prevented by the Preventing_cause.
The Time is when the thwarting occurs.
The Place is where the thwarting occurs.
The Manner in which the Preventing_cause thwarts the Action of the Protagonist.
The Degree to which the Action is thwarted.
The Explanation for why or how the Protagonist and/or Action was thwarted by the Preventing_cause.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often.

LUs in this frame denote a period of time in which an Enabled_action becomes possible. The Duration of this time period can be both exact and inexact. An Agent who performs the Enabled_action may be mentioned as well. Allow a three-day window for delivery. DNI
The action that becomes possible through the existence of the period of time.
A quantity or other characterization of the period of the time in which an Enabled_actionis allowed. In this frame, the duration may be exact or inexact.
The Agent is the one who performs the Enabled_action.
The Whole is the larger time period to which target is a part of.

An Event is identified as occurring at a particular Distance and in a particular Direction from a Landmark_event. The lexical units incorporate the Direction and, in some cases, the Landmark_event. This frame builds on the Direction frame, further specifying the Domain as Time. This frame will receive some of the lexical units currently found in Relative_time. Tell me that a week from now. Some twelve months after I had graduated, I had my first job interview
This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate the reference point in which the Event is anchored.
This FE marks expressions that indicate the amount of time that lies between the Target and the Landmark_event.
This FE marks expressions that indicate whether the Target is prior or subsequent to the Landmark_event on the time line.
This FE indicates the Event temporally located with respect to the Landmark_event.
The words in this frame describe a period of time, as opposed to a point in time. The best time of year for planting tends to be fairly regular.
A quantity or other characterization of the State's duration. In this frame, the duration can be inexact.
An ongoing state whose duration can be measured.
The Whole is the larger moment in time of which the target is a part.
Any characterization or evaluation of the timespan not covered by a more specific FE.

The words in this frame describe an Experiencer's feelings of tolerating with respect to some Content. A Reason for the toleration may also be expressed. Although the Content may refer to an actual, current state of affairs, quite often it refers to a general situation which causes the emotion. He could not tolerate the smell of coconut .
The Experiencer experiences tolerance with respect to the Content.

Content is what the Experiencer's feeling of tolerance is directed towards.. The Content differs from a stimulus because the Content is not construed as being direcly responsible for causing the emotion.
The Reason is the explanation for why an Experiencer tolerates the Content.
The Degree to which the toleration occurs.
The Parameter is a domain in which the Experiencer tolerates the Content.
The Topic is the area about which the Experiencer has the tolerated experience(s).
The State is the abstract noun that describes a more lasting experience by the Experiencer.
The Event is the occasion or happening that Experiencers in a certain emotional state participate in.

The Circumstances FE encodes the circumstances or conditions under which the Experiencer experiences the emotion. Unlike Content it does not give the specific content of the emotion, but the Content can often be inferred from the Circumstances.
The time at which the Experiencer is in the state of toleration.

A stretch of linguistic discourse or a Text that a Communicator produces has a Topic that it is about. Chapter 5 discusses the issue of transubstantiation. Smither's essay is about plane spotting. Ostrovsky addresses monetary policy in Chapter 5. This book is mostly about particle physics.
The Topic is what a Text is about.
A set of propositions that is coherent in being about a Topic
The Communicator is the person who has produced a Text on a Topic.
This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate to which Degree the Text is about the Topic
This FE marks expressions in which Manner the Topic is treated.
The Frame Element Status is used for expressions that indicate the relative importance of a Topic with respect to the other topics that a Text is about.
The time at which the Communicator produces Text on a Topic.
The reason for which the Text or Communicator presents the Topic.

A Tourist experiences an Attraction, a location with a unique history or other societally recognized individual character, with the goal of seeing and learning about it. Typically, the Attraction has a source of information about the Attraction--a guide, pamphlets, or displays.
The individual that is seeking an experience at an Attraction.
The societally-recognized unique location that the Tourist experiences.
The state of the Tourist or the Attraction during the tour.
The perceptual background against which the Attraction is experienced by the Tourist.
Any description of the details of the event in terms of how they compare to other events (the same way) or in terms of how the state of the Tourist affects them (happily, obliviously).
The Means indicates a method the Tourist is using to participate in a tour.
The time that the touring takes place.
Some action that the Tourist is trying to accomplish with touring. This is generally (at a minimum) for the purposes of entertainment and learning.
The location where the touring takes place.
The amount of time the touring activity lasts.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
The Co_participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the touring event with the Tourist.

A Toxic_substance causes death or harm when introduced into or absorbed by a living organism, the Victim. The Toxic_substance may be specified to be produced by or contained in a Toxin_source. The Toxic_substance may affect the Victim as a whole or a particular Body_part (understood here to include organs and other sub-systems). A Degree of harmfulness can be specified and the Toxic_substance may develop its effect only under particular Circumstances. The main product , sulphide , is toxic to cells They are better tolerated and are less toxic in overdose The reason he was close to danger was because an extremely poisonous beetle was crawling down his shoulder. Ingested gliadin and PT-gliadin are toxic to coeliac patients.
The Victim is the being or entity that is capable of being harmed by the Toxic_substance.
Degree is the degree to which the Toxic_substance is harmful to the Victim.
The Body_part defines the part of the Victim's body that is harmed.
A fact or action that explains why the Toxic_substance has a harmful effect on the Victim .
This FE marks expressions that indicate the substance which potentially causes harm to a Victim.
A set of circumstances, often the relative amount of the Toxic_substance that is present, under which the Toxic_substance is specified to have or lack a toxic effect.
A living organism, object or process that produces a Toxic_substance.
Type identifies the kind or sort of Toxic_substance.
Temporal period for which the substance or source remains toxic to the victim.

Basic Image Schema: contains a (more) profiled element, the Trajector, and an un- or less profiled element, the Landmark. In combination with a schematically-defined Profiled_region (with a pre-defined relationship to the Landmark), the Landmark serves as the basis for understanding the status or location of the Trajector. This schema essentially establishes a point-of-view or focus. above.prep and below.prep both make use of the verticality schema, but are differentiated by whether the Landmark is associated with the upper region and the Profiled_region with the lower or vice-versa. The cat in the shed purred violently . The shed around the cat shook . We 'll have to leave before noon . In the 1990s , though , the rate at which DNA could be read revved into high gear .
The entity whose status or location is (generally) unknown, and whose status or location is established by examining the Profiled_region.

The entity, generally presupposed, whose status or location is known or knowable and which thus serves as a basis for understanding the status or location of the Trajector by locating it in a Profiled_region which has a particular relation to the Landmark.

The region which has a particular shape, orientation, size, and location (literal or metaphorical) with respect to the Landmark. The shape of the Profiled_region is virtually always incorporated in the target. This shaped region usually includes the location of the Landmark, as seen with in.prep, at.prep, on.prep, but may also do exactly the opposite, as with away from.prep.
This frame involves a Donor transferring a Theme to a Recipient.
The entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
The person that begins in possession of the Theme and causes it to be in the possession of the Recipient.
The Reason for which an event occurs.
The Donor and Recipient conceived of as a unit.
The action whereby the transfer of the Theme from the Donor to the Recipient is effected.
Any description of the transfer which is not covered by more specific FEs
This FE identifies the purpose for which a Theme is transferred
In this scenario, the Theme begins in the possession of the Donor and ends up in the possession of the Recipient. Alternatively, these two participants may be jointly construed as Transferors.
The entity that ends up in possession of the Theme.
The person that begins in possession of the Theme and causes it to be in the possession of the Recipient.
The Donor and Recipient conceived of as a unit.
This frame characterizes, at a very abstract level, an Agent or Cause affecting a Patient. This frame is inherited by many lower-level frames.
Agent is the entity that acts on another entity.
Patient is the entity that is being acted on and that may but need not undergo a change.
Event is an event in which an agent acts on an entity.
Depictive phrase describing the actor of an action.
An act performed by anAgent that enables them to act upon the Patient.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The time at which the event takes place
The location at which the event takes place.
An event which causes the Patient to be affected in some way.

A Cognizer produces a Target_symbol which represents, in the Target_representation format, a Content that pre-exists in the form of a Source_symbol in a Source_representation format. This word is sometimes translated as ` girl '. CNI They all wore symbolic black clothes over bright yellow T-shirts and all spoke in Welsh, their statements being translated into English afterwards. CNI His texts were translated from French into Scots by Carl Gronau. Perhaps when Irish monks spoke in Latin about lionn, meaning ale, they translated the word literally from Irish into Latin as biber, 'drink'. Each of the ten Greek nouns below can be accurately translated by using just one English word. CNI.
This is the person who carries out the translation.
A symbol or set of symbols representing the Content in the Source_representation format.
The representation system in which the Content pre-exists.

Any description of the translation event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of the Cognizer that also affect the action (deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An intentional action performed by the Cognizer which accomplishes the translation of the Content.
This Frame Element marks expressions that indicate when a certain Categorization was made.
The Circumstances are the set of conditions in which the translation is made.
A symbol or set of symbols representing the Content in the Target_representation format.
The representation system into which the Content is rendered by the Cognizer.
The information that is meant to be represented by the Source_symbol and Target_symbol.
An assessment of how equivalent the Source_representation and the Target_representation are.
The Medium is a text produced by the Cognizer in which she uses a Target_symbol to express Content from a Source_representation system.
The location where the translation takes place.
The state-of-affairs that the Cognizer hopes to bring about by translating.

In this frame a Traveler goes on a journey, an activity, generally planned in advance, in which the Traveler moves from a Source location to a Goal along a Path or within an Area. The journey can be accompanied by Co_participants and Baggage. The Duration or Distance of the journey, both generally long, may also be described as may be the Mode_of_transportation. Words in this frame emphasize the whole process of getting from one place to another, rather than profiling merely the beginning or the end of the journey. Ellen journeyed to Europe with five suitcases. Samantha journeyed 2500 miles with her family by sea to China.The Osbournes took a trip from Beverly Hills to London on the Concorde.
This is the Area in which the traveling takes place. This frame element describes the enclosed area inside which travelling, of unspecified Source, Path or Goal takes place.
The Co_participant is the person or persons who accompany the Traveler on the journey.
This FE dientifies the Distance traveled.
This FE identifies the Duration of time during which the trip occurs.
The Goal is the location where the travelers end up.
The Manner in which the traveling takes place.
The action done by the Traveler by which the traveling is accomplished.
The Path is the route along which the travel takes place.
This is the living being which travels. Normally, the Traveler is expressed as an external argument.
The Source is the starting point of the trip.
The Speed is the rate at which the travel takes place.

The Mode_of_transportation expresses how the motion of the Traveler is effected, by their body or by a vehicle which holds and conveys the Traveler. Vehicles can move in any way and in any medium. They are usually expressed obliquely with 'in' or 'by'.
The Reason for which the travel is undertaken.
The Baggage are the items necessary for travel that accompany the Traveler.
The Frequency with which the Traveler makes the journey.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Traveler travels, i.e. the future state of affairs that will hopefully come about.
The number of times the trip is traveled by the Travelers.
The Time throughout which the traveling repeatedly takes place.
This FE applies to expressions that indicate documents, money, tickets, etc. which allow people to engage in travel.
The state of the Traveler during the journey.
The affect of travel on a Traveler.
The Place is the location of the motion. It describes the area in which motion (with a specified Source, Path or Goal) takes place.
The direction in which the Traveler goes.
A characterisitic of the traveling event.
A Theme changes location with respect to a salient Path location.

This is the object which moves. In many sentences this FE will be expressed as something which moves under its own power. However, this FE is not required to be an animate mover, so it is different from Self_mover.

Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion expresses the frame element Source. In prepositional phrases, the prepositional object expresses the starting point of motion. In particles, the starting point of motion is understood from context.
Any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal (see below) expresses the frame element Path, including directional expressions:
Any expression which tells where the Theme ends up as a result of the motion expresses the frame element Goal.

Any expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion expresses the frame element Manner. Descriptions of speed, steadiness, grace, means of motion, and other things count as Manner expressions.
Any expression which characterizes the extent of motion expresses the frame element Distance.
This frame element is used for expressions which describe a general area in which motion takes place when the motion is understood to be irregular and not to consist of a single linear path.
An event involving the Theme that results in the Theme moving in the specified way.
The Speed is the rate at which the Theme moves.
This is the second moving object, expressed as a direct object or an oblique:
Depictive phrase describing the actor of an action
The Place is where the motion (which is specified by a Source, Path or Goal) is located.
The configuration formed by the entire Path of the Theme, taken simultaneously.
The direction in which the Theme goes.
The time at which the motion takes place.
The state-of-affairs that the Theme wishes to bring about.
The device or bodypart that serves to move the Theme.
The length of time that the Theme spends in motion.
The state of the Theme at the end of the event.
A factor which explains the particular motion or manner of motion of the Theme.

An event paired with the motion, which explains why the motion is expected. In particular, or an action thatReciprocation is used to indicate an action that is being rewarded or punished by the motion, is paired with the motion as the other side of an agreement.
An event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at the time the Traversing occurs and which the Traversing is taken to be a part of.
The number of times that an action occurs in a given time.
A larger conceptualization that includes the Traversing as an integral part. The Traversing expressed by the target typically corresponds to a Means action in this larger conceptualization.
An unexpected event that affects some agent (usually the Theme), which is enabled by, and occurs after, the Traversing.

The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the Traversing event itself and any of its participants, and is merely peripherally related to the event as a whole.
The Source and Goal of either a single or a repeated motion taken together as Endpoints of the Path.

The label Coordinated_event is to be used for phrases denoting an event-it does not allow states-that the Traversing is rhythmically aligned with. The Coordinated_event is conceived of as independent: it would occur regardless of the event expressed by the target, which is not even an incidental or optional sub-part of the Coordinated_event.
The time period within which the motion event occurs repeatedly.
In general, this FE is used for phrases that describe the clause of the target as a whole. There are two somewhat distinct subgroups of sentence modifiers that cover this function.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.

A Behavior, attributed to an Evaluee, conforms with or is heavily influenced by a popular trend or practice, often in the realm of fashion, design, though extending social and interactional behavior in general. Trendiness differs from Popularity in adding a factor of aesthetic or other judgment to behaviors and individuals, and judging these with respect to social behavior; Popularity is about amount of acceptability or utilization based on general (often non-aesthetic) desirability. Wearing flowered brocaded silks was fashionable in the first few years of the decade.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the degree of trendiness from the norm or from the value for another Behavior.
The Time during which the Behavior is trendy or fashionable.
Some specification of the circumstances under which the Behavior is trendy or not.
The Evaluee is judged to conform to some degree with popular fashion with respect to his or her behavior.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment of trendiness.
The location where the Behavior is trendy..

A trial is a process conducted in a Court before a Judge and (usually) a Jury in which the participants meet in order to decide a Case. The Prosecution attempts to prove that the Defendant is guilty of the Charges and the Defense tries to prove that the Defendant is innocent. Trials have a rich schematic structure which is only partially represented here. The Trial frame is the part of the Criminal Process frame that occurs after a crime, Arrest of a suspect, Arraignment, jury selection, etc. and before Sentencing and Punishment or release. The Trial is made up of court appearances. The beginning of the Trial generally involves Opening Arguments, in which the Prosecution and the Defense present their respective points of view. Then during the course of the Trial, both sides present evidence, some of which is provided by witnesses with testimony, and this is then drawn upon as support for their arguments. Following the presentation of evidence, testimony, and arguments, generally culminating in Closing Arguments for each side, the Jury (if present) deliberates and either comes to no sufficient consensus or produces a Verdict.
The legal label for the crime that the Defendant is accused of.
The specific room where the participants in a Trial meet.
The individual or group which is responsible for promoting the welfare of the Defendant during a Trial, usually involving the contention that the Defendant is innocent of the Charges.
The group of individuals who observe the Trial and ultimately attempt to come to a verdict.
This FE identifies the place where the trial occurs.
The individual or group responsible for promoting the interests of the state in the Trial, prototypically including presenting arguments for the guilt of the the Defendant.
This FE identifies the Time when the trial occurs.
The person charged with an offence.
The official who directs and presides over the Trial.
The Case which a Trial is convened to decide.
The way in which the Trial is conducted.
A Cognizer thinks that the Information given by a particular Source is correct. The specific Content or Topic of the Information may also be described.
The Cognizer is the person who has an opinion about the reliability of a Source or the Information from the Source.
The Topic is the entity that a Cognizer trusts information about.
The Content denotes the mental content that the Cognizer is certain or uncertain about.
This FE indicates the Degree to which the Cognizer trusts the Source.
A description of an aspect of the Cognizer that also affects the nature of the trusting, or a general comparison of the state-of-affairs to others.
An object or action associated with the Cognizer which is so affected by the Cognizer's belief that it reveals the Cognizer's state.
The individual that gives Information to the Cognizer.
The text or speech which the Cognizer has heard and evaluates the truth of.
A Defendant is tried by a Jury or Judge in a Court for Charges. This frame perspectivalizes the general Trial frame.
The Judge heads the court where the case is tried. An expression referring to the court may also stand in for the Judge.
This FE identifies the Court in which a case is tried.
The Defendant is being tried for the Charges in Court.
This FE identifies the people who are charged by the Court to listen to the testimony, evidence, and arguments, and come to a consensus about the guilt or innocence of the Defendant.
This FE identifies the Time when the case is tried.
This FE identifies the place where the case is tried.
This FE identifies the Charges brought against the Defendant.
The Defendant is tried under the laws of the Governing_authority.
The Manner of the trial of the Defendant.

An Evaluator participates in an Experience (or metonymically, a salient Entity of the Experience), often for the first time, in order to form an opinion about its quality. The aspect of quality that is being judged is often implicit but may be expressed as the Purpose of the Evaluator's participation. Have you tried my latest get-rich-quick scheme? INI Don tried out the bike to see if it was the right size.
The person (or metonymic manifestation thereof) that participates in the Experience.
The activity or event that the Evaluator participates in.
Entity is something that the Evaluator uses to try an Experience, and metonymically stands in for the Experience.
A description of how the Evaluator acts in having the Experience.
A description of what the Evaluator does in order to participate in the Experience.
A more explicit description of what the Evaluator seeks to learn by having the Experience.
The temporal location during which the Experience occurs.
The physical location in which the Experience occurs.

A State_of_affairs turns out to be true in someone's knowledge of the world. This may be recognized with evidence or in certain circumstances. The cognizer whose beliefs are affected is not expressed. Hybrid grass may prove to be a valuable fuel source.
The state of affairs that a cognizer realizes.
The time at which the State_of_affairs is realized.

This frame has to do with nouns denoting types of entities. The Subtype refers to a collection of members of a more general Category which have certain defining characteristics; alternatively, the Subtype refers only to the type itself, i.e. a more restrictive set of characteristics than those of the more general Category. The properties of the items that are included in the collection may be specified by the Item_Property. Sometimes the Subtypes themselves are described by some Type_Property. I don't like this newfangled kind of fish. Kleo isn't our sort of people. He argued against the formalist type of analysis of art. I think that she was referring to the other type. DNI
The entity which denotes a subtype of the more general Category.
The more general type that the target denotes a subtype of. This FE is obligatory and should be labeled DNI when not present.
A property of the Subtype itself rather than the members of the Category.
A property of the members of the Category that helps identify (directly or indirectly) the particular set of members that are referred to by the Subtype.

An Entity is generally, or with regard to a particular Feature, representative of the Comparison_set of which it is a member. The Elan truly is an unusual car; the first and only Lotus with a front engined/front wheel drive layout, and the first new Lotus to be introduced since 1975. I need a plain, vanilla example that doesn't use PRINT! How smart is the average drug user/experimenter? It's not unusual to be loved by anyone, It's not unusual to have fun with anyone, Is lying normal for a child this age, and how can I best handle this situation?
The extent to which the Entity varies from other members of the Comparison_set.
The concrete or abstract thing which is evaluated with regard to whether it exhibits the essential characteristics of a Comparison_set.
The set of indviduals, which are of similar kind to the Entity, and to which the Entity is compared.
A property of the Entity wherein it differs or is similar to members of a Comparison_set.
A Reported_fact is presented by the speaker as deriving from statements (made directly to them or to others) of third parties.
An assertion of a state, event, property or existence or the assignment to a category that the speaker attributes to unnamed others.
The Time at which the Reported_fact was reported.
The span of time for which the Reported_fact has been circulating.
The reason for which or the apparant cause of the Reported_fact.

An Entity changes, either in its category membership or in terms of the value of an Attribute. In the former case, an Initial_category and a Final_category may be expressed, in the latter case an Initial_value and a Final_value can be specified. As soon as Tiffany kissed the frog, Tiffany turned into a frog. He chanted and the rock changed shape, becoming a great double bitted axe. The College has changed markedly over the century since it first opened its doors. If I'm understanding you correctly, you want the switchbar color to change whenever the bot says something? My life instantly changed from an empty life, to a life full of joy and purpose. As you can see, the word WALK changed from red to green rather than have a separate lens for each colour. My feet turned to stone. The promise will turn to ashes if progress is not made. The price changed from $1.26 to $1.27 per pint. DNI At least one relative instruction has changed in size from short to long
The concrete or abstract entity that undergoes a change.
The type of Entity that results from the change.
The category that the Entity belongs to before it undergoes the change.
The time at which the Entityundergoes the transformation.
The value of the Attribute before the change takes place.
The value of the Attribute that results from the change.
A characteristic of the Entity for which a value can be assigned or determined by calculation, measurement , or observation.

Any description of the Change event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
The extent to which the initial and final values or categories differ from each other.
The physical or abstract Circumstances under which the change takes place.
An event or state that causes the change to take place.
A value that the Attribute assumes before the Final_value obtains.
The Initial_value and Final_value taken together as the range through which the Entity changes. The main faith of the church has changed between Orthodox, Protestant and Greek Catholic several times.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.
An Entity is affected by an Event.
The thing which is affected by the Event.
A change in the world which affects the Entity.
The Time at which the Entity undergoes the Event.
The location at which the Entity undergoes the Event.
The Reason for which the Entity undergoes the Event.
The Purpose for which the Entity undergoes the Event.
Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
A Wearer removes an item of Clothing from a Body_location (the part of the body that the Clothing is prototypically worn on.) Walking on sand is better if you take off your shoes. INI
The individual who begins the action wearing the Clothing and ends the action without it.
The item that the Wearer is initially wearing but then removes.

The initial location of the Clothing on the body, before it changes location. Quite often, the location is not overtly specified and is implicitly supplied by the location on the body that the Clothing is prototypically associated with.

Any description of the clothing removal which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of a Wearer that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The Means is an act whereby the Wearer achieves the removal.
The location at which the Wearer undresses an item of Clothing.
The time at which a Wearer undresses.
The purpose for which a Wearer undresses.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.

Based on how many Individuals are employed, the Individuals as a whole are described with a Value (either a percentage or absolute number) representing the Employment of the Individuals. Unemployment is down, salaries are up for US chemists. As a result, the unemployment of Roma is very high. Today's report finds that unemployment among single mothers rose for the first time in six years in 2002. DNI In the 1950s and '60s, joblessness of 6 to 7 percent was intense, but now an unemployment rate of below 6 percent could be inflationary. DNI. The economy was operating at full capacity, traditionally defined as employment of 96 percent of the civilian labor force. DNI
The group of people whose employment status is considered.
The property of a group of Individuals describing how many of them are employed or unemployed.
The count or percentage of people among the group of Individuals that are of the specified employment status.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the Value from the norm.
The Time during which Employment level of the Individuals has a specified Value.
The number or rate of individuals that are either employed or unemployment may be contrasted, implicitly or explicitly, with different groups.
The location where the Individuals under consideration reside.

An Agent causes a Firearm to discharge, usually directing the projectile from the barrel of the Firearm (the Source), along a Path, and to a Goal. The Germans wouldn't stop shooting cannons at them. Oswald fired twice through the window.
The self-directed entity that uses and activates the Firearm.
This FE identifies the Firearm that an Agent activates so that it rapidly propels a projectile.
This FE identifies the means by which an Agent uses the Firearm.
This FE identifies the manner in which an Agent uses the Firearm.
This FE identifies the place where the Agent intentionally affects the Patient.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent uses the firearm.
This FE identifies the Time when the Agent fires the Firearm.
Goal is the location the Theme ends up in, or is intended to end up in.
This is the path along which the projectiles travel.
The Source is the location of the Firearm from which projectiles originate.
Area is the setting in which the projectile's movement takes place.
This FE identifies the number of times a firearm is used.
Depicitive phrase describing the state of a participant in the action.
A Driver transports themselves and possibly other passengers (the Theme) to another location.
The Theme is the entity which moves by means of the Vehicle.
The Vehicle is the means of conveyance of the Theme. It is usually expressed in a PP-complement or the direct object.
Any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion expresses the frame element Source.
The Manner describes a property of the motion not related to its trajectory.
The Path describes the trajectory of the motion.
The Goal is the endpoint of the trajectory of motion.
The Distance is the extent of the motion.
The Duration is the amount of time the motion takes.
The Speed is the rate at which the motion occurs.
The Area is the location where the motion takes place.
The Road is the thoroughfare on which the Vehicle travels.
The Route is the usual path that the Vehicle travles.
A theme that rides in the same Vehicle as the main Theme.
The individual that directs the motion of the Vehicle

Through use, a Resource is diminished in quality or quantity (up to complete attrition) such that it becomes less capable of sustaining future use. My entire life savings is depleted due to university and medical bills. All significant oil and gas reserves are exhausted or have dwindled to an uneconomical level except for those of the Middle East. Use shampoo and conditioner every day until the shampoo and conditioner are completely used up.
The Resource is a physical entity or an ability to perform work that was used in an earlier process, typically in pursuit of a goal.
A measure of the amount of the Resource that is gone, or of the degree to which its quality is reduced.
The Explanation denotes an event or state from whose occurrence the Resource's being used up logically follows.
This FE indicates that the presence of an overwhelming amount of a kind of entity or the high intensity of an event is sufficient to bring about the used up state of the Resource.
Subregion denotes a sub-part of the Resource in which the it is specifically exhausted or worn out.

An Entity aids in the successful completion of a Purpose. Its Degree of utility may also be expressed. Some of the lexical units in this frame (e.g. great, good) can only express permanent, generic states of the Entity.
The item which is useful for some purpose.
The kind of task which is promoted by the use or presence of the Entity.
The amount that the presence of the Entity aids in the completion of the (desirable) Purpose.
This Frame Element marks expressions of a Domain or parameter with respect to which the Entity is useful.
When the Entity is useful for a Purpose.
An Agent manipulates an Instrument in order to achieve a Purpose.
The Agent uses the Instrument to achieve their Purpose.
This FE identifies the place where the Agent uses the Instrument.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent uses the Instrument.
This FE identifies the time when the Agent uses the Instrument.
This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent uses the Instrument.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action ( deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An entity directed by the Agent that serves to bring about the Purpose of the Agent.
An Instrument that has a function associated with it.
The Outcome is the failure or success of the Agent's using the Instrument to achieve their Purpose.
An event within which the Agent uses the Instrument. Often, the Containing_event will also give an indication of the Agent's Purpose.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question "how often."
This FE modifies a clause with an iterative interpretation, which may be signified by the simple present tense on the main verb.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action. The depicted state does not necessarily or usually facilitate or cause the state of affairs reported by the target.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.
This FE identifies the population within which the Using event occurs.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute of the Instrument or the Using act and modifies the expected value for it.

Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation to its end. In many cases, the continuous situation is a dynamic action which is ongoing, while in others it is simply an undifferentiated state.
The frame concerns the vehicles that human beings use for the purpose of transportation.
This FE identifies a characteristic or description of the Vehicle.
Vehicle is the transportation device that the human beings use to travel.
This Frame Element denotes the Possessor of the Vehicle.
The frame element tells about the time and route of the service of the transportation device.
The Means_of_propulsion designates how the vehicle is moved.
The task which the Vehicle is put to. Normally, this includes the transportation of some kind.
In this frame, which is a part of the Trial sequence, a Judge gives a Finding with respect to the Charges against the Defendant in a particular Case.
The Judge (which may be the jury, judge, magistrate or court) decides on the Finding.
This FE identifies the outcome of the Judge's deliberation or consideration.
The person who stands accused of a crime and is subject to the verdict.
This FE refers to the Charges with respect to which the verdict is being given.
The Case on which the verdict is being given.
This FE indicates the basis in law of a verdict.
The Circumstances under which the verdict was reached.
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Judge acts.
This FE identifies the purpose for which the Judge returns a particular verdict.
This FE identifies an action that the Judge performs in order to return the verdict.
The Reason for the verdict given.
An Inspector attains a degree of certainty in the Unconfirmed_content, generally by inspecting some evidence.
The individual or individuals that ascertain that the Unconfirmed_content is true.
An open proposition that the Inspector decides by examining evidence. It is usually a propostion put forward which some parties would disbelieve or contest.

Any description of the verification which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), force (hard, softly), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Inspector that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An action performed by the Inspector by which the Inspector manages to establish the truth of the Unconfirmed_content.
The amount of certainty which the Inspector achieves after the process of verification.
The state of affairs that the Inspector hopes to bring about by going through the verification.
The Medium is the piece of text or work in which the Inspector verifies the Unconfirmed_content:
A tool or instrument used by the Inspector in the verification process.
The conditions under which the the verification will occur.
This FE describes a characteristic of the verification event.
This FE identifies the "by rule" domain in which the verification event is true or operational (often denoted by words such as "technically," "technically," "formally," etc.
This FE describes the Time at which the verification event takes place.
This FE describes where the verificiation event takes place.
The reason for the state of the verification event.
An entity goes through several versions, from initial to final.
The Item is one version among several versions (which may or may not yet exist), progressively getting closer to a final version.
The degree of the distance the Item is from the final version.

A Visitor matches location with a Host by going to a place strongly associated with a Host, the Host_location (often a place of residence, employment, or government), in order to achieve a Purpose. The Host allows the use of his/her resources. The visit is often social in nature.
The sentient entity that heads toward and is temporarily with the Host in order to fulfil some Purpose.
An individual that allows the use of his or her resources for the benefit of the Visitor.
The activity that is enabled by the hospitality of the Host and that the Visitor wishes to achieve.
The location that the Visitor normally resides in or is (permanently) associated with.
The location associated with the Host, where the Visitor arrives at and remains during the visit.
The Visitor arrives at the Host_location to visit the Host.
The Visitor goes to the Host

Normal_location is any expression which implies a definite starting-point of motion. While Normal_location expressions are possible in this frame, they are relatively infrequent. If present, they often express a general direction from which a Visitor moves, rather than a landmark away from which it moves.
Path is any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Normal_location nor a Host_location. In this frame, Path expressions almost always have a via-sense.
The Host welcomes the Visitor as a guest. The location strongly associated with the Host serves as the goal of the Visitor's motion.

A Manner expression describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion. Descriptions of speed, steadiness, grace, means of motion, and other things count as Manner expressions.
This FE identifies the Means by which an Visitor arrives.

The Mode_of_transportation expresses how the motion of the Visitor is effected, by its body or by a vehicle which holds and conveys the Visitor. Vehicles can move in any way and in any medium. They are usually expressed obliquely with 'in' or 'by'.
This FE identifies the Time when arriving occurs.
This FE identifies the purpose for which the Visitor arrives at the Host or Host_location.
The Host_location is a location associated with the Host, and is commonly the place of residence or employment of the Host.
The place where the arrival event occurs.
A Visitor departs from a Host_location after having visited a Host.
The Visitor departs from the location of the Host.
The Visitor departs from the Host_location, a location strongly associated with the Host.
Any description of the trajectory of the departure which is neither a Source nor a Goal expresses the frame element Path. In this frame, Path expressions almost always have a sense meaning 'via'.
This FE labels any expression which tells where the Visitor ends up, or would end up, as a result of departing from the Source.

Any expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion expresses the frame element Manner. Descriptions of steadiness, grace, and many other things count as Manner expressions, though Speed and Means should be tagged using the more specific FE labels.
The action of the Visitor which results in their departure.
This frame element labels words or phrases that describe how quickly the Visitor is moving.

The Mode_of_transportation expresses how the motion of the Visitor is effected, by its body or by a vehicle which holds and conveys the Visitor. Vehicles can move in any way and in any medium. In this frame, Mode_of_transportation is often expressed obliquely in a prepositional phrase headed by 'in' or 'by'.
The distance that the Visitor has traveled.

The Host allows the Visitor to use his/her resources, and to remain temporarily at the Host_location.
A Visitor is located with a Host for a visit.
The sentient entity that is temporarily with the Host in order to fulfil some Purpose.

The Host welcomes the Visitor to his/her location, with which he/she is permanently associated. The Host allows the Visitor use of resources to accomplish a Purpose. During the visit, the Visitor matches location with the Host.
A state (of the Visitor) that results as a consequence of the Visitor being situated with the Host.
The activity that is enabled by the Host and that the Visitor wishes to achieve.
The location that the Visitor normally resides in or is (permanently) associated with.
The time at which a visit is made.
The amount of time that the Visitor spends with the Host.

This frame is concerned with the sounds produced by animate entities by means of their vocal tracts. Descriptions of sounds from artifacts meant to emulate such sounds, or to act as vocalizing animals or people, are also treated here as figurative language.
An entity that is construed as a single point source emitting sound.
The place from which the sound emanates.

The location at which sound is produced. This FE differs from Location_of_sound_source in that it does not highlight the sound's spreading from its source to the perceiver's location, which is usually indicated by the preposition "from".
The noise-making may be prompted by either some outside phenomenon or occurrence, or by an Internal_cause, that is the mental or emotional state of an animate Sound_source.
Certain properties of the sound relating to its production, loudness, etc may be of lexicographic interest if they describe properties of a sounds as such: loudly, shrilly, etc.
Expressions that indicate the loudness of the sound.
This FE idntifies the Reason that the Sound_source produces the sound. Generally, this is some external stimulus that prompts the Sound_source to make noise.
The Path along which the sound travels away from the Sound_source.
How often the Vocalization event occurs.

These words describe the size of message that a Speaker is judged by a (usually unexpressed) Judge to give, either in a specific occasion or Topic or in general. As in other communication frames, Medium may also be expressed.
This is the person who is characterized as talkative, reticent etc. It is usually the External Argument:
The Company in which the Speaker exhibits a certain communicative behavior. In this frame, Company occurs in PP Complements headed by with:

Text is rarely expressed because the quantity of information given is the focus of the frame, rather than the information content. Texts can occur as NP objects, but cannot be either direct quotes or complement clauses.
This FE is the Topic on which much or little information is communicated. Topic is far more frequent than Message in this frame.
Medium is the physical entity or channel used to communicate, as in other Communication frames. It is usually a PP Complement headed by in or on.
Degree to which the Speaker withholds or does not withhold information and conversation.
