The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.

A Gambler commits an Asset to a prediction that an Uncertain_situation will have a particular Outcome (or class of outcomes). He or she loses the Asset if the prediction ends up being incorrect, and gains it back plus additional winnings if the prediction ends up correct.
The person who wages the Asset on a certain Outcome.
The place where the Gambler makes the wager.
The time when the Gambler makes the wager.
Something desirable possessed by or directly associated with the Gambler which is lost if the Gambler loses the wager.
The Frequency with which the Gambler makes wagers.
The desired action or goal that the Gambler hopes to bring about.
An Explanation for why the Gambler has put the Asset up in a wager.
The number of times that the Gambler makes wagers.
The Circumstances indicates the state of affairs under which the Gambler makes a wager.
The Gambler intends for his/her actions to benefit Beneficiary in some way.
The Gambler predicts that a certain Outcome will hold.
The Gambler predicts how an Uncertain_situation will resolve.

A Protagonist delays a planned action because they cannot or do not want to proceed until an Expected_event occurs. The Expected_event may be evoked by reference to a Salient_entity that participates in it. If a Salient_entity is expressed, the Expected_event is typically the arrival of the Salient_entity at the Place where the Protagonist is located. The cat waited on top of the washer as Elmer popped the lid off the can of cat food and then pounded the can's contents onto the plate The family was furious that their 84-year-old dad had to wait 52 hours in the emergency room. Although in both frames a Protagonist/Agent is not performing some desired action for some period of time, the use of wait.v in this frame is different from that in Holding_off_on in that Waiting prominently portrays a future event that will allow the Protagonist to proceed (with doing something), whereas Holding_off_on does not necessarily imply that there is some event or state-of-affairs that will allow the Agent to proceed, rather focussing on the action that the Agent is not yet taking.
The sentient being who cannot proceed with their planned activities until a Salient_entity has arrived or an Expected_event has occurred.
A concrete or abstract entity that the Protagonist expects to participate in an Expected_event, typically that of arriving at the Place of the Protagonist.
The time period during which the Protagonist is waiting.
The location in which the Protagonist is waiting.
Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of the waiting to its end.

Any description of the waiting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way) and salient characteristics of the Protagonist that also affect the action (patiently, anxiously).
The Expected_event is an event that needs to take place or a state that needs to begin to hold before the Protagonist can proceed with their planned activities.
The point in time, defined either as a clock time or in terms of an event that takes place, at which the Protagonist ends the waiting.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the occurrence of the waiting event logically follows.
This FE describes the Protagonist as being in some state during the waiting.
An action that the Protagonist intends to accomplish by waiting.

Co_participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the same event as the primary protagonist, regardless of whether the protagonist, and hence the Co_participant, is more agent- or more undergoer-like.
A Sleeper transitions from a state of consciousness where they are largely unaware of their environment to a wakeful state.
This FE identifies the Place where the event occurs.
This FE identifies the sleeping entity.
This FE identifies the Time when the event occurs.
This describes the state out of which the Sleeper awakens.
The Manner in which the Sleeper awakens.
The state of the Sleeper upon waking up.
The World_state is the situation the Sleeper finds him or herself in upon awaking.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
This FE indicates an instance of the Waking_up event within an iterated series of similar events or states.
The reason for which the Sleeper awakes from the Sleep_state.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.
A Suspect has been investigated and has a warrant issued for his or her arrest on certain Charges. Bill is wanted on murder charges.
The Suspect is suspected of having committed a crime by the authorities who want the Suspect to enter the criminal process.
The Charges are the offenses the Suspect will be accused of committing.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.

A Cognizer faces a choice on some Issue. They have several Options available but keep changing their mind between Option_1 and Option_2. The Cognizer may in fact act on their choice at some point but they need not; the Options can simply be considered for some time with one being favored for a while and then the other. Dave Hayes wavered about moving to California because so many of his friends are in Baltimore. He had wavered between half a dozen places; it was pure chance that he had chosen Marvis Bay. In any event, I still go back and forth on what I want to do. He was firm in his beliefs, never waffled from one platform to another and was always harshly clear in his stance. Upper management waffled whether Fletcher fit their salary structure.
The Cognizer is the person who repeatedly changes their mind about which of the Options to choose.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which it logically follows that the Cognizer keeps changing their mind about the Issue.
The Options are the alternative courses of action or the alternative physical or concrete entities that the Cognizer can choose from.
This FE identifies thePlace where the Cognizer keeps changing their mind between the Options that present themselves.
This FE denotes the Time interval during which the Cognizer keeps changing their mind about which of the Options to select.

Any description of the selecting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way) and salient characteristics of the Cognizer that also affect the action.
The Issue is a question about a course of action or a choice between items.

When there is an explicitly separate construal of the Options, Option_1 is the first-mentioned alternative, typically in the form of a from-PP. When it is clear that the Cognizer actually acted on their choice, Option_1 is the alternative they embraced first before pursuing Option_2.

When there is an explicitly separate construal of the Options, Option_2 is the second-mentioned alternative, typically in the form of a to-PP. When it is clear that the Cognizer actually acted on their choice, Option_2 is the alternative they embraced after abandoning Option_1.

In the cases where the Cognizer does not act on their choice, the Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of the Cognizer's deliberations to the end. In situations where the Cognizer does act on the Options, the Duration denotes the length of the interval during which the Cognizer repeatly changes from one option to the other.
This FE describes the number of times within a given period that the Cognizer wavers.
The Degree to which the Cognizer wavers.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
A Person or Institution is being described in terms of their wealthiness, in other words the amount of money in their possession. Jess is very rich. The university is wealthy.
The individual or individuals whose wealthiness is being described.
A group which has (or lacks) possession of some resource.
The degree of wealthiness (or poverty) of the Person or Institution.
A characterization of the entity (usually money) that the Person (or Institution possesses.

A Weapon is an artifact created specifically to cause harm or damage. In some cases, a Use, Material of construction, Part or Type may be more narrowly specified. Did you, or did you not, fire this gun with intent to harm my client? Cyra tried to swing her sword to parry, but it was to heavy. I investigated a specialist precious metal firearms manufacturer. My neighbor, a member of the NRA since birth, has got an AK-47 fully automatic assault rifle. Let 's just say that he 's the kind of guy who likes guns with hair triggers.
An entity prototypically used by a Wielder to cause damage.
The type of activity that the Weapon is generally involved in. Often this can be considered a kind of Type specification also.
This FE indicates what subtype of the general category the Weapon belongs to.
The substance that makes up the Weapon.
The person (or other sentient entity) that is using the Weapon.
This FE identifies a part of the Weapon. This includes permanent, obligatory parts and mere attachments.
The term used to refer to an Weapon.
The time at which a Weapon comes into existence.
The individual or group responsible for the creation of the Weapon.
A description or characteristic of the Weapon.

The words in this frame refer to what Clothing the Wearer (or a specific Body_part of the Wearer) has on. I had on the most ridiculous monkey-suit you could imagine. These two losers were wearing bras on their heads! Many targets incorporate the Clothing item, and some targets describe the state of not wearing something (when it might be expected). Do you think anyone would notice if I went topless? NB: There is a very common metonymy in which characteristics of the clothing stand for the clothing itself, such as the man clad in leather. She was dressed all in red. Such sentences should be tagged METAPHOR on the sentence level.
The person whose clothing is under discussion.
This FE identifies the Clothing that the Wearerwears.
The body part of the Wearer which is covered by the Clothing.
A characterization of how completely the clothing status holds.
A characterization of the impression given by the Wearer's clothing status.
The time at or during which the Wearer has the Clothing on.
The location that the Wearer exits while wearing the Clothing.
The location that the Wearer arrives at or enters while wearing the Clothing.
The state-of-affairs that the Wearer wishes to bring about.
The location relative to the body of the Wearer that the Clothing occupies. Note that in many cases, the location is defined relative to other clothing.

Ambient conditions of temperature, precipitation, windiness, and sunniness pertain at a certain Place and Time. Further Specification of the conditions that pertain may also be indicated. A blustery storm blew in. There was a thick blizzard last night. An armada of hailstorms swept through the region.
This FE identifies the Place where the weather occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the weather occurs.
This FE identifies a further Specification of the weather conditions.

A Whole is made up of multiple Parts, which themselves may not be independent of each other or of the Whole. Wholes_and_parts is contrasted with Set_relation, where the Whole is simply a set of a number of (usually independent) parts.
The Whole is the larger entity that includes the Part.
The Part is either a subset or a constituent part of the Whole.
Any description of the inclusion event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).
The Time at which the inclusion relation holds.
The location at which the inclusion relation holds.

A Cognizer would engage in an Activity if asked or otherwise prompted to do so. The court is willing to depart from the usual range of sentencing . The Nicaraguan National Assembly has been reluctant to destroy the remaining stockpile. The Turks are in grudging acceptance of terms set by EU. Would you be preparedto give up some of your privacy to industry to help improve customer service?
The Cognizer is the individual that is willing to engage in the Activity.
The Activity is what the Cognizer would do under certain circumstances.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the Cognizer's willingness logically follows.
This FE identifies thePlace where the Cognizer is willing to engage in the Activity.
This FE identifies the Time when the Cognizer is willing to engage in the Activity.
The state of affairs that the Cognizer wants to achieve by being willing to engage in the Activity.
A modifier expressing the deviation of the willingness from the norm or from the value for another Cognizer.
This FE denotes the number of times the Cognizer is willing per some unit of time.
A Competitor claims a Prize as a result of the outcome of their participation in a Competition.
The individual or individuals involved in the Competition.
A quantity whereby progress is measured during the game, and Rank and Prizes are awarded to the Competitor afterward.
The amount by which the Competitor's and Scores differ.
The rank (according to Score) that a Competitor acheives.
A socially and/or monetarily significant entity which is given to a Competitor according to Score or Rank.
An action of the Competitor that results in the outcome of the Competition.

Any description of the Competitor which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of a Competitor that also affect their action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The location where the Competition takes place.
This FE is for the named venue of a competition, particularly when the place has been built for the purpose of a Competition.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
The event in which the Competitor competes.
The reason why the Competitor wins the Competition.
The length of time from when winning events began to be repeated to when they stopped.
The individual that the Competitor has been competing against.
The state of the world when the Competitor wins the Competition.
The frame expressed by the target typically corresponds to a Means action within the frame expressed by the Re_encoding, but not necessarily.
The state-of-affairs that prevails as a result of the Competitor winning the Competition.
The frame element Iteration is used for expressions that indicate the number of times the Competitor wins the Competition.
This FE modifies the target to indicate the legal- or other domain within which the winning event is considered true.
This FE applies to appraisals of the event, typically a judgment of its expectedness, or a description of the state-of-affairs introduced by the winning event.

An individual that is scheduled to be a Participant, or already is a Participant in an Activity or an Organization, indicates that they will no not or no longer participate in that Activity or Organization. Note that the Organization often is one that is constituted by a treaty or agreement. The Moslem contingent had withdrawn from the EC talks on May 27. The right-wing nationalist Tsomet Party formally withdrew from the ruling coalition.
The individual or individuals that are engaged or are scheduled to be engaged in an Activity.
The event that the Participant is engaged in or was scheduled to be engaged in.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the withdrawing event logically follows.
This FE identifies the Place where the Participant ends the participation in the Activity.
This FE identifies the Time when the Participant ends their participation in the Activity.
The Organization is an intentionally formed human social group with some definite structure to which the Participant belongs.
The state-of-affairs that the Participant hopes to bring about by withdrawing
The act done by the Participant that accomplishes their withdrawal.
The document that the Participant uses to communicate their withdrawal.
A description of the attitude of the Participant which also affects the character of the withdrawal.

As is usual for locative relations, the location of the Figure is specified as being inside a region defined relative to the Ground. In this case, the region measures outward from the Ground with a width specified by the Distance. The number of large galaxies within 5 million light years is three. DNI What 's within 100 miles of you ? Two of Russia's long-range bombers flew around Iceland last Friday -- coming within striking distance of the United States for the first time in five or six years .
The Ground serves as a basis for describing the location of the Figure, as inside a region measured outward from the Ground and of a width specified by Distance.
The Figure is perceived as located relative to a certain Ground location.
This FE identifies the Distance between the Ground and the borders of the region within which the Figure is located.

One linguistic unit, Sign_1, has a relation to another linguistic unit, Sign_2. This relation may be semantic, phonological, orthographic, or distributional in nature. The parameter along which the two signs are set in relation to each other is incorporated in the meaning of the target words in this frame. When the relation is symmetrical, the two linguistic units can be expressed jointly, Signs. Otherwise they have to be expressed disjointly. Ordinarily it is assumed that one linguistic unit has exactly one meaning but in cases where this is not so, a set of Circumstances may be specified that helps pick out the relevant sense. Happy and sad are antonyms. In one sense, dog is a hyponym of itself.
FN: a linguistic unit that carries semantic, phonological or syntactic information.
The Circumstances are conditions under which the relationship holds between Sign_1 and Sign_2.

An Agent expends effort towards achieving a Goal. Alternatively, a Salient_entity involved in the Goal can be expressed in place of a Goal expression. In addition, our organization will work on improving accountability in every department. If somebody is working on the pipes of your house and you turn on the faucet hard, you get sand, junk. You could see several students plugging away at the problem. We have benefited greatly from their work on this problem.
The Agent puts effort into reaching Goal.
The Goal is what the Agent expends effort to achieve.
The Outcome is the failure or success of an attempt to achieve a Goal.
This FE identifies the Means by which the effort is done.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an attempt occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the effort occurs.
The Depictive is a phrase which describes the Agent.
The place where the work is done.
The Manner in which the Agent puts in effort in acheiving the Goal.
The time peiod over which the work takes place.
The reason for which the Agent puts effort into achieving the Goal.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is independent of the the attempt of the Agent to achieve the Goal.
The domain or area within which the work towards the Goal belongs.
An entity that is centrally involved in the Goal that the Agent is attempting to acheive.
This FE applies to appraisals of the event, typically a judgment of its expectedness.
Descriptor covers any characterization or description of the target that is not covered by another more specific FE.
